guides.title: 把晶片剖面變成可檢查的製程依存圖
guides.titleEn: Turn a chip cross-section into a checkable process dependency graph
guides.concept: 製程不只是工序清單。每一步必須取得特定的表面、材料或圖案狀態，並留下下一步能使用的結果。同一種沉積或清洗可在不同層重複出現，目的卻不同。先理解輸入與輸出，才能診斷為何一個缺陷跨數道工序後才被發現。
guides.conceptEn: A process flow is more than a list. Each operation requires a particular surface, material or pattern state and must leave a usable state for the next operation. A repeated deposition or clean can serve different purposes at different layers. Tracking states helps explain why a defect may become visible several operations after it originated.
procedure: 選擇公開資料中的簡化 MOS 電晶體剖面，在自己的圖上用不同顏色標出基板、介電層、閘極、接觸與互連；註明圖不是比例尺，也不套用先進節點尺寸。
對每一層填寫「已有材料、要新增或移除的材料、保護區域、可用的量測」。例如介電層中的接觸開口需要圖案轉移，但開口存在不代表接觸電阻已合格。
把沉積、塗阻、曝光、適用的曝光後烘烤、顯影、蝕刻、去阻與量測接成有向圖。只加入具有物理依存的箭頭；依選定光阻文件決定是否需要曝光後烘烤。
假設接觸開口底部有殘留，沿圖往前追查光阻殘膜、蝕刻不足與清洗不充分三種可能；為每一個假說指定能區分它的觀察，而不是只增加蝕刻時間。
在工作單保留「停止」與「待查證」節點。若材料相容性、量測方式或前後順序不明，記下要查的原始技術文件，避免把未知寫成既定配方。
procedureEn: Choose a simplified MOS cross-section from a public reference. Redraw substrate, dielectric, gate, contact and interconnect in different colors; label the drawing as not to scale and do not assign advanced-node dimensions.

For each layer, record existing material, material to add or remove, protected regions and an available measurement. A contact opening in a dielectric requires pattern transfer, but an opening alone does not establish acceptable contact resistance.

Connect deposition, coating, exposure, applicable post-exposure bake, development, etch, strip and inspection in a directed graph. Add only physical dependencies; determine whether a post-exposure bake applies from the selected resist documentation.

Assume residue remains at a contact bottom. Trace three hypotheses: resist scum, incomplete etch and inadequate cleaning. Specify an observation that distinguishes each hypothesis instead of simply extending etch time.

Keep stop and unresolved nodes in the worksheet. When compatibility, measurement or ordering is unknown, name the original technical document needed rather than treating an assumption as an established recipe.
evidence: 交付帶材料狀態的依存圖、三個可被觀察推翻的缺陷假說，以及來源表。合格判準是每條箭頭能解釋「為何必須先做」，不是圖上節點越多越好。
如果使用來源中的顯微圖，記錄材料、尺度、取樣位置與來源；不要把影片動畫當作量測證據。
evidenceEn: Deliver a material-state dependency graph, three falsifiable defect hypotheses and a reference table. Each arrow must explain why one action precedes another; a larger node count is not the success criterion.
For referenced micrographs, record material, scale, sampling location and provenance. Animation frames are not measurement evidence.
pitfalls: 把所有 CMOS 架構拼成同一片晶圓必經的流程。
看見圖案就假定材料、電性和污染全都合格。
pitfallsEn: Combining all CMOS architectures into one mandatory wafer route.
Assuming a visible pattern establishes material, electrical and contamination quality.

guides.title: 光阻不是顏料：建立曝光與顯影的判讀表
guides.titleEn: Photoresist is not paint: interpret exposure and development
guides.concept: 曝光改變光阻的化學狀態，顯影將這種差異轉成形狀。殘留、線寬偏差或倒塌可能來自塗膜、烘烤、曝光和顯影的交互影響。這份練習建立診斷方法，不提供化學品配製或機台設定。
guides.conceptEn: Exposure changes the chemical state of resist; development converts that difference into geometry. Residue, dimensional bias or collapse can involve coating, baking, exposure and development together. This exercise develops diagnosis rather than chemical formulations or equipment settings.
procedure: 先從所選光阻的官方說明辨認正型、負型或影像反轉模式。畫出曝光區與保留區；如果使用不同光阻，重新建立圖，不沿用原本的顯影方向。
建立一張欄為曝光條件、列為顯影條件的空白比較表，填入自行取得且具有相同膜厚與基材的資料。沒有資料時，只畫假說趨勢並明確標為預測。
對每格記錄開口是否清底、保留區剩餘膜厚、特徵寬度及缺陷類型。使用同一測量定義和位置，避免拿不同倍率或不同圖形密度的影像直接排名。
若開口殘留但保留區完整，提出曝光不足與顯影不足兩個假說；若兩區都過度損失，檢查選擇性、膜厚與烘烤狀態。用額外觀察排除假說，不一次改動所有因素。
圈出同時符合自己先訂判準的區域，標示其邊緣最容易失效的指標。用重複資料檢查穩健性；只有單張漂亮影像時，不宣稱已找到製程窗口。
procedureEn: Identify positive, negative or image-reversal operation from the selected resist documentation. Draw exposed and retained regions; rebuild this map when changing resist rather than reusing the previous development polarity.

Create an empty matrix of exposure versus development conditions. Populate it with data you obtain for consistent film thickness and substrate. Without data, draw only clearly labeled hypothetical trends.

Record opening clearance, retained-film thickness, feature width and defect type for each cell. Use consistent measurement definitions and locations; do not directly rank images taken at different magnifications or pattern densities.

For residue in openings with intact retained resist, propose underexposure and underdevelopment as separate hypotheses. If both regions erode excessively, examine selectivity, thickness and bake state. Discriminate hypotheses with additional observations rather than changing every factor.

Identify regions meeting criteria you defined in advance and note the metric most likely to fail at each boundary. Assess robustness using repeat data; one attractive image does not establish a process window.
evidence: 提交附資料來源的比較表，或明確標為假說的空白計畫；列出至少一個能區分兩個成因的觀察。
說明正負型光阻保留區的差異，以及為何清底與保留膜厚必須同時檢查。
evidenceEn: Submit a comparison matrix with data provenance, or an explicitly hypothetical study plan; include an observation that separates two potential causes.
Explain retained-region polarity and why opening clearance and remaining film thickness must be checked together.
pitfalls: 把正型光阻的曝光效果直接套到所有負型材料。
只求開口清空而忽略遮罩膜厚被消耗。
把廠商示例參數當成未知材料可直接使用的設定。
pitfallsEn: Applying positive-resist exposure behavior to every negative material.
Clearing openings while ignoring loss of masking thickness.
Treating a supplier example as a usable setting for an unspecified material.

guides.title: 半導體製程工藝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Semiconductor Fabrication: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「建立 CMOS 剖面層序」建立判讀邊界。閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。 對應操作：將基板、隔離、井區、閘極與接觸層拖入剖面，標出導電及絕緣區域。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Build the CMOS cross-section stack to define the interpretation boundary. A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes. Corresponding operation: Place substrate, isolation, wells, gate and contact layers in a cross-section; mark conducting and insulating regions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立 CMOS 剖面層序：保存本步操作前後的對照證據。判讀重點：閘極與通道之間保留介電層，接觸孔只連接指定節點。
觀察站 2｜延伸接面剖面建模：觀察與驗證重點：接面深度與橫向侵入均有標示。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
觀察站 3｜良品晶圓製造交接：觀察與驗證重點：接收端可重建良品判定及剩餘限制。這是要檢查的證據條件，並非宣稱已取得真實工廠量測結果。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build the CMOS cross-section stack: Keep before-and-after evidence for this operation. Interpret it against this criterion: A dielectric separates gate and channel; contacts connect only their assigned nodes.

Observation station 2 | Model extension-junction profiles: Observation and validation target: both junction depth and lateral encroachment are identified. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.

Observation station 3 | Handoff qualified wafers: Observation and validation target: the receiver can reconstruct good-die decisions and remaining limits. This is an evidence criterion, not a claim of measured factory results.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「延伸接面剖面建模」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「良品晶圓製造交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model extension-junction profiles: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Handoff qualified wafers to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若未符合判據，優先檢查：介電層遺漏或接觸節點放錯。這是待驗證的原因；回到相同測點或剖面比對，不能僅據異常外觀定因。
診斷提醒：只看峰值會漏掉深部尾端。先用本工序的物理證據確認，再考慮修改上游假設。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the criterion is not met, investigate: Missing dielectric or misassigned contact nodes. This is a hypothesis; compare matching sites or cross-sections before assigning a cause.
Diagnostic consideration: peak concentration alone hides deep tails. Confirm this with physical evidence before revising upstream assumptions.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 奈米片釋放：用剖面追蹤選擇性與可達性
guides.titleEn: Nanosheet release: track selectivity and access in cross-section
guides.concept: 堆疊 GAA 的重要挑戰是保留通道，同時移除其間的犧牲材料，並在狹窄空間建立連續的閘極堆疊。結構概念能公開學習，但影片不揭露特定晶圓廠的材料配比、蝕刻配方或驗收門檻。
guides.conceptEn: A central stacked-GAA challenge is preserving channels while removing intervening sacrificial material and forming a continuous gate stack in narrow spaces. The structural concept is public; a video does not disclose foundry-specific compositions, etch recipes or acceptance limits.
procedure: 用不同顏色畫出通道與犧牲層的交替堆疊，標示蝕刻物種可能進入及副產物離開的方向。只畫結構關係，不填入未公開的厚度或濃度。
在副本中移除犧牲層，檢查內側、外側及底部是否都能被接觸。比較「入口先變寬、深處仍殘留」與「通道也被侵蝕」兩種失效圖。
補上內側間隔層和源汲極的位置，追查它們如何界定後續閘極與源汲極的相鄰區域。將可能的寄生電容路徑用另一種顏色標示。
在釋放後空間畫出介電層與閘極金屬，檢查狹縫提早封口是否可能留下空隙。把蝕刻成功與後續填充成功列為兩個獨立的驗證項目。
若參考公開 TEM 圖，記錄它能證明的局部形貌與不能直接證明的漏電、變異或全晶圓良率。提出一項形貌與一項電性觀察的配對驗證計畫。
procedureEn: Draw alternating channel and sacrificial layers in different colors. Mark access for reactants and removal of by-products. Show structural relationships without inventing unpublished thicknesses or compositions.

Remove sacrificial layers in a copy and check access to inner, outer and bottom regions. Contrast two failure sketches: a widened entrance with residual material deeper inside, and unwanted channel erosion.
Add inner spacers and source/drain regions to trace how they define adjacency between the future gate and source/drain. Mark potential parasitic-capacitance paths in another color.

Draw dielectric and gate metal inside the released space. Check whether premature closure could leave a void. Treat successful release and successful subsequent fill as independent verification questions.

For a public TEM image, record the local morphology it supports and the leakage, variation or wafer-wide yield it cannot directly establish. Propose a paired morphological and electrical verification plan.
evidence: 交付釋放前、釋放後與閘極填充後三張原創剖面，及「殘留／通道損失／填充空隙」三類缺陷的可觀察差異。
成功的教學結果是能指出不同資料的證據邊界；不以圖中奈米片數量推算某節點的真實效能。
evidenceEn: Deliver original cross-sections before release, after release and after gate fill, with observable differences among residue, channel loss and fill voids.
Success means identifying evidence limits; do not infer real node performance from the number of sheets drawn.
pitfalls: 把選擇性當成永遠不會損傷通道的保證。
用一個理想剖面替代多位置的統計量測。
將節點名稱直接當作通道厚度。
pitfallsEn: Treating selectivity as a guarantee of zero channel damage.
Replacing multi-location statistics with one ideal cross-section.
Using a node label as channel thickness.

guides.title: 背面供電：把收益與整合代價放在同一張圖
guides.titleEn: Backside power: map benefits and integration costs together
guides.concept: 背面供電重新分配供電與訊號互連的空間。它可能改善供電路徑和布線條件，但不能只靠一條較短的線證明整顆晶片更快或更省電；接點、熱路徑、製造與失效分析也必須納入。
guides.conceptEn: Backside power redistributes the space used for power and signals. It can improve delivery paths and routing conditions, but a shorter line alone cannot establish a faster or more efficient chip. Contacts, thermal paths, fabrication and failure analysis also matter.
procedure: 使用相同的簡化負載方塊，畫一版前面供電與一版背面供電。分別標出外部電源、封裝、晶片金屬、垂直接點與電晶體，避免把晶片改善與封裝改善混在一起。
把每段路徑視為電阻並標上來源或未知。用 Vdrop = I × R 與 Ploss = I² × R 做趨勢比較；只使用自訂教學假設或可追溯資料，並在表中保留單位。
在同一張圖增加訊號佈線與散熱方向，說明釋出的佈線空間不會自動消除所有 RC 延遲。提出可能因接點、局部熱點或路徑不均勻而出現的限制。
建立製造檢查清單：背面接觸的對準、晶圓支撐與厚度控制、連接完整性，以及失效定位可達性。每項只寫需要何種證據，不捏造機台操作設定。
比較時固定電壓、工作負載和量測邊界，並把影片中的歷史路線圖和已公布量測分欄。無法固定條件的效能百分比，標為不能直接比較。
procedureEn: Use the same simplified load blocks for frontside- and backside-powered drawings. Label external supply, package, chip metals, vertical contacts and transistors so chip-level improvements are not conflated with package changes.

Represent each path segment by a resistance with a source or unknown label. Compare trends using Vdrop = I × R and Ploss = I² × R. Use declared educational assumptions or traceable data, keeping units visible.
Add signal routing and heat-flow directions. Explain why freed routing space does not automatically remove all RC delay. Identify limitations from contacts, local hotspots or uneven delivery paths.

Create a manufacturing evidence checklist covering backside-contact alignment, wafer support and thickness control, connection integrity and fault-localization access. Specify the evidence needed without inventing tool settings.

Hold voltage, workload and measurement boundary fixed when comparing cases. Separate historical roadmaps from published measurements. Mark performance percentages as non-comparable when conditions cannot be matched.
evidence: 提交兩張剖面、一張含假設與單位的等效電阻表，以及一項電性、一項熱、一項製造驗證需求。
若使用簡化電阻模型，結論只能涉及所建模的壓降與損耗，不可宣稱已模擬電晶體速度、電感暫態或完整熱可靠性。
evidenceEn: Submit two cross-sections, an equivalent-resistance table with assumptions and units, and electrical, thermal and manufacturing verification needs.
A resistance model supports only its modeled drop and loss; it does not simulate transistor speed, inductive transients or full thermal reliability.
pitfalls: 只算電源線而漏掉封裝及接點電阻。
把 2021 年的預定時程寫成今天的量產事實。
將 GAA 和背面供電當成同一項技術。
pitfallsEn: Counting power lines while omitting package and contact resistance.
Presenting a 2021 schedule as current production fact.
Treating GAA and backside power as the same technology.

guides.title: 線條印得小，並不等於每層對得準
guides.titleEn: Small printed features and accurate layer overlay are different
guides.concept: 解析度描述可分辨的圖案尺度；套刻描述不同層的位置關係。微影系統需要光學、載台、晶圓形貌量測與回饋共同工作。把兩個指標分開，才能知道改善 NA、焦距控制或位置校正各自處理什麼問題。
guides.conceptEn: Resolution describes separable pattern scale; overlay describes relative placement of layers. Lithography depends on optics, stages, wafer-shape measurement and feedback together. Keeping the metrics separate clarifies which problems numerical aperture, focus control and position correction address.
procedure: 先用本網站示意或自製線條圖，建立「線寬變粗／線條模糊」和「整層平移」兩組例子。保持標示尺度一致，並說明兩者可能同時出現。
用 CD ≈ k1 × λ / NA 比較只改波長或只改 NA 的相對趨勢。固定另一變數並註明 k1 是模型參數；此公式不提供某晶圓廠的節點名稱、良率或完整曝光窗口。
在兩層標記圖上量出多個位置的 x、y 位移。先擬合平移，再考慮旋轉或尺度差異；記錄校正前後殘差，避免只把中心位置對齊就宣稱全片合格。
將焦點與劑量另外列成兩個變數。若邊緣變模糊卻沒有整層位移，提出焦點、光阻或圖形對比等假說；如果線條清晰但偏離底層，優先檢查套刻資料。
規劃量測取樣：至少說明為何要涵蓋不同曝光場及場內位置。將量測不確定度和校正後殘差分開記錄，並保留尚未驗證的高階誤差。
procedureEn: Using the site schematic or your own line drawing, construct examples of broadened or blurred lines and examples of a translated layer. Keep scale labels consistent and explain that both errors can coexist.

Compare relative trends with CD ≈ k1 × λ / NA while varying wavelength or NA separately. State that k1 is a model parameter; this relation does not supply a foundry node label, yield or complete exposure window.

Measure x and y offsets at several positions on a two-layer marker drawing. Fit translation first, then consider rotation or scale. Record residuals before and after correction instead of declaring success from the center alone.

Treat focus and dose as separate variables. For blurred edges without layer translation, consider focus, resist or image-contrast hypotheses. For sharp but displaced features, first inspect overlay evidence.
Plan sampling across exposure fields and within fields. Record measurement uncertainty separately from post-correction residuals and retain higher-order errors that have not been tested.
evidence: 交付兩組錯誤示意、一張標有假設的解析度比較表，及校正前後位移殘差圖；資料可以自行建立，但必須標為教學示意。
檢核是否能解釋：提升 NA 不能直接校正所有層間位移；量測解析度與晶片功能良率也是不同證據。
evidenceEn: Deliver two error illustrations, a resolution comparison with assumptions and a before/after offset-residual plot. Self-created values must be labeled educational illustrations.
Check that you can explain why increasing NA does not directly correct all layer offsets, and why metrology resolution differs from functional chip yield.
pitfalls: 把 NA 的數值直接當成可製造節點的名稱。
只看單點偏移，忽略場內與場間變化。
用線條清晰代替套刻合格的判斷。
pitfallsEn: Treating an NA value as a manufacturable node label.
Ignoring within-field and across-field variation after inspecting one point.
Using sharp lines as evidence of acceptable overlay.

guides.scope: 原創教學工作單；使用本網站示意圖，並自行準備或從所列來源取得圖表、量測或模擬資料。沒有提供晶圓廠製程配方，也沒有內建本題的實測資料。
guides.scopeEn: Original educational worksheet. Use the site schematics and figures, measurements or simulation data you supply or obtain from the references. This is not a foundry recipe, and no measured dataset for this exercise is bundled.

guides.title: EUV 光路：從光源到晶圓的能量帳本
guides.titleEn: EUV optical path: an energy ledger from source to wafer
guides.concept: EUV 系統採用反射光學與真空環境，原因涉及材料對 EUV 的吸收。每一個子系統都有傳輸損失、穩定度和污染控制問題。系統工程必須連接這些界面，不能把光源規格直接當成晶圓可用曝光能量。
guides.conceptEn: EUV systems use reflective optics and vacuum because material absorption matters strongly at EUV wavelengths. Each subsystem introduces transmission losses, stability requirements and contamination concerns. Systems engineering connects these interfaces rather than equating source specifications with usable wafer exposure energy.
procedure: 依官方光路導覽，用自己的方塊圖標出光源、收集器、照明光學、光罩、投影光學和晶圓。用實線標光能路徑、虛線標量測與回饋，不重製受保護的機台施工圖。
給每個光學界面一個符號傳輸係數 ηi，寫出 Pwafer = Psource × ∏ηi。只有取得對應定義和量測邊界的資料時才填數值；沒有資料時比較相對變化即可。
假設某界面傳輸下降，追蹤在其他條件固定時需要補償的光源輸出或曝光時間。說明此靜態帳本沒有包含掃描同步、熱漂移、脈衝變異或維護停機。
在每個方塊附一項可能觀察：功率穩定性、波前／成像變化、污染跡象或位置殘差。若曝光劑量下降，提出至少兩個可能位置及一項能分辨它們的量測。
把「提高功率」和「維持影像品質」分成兩條驗證鏈。新增功率可能改變熱負載，必須重新考慮形變與控制，而非假設所有光學係數固定不變。
procedureEn: Redraw the official optical tour as source, collector, illumination optics, mask, projection optics and wafer. Use solid lines for optical energy and dashed lines for measurement and feedback; do not reproduce proprietary assembly drawings.

Assign each optical interface a symbolic transmission factor ηi and write Pwafer = Psource × ∏ηi. Populate values only when definitions and measurement boundaries match; otherwise compare relative changes.

Assume transmission falls at one interface and trace the compensating source output or exposure time with other factors held fixed. State that this static ledger omits scan synchronization, thermal drift, pulse variation and maintenance downtime.

Attach an observation to each block: power stability, wavefront or image change, contamination indication or positioning residual. For reduced exposure dose, identify at least two possible locations and a discriminating measurement.

Separate the verification chains for more power and maintained image quality. Added power may change thermal loading, so reconsider deformation and control rather than assuming every optical coefficient stays constant.
evidence: 提交光路圖、含單位與邊界的能量帳本，以及兩個故障假說的辨識計畫。可以用任意清楚標示的教學係數演算，但不可稱為 ASML 機台規格。
說明 EUV 使用鏡面與真空的物理原因，並指出此帳本不能預測晶圓每小時產量或成品良率。
evidenceEn: Submit an optical diagram, an energy ledger with units and boundaries, and a plan distinguishing two fault hypotheses. Arbitrary educational coefficients are acceptable if labeled and never presented as ASML specifications.
Explain the physical rationale for mirrors and vacuum and identify why this ledger cannot predict wafers per hour or final yield.
pitfalls: 把所有鏡面的反射率都假定為 100%。
將來源中的光源功率和晶圓面功率混用。
用光路圖宣稱已掌握真實機台裝配與校準技術。
pitfallsEn: Assuming every mirror reflects 100% of the incident power.
Mixing source power with wafer-plane power.
Claiming an optical diagram provides real machine assembly and calibration expertise.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ASML 微影機系統工程
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ASML Lithography Systems Engineering
guides.concept: 延伸既有的解析度、光源鏈、多層膜與定位迴路課程，深入 0.55 NA 變形光學為何只能曝半場、8× 掃描倍率下 32 g 光罩台的動力學、EUV 護膜與集光鏡的壽命物理、水平與對準感測器的量測誤差、晶圓加熱與夾持、逐曝光套刻建模，以及每小時晶圓數與可用度的系統驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Extending the existing lessons on resolution, the source chain, multilayers and positioning loops, this part goes into why 0.55 NA anamorphic optics expose only a half field, the dynamics of a 32 g reticle stage under 8× scan magnification, the lifetime physics of EUV pellicles and collectors, measurement errors of level and alignment sensors, wafer heating and clamping, per-exposure overlay modelling, and system acceptance of wafers per hour and availability.
procedure: 把 NA 從 0.33 提高到 0.55，光罩端的光錐也跟著變寬。EUV 光罩是反射式，入射錐與反射錐不能重疊，而且必須落在光罩多層膜的角度接受範圍內；以光罩上約 6° 的主光線角計算，若仍用等向 4× 縮小，光錐半角會超過 6°，入射與反射光互相干涉。ASML 的 EXE 平台因此採用變形光學：垂直掃描方向（x，沿狹縫）縮小 4×，掃描方向（y）縮小 8×，掃描方向的光罩端光錐減半。代價是標準 6 吋光罩的 104 × 132 mm 圖案區在晶圓上只剩 26 × 16.5 mm，即半場，每片晶圓曝光次數加倍，大晶粒需要拼接，光罩資料也必須在 y 方向拉長 2 倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「0.55 NA 變形投影光學」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

掃描曝光時光罩與晶圓反向運動，速度比等於掃描方向的縮小倍率：NXE 為 4，EXE 為 8。同樣的晶圓掃描速度下，EXE 的光罩台要跑 NXE 的兩倍快，而且曝光場數加倍，加減速時間必須更短；ASML 公開的數字是 EXE 光罩台 32 g（NXE 的四倍）、晶圓台 8 g。8× 倍率也有好處：光罩在掃描方向的位置誤差到晶圓上縮小 8 倍，垂直方向縮小 4 倍。代價是慣性力：真空中的光罩靠靜電夾盤的摩擦力固定，加速度越大越容易微滑，而光罩滑移會直接變成影像位移。同步誤差的移動平均（MA）與移動標準差（MSD）以晶圓座標、在狹縫曝光窗內計算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光罩台與晶圓台同步」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

護膜是一張只有數十奈米厚的自撐薄膜，裝在光罩前方數毫米處；落在護膜上的顆粒嚴重離焦而不成像，但若直接落在光罩上，會在每個場的每顆晶粒重複印出。EUV 下薄膜本身會吸收，而且光線來回穿過兩次，所以單程穿透率 T 對產能的影響是 T²；吸收的功率在真空中只能靠輻射散熱，光源功率越高薄膜溫度可達數百 °C。ASML 公開的第一代護膜約 50 nm 厚、單程損失約 10%，後續的矽化物、碳奈米管等材料在穿透率、強度與熱穩定性之間取捨。數微米以上的顆粒仍不能留在護膜上，抽真空與破真空時的壓差也是薄膜破裂的風險。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「EUV 護膜與光罩正面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

集光鏡是一面大型橢球 Mo/Si 多層膜反射鏡，距錫電漿僅數百毫米，把電漿成像到中間焦點。每一發脈衝都噴出錫離子、中性原子與微小碎屑；約百帕的氫氣緩衝層讓離子減速，EUV 光子與電漿則產生氫自由基，把沉積的錫蝕刻成可揮發的 SnH₄，由氣流帶到真空泵。集光鏡反射率由沉積與蝕刻的平衡決定：SnH₄ 若在熱表面分解會把錫再沉積回去，氫滲入多層膜則可能起泡。壽命以每十億發（gigapulse）的相對反射率損失追蹤，光源以提高驅動雷射功率或掃描機延長曝光來維持劑量，最後排定更換。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「集光鏡與氫氣緩衝」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雙載台掃描機在量測側先量晶圓：水平感測器以掠射角把光柵圖樣投到晶圓上，反射像的橫移正比於高度，逐場繪出地形與晶圓不平度，曝光時載台沿此焦面追蹤。因為光從多層透明膜反射，量到的「表觀高度」與膜層結構有關，這種製程相依偏差要用氣壓式量規或選擇波長、偏振來校正。對準感測器量繞射光柵標記的位置：±1 階干涉的相位就是位置；化學機械研磨或蝕刻使標記不對稱時，誤差隨波長改變，因此用多波長量測並比較色間差異來偵測不對稱。0.55 NA 的景深只剩約 45 nm，焦距預算縮到數奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「水平感測器與對準感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

EUV 晶圓在真空中由靜電夾盤固定，夾盤表面是數千個微小凸點，以減少接觸面積、降低顆粒造成的局部變形，熱量經由凸點與背面氣體傳到台面。每次曝光把劑量能量與吸收的帶外紅外線留在該場，局部升溫使晶圓想要膨脹；凸點的摩擦力先抵抗，當剪力超過摩擦力時晶圓局部滑移，形成與曝光順序有關的場間變形。晶圓上機前的溫度必須與台面差在毫開爾文等級，台面以水循環控溫，並以前饋的晶圓加熱模型預測每場膨脹、調整倍率與平移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「晶圓夾盤、凸點與溫控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

套刻誤差可拆成：晶圓層級（場間）的平移、旋轉、倍率與非正交（六參數線性模型）及高階多項式；場內的倍率、旋轉與非對稱項（十參數模型）以及鏡頭與光罩特徵；還有無法修正的隨機殘差。以繞射式套刻標記量測後，先進製程控制把修正量回饋給掃描機致動器：載台負責平移與旋轉，鏡頭與光罩台負責倍率；逐曝光修正（CPE）讓每一場都有自己的一組小修正。參數越多能吃掉越多系統特徵，但也會把量測雜訊擬合進去，參數數與取樣點數共同決定雜訊放大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「套刻量測與逐場修正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

產能是在指定劑量與佈局下每小時能曝多少片晶圓。單片時間由三部分組成：曝光時間（晶圓端功率除以劑量決定）、每場的額外時間（加速、減速、穩定與步進）、以及雙載台無法隱藏的晶圓交換時間。產出量等於每小時晶圓數乘可用度與使用率；可用度受計畫保養（集光鏡、錫滴產生器更換）與非計畫停機（平均故障間隔與修復時間）限制。驗收時以指定劑量與佈局連續運轉，記錄每小時晶圓數、劑量穩定度、套刻、焦距與可用度，交接時附上光源功率趨勢、集光鏡反射率與護膜狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「產能、可用度與交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Raising NA from 0.33 to 0.55 widens the cone of light at the reticle as well. The EUV reticle is reflective, so the incident and reflected cones must not overlap and must stay within the angular acceptance of the mask multilayer; with a chief-ray angle of about 6° on the mask, keeping an isotropic 4× reduction would push the cone half-angle beyond 6° and the incident and reflected light would collide. ASML's EXE platform therefore uses anamorphic optics: 4× reduction across the scan (x, along the slit) and 8× in the scan direction (y), halving the mask-side cone in y. The price is that the 104 × 132 mm pattern area of a standard 6-inch mask covers only 26 × 16.5 mm on the wafer, a half field, so each wafer needs twice as many exposures, large dies must be stitched, and mask data are stretched 2× in y. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “0.55 NA anamorphic projection optics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

During a scan the reticle and wafer move in opposite directions with a speed ratio equal to the scan-direction reduction: 4 for NXE and 8 for EXE. For the same wafer scan speed the EXE reticle stage must run twice as fast as NXE's, and with twice as many fields the ramps must be shorter; ASML publishes 32 g for the EXE reticle stage, four times NXE, and 8 g for the wafer stage. The 8× ratio also helps: reticle position errors in the scan direction shrink 8× at the wafer and cross-scan errors 4×. The price is inertial force: in vacuum the reticle is held by friction on an electrostatic clamp, higher acceleration invites micro-slip, and any reticle slip becomes image displacement. Moving-average (MA) and moving-standard-deviation (MSD) synchronisation errors are computed in wafer coordinates over the slit exposure window. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reticle-stage and wafer-stage synchronisation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A pellicle is a free-standing membrane only tens of nanometres thick mounted a few millimetres in front of the reticle; particles landing on it are far out of focus and do not print, whereas a particle on the mask itself repeats in every die of every field. In EUV the membrane absorbs and the light crosses it twice, so a single-pass transmission T costs throughput as T²; the absorbed power can leave only by radiation in vacuum, and at higher source powers the film reaches several hundred °C. ASML's published first-generation pellicle was about 50 nm thick with roughly 10% single-pass loss, and later silicide and carbon-nanotube materials trade transmission, strength and thermal stability. Particles larger than a few micrometres must still be kept off the film, and pressure differences during pump-down and venting are a rupture risk. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “EUV pellicle and reticle front side”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The collector is a large ellipsoidal Mo/Si multilayer mirror only a few hundred millimetres from the tin plasma, imaging the plasma onto the intermediate focus. Every pulse throws out tin ions, neutral atoms and fine debris; a hydrogen buffer of order a hundred pascals slows the ions, while EUV photons and the plasma create hydrogen radicals that etch deposited tin into volatile SnH₄, which the gas flow carries to the pumps. Collector reflectance is set by the balance of deposition and etching: SnH₄ that decomposes on hot surfaces puts tin back, and hydrogen penetrating the multilayer can raise blisters. Lifetime is tracked as relative reflectance loss per gigapulse, the source holds dose by raising drive-laser power or the scanner by lengthening exposure, and a replacement is eventually scheduled. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collector mirror and hydrogen buffer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On the measure side of a dual-stage scanner the wafer is mapped first: the level sensor projects a grating pattern onto the wafer at grazing incidence, and the lateral shift of the reflected image is proportional to height, so each field's topography and wafer unflatness are mapped for the stage to follow during exposure. Because the light reflects from a stack of transparent films, the apparent height depends on the stack, and this process dependency is calibrated with an air gauge or by choice of wavelength and polarisation. The alignment sensor locates diffraction-grating marks, where the phase of the ±1-order interference is the position; marks made asymmetric by CMP or etch give wavelength-dependent errors, so multi-wavelength readings and colour-to-colour differences expose asymmetry. At 0.55 NA the depth of focus is only about 45 nm and the focus budget shrinks to a few nanometres. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Level sensor and alignment sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An EUV wafer is held in vacuum by an electrostatic clamp whose surface consists of thousands of small burls, reducing contact area and particle-induced deformation, and heat leaves through the burls and backside gas into the table. Each exposure leaves its dose energy plus absorbed out-of-band infrared in that field, and the local temperature rise makes the wafer want to expand; burl friction resists at first, but once shear exceeds friction the wafer slips locally, producing field-to-field distortion that depends on exposure order. The wafer must arrive within millikelvins of the table temperature, the table is water-conditioned, and a feedforward wafer-heating model predicts expansion per field to adjust magnification and translation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wafer clamp, burls and thermal conditioning”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Overlay error splits into wafer-level (inter-field) translation, rotation, magnification and non-orthogonality, the six-parameter linear model, plus higher-order polynomials; intra-field magnification, rotation and asymmetric terms, the ten-parameter model, plus lens and reticle signatures; and a non-correctable random residual. After measurement on diffraction-based overlay targets, advanced process control feeds corrections to scanner actuators: the stage handles translation and rotation and the lens and reticle stage handle magnification, while corrections per exposure (CPE) give every field its own small set. More parameters absorb more systematic signature but also fit measurement noise, and the parameter count together with sampling density sets noise amplification. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Overlay metrology and per-exposure corrections”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Throughput is how many wafers per hour the tool exposes at a specified dose and layout. Wafer time has three parts: exposure time, set by wafer-level power divided by dose; per-field overhead for acceleration, deceleration, settling and stepping; and wafer exchange that the dual stage cannot hide. Output equals wafers per hour times availability and utilisation, and availability is limited by planned maintenance such as collector and droplet-generator swaps and by unplanned downtime governed by mean time between failures and mean time to repair. Acceptance runs the specified dose and layout continuously, logging wafers per hour, dose stability, overlay, focus and availability, and the handoff carries source-power trends, collector reflectance and pellicle status. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Throughput, availability and handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: A die larger than 26 × 16.5 mm must be split into two half fields, and overlay or CD discontinuity at the seam can open or neck lines that cross it; mishandled y scaling in the mask data distorts the whole pattern; mask 3D shadowing shifts images depending on orientation, showing up as systematic overlay that no single focus setting can correct.

An uncalibrated process dependency on a new stack shifts focus by tens of nanometres at the wafer edge or in particular regions, causing CD variation and defects; aligning to asymmetric marks gives the whole wafer a systematic offset of a few nanometres that looks like random overlay noise.

guides.title: 先畫資料流，再決定中介層或矽橋
guides.titleEn: Map data flow before choosing an interposer or bridge
guides.concept: 先進封裝把不同功能晶粒連成系統。中介層、局部矽橋及垂直堆疊提供不同的連接幾何；選擇必須同時考慮 I/O 位置、連線密度、供電、熱、測試和組裝條件。品牌名稱不是可以互換的配方。
guides.conceptEn: Advanced packaging connects functional dies into a system. Interposers, local silicon bridges and vertical stacking offer different connection geometries. Choices depend on I/O placement, connection density, power, heat, testing and assembly conditions together; brand names are not interchangeable recipes.
procedure: 選一個教學系統，例如邏輯晶粒加高頻寬記憶體，畫出功能與資料方向。為每條連接記錄資料率的定義、方向、通道數和時脈假設；未知值保持未知。
畫兩種平面配置：一種以較廣的中介層連接，另一種只在相鄰晶粒邊緣配置局部橋。用不同顏色標示高速訊號、電源與低速控制線。
檢查每條重要路徑是否能到達正確的 I/O 邊界，是否存在交叉、繞路或間距衝突。不能只把方塊靠近就假定走線容量足夠。
在配置圖加上熱源、可能的冷卻路徑與測試存取點。提出一個為減少走線而移動晶粒、卻使熱或測試變差的例子，練習共同設計的取捨。
建立比較表，將幾何可行性、電性模型、組裝對準、已知良品晶粒與供應鏈限制分欄。對沒有可追溯成本或良率資料的方案，只做條件式結論。
procedureEn: Choose an educational system such as a logic die with high-bandwidth memory and map functions and data directions. For each link, record rate definition, direction, lane count and clock assumptions; preserve unknown values.
Draw two floorplans: a broader interposer and local bridges at adjacent die edges. Color high-speed signals, power and low-speed control separately.
Check whether each important path reaches the correct I/O boundary and encounters crossing, detour or spacing conflicts. Placing blocks close together does not establish adequate routing capacity.
Add heat sources, possible cooling paths and test access. Give an example where moving a die to reduce routing worsens heat removal or testability, exposing a co-design tradeoff.

Compare geometric feasibility, electrical models, assembly alignment, known-good-die evidence and supply constraints in separate columns. Make only conditional conclusions without traceable cost or yield data.
evidence: 提交兩張配置圖、一張介面清單與條件式比較表。每條重要連接都應有起點、終點、方向和待驗證項目。
解釋兩種配置各有何限制，並指出資料尚不足時不宜宣稱哪種一定更便宜或更快。
evidenceEn: Submit two floorplans, an interface register and a conditional comparison. Every important connection should have endpoints, direction and an unresolved verification item.
Explain constraints of both layouts and why missing data prevents unconditional claims of lower cost or higher speed.
pitfalls: 把 EMIB、CoWoS 和 SoIC 視為同一種結構。
只比較平面面積，忽略基板、供電、冷卻及測試。
把示意圖上的連線當成已完成訊號完整性分析。
pitfallsEn: Treating EMIB, CoWoS and SoIC as the same structure.
Comparing footprint alone while ignoring substrate, power, cooling and testing.
Treating lines in a drawing as completed signal-integrity analysis.

guides.title: 3D 堆疊：一起追蹤熱路徑、互連與可測試性
guides.titleEn: 3D stacking: trace heat paths, interconnects and testability together
guides.concept: 垂直堆疊縮短部分連接並增加整合密度，同時改變熱路徑、接合界面與測試方式。單顆晶粒測試通過，不代表接合後沒有缺陷；連接密度提高也不代表熱限制自然消失。
guides.conceptEn: Vertical stacking shortens some connections and increases integration density while changing heat paths, bonding interfaces and test methods. A die passing standalone tests does not prove a defect-free assembled stack, and denser connections do not remove thermal constraints.
procedure: 畫出兩層晶粒、接合界面、封裝基板與散熱面的剖面。將訊號、供電和熱三種路徑分開追蹤，並標示哪個路徑是教學假設。
建立簡化熱阻網路，先用 ΔT ≈ P × Rθ 觀察單一熱源的趨勢。加入第二層熱源時，註明互相加熱和三維擴散需要更完整模型，不把各層獨立溫升直接相加當作精確答案。
在接合界面畫出未對準、局部未接合與電性開路三種可能。分別提出位置觀察、界面觀察及電性連續性測試；說明它們能支持但不能互相取代的結論。
安排接合前、接合後、最終組裝後三個測試關卡，記錄各關卡可接觸哪些節點、能發現哪些故障。把未測到的故障保留在風險表，不把已知良品晶粒當作零風險。
提出一版重新安排熱源或調整測試存取的方案，列出它對佈線與組裝的副作用。以證據完整性比較方案，而不是只選剖面看起來最密集的版本。
procedureEn: Draw two die tiers, the bonding interface, package substrate and cooling surface in cross-section. Trace signal, power and heat separately and identify educational assumptions.

Build a simplified thermal-resistance network and use ΔT ≈ P × Rθ to inspect a single-source trend. With a second heat source, state that mutual heating and three-dimensional spreading need a fuller model; do not sum isolated temperature rises as an exact result.

Illustrate misalignment, local nonbonding and electrical opens at the interface. Propose positional, interface and continuity observations, explaining which conclusions each can support without substituting one for another.

Schedule prebond, postbond and post-assembly test gates. Record accessible nodes and detectable faults at each stage. Retain untested fault classes in a risk table; known-good die does not mean zero assembly risk.
Propose a revised heat-source arrangement or test-access scheme and list side effects on routing and assembly. Compare evidence completeness rather than selecting the visually densest cross-section.
evidence: 交付三路徑剖面、熱模型假設表，以及「故障類型→檢查方法→可判斷與不可判斷事項」對照表。
驗收是能說清楚最弱的證據環節及下一個需要的測試；本工作單不等同產品可靠度認證。
evidenceEn: Deliver a three-path cross-section, thermal-model assumptions and a fault-to-observation table stating what can and cannot be concluded.
Acceptance means identifying the weakest evidence link and the next needed test; this worksheet is not product reliability qualification.
pitfalls: 把薄化晶粒一律視為更冷或更可靠。
用單一影像推論所有互連都導通。
把廠商特定堆疊世代的參數混在同一個模型。
pitfallsEn: Assuming thinner dies are always cooler or more reliable.
Inferring all interconnects conduct from one image.
Mixing parameters from different vendor-specific stacking generations.

sources.title: Intel Leads the Way with Advanced Packaging | Intel

guides.scope: 原創教學工作單；使用本網站示意圖，並自行準備或從所列來源取得圖表、量測或模擬資料。沒有提供晶圓廠製程配方，也沒有內建本題的實測資料。
guides.scopeEn: Original educational worksheet. Use the site schematics and figures, measurements or simulation data you supply or obtain from the references. This is not a foundry recipe, and no measured dataset for this exercise is bundled.

guides.title: 先進封裝共同設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Advanced Packaging Co-Design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 將晶粒、互連、基板與散熱責任分開。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Separate die, interconnect, substrate and cooling responsibilities. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：將晶粒、互連、基板與散熱責任分開。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以功耗、頻寬及接點數建立介面表。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Separate die, interconnect, substrate and cooling responsibilities. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build an interface table with power, bandwidth and connection count. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以功耗、頻寬及接點數建立介面表」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build an interface table with power, bandwidth and connection count, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。

guides.title: 先進封裝共同設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Advanced Packaging Co-Design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識封裝功能邊界」建立判讀邊界。封裝同時承擔電連接、散熱與保護。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify package functions to define the interpretation boundary. Packaging provides connection, heat removal and protection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識封裝功能邊界：每條跨區連線都有訊號或熱的角色；保留可重現判讀所需的原始圖像、量測或流程圖。
觀察站 2｜TSV 深寬比核對：觀察重點：幾何位於已核准設備能力範圍；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
觀察站 3｜產品測試與譜系移交：觀察重點：交付狀態與所有識別資料一致；保留局部異常，勿只抄錄平均結果。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify package functions: Every crossing has an electrical or thermal role; retain the original image, measurement or process map needed to reproduce the assessment.
Observation station 2 | Check TSV aspect ratio: Observable evidence: Geometry falls within the approved tool capability. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
Observation station 3 | Handoff product test and genealogy: Observable evidence: Delivery status agrees with all identifiers. Retain local anomalies instead of reporting only averages.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「TSV 深寬比核對」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「產品測試與譜系移交」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Check TSV aspect ratio: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Handoff product test and genealogy to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 把板級功能算入晶粒會漏掉封裝介面。
入口寬度代替最窄處會低估填孔難度。應先回看此步的原始資料及對照樣本，不能用後段通過結果直接排除此原因。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Assigning board functions to the die hides package interfaces.
Using entrance width hides the narrowest fill restriction. Revisit raw data and controls for this step; a later passing result alone does not exclude this cause.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 先做光功率帳本，再談連線能否工作
guides.titleEn: Build an optical power budget before judging a link
guides.concept: 光學互連包含光源、調變、耦合、傳輸、偵測與電子電路。光功率足夠只是必要條件之一；頻寬、雜訊、抖動與誤碼表現還需要另外證據。先定義功率量測的起點與終點，才能公平比較配置。
guides.conceptEn: An optical interconnect includes generation, modulation, coupling, transmission, detection and electronics. Adequate optical power is only one requirement; bandwidth, noise, jitter and error performance need separate evidence. Define the start and end of power measurements before comparing architectures.
procedure: 畫出發射器到接收器的功能鏈，在每個光／電轉換處分界。標示雷射是外接還是整合案例，並記錄使用哪個來源作為架構依據，不假設所有矽光子都採同一光源。
建立損耗表：耦合器、波導、彎曲、連接器與分光等項目分列。對長度相關損耗，先確認資料單位是 dB/m 還是 dB/cm，再乘上對應長度。
用 Prx(dBm) = Ptx(dBm) − ΣL(dB) 計算簡化接收功率；若加入分光，列出理想分配與額外損耗。缺少可追溯數字時，保留符號或明確標示自訂教學值。
把接收器靈敏度、飽和界限、目標資料率和測試條件列在另一欄。只有條件相符時才計算餘裕；沒有接收器文件時，不能把正的光功率直接稱為連線通過。
改變一項耦合損耗或路徑長度，觀察餘裕趨勢，再列出此帳本缺少的頻寬與誤碼驗證。說明零觀察到錯誤仍需測試位元數和信賴度背景。
procedureEn: Draw the transmitter-to-receiver chain with boundaries at optical/electrical conversions. Identify an external or integrated laser in the chosen reference architecture; do not assume all silicon photonics uses the same source.

Build a loss table for couplers, waveguides, bends, connectors and splitters as applicable. For length-dependent loss, check whether the unit is dB/m or dB/cm before multiplying by the matching length.

Calculate a simplified received power with Prx(dBm) = Ptx(dBm) − ΣL(dB). For splitters, distinguish ideal division from excess loss. Keep symbols or explicitly educational values when traceable numbers are unavailable.

List receiver sensitivity, saturation limit, target data rate and test conditions separately. Calculate margin only for matching conditions; without receiver documentation, nonzero optical power cannot establish a working link.

Vary one coupling loss or path length to inspect margin trends, then list missing bandwidth and error-rate verification. Explain that observing zero errors still requires bit-count and confidence context.
evidence: 提交帶量測邊界的功能圖、單位一致的損耗表與來源／假設標記。用一個例子說明 dBm 是功率基準，而 dB 是比值。
結論分成「光功率預算可行」與「通訊品質仍待驗證」，不能把前者當作誤碼測試結果。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional diagram with measurement boundaries, a unit-consistent loss table and source/assumption labels. Use an example to distinguish absolute dBm power from a dB ratio.
Separate optical-budget feasibility from communication quality still requiring verification; the former is not a bit-error-rate result.
pitfalls: 直接相加 dBm 值來合併不同光源。
漏掉耦合界面或把波導長度單位弄錯。
只看總雙向頻寬而忽略每方向和每通道的定義。
pitfallsEn: Adding dBm values directly to combine optical sources.
Omitting coupling interfaces or mismatching waveguide-length units.
Using aggregate bidirectional bandwidth without defining directions and lanes.

guides.title: 環形共振器：讀懂共振、線寬與溫度漂移
guides.titleEn: Ring resonators: interpret resonance, linewidth and thermal drift
guides.concept: 環形共振器依靠光在環路中累積的相位與耦合來選擇波長。共振位置、線寬、損耗與耦合不是同一個參數；溫度或製程變異也可能讓工作點偏移。這份練習使用圖表與公開模型概念，不宣稱網站內建完整電磁求解器。
guides.conceptEn: A ring resonator selects wavelengths through round-trip phase and coupling. Resonance position, linewidth, loss and coupling are distinct quantities; temperature or fabrication variation can shift the operating point. This exercise uses plots and public model concepts, not a claimed built-in full-wave electromagnetic solver.
procedure: 畫出單匯流排環形結構並標示 through port；若改用 add-drop 結構，另外標出 drop port。先預測共振時在哪一個埠看見凹谷或峰值，再對照所選模型的埠定義。
從自行取得或參考來源的傳輸頻譜讀出相鄰共振位置與半高全寬。記錄座標是波長還是頻率，以及訊號是功率還是場振幅，避免用不同定義直接計算。
在適用定義下估算 FSR 與 loaded Q ≈ λres / Δλ，並標示取樣解析度。若頻譜點太稀，回報線寬無法可靠解析，不把插值曲線當作新增量測。
用共振條件與有效折射率的概念，預測改變環路長度或溫度會移動共振位置。對溫度掃描，固定其他假設，並說明調諧所需功率及跨通道熱影響仍待資料。
比較兩條相同正規化方式的頻譜，區分共振位置偏移、凹谷深度改變與線寬改變。提出損耗或耦合變化等不同假說，說明僅一條頻譜可能無法唯一反推出所有參數。
procedureEn: Draw a single-bus ring and label the through port. For an add-drop structure, label the drop port separately. Predict which port shows a dip or peak at resonance, then check the selected model’s port definitions.

Read adjacent resonance positions and full width at half maximum from spectra you supply or obtain from references. Record wavelength versus frequency axes and power versus field amplitude before calculating.

Where definitions apply, estimate FSR and loaded Q ≈ λres / Δλ, recording sampling resolution. If sampling is too sparse, report unresolved linewidth instead of treating interpolation as new measurement.

Use the resonance condition and effective-index concept to predict shifts with ring length or temperature. Hold other assumptions fixed in a temperature sweep and identify missing tuning-power and thermal-crosstalk data.

Compare two consistently normalized spectra to distinguish shifted resonance, changed dip depth and changed linewidth. Propose loss and coupling hypotheses and explain why one spectrum may not uniquely determine every parameter.
evidence: 提交有埠標示的原創圖、兩條具有來源或假設標記的頻譜比較，以及 Q 與 FSR 的定義和單位。
指出資料解析度與參數可辨識性的限制；能解釋峰／谷差異，而不是背誦某一種曲線形狀。
evidenceEn: Submit an original port-labeled drawing, a two-spectrum comparison with provenance or assumption labels, and Q/FSR definitions and units.
Identify resolution and parameter-identifiability limits; explain peak/dip behavior rather than memorizing one curve shape.
pitfalls: 把 through port 的凹谷和 drop port 的峰值搞混。
用場振幅半高代替功率半高而不說明。
將 loaded Q 當成單獨材料吸收損耗。
pitfallsEn: Confusing through-port dips with drop-port peaks.
Substituting field-amplitude half-height for power half-height without explanation.
Treating loaded Q as material-absorption loss alone.

guides.title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光引擎由光源、調變、偵測、封裝與控制共同構成。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An optical engine combines source, modulation, detection, packaging and control. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光引擎由光源、調變、偵測、封裝與控制共同構成。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：建立端到端功率、頻寬、溫度與失效預算。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An optical engine combines source, modulation, detection, packaging and control. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build end-to-end power, bandwidth, thermal and failure budgets. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「建立端到端功率、頻寬、溫度與失效預算」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build end-to-end power, bandwidth, thermal and failure budgets, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽光子與 CPO 光引擎：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon Photonics and CPO Optical Engines: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分辨光與電介面」建立判讀邊界。光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish optical and electrical interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分辨光與電介面：光傳輸搬運資訊，驅動、接收與控制仍需電子電路。 在系統圖區分光路、電路與控制路徑。
觀察站 2｜分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗：假設參考功率 1.00 mW，輸出 0.25 mW，IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB；此值仍包含未去嵌耦合器。
觀察站 3｜交付可重現 CPO 設計審查：最小封包包含有單位輸入、公式、假設、輸出圖、來源 URL 與未解議題；模擬不得標為量產實測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish optical and electrical interfaces: Optical transmission carries information while drivers, receivers and control remain electronic. Separate optical, electrical and control paths in the system diagram.
Observation station 2 | Separate reference planes and insertion loss: With hypothetical reference 1.00 mW and output 0.25 mW, IL=10 log10(1/0.25)=6.02 dB; unremoved coupler loss remains included.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a reproducible CPO review: A minimal package includes inputs with units, formulas, assumptions, plots, source URLs and open issues; simulation must not be labeled production measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分離鏈路參考面與插入損耗」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重現 CPO 設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate reference planes and insertion loss: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a reproducible CPO review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 把熱調諧控制線當成高速資料線，會混淆頻寬需求。
重新插拔參考線後未重校正，會把治具漂移當元件變化。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Treating a thermal-control line as the high-speed data path confuses bandwidth requirements.
Reconnecting without rereferencing makes fixture drift appear to be device change.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：橋梁尚未合龍時，力走哪裡？
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Where do loads go before bridge closure?
guides.concept: 斜張橋在施工中不斷改變支承條件。完成節塊吊裝並不等於完成結構接合；合龍後的連續橋面，也不能直接代表吊裝中的懸臂。先分階段畫自由體圖，再討論索力與橋面高程，才能把「拼起來」變成可檢查的工程推理。
guides.conceptEn: A cable-stayed bridge changes its support conditions during erection. Placing a closure segment does not complete its structural connections. Treat the unclosed cantilever and the connected deck as different systems before discussing stay forces or deck elevation.
procedure: 依官方施工敘述，自繪「吊入節塊、暫時連接、斜索調整、完成接合」四張示意圖；缺乏施工細節處標為待查。
在每張圖上標示自重、索力、支承與施工設備荷重，用箭頭連到基礎；不得把尚未接合的接縫畫成剛接。
以同一張示意圖比較增加一個節塊前後，哪些索、塔與橋面區段會改變受力；只推論方向，不替工程猜測數值。
把官方的索力施拉、銲接與線形校正記錄連到對應階段，寫出解除臨時支承前必須取得哪些設計與量測確認。
procedureEn: Draw four original sketches: segment placement, temporary connection, stay adjustment and completed joining. Mark undocumented details as unknown.
Label dead load, stay forces, supports and construction-equipment loads. Trace them to the foundation; do not represent an unfinished joint as rigid.
Compare conditions before and after adding one segment. Predict which stays, pylon regions and deck sections change load, without inventing project values.
Associate the owner’s tensioning, welding and alignment records with stages. List the design and measurement approvals required before releasing temporary support.
evidence: 四張支承狀態不同且標註清楚的自由體示意。
一張「工序—受力改變—需查證資料」對照表。
解釋為何節塊就位照片不足以證明全橋已完成結構接合。
evidenceEn: Four annotated sketches with distinct support states.
A table linking each operation to a load-path change and required evidence.
An explanation of why a placement photograph alone cannot prove structural completion.
pitfalls: 把施工階段當成已完工橋梁計算。
只核對索力，忽略橋面高程、溫度與施工荷重。
把公開里程碑當成完整的現場作業指示。
pitfallsEn: Analysing an erection stage as a finished bridge.
Checking stay force while ignoring deck elevation, temperature and construction loads.
Treating a public milestone report as a complete field procedure.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從線形誤差到可追溯的橋梁健康紀錄
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: From alignment error to traceable bridge-health records
guides.concept: 索力或高程變化可能來自施工調整、溫度、車流、感測器偏移或結構狀態改變。同一數字在不同時刻未必可直接比較。監測的核心是保留基準、單位、環境與儀器狀態，並用獨立證據辨別異常。
guides.conceptEn: A change in stay force or elevation can reflect adjustments, temperature, traffic, sensor drift or structural behaviour. Monitoring requires comparable baselines and independent checks, rather than treating every change as damage.
procedure: 依官方耐久與監測說明，建立「斜索、錨定端、橋面、橋塔」觀測清單；每列對應可見缺陷或可量測物理量。
自行製作學習用紀錄表，保留時間、構件編號、儀器、校正資訊、單位、溫度與作業狀態；沒有實測值就保留空白。
假設某索力讀值突然改變，分別提出儀器、環境、構件三種解釋，為每一種指定一項能區分原因的後續證據。
把視覺檢查、索力量測與幾何複測安排在同一時間軸；寫出應由誰核定判讀與下一步，並保留原始資料。
procedureEn: Build an observation list for stays, anchorages, deck and pylon using the official durability and monitoring description. Associate each with a visible condition or measurable quantity.
Create a learning record with time, component ID, instrument, calibration information, units, temperature and work state. Leave unavailable measurements blank.
For a hypothetical sudden stay-force change, propose instrument, environmental and structural explanations. Specify one discriminating observation for each.
Align visual inspections, force measurements and geometry surveys on a timeline. Identify who must approve interpretation and follow-up while preserving raw records.
evidence: 含資料來源及缺值標記的監測表。
三個競爭假說及各自的查證方法。
可從結論回查到構件、時間與原始紀錄的證據鏈。
evidenceEn: A monitoring sheet that identifies provenance and missing values.
Three competing hypotheses with discriminating checks.
A traceable chain from conclusion to component, time and original record.
pitfalls: 將單一感測器警報直接等同結構破壞。
拿不同溫度或荷重狀態的讀值硬作比較。
自行捏造警戒門檻或把設計壽命當作免維護年限。
pitfallsEn: Equating one sensor alarm with structural failure.
Comparing readings taken under different temperatures or loads without adjustment.
Inventing alarm limits or interpreting design life as maintenance-free life.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：硬岩為何仍會困住鑽掘機？
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Why can hard rock still trap a TBM?
guides.concept: 岩塊很硬，不代表整體岩盤穩定。裂隙方向、破碎帶、地下水壓與開挖擾動會共同改變掌子面及機身周圍條件。雪山隧道的公開案例適合練習把「材料強度」和「岩體行為」分開判讀。
guides.conceptEn: Hard intact rock does not guarantee a stable rock mass. Discontinuities, fractured zones, groundwater and excavation disturbance influence the face and the ground around the machine. Use the Hsuehshan case to separate material strength from rock-mass behaviour.
procedure: 由官方歷史文獻整理兩欄：已知地層與施工中實際遭遇；把觀察到的湧水、破碎與夾埋分開記錄。
自繪沿線地質示意，標示已查到的破碎帶與地下水可能路徑；未取得精確位置時不自行補數。
建立「現象—可能機制—需要資料」表，例如湧水增加需比對壓力、流量與出水位置，推進阻力改變需比對機況與地層。
對同一假想異常提出至少兩個假說，指定超前調查或現場監測應補足的資訊，再寫出何時應暫停推進並交由工程團隊審查。
procedureEn: Separate the official historical record into anticipated geology and encountered conditions. Record inflow, fragmentation and machine entrapment independently.
Draw an original geological section showing documented fractured zones and plausible water paths. Do not fabricate exact locations.
Create an observation–mechanism–evidence table: an inflow change requires pressure, flow and location information; changed resistance requires both machine and ground evidence.
For one hypothetical anomaly, give two hypotheses and the investigation or monitoring needed to distinguish them. Define the information gap that warrants a stop and engineering review.
evidence: 岩塊性質與岩體結構分列的概念圖。
含至少兩種可能原因的異常判讀表。
說明採用機械鑽掘或其他工法不能僅由岩石硬度決定。
evidenceEn: A concept map separating intact-rock properties from rock-mass structure.
An anomaly table with at least two plausible causes.
An explanation of why hardness alone cannot choose the excavation method.
pitfalls: 把岩塊抗壓強度直接當成掌子面穩定保證。
把有水與有高水壓視為同一觀測。
把歷史個案的處置搬成任何隧道通用配方。
pitfallsEn: Using intact-rock strength as proof of face stability.
Confusing the presence of water with evidence of high water pressure.
Turning one historical response into a universal tunnelling recipe.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：把通風系統畫成可驗證的控制迴路
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Draw ventilation as a verifiable control loop
guides.concept: 風機是致動器，空氣品質與風向風速是回饋，交控與供電則限制可採取的動作。平時稀釋污染物和火災時控制煙流的目標不同，不能把「全部開到最大」當作共同答案。
guides.conceptEn: Fans are actuators; air quality and airflow measurements provide feedback. Traffic control and power availability constrain the response. Routine pollutant dilution and fire-smoke management are different control objectives.
procedure: 觀看官方長版影片，畫出洞外、進氣豎井、車道、排氣豎井四部分，另標出軸流與噴流風機。
在圖旁補上空氣品質、能見度、風向風速及設備狀態等輸入；以箭頭連到控制判斷與致動設備。
建立正常交通、壅塞、火警、停電四列情境表；每列說明控制目標與需要確認的資料，實際設定留給核定文件。
用紙上故障案例測試：若回傳資料中斷或風機有命令卻無狀態確認，哪些量測能判斷是感測、通訊、供電或設備問題？
procedureEn: Watch the official long film and draw outside air, intake shaft, roadway and exhaust shaft. Identify axial and jet fans separately.
Add air-quality, visibility, airflow and equipment-state inputs. Connect these to decisions and actuators.
Create scenarios for normal traffic, congestion, fire and power loss. State the objective and required evidence for each; leave actual settings to approved documentation.
Run a paper fault case: if telemetry disappears or a commanded fan lacks confirmation, what observations distinguish sensing, communication, power and equipment faults?
evidence: 可追蹤輸入、決策、輸出與回饋的控制圖。
四種情境各有不同控制目標的比較表。
一份把命令、回報狀態與實際風流分開驗證的故障追查紀錄。
evidenceEn: A diagram tracing input, decision, output and feedback.
A comparison of control objectives across four operating scenarios.
A fault record checking command, reported state and actual airflow separately.
pitfalls: 把風機運轉回報當成已量到所需風量。
忽略火災位置與煙流分層，套用日常通風邏輯。
將歷史文獻數值當成目前核定的緊急操作設定。
pitfallsEn: Treating a running-status signal as a measurement of adequate airflow.
Applying normal ventilation logic without considering fire location or smoke stratification.
Treating historical document values as current approved emergency settings.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從水頭到電力，別漏掉能量損失
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: From hydraulic head to electricity, account for losses
guides.concept: 水力發電把水的能量經水輪機轉成軸功，再由發電機轉成電能。可用功率與淨水頭、流量和總效率有關；壩高不是自動等於淨水頭，裝置容量也不是所有時間的實際輸出。
guides.conceptEn: Hydropower converts hydraulic energy to shaft work and then electricity. Output depends on net head, flow and combined efficiency. Dam height is not automatically net head, and installed capacity is not continuous output.
procedure: 觀看電站原理影片，自繪水流與能量兩條路徑，標出進水、壓力水道、水輪機、發電機與尾水。
寫出學習模型 P = ρgQHη，逐一標示密度、重力加速度、流量、淨水頭與總效率的單位。
自行選一組標為「虛構練習」的 Q、H、η，比較流量或水頭改變時功率的趨勢；不得把結果標成三峽實測。
把水道損失、機械損失、電氣損失列成三欄，指出各自需取得的量測；缺乏效率曲線時保留不確定性。
procedureEn: Draw separate water and energy paths after watching the plant film. Identify intake, pressure conduit, turbine, generator and tailwater.
Write the learning model P = ρgQHη and label the units of density, gravity, flow, net head and overall efficiency.
Choose explicitly fictional Q, H and η values. Compare the output trend as flow or head changes; never label the result as measured Three Gorges performance.
Separate hydraulic, mechanical and electrical losses. Specify the measurements needed for each and retain uncertainty when efficiency curves are unavailable.
evidence: 水流路徑與能量轉換圖。
單位一致、假設清楚的功率估算表。
解釋毛水頭、淨水頭、額定容量與實際輸出的差異。
evidenceEn: Water-path and energy-conversion diagrams.
A dimensionally consistent power estimate with explicit assumptions.
A distinction between gross head, net head, rated capacity and actual output.
pitfalls: 用壩頂至河床高度代替工作淨水頭。
把效率設為百分之百卻未標成理想模型。
只追求流量，忽略水輪機允許運轉範圍。
pitfallsEn: Substituting dam height for operating net head.
Using 100% efficiency without identifying an ideal model.
Increasing flow without considering the turbine operating envelope.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：水庫削峰不是把洪水消失掉
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Flood attenuation stores water; it does not erase it
guides.concept: 水庫調度改變洪水通過的時間與流量，但水量仍須守恆。入流大於出流會增加蓄水；已被占用的庫容會限制後續洪峰的緩衝空間。下游支流洪峰與預報誤差也必須納入判斷。
guides.conceptEn: Reservoir operation changes the timing and magnitude of a flood hydrograph while conserving water. Inflow above outflow increases storage and uses space needed for later inflows. Downstream tributary peaks and forecast uncertainty also matter.
procedure: 由官方調度案例分列攔洪、削峰與錯峰三種目的，不將任何一個案例的流量直接套用到別的事件。
自製虛構入流與出流時序表，統一時間步長與單位，用 ΔS = (Qin − Qout)Δt 逐步更新蓄水量。
為模型設定明確標示為教學假設的庫容上限，比較提前釋放、延後釋放對剩餘空間與下游流量的影響。
再加入「支流較早洪峰」或「入流預報偏低」情境，記錄原方案何時失效及需要更新的資訊。
procedureEn: Separate retention, peak reduction and peak-timing objectives in official dispatch cases. Do not transfer event-specific releases to another flood.
Create fictional inflow and outflow time series with consistent units and time steps. Update storage using ΔS = (Qin − Qout)Δt.
Set an explicitly educational storage limit. Compare early and delayed releases in terms of remaining storage and downstream flow.
Add an earlier tributary peak or an underestimated inflow forecast. Identify when the original plan fails and what information must be updated.
evidence: 逐時段水量平衡表，累計誤差可回查。
兩種釋放方案的蓄水與下游流量比較。
標示預報不確定性及生態、航運、供水需求的決策註記。
evidenceEn: A time-step water balance with traceable cumulative error.
A comparison of storage and downstream flow under two release scenarios.
Decision notes covering forecast uncertainty, ecology, navigation and water supply.
pitfalls: 把瞬間流量與累計水量直接相比。
只算壩址出流，忽略下游區間來水。
將課堂模型的「最佳解」稱為實際調度命令。
pitfallsEn: Comparing instantaneous flow directly with accumulated volume.
Considering only dam releases while ignoring downstream inflows.
Presenting a classroom optimum as an operational dispatch order.

Identify why trains and the wayside control system exchange information.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：移動閉塞仍然需要停得下來的證據
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Moving block still requires evidence of stopping capability
guides.concept: 更頻繁取得位置資訊，有助於細緻管理列車間隔，但無法消除煞車距離。通訊延遲、位置不確定度、坡度與黏著條件都會影響保護範圍。用簡化模型理解依存關係，不能據此設定真實號誌參數。
guides.conceptEn: More frequent position information supports finer separation management but does not remove braking distance. Latency, position uncertainty, gradient and adhesion affect the protective envelope. A simple model explains dependencies, not operational signalling settings.
procedure: 以官方 CBTC 影片畫出列車、軌旁與控制中心的資訊交換，標出位置、速度與移動授權的不同角色。
在紙上建立兩列車位置圖，分別畫出前車占用範圍、後車位置誤差與後車可用停止距離。
使用理想化 d = v²/(2a) 比較同一減速度下速度加倍的影響；另以 vτ 表示示意延遲距離，所有數值明列為教學假設。
討論一筆位置回報過期時，哪些條件不能再確定；把保守限制與重新取得可信位置證據寫成狀態轉換。
procedureEn: Map train, wayside and control-centre communication from the official CBTC film. Distinguish position, speed and movement authority.
Draw two trains with the leading train’s occupied extent, following-train position uncertainty and available stopping distance.
Use idealised d = v²/(2a) to compare doubled speed at constant deceleration; add illustrative latency travel vτ. Label all numerical inputs as teaching assumptions.
Identify what becomes unknown when a position report is stale. Describe conservative restrictions and the evidence needed to restore a trusted position state.
evidence: 不重疊的占用與保護範圍示意。
呈現速度平方關係的紙上計算。
說明位置更新率改善不能取代煞車能力與安全驗證。
evidenceEn: A sketch distinguishing occupied and protected extents.
A calculation demonstrating the square-of-speed relationship.
An explanation of why update rate cannot replace braking capability or safety validation.
pitfalls: 把發出煞車命令當成列車已經停止。
把通訊中斷等同軌道上沒有列車。
把簡化等減速模型當成核准的安全煞車曲線。
pitfallsEn: Treating a brake command as proof the train has stopped.
Treating lost communication as an unoccupied track.
Using a constant-deceleration exercise as an approved safe braking curve.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：列車能動，不代表整套捷運已驗證
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: A moving train does not prove an integrated metro
guides.concept: 車輛、號誌、月台與電力之間的介面，往往決定系統是否能安全而穩定地營運。單機功能合格不等於整合情境合格。LTA 的號誌模擬設施提供一個公開例子：在受控環境先測軟體與營運場景。
guides.conceptEn: Interfaces among rolling stock, signalling, platforms and traction power determine system behaviour. Passing a component test does not establish integrated performance. LTA’s simulation facilities illustrate testing software changes against operational scenarios before mainline use.
procedure: 為「列車到站、停妥、開門、關門、允許發車」自繪狀態表，列出每次轉換必需的確認資訊。
依 LTA 公開情境，加入臨時速限、列車留站及班距調整；記錄其對車輛命令與號誌授權的不同影響。
每個情境建立預期結果、觀察量與失敗條件；再加入一個介面回報延遲，檢查系統是否仍有清楚的限制狀態。
把軟體版本、設定、模擬器版本與測試紀錄綁成同一組，說明重測與正式線路驗證還缺哪些證據。
procedureEn: Draw a state table for arrival, verified stop, door opening, door closure and departure permission. List the confirmations required at each transition.
Add the published LTA scenarios: temporary speed restriction, holding at a platform and headway regulation. Separate their effects on commands and authority.
Define expected results, observable signals and failure conditions. Introduce delayed interface feedback and check for a clearly restricted state.
Bind software version, configuration, simulator version and test records together. List the evidence still needed for regression and mainline validation.
evidence: 狀態轉換與允許條件矩陣。
至少三個營運情境與一個介面異常的測試表。
能由結果回溯軟體與設定版本的測試紀錄。
evidenceEn: A state-transition and permission matrix.
A test sheet with three operational scenarios and one interface anomaly.
Test records traceable to software and configuration versions.
pitfalls: 只驗證正常旅程而忽略異常回報。
把模擬成功直接宣稱可載客營運。
測試時更動設定，卻沒有留下版本紀錄。
pitfallsEn: Testing only a normal journey and ignoring abnormal feedback.
Declaring readiness for passenger service from simulation alone.
Changing configuration during testing without preserving version history.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：分清煙氣、鍋爐水與做功蒸汽
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Separate combustion gas, boiler water and working steam
guides.concept: 蒸汽機車看似一個大型鍋爐，實際上至少有三條不同流路。煙氣把熱傳給水，產生的蒸汽進入汽缸做功，再經排汽系統離開。輪子轉動來自壓力差與連桿機構，而不是煙直接推動車輪。
guides.conceptEn: A steam locomotive contains distinct gas, water and steam paths. Combustion gases transfer heat to water; steam then expands in cylinders and exhausts. Pressure differences and mechanical linkages turn the wheels, rather than smoke driving them directly.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 蒸汽原理解說，以三種線型自繪煙氣、給水與蒸汽流路，交會處僅代表換熱時不得畫成流體混合。
把熱量傳入、汽缸做功與機械傳動分成三段，為每段列出輸入與輸出。
在不加壓的紙上模型中，畫出活塞前後兩端壓力不同時的受力方向；再連到連桿與曲柄。
依博物館剖面解說，指出圖上看不到或尚未查證的部件，將它們列為待查而不是補造配置。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS explanation and draw gas, feedwater and steam routes with different line styles. Do not show fluid mixing where only heat transfer occurs.
Separate heat input, cylinder work and mechanical transmission. List the input and output of each.
In an unpressurised paper model, draw the force direction caused by different pressures across a piston and connect it to the rod and crank.
Use the museum cutaway explanation to identify missing or unverified components. Mark them for research instead of inventing an arrangement.
evidence: 三條不混淆的流路示意。
能量轉換與損失位置的標註。
能用自己的話說明鍋爐、汽缸與連桿各自的作用。
evidenceEn: A schematic with three distinct fluid paths.
Annotations locating energy conversions and losses.
An independent explanation of the boiler, cylinder and connecting-rod roles.
pitfalls: 把火管內煙氣與管外水混成一條路徑。
把高壓當成無限能量來源而忽略熱輸入。
將博物館原理介紹當成壓力容器製造或點火程序。
pitfallsEn: Merging gases inside fire tubes with water outside them.
Treating pressure as unlimited energy without heat input.
Using museum interpretation as pressure-vessel fabrication or firing instructions.

guides.title: 師傅導讀：從駕駛室儀表建立機械狀態判讀
guides.titleEn: Mentor guide: Read mechanical state through cab instruments
guides.concept: 儀表顯示的量、閥件改變的量與機器真正的反應不一定相同。駕駛室導覽可以用來練習「控制—量測—回應」對照；Big Boy 4012 的靜態展示也提醒我們，外觀完整不等於已具備動態運轉資格。
guides.conceptEn: An indicated quantity, a valve’s commanded change and the machine’s response are different kinds of evidence. Use the cab tour to map control, measurement and response. Big Boy 4012’s static display also distinguishes appearance from operational readiness.
procedure: 觀看 NPS 駕駛室導覽，把確認名稱的儀表與控制件列成表；聽不清楚的項目保留待查。
每列寫下它量測或控制的物理量、操作者希望知道的狀態，以及還需要哪些獨立觀察。
設計一個純紙上案例：指示值不動，但其他相關跡象改變；提出儀表失靈與系統狀態不變兩個假說，避免先指定原因。
比較 NPS 對靜態展示與完成運轉整修機車的說明，整理外觀修復、功能檢查與運轉驗證屬於不同證據層級。
procedureEn: Watch the NPS cab tour and tabulate instruments and controls whose names you can verify. Leave uncertain items unresolved.
For each, state the physical quantity, the condition the crew needs to infer and any independent observation required.
Create a paper case where one indication stays fixed while related signs change. Compare a faulty instrument with an unchanged process as competing hypotheses.
Compare NPS descriptions of static display and operational overhaul. Separate cosmetic restoration, functional checks and operating validation as distinct evidence levels.
evidence: 含已確認與待查項目的儀表功能表。
一項指示異常的兩個假說及區分方法。
說明為何看見閥件或輪子就不能判定機車可投入運轉。
evidenceEn: An instrument-function table separating verified and unresolved items.
Two hypotheses and discriminating evidence for an anomalous indication.
An explanation of why visible controls or wheels do not establish operating readiness.
pitfalls: 認為所有機車的閥件配置與操作邏輯相同。
把儀表讀值直接視為完整機械狀態。
忽略靜態展車與動態運轉機車的不同驗證要求。
pitfallsEn: Assuming all locomotives share the same valve arrangement and operating logic.
Treating one indication as the full mechanical state.
Ignoring the different evidence required for static display and operation.

guides.title: 用授權決策表理解零信任
guides.titleEn: Understand zero trust through an authorization table
guides.concept: NIST將政策引擎、政策管理與執行點分成邏輯角色。教學重點是每個資源請求的明確授權與撤銷，不是把VPN改名。
guides.conceptEn: NIST separates policy engine, administration and enforcement as logical roles. The exercise focuses on explicit resource authorization and revocation, not renaming a VPN.
procedure: 用虛構使用者、裝置與文件建立小型資源清單，不使用真實憑證。
寫出身分、角色、裝置狀態與資源敏感度的判定欄位。
為允許、拒絕和撤銷各做一個紙上案例，標出PE、PA與PEP的角色。
記錄決策理由與事件ID，確認無權限者不能僅因在內網而通過。
procedureEn: Create fictional users, devices and documents without real credentials.
Define identity, role, device posture and resource sensitivity fields.
Work one allow, deny and revoke case on paper, identifying PE, PA and PEP roles.
Record reasons and event IDs; network location alone must not authorize access.
evidence: 三種決策的輸入、輸出與理由表。
可指出每個執行點保護的資源。
evidenceEn: Input, output and reasoning for three decisions.
An identified protected resource for each enforcement point.
pitfalls: 把認證成功等同於全部資源授權。
將教學模型直接部署到未授權網路。
pitfallsEn: Equating authentication with universal authorization.
Deploying the teaching model into an unauthorized network.

guides.title: 以恢復演練驗證備份
guides.titleEn: Validate backups through a restore exercise
guides.concept: 備份完成訊息不等於可恢復。以無敏感資料的獨立測試資料夾，驗證完整性、復原順序與負責人，呼應CSF 2.0 Recover。
guides.conceptEn: A successful backup message does not prove recoverability. Use an isolated folder of nonsensitive test files to verify integrity, restoration order and ownership, consistent with CSF 2.0 Recover.
procedure: 先建立可重新產生的假資料與預期檔案清單。
在獨立測試位置恢復副本，保留原始檔，不覆寫正式資料。
比較檔名、雜湊及必要開啟測試；有差異就記錄原因。
記錄恢復所需時間、缺少的權限或金鑰，以及下一次改善項目。
procedureEn: Create reproducible dummy files and an expected inventory.
Restore to an isolated location, preserving originals and production data.
Compare names, hashes and required open tests; record discrepancies.
Record elapsed recovery time, missing permissions or keys, and improvements.
evidence: 可重跑的假資料清單與比對結果。
含責任人與未決事項的演練紀錄。
evidenceEn: A reproducible dummy-data inventory and comparison.
An exercise record with ownership and unresolved issues.
pitfalls: 在正式資料上做破壞性測試。
只驗檔案存在而未驗內容完整。
pitfallsEn: Performing destructive tests on production data.
Checking existence without content integrity.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：防禦性資訊安全網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Defensive Cybersecurity Network
guides.concept: 以身分、資源與復原證據連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。 原有步驟及進度識別完整保留。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect identity, resources and recovery evidence through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation. Existing steps and progress identities are preserved.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「資產身分」的資料、控制與時間關係。IP 可能改變，資產鍵需維持穩定。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「合併兩次假想盤點並查重。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「風險排序」的資料、控制與時間關係。風險需同時考慮影響與暴露條件。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較相同分數但不同損失案例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「政策決策」的資料、控制與時間關係。政策決策點與執行點有不同失效邊界。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「模擬政策服務不可用的結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「遙測覆蓋」的資料、控制與時間關係。缺少感測器與沒有事件不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「將資料缺口與零值分開呈現。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「證據保全」的資料、控制與時間關係。摘要證明位元一致，不證明內容真實。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「記錄取得時間、來源與雜湊。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「控制審查」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制需可追溯至責任與證據。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立例外到期與重審清單。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for asset identity. IPs may change; asset keys must remain stable. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Merge two synthetic inventories and check duplicates. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for risk ranking. Risk combines impact and exposure conditions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare equal scores with different losses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for policy decisions. Decision and enforcement points fail differently. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Model policy-service unavailability. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for telemetry coverage. Missing sensors differ from absent incidents. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate gaps from zero-valued events. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for evidence preservation. Hashes show byte identity, not factual truth. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Record acquisition time, source and hash. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for control review. Controls need accountable owners and evidence. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Create exception expiry and review records. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「備份復原」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「以虛構資料驗證還原及權限。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「控制審查」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「控制需可追溯至責任與證據。」。
提交「控制審查」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立例外到期與重審清單。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit backup recovery input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit control review two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit control review input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：高告警數必定代表高精確率。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: More alerts necessarily mean higher precision. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.concept: 車門間隙與外板位置受前段定位、接合及活動件調整共同影響。這是公差鏈的概念練習，不重建Ferrari治具或使用其產品尺寸。
guides.conceptEn: Door gaps and panel position reflect locating, joining and moving-part adjustment. This is a tolerance-chain exercise, not a reconstruction of Ferrari fixtures or product dimensions.
procedure: 畫出車身開口與車門的簡化輪廓，指定共同基準。
用符號誤差表示治具定位、接合變形與裝配調整。
比較一致偏移和局部變形對四周間隙的不同影響。
製作量測點表，說明為何只看一個間隙不足以定位原因。
procedureEn: Draw a simplified body opening and door with shared datums.
Represent fixture error, joining deformation and adjustment symbolically.
Compare uniform displacement with local deformation around the opening.
Create a measurement-point table and explain why one gap cannot locate a cause.
evidence: 有基準、方向與量測點的原創示意。
能區分整體偏移與局部形變的判讀。

A diagnosis separating rigid shift from local deformation.

procedure: 依報告畫出功能流程，註明資料年份。
挑選一個自創的非產品專屬零件，列出毛坯、加工與檢查介面。

Choose a fictional generic part and define blank, machining and inspection interfaces.
Assign dimensional, surface or traceability evidence to each handoff.
Add one hypothetical nonconformance with quarantine and investigation rather than arbitrary rework.
evidence: 帶年份與假設標籤的工站圖。
每個交接點都有明確輸入輸出。

Explicit input and output at each handoff.
