procedure: 從影片選三個可辨識工站，以自己的文字記錄畫面。
畫出物料流與人員活動區，不臆測封閉區域。
自行設定明確標示為假設的三站週期，用最慢站討論理想瓶頸。
加入停機或重工的概念影響，說明為何影片剪輯長度不能當週期時間。
procedureEn: Choose three identifiable stations and describe visible evidence in your own words.
Map material flow and human areas without guessing hidden regions.
Assign explicitly hypothetical cycle times and discuss the slowest ideal station.
Discuss downtime or rework and explain why shot duration is not cycle time.
evidence: 事實與假設分欄的流程圖。
可重算的假設節拍表，未宣稱Tesla實測產能。
evidenceEn: A flow map separating observation and assumption.
A reproducible hypothetical timing table, not measured Tesla capacity.
pitfalls: 用快轉或剪輯片段推導真實UPH。
把一座工廠畫面套用所有車型及工廠。
pitfallsEn: Deriving real UPH from edited or accelerated footage.
Applying one factory’s visuals to all plants and models.

guides.concept: 電池熱管理同時關注溫度、溫差與異常傳播。Tesla的公開說明描述分層設計；本練習只用低風險的符號熱網路，不拆電池或進行失效試驗。
guides.conceptEn: Battery thermal management concerns temperature, gradients and fault propagation. Tesla describes layered design publicly; this exercise uses symbolic thermal networks without dismantling packs or inducing failures.
procedure: 畫出電芯、介面、冷卻端的R-C概念網路。
以自定但清楚標示的假設比較單顆高溫與全包均溫。
把主動冷卻、溫度偵測與被動隔離分成不同功能。
列出真實驗證仍需的材料、邊界條件與感測位置，未知不自行補值。
procedureEn: Draw an R-C concept network for cells, interfaces and cooling.
Use clearly labeled assumptions to compare one hot cell with pack-wide uniformity.
Separate active cooling, sensing and passive isolation functions.
List material data, boundaries and sensor locations needed for real validation; leave unknowns unresolved.
evidence: 功能分明的熱網路與假設表。
能說明平均溫度不足以代表局部安全。
evidenceEn: A thermal network and explicit assumptions.
An explanation of why average temperature cannot establish local safety.
pitfalls: 把概念計算當作電池包安全認證。
對真實電芯短路、穿刺或拆解。
pitfallsEn: Treating a concept calculation as battery-pack certification.
Shorting, puncturing or disassembling real cells.

Distinguish optical and radio links and label optional paths conceptual.
Map power, attitude and communication-payload functions without build parameters.
Label hardware claims by source date and generation; omit exact counts when generation is unclear.

procedure: 依官方支援頁辨識遮蔽物類型與終端視野。

procedureEn: Identify obstruction types and terminal field of view from official support.
If a compatible setup is available, compare safe ground-level sites using the official app; otherwise draw a diagram.
Record trees, eaves and obstructions from a consistent viewpoint.
Separate obstruction findings from congestion, power or cable issues rather than assigning one cause to every interruption.

guides.title: 相位移光罩工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Phase-shift mask engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光」建立判讀邊界。相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane to define the interpretation boundary. Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜以複數平面表示兩束等振幅光：相位差決定相長或相消干涉。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜對密集與孤立線比較成像對比：一種相位配置不會同等改善所有圖形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查：設計可印性與光罩可製造性需共同成立。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Represent equal-amplitude fields in the complex plane: Phase difference controls constructive or destructive interference. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: One phase scheme does not improve every pattern equally. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review phase assignment and imaging window together: Printability and mask manufacturability must both hold. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「對密集與孤立線比較成像對比」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交相位配置與成像窗口設計審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Compare imaging contrast for dense and isolated lines: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review phase assignment and imaging window together to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「只需把兩束光強相加。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「最佳焦點改善代表所有焦距都改善。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Simply add the two intensities.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Better best-focus imaging proves improvement at every focus.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 浸潤式微影製程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Immersion lithography processing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「用 NA=n sinθ 比較乾式與浸潤式」建立判讀邊界。折射率與入射角共同決定數值孔徑。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare dry and immersion imaging using NA=n sinθ to define the interpretation boundary. Index and ray angle jointly determine numerical aperture. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜用 NA=n sinθ 比較乾式與浸潤式：折射率與入射角共同決定數值孔徑。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜追蹤掃描方向與缺陷條紋：方向性缺陷可提供液體或運動線索。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付光學、液體與量測整合圖：浸潤微影是多子系統協同工程。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare dry and immersion imaging using NA=n sinθ: Index and ray angle jointly determine numerical aperture. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Relate scan direction to defect streaks: Directional defects can reveal fluid or motion effects. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver an integrated optics–fluid–metrology diagram: Immersion lithography is a coordinated multisystem process. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「追蹤掃描方向與缺陷條紋」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付光學、液體與量測整合圖」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Relate scan direction to defect streaks: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver an integrated optics–fluid–metrology diagram to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「浸潤只要把晶圓浸水即可。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「速度提高不會改變液體狀態。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Immersion simply requires submerging a wafer.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Higher speed cannot affect liquid behavior.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 高數值孔徑 EUV 成像：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: High-numerical-aperture EUV imaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分開節點名稱與實際線寬」建立判讀邊界。微影解析度與半導體節點命名描述不同層面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate node labels from feature dimensions to define the interpretation boundary. Lithographic resolution and node naming describe different aspects. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分開節點名稱與實際線寬：節點名稱不能直接代入每個幾何尺寸。
觀察站 2｜推演晶圓與光罩同步掃描：平台各自位置正確仍須保持相對同步。
觀察站 3｜完成成像整合交付：漂亮影像不能取代統計與流程相容證據。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate node labels from feature dimensions: A node label is not every physical dimension.
Observation station 2 | Model synchronized wafer and mask scanning: Individually correct positions still require relative synchronization.
Observation station 3 | Complete the imaging-integration dossier: Attractive images cannot replace statistics and integration evidence.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「推演晶圓與光罩同步掃描」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成成像整合交付」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model synchronized wafer and mask scanning: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the imaging-integration dossier to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把「2 nm」當成所有線寬，退回欄位定義。
若兩平台使用相同位移卻倍率不同，重算對應關係。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Revisit definitions if a 2 nm label is treated as every linewidth.
Recalculate mapping if both stages move equally despite demagnification.

guides.titleEn: Planar CMOS process integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「互補反相器」建立判讀邊界。NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a complementary inverter to define the interpretation boundary. NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜互補反相器：檢查結果是否能支持「NMOS 與 PMOS 的連接決定靜態邏輯功能。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜矽化物形成：檢查結果是否能支持「導電接觸反應也會消耗表面矽。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜整合流程審查：檢查結果是否能支持「步驟可單獨合格仍可能在相互作用後失敗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a complementary inverter: Check whether the evidence supports: NMOS and PMOS connectivity determines static logic function. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Assess silicide formation: Check whether the evidence supports: Conductive contact reactions also consume surface silicon. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review the integrated flow: Check whether the evidence supports: Individually acceptable steps can fail through integration interactions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「矽化物形成」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合流程審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Assess silicide formation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review the integrated flow to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「互補反相器」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw a complementary inverter and add discriminating evidence.

guides.title: 環繞閘極奈米片電晶體：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Gate-all-around nanosheet transistors: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「環繞閘拓撲」建立判讀邊界。閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw the gate-all-around topology to define the interpretation boundary. The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜環繞閘拓撲：檢查結果是否能支持「閘須包覆通道四周而非只有上表面。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜犧牲層選蝕：檢查結果是否能支持「需要移除犧牲層而盡量保留通道。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜GAA 整合審查：檢查結果是否能支持「須同時交付釋放、覆蓋、接觸與變異證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw the gate-all-around topology: Check whether the evidence supports: The gate surrounds the channel rather than covering only its top. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Assess sacrificial-layer selectivity: Check whether the evidence supports: Sacrificial material must be removed while preserving channels. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review GAA integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Provide release, coverage, contact and variability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「犧牲層選蝕」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「GAA 整合審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Assess sacrificial-layer selectivity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review GAA integration to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「環繞閘拓撲」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：節點名稱就是實體閘長的量測值。 應回到「犧牲層選蝕」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for draw the gate-all-around topology and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: The node name is a measured physical gate length. Revisit assumptions and sampling for assess sacrificial-layer selectivity and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Observation station 2 | Trace frontside bottom contacts: Check whether the evidence supports: Bottom contacts from the front must pass or bypass upper structures. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Assemble a CFET evidence map: Check whether the evidence supports: Report isolation, both polarities, contacts, circuits and repeatability separately. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw separate power and signal paths to define the interpretation boundary. Backside power changes routing allocation; it does not move every signal backside. procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出電源與訊號的兩條路徑：供電轉到背面後，訊號層並未消失。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw separate power and signal paths: Moving power does not eliminate signal layers.
Observation station 2 | Compare buried-rail and direct-contact schemes: Schemes can share goals without sharing every process step.
Observation station 3 | Complete the chief-engineer integration review: Evidence completeness differs from the size of a performance gain.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Interpret node names to define the interpretation boundary. A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜節點名稱：檢查結果是否能支持「節點名稱不是任何單一實體幾何的直接量測。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜接觸瓶頸：檢查結果是否能支持「通道改善可能被增加的存取電阻抵銷。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜研究提案交付：檢查結果是否能支持「提出可量測假說、對照組及失敗判準才可檢驗。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Interpret node names: Check whether the evidence supports: A node name is not a direct measurement of one physical dimension. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Locate contact bottlenecks: Check whether the evidence supports: Channel improvements can be offset by access resistance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a research proposal: Check whether the evidence supports: A testable proposal needs measurable hypotheses, controls and failure criteria. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸瓶頸」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「研究提案交付」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Locate contact bottlenecks: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a research proposal to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：總電流合格就證明每個通道都完整。 應回到「節點名稱」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Acceptable total current proves every channel is intact. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret node names and add discriminating evidence.

guides.concept: 先用「內外間隔差別」建立判讀邊界。內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate inner and outer spacers to define the interpretation boundary. Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜內外間隔差別：檢查結果是否能支持「內間隔位於片間端部，外間隔位於閘外側。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

觀察站 3｜間隔模組放行：檢查結果是否能支持「尺寸、覆蓋、低電容及釋放後存活須共同成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate inner and outer spacers: Check whether the evidence supports: Inner spacers occupy inter-sheet ends while outer spacers flank the gate. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Compare low-k materials: Check whether the evidence supports: Low permittivity does not guarantee mechanical or chemical robustness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the spacer module: Check whether the evidence supports: Dimensions, coverage, capacitance and post-release survival must all hold. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「低介電材料」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

guides.title: 曝光焦距與劑量控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Exposure focus and dose control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義名目焦點與離焦符號」建立判讀邊界。焦點需有一致的參考面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define nominal focus and defocus signs to define the interpretation boundary. Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義名目焦點與離焦符號：焦點需有一致的參考面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜畫出表面高度到鏡頭焦點的前饋鏈：量測延遲與空間對應會影響補償。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付包含條件與取樣範圍的控制計畫：控制計畫需要清楚的適用範圍。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define nominal focus and defocus signs: Focus needs a consistent reference plane. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Sketch height-to-focus feedforward: Latency and spatial registration affect compensation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver controls with conditions and sampling scope: Control plans need explicit applicability limits. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「畫出表面高度到鏡頭焦點的前饋鏈」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付包含條件與取樣範圍的控制計畫」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch height-to-focus feedforward: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver controls with conditions and sampling scope to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「焦距與劑量是完全相同的控制量。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「高度感測器讀值就等於光阻最佳焦點。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Focus and dose are the same control variable.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A height-sensor reading equals the resist best focus.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶圓廠自動搬運系統：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Automated material handling in fabs: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「辨識載具與批號」建立判讀邊界。載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify carriers and lots to define the interpretation boundary. Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識載具與批號：檢查結果是否能支持「載具 ID 與晶圓批號不是同一資料欄位。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜瓶頸利用率：檢查結果是否能支持「高平均車速不能證明最繁忙路段不塞車。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜搬運系統驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「產能、錯送防護、故障恢復及潔淨度均需證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify carriers and lots: Check whether the evidence supports: Carrier identity and wafer-lot identity are separate fields. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure bottleneck utilization: Check whether the evidence supports: High average speed does not exclude congestion on a busy segment. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the transport system: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs throughput, misdelivery prevention, recovery and cleanliness evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「瓶頸利用率」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「搬運系統驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure bottleneck utilization: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the transport system to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：平均車速較快就保證所有任務延遲下降。 應回到「辨識載具與批號」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：已派工與已送達可使用同一狀態。 應回到「瓶頸利用率」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Higher mean speed guarantees lower delay for every task. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify carriers and lots and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Assigned and delivered can share one state. Revisit assumptions and sampling for measure bottleneck utilization and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜1T1C 儲存：建立模型：讀出擾動儲存電荷並需要恢復；位元線電容影響電荷共享電壓。
觀察站 2｜機械支撐：建立模型：高度增加同時提高機械整合難度；乾燥表面力可拉倒高柱結構。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | One-transistor one-capacitor storage: construct and analyze: Readout disturbs stored charge and requires restoration; Bitline capacitance affects charge-sharing voltage.
Observation station 2 | Mechanical support: construct and analyze: Greater height also raises mechanical integration difficulty; Drying forces can collapse tall structures.
Observation station 3 | Capacitor integration review: diagnose and verify: Electrical and structural evidence must correspond; Capacitor quality does not qualify sense amplifiers.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Mechanical support: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Capacitor integration review: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把 DRAM 讀取當成完全不改變電容電荷」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。

guides.title: 晶圓級參數測試：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer-level parametric testing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「SMU 四象限：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：設定源量不等於被測端實際值。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with SMU quadrants: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: A source setting need not equal the actual DUT value. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜SMU 四象限：建立模型：設定源量不等於被測端實際值；SMU 的量程切換可能產生暫態。
觀察站 2｜MOS 參數：建立模型：不同 Vth 定義可產生不同數值；遷移率抽取也依有效幾何。
觀察站 3｜判限與重測：故障判讀與驗證：重測需事先規則避免挑選有利數據；判限守門需考慮假接受和假拒絕。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | SMU quadrants: construct and analyze: A source setting need not equal the actual DUT value; SMU range switching can create transients.
Observation station 2 | MOS parameters: construct and analyze: Different threshold definitions produce different values; Mobility extraction needs effective geometry.
Observation station 3 | Limits and retest: diagnose and verify: Retest rules prevent selection of favorable results; Guardbanding balances false acceptance/rejection.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「MOS 參數：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「判限與重測：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for MOS parameters: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Limits and retest: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只記設定值就當成實測電壓」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「不同抽取法數字不等就一定量測錯」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Recording setpoints as measured voltage", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Calling every method difference an error", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶圓表面清洗：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer surface cleaning: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「污染分類」建立判讀邊界。粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Classify contaminants to define the interpretation boundary. Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜污染分類：檢查結果是否能支持「粒子、金屬、有機物與原生氧化層需要不同證據。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜沖洗置換模型：檢查結果是否能支持「僅靠出口平均值可能漏掉滯留區。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜潔淨交接單：檢查結果是否能支持「移除效果、表面變化及等待上限應一併交付。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Classify contaminants: Check whether the evidence supports: Particles, metals, organics and native oxide need different evidence. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Model rinse displacement: Check whether the evidence supports: Outlet averages can miss stagnant regions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Complete the cleanliness handoff: Check whether the evidence supports: Removal, surface change and queue limits belong in the handoff. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沖洗置換模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「潔淨交接單」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Model rinse displacement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete the cleanliness handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「污染分類」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「沖洗置換模型」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for classify contaminants and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for model rinse displacement and add discriminating evidence.

guides.titleEn: Ultrapure-water supply systems: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「界定使用點」建立判讀邊界。沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define points of use to define the interpretation boundary. Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜界定使用點：檢查結果是否能支持「沖洗、配液與設備用水可能有不同品質要求。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜循環管網：檢查結果是否能支持「持續循環降低滯留但不能代替材料潔淨度。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜水務放行報告：檢查結果是否能支持「品質、供應穩定、採樣及異常追溯須同時成立。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define points of use: Check whether the evidence supports: Rinsing, blending and utilities can require different water quality. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Trace the recirculation loop: Check whether the evidence supports: Recirculation reduces stagnation but cannot replace material cleanliness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Assemble water-system acceptance: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs quality, supply stability, sampling and excursion traceability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「循環管網」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「水務放行報告」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace the recirculation loop: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assemble water-system acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：粒子數低就證明金屬離子濃度低。 應回到「界定使用點」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：濾膜截留尺寸等同所有污染物去除率。 應回到「循環管網」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Low particle counts prove low metal-ion concentration. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define points of use and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: Membrane retention size equals removal efficiency for every contaminant. Revisit assumptions and sampling for trace the recirculation loop and add discriminating evidence.

guides.titleEn: imec NanoIC pilot-line architecture: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「試驗線目的：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Pilot-line purpose: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜試驗線目的：建立模型：試驗線用於技術驗證，與量產工廠目標不同；技術成功也需評估可移轉性。
觀察站 2｜測試載具：建立模型：試片應將技術風險轉為可量測問題；對照試片應保留相同量測條件。
觀察站 3｜里程碑核對：故障判讀與驗證：各里程碑代表不同完成程度；設備校正和產品資格是不同驗收。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Pilot-line purpose: construct and analyze: Pilot lines validate technology and differ from volume-fab objectives; Technical success also needs transferability assessment.
Observation station 2 | Test vehicles: construct and analyze: Test vehicles turn technology risks into measurements; Controls need matching measurement conditions.
Observation station 3 | Milestone verification: diagnose and verify: Milestones represent different completion states; Tool qualification and product qualification differ.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「測試載具：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「里程碑核對：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Test vehicles: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Milestone verification: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「有最先進設備便等於產品已量產」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只做完整大晶片才算有效研究」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Equating advanced equipment with production-ready products", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Treating only full large chips as useful research", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜用孔深除以孔寬定義深寬比：深寬比需註明採用的橫向尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

觀察站 3｜交付深度、側壁與後續相容性報告：DRIE 應作為整合流程的一部分驗收。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define aspect ratio from depth and width: Aspect ratio needs a stated lateral dimension. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Compare etch lag at different opening sizes: Aspect-ratio-dependent rate can create depth differences. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Report depth, walls and downstream compatibility: DRIE should be accepted as part of an integrated flow. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「比較不同孔徑的蝕刻延遲」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare etch lag at different opening sizes: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Report depth, walls and downstream compatibility to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「只延長時間就能維持相同輪廓無限加深。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「孔口寬度相同就代表底部速率相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Longer time preserves the same profile at unlimited depth.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Equal opening width proves equal bottom etch rate.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

guides.title: 由三張 DRIE 顯微圖區分深寬比、側壁波紋與失敗原因
guides.titleEn: Separate aspect-ratio effects, scallops and failures in three DRIE micrographs
guides.concept: 同樣是深反應式離子蝕刻，開口幾何、側壁鈍化與循環條件會在影像中留下不同證據。把影像觀察和原因假說分開，才能避免看到缺陷就直接猜一組設備參數。
guides.conceptEn: Opening geometry, sidewall passivation and process cycles leave different evidence in DRIE images. Separate observations from causal hypotheses before proposing changes.
procedure: 分別開啟「不同開口深寬比的矽蝕刻深度」、「微柱與側壁波紋」、「DRIE 鈍化不足」完整圖片，記下作者、試片與比例尺。
在原圖上辨認開口寬度、深度、側壁角與波紋；使用同張圖的比例尺換算，不能直接比較縮圖像素。
把可直接觀察到的事實寫在左欄，深寬比傳輸限制、鈍化不足等假說寫在右欄。
為每項假說列出缺少的實驗紀錄，例如循環歷程、材料、遮罩與取樣位置；這些資料未隨照片提供。
設計一個控制變因的比較計畫，先訂觀察指標與停止條件；交付教學分析，不操作未受訓的蝕刻設備。
procedureEn: Open the full etch-depth, micropillar and DRIE-failure images. Record author, specimen and scale bar.
Identify opening width, depth, sidewall angle and scallops. Calibrate within each image using its scale bar; do not compare thumbnail pixels directly.
Place direct observations in one column and hypotheses such as transport limitation or insufficient passivation in another.
List missing records for each hypothesis: cycle history, materials, mask and sampling location. These records are not supplied with the photographs.
Design a controlled comparison with observation metrics and stop conditions. Deliver an educational analysis; do not operate etch tools without training.
evidence: 交付三張圖的觀察表與至少兩個可被額外量測推翻的假說。
標註同一張照片不代表不同製程條件的對照實驗。
evidenceEn: Deliver an observation table and at least two hypotheses falsifiable by additional measurements.
State that a single photograph does not constitute a controlled comparison across process conditions.
pitfalls: 把影像中亮暗直接當成材料成分。
把代表照片當成本站每一步的實拍結果。
pitfallsEn: Equating image brightness directly with composition.
Treating representative photographs as measured outcomes of every site activity.

guides.title: 高深寬比介電層蝕刻：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: High-aspect-ratio dielectric etching: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出交替介電層與目標通道」建立判讀邊界。不同材料層可能有不同移除速率。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw alternating dielectric layers and the target channel to define the interpretation boundary. Different layers can have different removal rates. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出交替介電層與目標通道：不同材料層可能有不同移除速率。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

觀察站 2｜量測孔口、最大膨脹處與孔底：單一截面寬度不足以描述弓形。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
交付 10、16.7、20% 與三位置截面標記。
觀察站 3｜交付含深度剖面的整合風險圖：高深寬比驗證必須涵蓋整個深度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw alternating dielectric layers and the target channel: Different layers can have different removal rates. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Measure opening, maximum bow and bottom: One width cannot characterize bowing. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Report 10, 16.7 and 20% with three labeled cross-sectional sites.

Observation station 3 | Deliver an integration-risk map with depth profiles: High-aspect-ratio validation must cover the full depth. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測孔口、最大膨脹處與孔底」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付含深度剖面的整合風險圖」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure opening, maximum bow and bottom: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver an integration-risk map with depth profiles to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「開口相同就代表所有深度的通量相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「孔口圓形可保證整孔筆直。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Equal openings imply equal flux at every depth.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A circular opening guarantees a straight hole.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.titleEn: MEMS inertial-sensor processing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「質量彈簧：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Mass and spring: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Static approximation needs operation below resonance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜質量彈簧：建立模型：靜態近似需要低於機械共振的條件；動態方程還包含阻尼與慣性項。
觀察站 2｜沾黏：建立模型：表面力可能勝過微結構回復力；防沾黏表面也需相容性驗證。
觀察站 3｜溫漂校正：故障判讀與驗證：零偏溫漂與比例溫漂是不同校正項；溫度遲滯需要往返循環檢查。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Mass and spring: construct and analyze: Static approximation needs operation below resonance; Dynamics also include damping and inertia.
Observation station 2 | Stiction: construct and analyze: Surface forces can exceed microstructure restoring force; Anti-stiction surfaces need compatibility checks.
Observation station 3 | Temperature calibration: diagnose and verify: Offset drift and scale drift are different corrections; Thermal hysteresis needs heating/cooling cycles.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「沾黏：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「溫漂校正：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Stiction: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Temperature calibration: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把靜態位移式套到所有振動頻率」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「元件重量很小就不可能被表面力拉住」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Applying static displacement at every frequency", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Assuming low weight prevents surface-force sticking", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 銅柱微凸塊製作：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Copper-pillar microbump fabrication: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：銅柱、焊帽及金屬間化合物不是同一層。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：需要截面元素分析與高度分布才能確認組成和共面性。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish copper pillar, solder cap and intermetallic layers. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Composition and coplanarity require cross-sectional composition and height data. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

Observation station 3 | Limits of process-window transfer: Document changes and holds using geometric, electrical, interface and thermal-cycle evidence. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連的比較照片，不是直接 Cu-Cu 或介電／銅混合接合界面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：銅對銅接合不依賴回焊焊料。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以界面空洞和接觸電阻檢查真正接合面。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This Quilt Packaging solder interconnect is a comparison image, not a direct Cu-Cu or dielectric/Cu hybrid-bond interface. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Copper-to-copper bonding is distinct from solder reflow. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Inspect actual bonded area with interface-void and contact-resistance evidence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

guides.title: 直接銅對銅接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Direct copper-to-copper bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「銅與介電界面區分」建立判讀邊界。直接銅接合的承載與導電區必須明確界定，不能把混合接合的介電質支撐默認套入。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces to define the interpretation boundary. Define the load-bearing and conductive regions explicitly; do not silently import dielectric support from hybrid bonding. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜銅與介電界面區分：畫有無介電支撐兩種剖面，標出接觸應力和電流路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜晶粒取向與界面遷移：用多位置截面或取向分析對照電性，標注取樣偏差。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜接合界面交接：建立批次證據包並列出未覆蓋的面積或應力範圍。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate Cu and dielectric interfaces: Draw sections with and without dielectric support and mark contact stress and current paths. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 2 | Grain orientation and interface migration: Compare multisite sections or orientation analysis with electrical data and note sampling bias. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

Observation station 3 | Interface qualification handoff: Assemble lot evidence and declare untested area or stress ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「晶粒取向與界面遷移」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「接合界面交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Grain orientation and interface migration: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Interface qualification handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有無焊料接合都具有相同混合界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：一張無接縫截面足以代表整片界面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating every solderless bond as the same hybrid interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Using one seam-free section to certify the whole interface. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define the two functions of hybrid bonding to define the interpretation boundary. Hybrid bonding combines dielectric attachment and embedded metal interconnects at one interface. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜界定混合接合的兩種功能：整片看似貼合，並不表示每個銅接點已導通。

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define the two functions of hybrid bonding: Apparent full-area attachment does not prove continuity through every copper contact.

guides.title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Die-to-wafer hybrid bonding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 已知良品晶粒的選擇不能取代接合後檢查。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Known-good die selection does not replace post-bond inspection. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。以實際多晶片排列比較封裝幾何；不是 Foveros、SoIC 或混合接合剖面。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：已知良品晶粒的選擇不能取代接合後檢查。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較放置誤差、接合空洞及鏈路導通率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare physical multi-chip geometry; this is not a Foveros, SoIC or hybrid-bond cross-section.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Known-good die selection does not replace post-bond inspection. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare placement error, bond voids and daisy-chain continuity. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較放置誤差、接合空洞及鏈路導通率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare placement error, bond voids and daisy-chain continuity, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 晶粒對晶圓混合接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Die-to-wafer hybrid bonding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「已知良品置信度」建立判讀邊界。測試覆蓋率與逃逸率決定選片可信度，通過並非零缺陷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Known-good-die confidence to define the interpretation boundary. Test coverage and escapes determine selection confidence; passing is not defect-free. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜已知良品置信度：比較前測、接合後測與失效定位。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜接合波與局部接觸：比較空洞形狀與接觸起點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜熱與資料交接：提交前後測配對資料及未驗證熱範圍。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Known-good-die confidence: Compare pre-bond, post-bond and localization data. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Bond-wave contact: Compare void shapes with contact initiation points. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Thermal and data handoff: Submit paired tests and unverified thermal ranges. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接合波與局部接觸」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「熱與資料交接」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Bond-wave contact: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Thermal and data handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：把前測通過當成永久良品。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：只看最終位置即可判斷接合完整。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating a pretest pass as permanently good. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring bond completeness from final position. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

guides.title: 晶粒拾取與精密放置：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Die picking and precision placement: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 拾取釋放與光學對準誤差分開。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Separate pickup/release error from optical registration error. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：拾取釋放與光學對準誤差分開。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用放置後位置分布與晶粒損傷率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Separate pickup/release error from optical registration error. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use post-placement position distributions and die-damage rate. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用放置後位置分布與晶粒損傷率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use post-placement position distributions and die-damage rate, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「晶粒地圖身分」建立判讀邊界。晶粒座標需連結測試結果與取放紀錄以避免錯選。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Die-map identity to define the interpretation boundary. Die coordinates must link test results to placement logs. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶粒地圖身分：核對原點、列行與缺口方向。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜視覺標記：比較不同光照下的座標漂移。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜後段可接合性：交付逐顆座標、缺陷與來源追溯。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Die-map identity: Check origin, row/column and notch direction. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Vision fiducials: Compare coordinate drift under different illumination. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Downstream bondability: Deliver per-die coordinates, defects and source traceability. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「視覺標記」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「後段可接合性」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Vision fiducials: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Downstream bondability to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：地圖尺寸相同就表示座標定義相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：影像解析度高即可消除識別偏差。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating equal map dimensions with equal coordinates. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming high image resolution eliminates recognition bias. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Fan-out RDL extends beyond the die boundary. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：扇出封裝的 RDL 超出晶粒邊界。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：建立晶粒位移到 RDL 對準殘差的關聯。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Fan-out RDL extends beyond the die boundary. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Relate die shift to residual RDL overlay. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「建立晶粒位移到 RDL 對準殘差的關聯」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Relate die shift to residual RDL overlay, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 扇出型晶圓級封裝：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Fan-out wafer-level packaging: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「Chip-first 與 chip-last」建立判讀邊界。先放晶粒或先做 RDL 改變對位、已知良品與返修節點。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Chip-first and chip-last to define the interpretation boundary. Die-first versus RDL-first changes overlay, screening and rework points. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜Chip-first 與 chip-last：畫兩路徑的材料與測試交接。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜露墊與表面：配對露墊截面與接觸電阻。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜良率與成本：比較相同封裝功能下兩路徑成本。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Chip-first and chip-last: Map material/test handoffs for both routes. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Pad exposure and surface: Pair pad sections with contact resistance. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Yield and cost: Compare routes at equal package functionality. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「露墊與表面」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「良率與成本」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Pad exposure and surface: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Yield and cost to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：兩路徑只改步驟名稱不改風險。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：可見金屬即等於可可靠接線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating the routes as renamed identical risks. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Equating visible metal with reliable contact. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Redistribution-layer lithography and plating: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 種子層、電鍍及去種子層共同決定線路。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Seed, plating and seed removal jointly define routing. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為 Quilt Packaging 焊料互連，不是 RDL 金屬線的截面。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：種子層、電鍍及去種子層共同決定線路。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以線寬、厚度及隔離電阻形成三維驗收。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This shows Quilt Packaging solder interconnects, not an RDL metal-line cross-section. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Seed, plating and seed removal jointly define routing. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Accept against width, thickness and isolation resistance. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以線寬、厚度及隔離電阻形成三維驗收」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Accept against width, thickness and isolation resistance, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 重佈線層微影與電鍍：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Redistribution-layer lithography and plating: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「互連功能分層」建立判讀邊界。電源與訊號線有不同寬度、阻抗和電流需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Interconnect function layers to define the interpretation boundary. Power and signal traces need different widths, impedances and currents. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜互連功能分層：標每層網路及回流面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜電鍍線形：量線頂、底及彎角截面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜可靠度與設計回饋：建立失效位置對版圖規則的對照。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Interconnect function layers: Mark networks and return planes per layer. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Plated profile: Measure top, bottom and bend sections. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Reliability and design feedback: Map failures back to layout rules. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「電鍍線形」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可靠度與設計回饋」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plated profile: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Reliability and design feedback to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：最小線寬可用於所有電源線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：電鍍總量可直接推得最小線截面。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Using minimum width for all power traces. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Inferring minimum cross-section from total plated mass. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.
