guides.title: 系統級封裝異質整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: System-in-package heterogeneous integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 異質系統的介面不只有電訊號。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Heterogeneous-system interfaces include more than signals. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：異質系統的介面不只有電訊號。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：記錄接地、功耗、時序及材料相容性。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Heterogeneous-system interfaces include more than signals. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Record grounds, power, timing and material compatibility. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「記錄接地、功耗、時序及材料相容性」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record grounds, power, timing and material compatibility, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 系統級封裝異質整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: System-in-package heterogeneous integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「功能需求樹」建立判讀邊界。系統性能需拆成可量測的模組接口。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Functional requirement tree to define the interpretation boundary. System performance must become measurable module interfaces. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜功能需求樹：把頻寬、延遲、功耗連到各元件。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜射頻隔離：畫有意信號與非預期耦合路徑。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜系統接受測試：提交代表和邊界情境驗證矩陣。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Functional requirement tree: Allocate bandwidth, latency and power to components. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | RF isolation: Draw desired signals and unintended coupling. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | System acceptance: Submit representative and boundary-scenario matrices. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「射頻隔離」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「系統接受測試」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for RF isolation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use System acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：把功能元件放一起即成完整系統。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：金屬罩能消除全部電源耦合。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Equating colocated components with a complete system. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Assuming a shield eliminates all power coupling. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.concept: 先用「Via-first/middle/last」建立判讀邊界。形成時點決定可用熱預算與保護的既有結構。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Via-first/middle/last to define the interpretation boundary. Insertion timing determines thermal budget and structures needing protection. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜Via-first/middle/last：畫三條整合路徑和不可逆界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。

觀察站 3｜金屬化交接：提交孔形與漏電共同地圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Via-first/middle/last: Draw three integration routes and irreversible interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Cleaning and surface: Pair cleaning witnesses and leakage distributions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Metallization handoff: Deliver paired geometry/leakage maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Cleaning and surface: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Metallization handoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有 TSV 都可用相同熱預算。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

Avoid: Skipping surface qualification after geometry passes. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.title: 矽穿孔金屬填充：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via metal filling: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: TSV 金屬填充不能由表面封口判斷。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A sealed TSV top does not prove void-free fill. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。圖中為外露焊料互連，不顯示 TSV 孔內部或其填充完整性。 觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：TSV 金屬填充不能由表面封口判斷。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用內部空洞分布、電阻及熱循環資料。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Exposed solder interconnects do not show TSV interiors or fill integrity. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.
Mark this question on your own diagram: A sealed TSV top does not prove void-free fill. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use internal void distributions, resistance and cycling data. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用內部空洞分布、電阻及熱循環資料」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use internal void distributions, resistance and cycling data, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「導體選擇」建立判讀邊界。Cu 與 W 的電阻、成膜方式和热失配不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。

Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜導體選擇：比較電阻與應力的雙目標表。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜傳質與圖形：按密度區比較空洞與厚度。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜放行與露出：交付深度對位圖與缺陷界限。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Conductor selection: Compare resistance and stress objectives. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Transport and pattern: Compare voids/thickness by density region. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Release to reveal: Deliver depth-registered maps and defect bounds. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「傳質與圖形」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「放行與露出」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transport and pattern: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Release to reveal to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：最低電阻材料必是每種 TSV 最佳選擇。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：流場均勻就代表所有孔內傳質相同。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Assuming lowest resistivity is always best. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Equating uniform bulk flow with equal in-via transport. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.

guides.conceptEn: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認晶粒排列；色彩不等於特定膜厚或製程節點。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：背面露出有矽殘留與過度去除兩種風險。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較晶圓厚度圖與每區露出高度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify the die array; colour alone does not determine film thickness or process node.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Backside reveal risks both silicon residue and over-removal. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare wafer thickness maps and local reveal height. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較晶圓厚度圖與每區露出高度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare wafer thickness maps and local reveal height, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽穿孔背面露出：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Through-silicon-via backside reveal: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「深度座標」建立判讀邊界。TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Depth coordinates to define the interpretation boundary. TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜深度座標：統一圖面和量測零點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜終點感測：以局部量測核對全域終點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜露出驗收：建立逐區幾何電性對照。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Depth coordinates: Unify design and metrology zero references. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | Endpoint sensing: Check global endpoints against local measurements. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Reveal acceptance: Build regional geometry/electrical comparisons. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「終點感測」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「露出驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Endpoint sensing: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Reveal acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：全域終點一出現即可停止且全部完成。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Stopping at first global endpoint as complete reveal. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 矽中介層佈線：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silicon-interposer routing: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 中介層提供細間距佈線但增加界面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An interposer adds fine routing and additional interfaces. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：中介層提供細間距佈線但增加界面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：標示水平配線、垂直通孔與返回路徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An interposer adds fine routing and additional interfaces. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Mark horizontal routing, vertical vias and return paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「標示水平配線、垂直通孔與返回路徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Mark horizontal routing, vertical vias and return paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 矽中介層佈線：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Silicon-interposer routing: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「被動與主動中介層」建立判讀邊界。是否含主動電路改變供電、測試和熱需求。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Passive and active interposers to define the interpretation boundary. Active circuitry changes power, testing and thermal requirements. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜被動與主動中介層：標出被動線路及主動功能邊界。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 2｜TSV 分配：建立 TSV 網路與電流密度圖。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
觀察站 3｜共同簽核：檢查模型版本及重複計算界面。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Passive and active interposers: Mark passive wiring and active functions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 2 | TSV allocation: Build TSV net and current-density maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
Observation station 3 | Co-signoff: Check versions and double-counted interfaces. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「TSV 分配」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「共同簽核」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for TSV allocation: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Co-signoff to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 避免：所有矽中介層都只是無源連線。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
避免：地 TSV 可只按剩餘空間放置。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Avoid: Treating all silicon interposers as passive. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
Avoid: Placing ground TSVs only in leftover space. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 玻璃核心封裝基板：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Glass-core package substrates: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。此 BGA 截面僅示意接點與基板位置，不能確認其核心材料是玻璃。 代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：玻璃核心的平坦度與通孔可靠度需共同驗證。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：將核心翹曲、通孔裂紋和增層界面分開。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This BGA section locates joints and substrate but does not establish a glass-core material. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Glass-core flatness and via reliability need joint verification. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate core warpage, via cracks and build-up interfaces. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「將核心翹曲、通孔裂紋和增層界面分開」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Separate core warpage, via cracks and build-up interfaces, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.titleEn: Glass-core package substrates: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義核心與增層」建立判讀邊界。核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define core and build-up to define the interpretation boundary. The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義核心與增層：觀察焦點：將核心和增層分色標示。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜估算熱失配：觀察焦點：重算 12 μm 差位移並說明不是裂紋張開量。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜評估研究成熟度：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：用公開證據標註已證明與仍待證明事項。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define core and build-up: Observation focus: Color core and build-up separately. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Estimate thermal mismatch: Observation focus: Recalculate 12 μm mismatch and explain why it is not crack opening. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Label demonstrated and unresolved claims from public evidence. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「估算熱失配」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「評估研究成熟度：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Estimate thermal mismatch: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Assess research maturity: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「定義核心與增層」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到核心負責機械支撐及穿通，外側增層負責細密佈線。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：玻璃平整就不會產生裂紋。本步先檢查「估算熱失配」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到玻璃和銅膨脹不同會在孔口及端面形成局部負荷。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for define core and build-up actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: The core supports mechanics and through-connections; outer build-up handles fine routing.

Misinterpretation to reject: Flat glass cannot crack. First check whether evidence for estimate thermal mismatch actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Glass-copper mismatch loads via entrances and ends locally.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 小晶片互連實體層：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Chiplet-interconnect physical layers: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 實體層通道必須包含封裝返回路徑。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A physical-layer channel includes the package return path. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察橫向多晶片互連；這是 Quilt Packaging 實例，不是 CoWoS 或 EMIB 實物。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：實體層通道必須包含封裝返回路徑。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用眼圖、BER 與通道 S 參數連結驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe lateral multi-chip assembly; this is Quilt Packaging, not a CoWoS or EMIB specimen.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A physical-layer channel includes the package return path. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Link eye, BER and channel S-parameter evidence. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用眼圖、BER 與通道 S 參數連結驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Link eye, BER and channel S-parameter evidence, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 小晶片互連實體層：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Chiplet-interconnect physical layers: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「分離 PHY 與協定」建立判讀邊界。電氣傳輸、連結管理與上層資料語義處於不同層。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Separate PHY and protocol to define the interpretation boundary. Electrical transport, link management and data semantics occupy different layers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分離 PHY 與協定：觀察焦點：畫出資料由協定到焊墊的邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜理解初始化與訓練：觀察焦點：畫出上電到可傳有效資料的狀態。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付連結證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出未經測試的相容性主張。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate PHY and protocol: Observation focus: Draw boundaries from protocol to pads. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Understand initialization and training: Observation focus: Draw states from power-on to valid data transfer. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver link evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: List compatibility claims that remain untested. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「理解初始化與訓練」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付連結證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Understand initialization and training: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver link evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：支援相同協定就保證電氣互通。本步先檢查「分離 PHY 與協定」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到電氣傳輸、連結管理與上層資料語義處於不同層。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：支援相同協定就保證電氣互通。本步先檢查「理解初始化與訓練」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到連線建立需確認時鐘、通道與能力，不只看到資料切換。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: The same protocol guarantees electrical interoperability. First check whether evidence for separate phy and protocol actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Electrical transport, link management and data semantics occupy different layers.

Misinterpretation to reject: The same protocol guarantees electrical interoperability. First check whether evidence for understand initialization and training actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Link establishment verifies clocks, lanes and capabilities, not just transitions.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Identify HBM hierarchy to define the interpretation boundary. DRAM stacks, base interfaces and external accelerators play distinct roles. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨識 HBM 層級：觀察焦點：畫堆疊到中介層再到邏輯晶片的路徑。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜驗證層間對準：觀察焦點：比較中心及邊緣接點的重疊。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成堆疊驗收：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：標明未公開設計細節與教學假設。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify HBM hierarchy: Observation focus: Draw stack-to-interposer-to-logic paths. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Verify interlayer alignment: Observation focus: Compare center and edge joint overlap. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete stack acceptance: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Label unpublished details and teaching assumptions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Complete stack acceptance: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: 3D 邏輯堆疊熱管理：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Thermal management for 3D logic stacks: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 3D 堆疊的熱點不一定靠近散熱面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A 3D-stack hotspot need not lie next to its cooling surface. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。用外置冷板比較對流表面與流阻；不是蝕刻在晶片內部的微流道。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：3D 堆疊的熱點不一定靠近散熱面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以分層熱阻模型對照埋藏接面溫度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare convective area and flow restriction in an external cold plate; these are not microchannels etched inside a chip.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A 3D-stack hotspot need not lie next to its cooling surface. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare a layered thermal-resistance model with buried-junction temperature. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以分層熱阻模型對照埋藏接面溫度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare a layered thermal-resistance model with buried-junction temperature, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.titleEn: Thermal management for 3D logic stacks: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「標出每層熱源」建立判讀邊界。不同功能區的功率密度不均，不能以整片平均代表局部峰值。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Map layer heat sources to define the interpretation boundary. Functional regions have unequal power density; averages hide peaks. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜標出每層熱源：觀察焦點：建立各層位置相對應的功率圖。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜比較單面與雙面冷卻：觀察焦點：用雙分支熱路重解層溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付效能熱權衡：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：報告性能、功耗、溫度及未驗證情境。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Map layer heat sources: Observation focus: Build registered power maps for all layers. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Compare single and double cooling: Observation focus: Resolve layer temperatures with dual branches. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver performance-thermal tradeoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Report performance, power, temperature and untested scenarios. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「比較單面與雙面冷卻」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付效能熱權衡：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Compare single and double cooling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver performance-thermal tradeoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：各層溫升都只用自己的功率乘同一熱阻。本步先檢查「標出每層熱源」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不同功能區的功率密度不均，不能以整片平均代表局部峰值。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：各層溫升都只用自己的功率乘同一熱阻。本步先檢查「比較單面與雙面冷卻」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到新增冷端會重分配熱流，不是簡單把所有溫度除二。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Each layer rises only by its own power times the same resistance. First check whether evidence for map layer heat sources actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Functional regions have unequal power density; averages hide peaks.

Misinterpretation to reject: Each layer rises only by its own power times the same resistance. First check whether evidence for compare single and double cooling actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: An added sink redistributes heat; it does not simply halve every temperature.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 封裝供電完整性設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package power-integrity design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：封裝供電完整性包含頻率相關阻抗。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：把 DC 壓降與瞬時壓降頻譜分開。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Package power integrity involves frequency-dependent impedance. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate DC voltage drop from transient-droop spectra. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Separate DC voltage drop from transient-droop spectra, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝供電完整性設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿

guides.concept: 先用「分配電壓容差」建立判讀邊界。DC 壓降、動態下陷和漣波共用有限容差，需避免重複計算。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Allocate voltage tolerance to define the interpretation boundary. DC drop, dynamic droop and ripple share finite tolerance. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜分配電壓容差：觀察焦點：把電壓預算分成獨立欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建構去耦頻帶：觀察焦點：標示各去耦支路共振與感性區。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付供電證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：指出哪個角點消耗最多容差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Allocate voltage tolerance: Observation focus: Split the voltage budget into separate terms. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Construct decoupling bands: Observation focus: Mark resonant and inductive regions of each branch. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver PI evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Identify which corner consumes most tolerance. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建構去耦頻帶」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付供電證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Construct decoupling bands: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver PI evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「分配電壓容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到DC 壓降、動態下陷和漣波共用有限容差，需避免重複計算。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：DC 壓降合格就保證所有瞬態合格。本步先檢查「建構去耦頻帶」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到ESR、ESL 和安裝路徑決定支路有效範圍。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing DC drop guarantees all transients. First check whether evidence for allocate voltage tolerance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: DC drop, dynamic droop and ripple share finite tolerance.

Misinterpretation to reject: Passing DC drop guarantees all transients. First check whether evidence for construct decoupling bands actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: ESR, ESL and mounting determine branch effectiveness.

guides.title: 封裝射頻遮蔽：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package RF shielding: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 金屬外殼不自動形成完整射頻屏蔽。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: A metal enclosure does not automatically provide RF shielding. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認功率模組外殼與引腳；封裝內部陶瓷、銀燒結及雙面冷卻結構沒有顯露。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：金屬外殼不自動形成完整射頻屏蔽。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：辨認縫隙、接地阻抗及共模路徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Identify housing and pins; internal ceramics, silver sintering and double-sided cooling are not visible.

Mark this question on your own diagram: A metal enclosure does not automatically provide RF shielding. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Identify apertures, ground impedance and common-mode paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「辨認縫隙、接地阻抗及共模路徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Identify apertures, ground impedance and common-mode paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝射頻遮蔽：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package RF shielding: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義干擾源和受害者」建立判讀邊界。頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define source and victim to define the interpretation boundary. Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義干擾源和受害者：觀察焦點：畫源、耦合路徑及受害回路。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜辨識接縫洩漏：觀察焦點：比較等面積小孔與長縫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付頻帶屏蔽證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：將低於檢出限結果寫為界限而非精確值。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define source and victim: Observation focus: Draw source, coupling path and victim loop. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Identify seam leakage: Observation focus: Compare a compact opening with a long slot of equal area. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver band-specific shield evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Report below-floor results as bounds rather than exact values. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「辨識接縫洩漏」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付頻帶屏蔽證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Identify seam leakage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver band-specific shield evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：金屬厚度足夠就可忽略接縫。本步先檢查「定義干擾源和受害者」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到頻譜與敏感節點決定屏蔽需求，不是只看最高時鐘。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：金屬厚度足夠就可忽略接縫。本步先檢查「辨識接縫洩漏」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到長縫可能成有效天線，金屬本體厚度再大也未必有用。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Sufficient metal thickness makes seams irrelevant. First check whether evidence for define source and victim actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Spectrum and sensitive nodes define shielding needs, not only maximum clock.

Misinterpretation to reject: Sufficient metal thickness makes seams irrelevant. First check whether evidence for identify seam leakage actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Long seams can act as antennas regardless of wall thickness.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。

建立量測計畫：觀察阻抗最低點及反共振峰而不只容量。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.
Mark this question on your own diagram: ESL and placement paths limit decoupling effectiveness. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Inspect impedance minima and antiresonance peaks, not only capacitance. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

guides.concept: 先用「界定負載電荷」建立判讀邊界。電流脈衝面積才是電荷需求，峰值相同的兩個脈衝可能需要不同儲能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define load charge to define the interpretation boundary. Pulse area determines charge; equal peak currents can require different stored charge. procedure: 觀察站 1｜界定負載電荷：觀察焦點：畫兩個峰值相同而寬度不同的負載脈衝，積分比較。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜辨識反共振：觀察焦點：對兩支路並聯模型掃頻，記錄峰頻與阻尼變化。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付去耦證據：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：用相同負載與頻帶比較兩種佈局，不用電容顆數替代結果。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define load charge: Observation focus: Draw equal-peak pulses of different duration and compare their integrals. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Identify antiresonance: Observation focus: Sweep a two-branch parallel model and record peak frequency and damping. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver decoupling evidence: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Compare two layouts under identical load and band, rather than by capacitor count. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

以「交付去耦證據：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Identify antiresonance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver decoupling evidence: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：並聯越多種容量必定降低所有頻率阻抗。本步先檢查「界定負載電荷」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到電流脈衝面積才是電荷需求，峰值相同的兩個脈衝可能需要不同儲能。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：並聯越多種容量必定降低所有頻率阻抗。本步先檢查「辨識反共振」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到不同電容支路的感性與容性可形成高阻抗峰，總容量大仍可能失敗。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Paralleling more values always lowers impedance at every frequency. First check whether evidence for define load charge actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Pulse area determines charge; equal peak currents can require different stored charge.

Misinterpretation to reject: Paralleling more values always lowers impedance at every frequency. First check whether evidence for identify antiresonance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Inductive and capacitive branches can produce an impedance peak despite large total capacitance.

guides.concept: 先用「定義熱通量分布」建立判讀邊界。熱點位置比平均功率更能決定通道需求，上游與下游溫差也不可忽略。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define heat-flux distribution to define the interpretation boundary. Hotspot locations can govern channel needs more strongly than average power; upstream-downstream gradients matter. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義熱通量分布：觀察焦點：畫一個集中熱點，分別置於入口及出口比較。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜驗證溫度場：觀察焦點：比較兩種熱點形狀，保持總熱量及流量相同。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜提交系統權衡：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：交付正常與堵塞兩工況，清楚區分假設及實測資料。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define heat-flux distribution: Observation focus: Place the same hotspot near inlet and outlet and compare. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Validate temperature fields: Observation focus: Compare two hotspot shapes at identical total heat and flow. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Submit a system tradeoff: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Deliver normal and blocked conditions, separating assumptions from measured data. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「驗證溫度場」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「提交系統權衡：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Validate temperature fields: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Submit a system tradeoff: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「定義熱通量分布」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到熱點位置比平均功率更能決定通道需求，上游與下游溫差也不可忽略。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：通道愈窄總系統能耗必定愈低。本步先檢查「驗證溫度場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到流體出口平均溫度不能代表晶片峰值，需把固體導熱和流體對流連接。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for define heat-flux distribution actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Hotspot locations can govern channel needs more strongly than average power; upstream-downstream gradients matter.

Misinterpretation to reject: Narrower channels always reduce total system energy. First check whether evidence for validate temperature fields actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mean outlet temperature is not peak die temperature; couple solid conduction to fluid convection.

guides.title: 氣密封裝與漏率檢測：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Hermetic packaging and leak testing: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 氣密封裝的外觀不能證明漏率。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Appearance cannot establish package leak rate. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察晶粒、接線與封裝；不應模仿拆殼通電，照片沒有提供雷射安全分類的量測。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：氣密封裝的外觀不能證明漏率。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：區分粗漏、細漏與水氣侵入測試。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe die, wires and package; do not infer laser classification from the photograph or reproduce powered operation of a decapped laser.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Appearance cannot establish package leak rate. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Distinguish gross-leak, fine-leak and moisture-ingress tests. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「區分粗漏、細漏與水氣侵入測試」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Distinguish gross-leak, fine-leak and moisture-ingress tests, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define hermetic boundary to define the interpretation boundary. Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal. procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義氣密邊界：觀察焦點：逐一標出焊縫及電氣穿越處。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜先辨粗漏：觀察焦點：列出示蹤注入與量測延遲造成的偏差。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜建立氣密證據鏈：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：讓同學重算一份漏率報告。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define hermetic boundary: Observation focus: Mark each seam and electrical crossing. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Screen gross leaks first: Observation focus: List biases from tracer charging and measurement delay. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Build hermetic evidence chain: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Have a peer reconstruct one leak report. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「先辨粗漏」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「建立氣密證據鏈：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Screen gross leaks first: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Build hermetic evidence chain: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：氦細漏合格即可省略粗漏檢查。本步先檢查「定義氣密邊界」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到腔體、蓋板與穿通件共同形成密封邊界。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：氦細漏合格即可省略粗漏檢查。本步先檢查「先辨粗漏」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到大漏可能讓示蹤氣體在量測前流失，導致細漏假陰性。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for define hermetic boundary actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Cavity, lid and feedthroughs jointly define the seal.

Misinterpretation to reject: Passing helium fine leak eliminates the need for gross-leak screening. First check whether evidence for screen gross leaks first actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A gross leak can lose tracer before measurement, causing a fine-leak false negative.

guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：溫度循環的失效機制不等同恆溫老化。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：記錄溫差、停留、升降速率及失效位置。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Temperature cycling does not reproduce constant-temperature aging. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Record range, dwell, ramp rate and failure location. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「記錄溫差、停留、升降速率及失效位置」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record range, dwell, ramp rate and failure location, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 封裝溫度循環可靠度：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Package thermal-cycling reliability: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義服役溫度史」建立判讀邊界。幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define service thermal history to define the interpretation boundary. Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義服役溫度史：觀察焦點：列完整時間軸而非只寫高低溫。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜定位首發失效：觀察焦點：結合分段測試與影像縮小位置。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：寫出資料能支持與不能支持的壽命主張。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define service thermal history: Observation focus: Record a full timeline, not only extremes. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Locate first failure: Observation focus: Combine segmented testing and imaging to localize. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: State which life claims the data support and do not support. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「定位首發失效」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「完成可靠度結論：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Locate first failure: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Complete reliability conclusion: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定義服役溫度史」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到幅度、平均溫度、停留與升降速率都影響損傷。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：零失效樣品可以證明永不失效。本步先檢查「定位首發失效」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到串聯菊鏈只指出某段異常，不能直接識別每個焊點。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for define service thermal history actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Amplitude, mean temperature, dwell and ramp all affect damage.

Misinterpretation to reject: Zero failed samples prove infinite life. First check whether evidence for locate first failure actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: A daisy chain identifies a faulty segment, not automatically the individual joint.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Solder-life models require the appropriate strain metric. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察接點及焊料形貌；不可從灰階判定銅柱材料、界面反應或機械可靠度。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：焊點壽命模型必須對應正確應變指標。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用多個負載條件擬合並保留驗證組。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Inspect joints and solder morphology; greyscale alone cannot identify copper-pillar composition, interfacial reactions or mechanical reliability.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Solder-life models require the appropriate strain metric. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Fit several load conditions and retain a validation set. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Build thermal loading to define the interpretation boundary. Peaks, dwell and ramp determine viscoplastic history. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜建立溫度載荷：觀察焦點：輸入完整循環而不是單一 ΔT。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜套用應變壽命比例：觀察焦點：重算 4000 至 1000 的比例例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付壽命區間：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：比較指數 2 與 1.5 的預測並說明差異。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Build thermal loading: Observation focus: Specify the full cycle rather than only ΔT. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Apply strain-life scaling: Observation focus: Recalculate the 4000-to-1000 scaling example. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver life intervals: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Compare exponents 2 and 1.5 and explain the difference. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Apply strain-life scaling: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver life intervals: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：所有焊料都可共用同一疲勞常數。本步先檢查「建立溫度載荷」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到峰值、停留與升降速率決定焊點黏塑性歷史。所指出的物理限制。

guides.concept: X 光投影重疊不能當作三維斷層。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。

procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. This Quilt Packaging microscopy image is not an X-ray CT slice or tomographic reconstruction. Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define inspection target: Observation focus: List minimum relevant size for each class. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Report detection limits: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Distinguish not detected from proven absent. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Report detection limits: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：更小體素必定有同等更高解析度。本步先檢查「定義檢測目標」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到空洞、橋接與裂紋的尺度和方向不同，需先說明要檢出的缺陷。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：更小體素必定有同等更高解析度。本步先檢查「選擇重建與校正」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到濾波、環狀修正與去噪可能改變細節，不可當成中性處理。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for define inspection target actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Voids, bridges and cracks differ in scale and orientation; define the target first.

Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for select reconstruction and correction actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Filtering, ring correction and denoising can alter detail.

guides.titleEn: Low-loss silicon-nitride waveguides: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: SiN 低損耗需要分開吸收與散射。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Low-loss SiN requires separating absorption and scattering. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。作為光子材料製備設備及無塵操作情境；不代表特定 SiN、SOI 或量產配方。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：SiN 低損耗需要分開吸收與散射。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：用波長與長度掃描找出損耗來源。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Context for photonics material preparation and clean handling, not a particular SiN, SOI or production recipe.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Low-loss SiN requires separating absorption and scattering. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use wavelength and length sweeps to investigate loss origin. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「用波長與長度掃描找出損耗來源」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use wavelength and length sweeps to investigate loss origin, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
