guides.titleEn: Low-loss silicon-nitride waveguides: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「選定工作頻帶」建立判讀邊界。低損耗需連到特定波長，鍵結吸收與包覆會形成頻譜限制。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Choose operating band to define the interpretation boundary. Low loss is wavelength-specific; bond absorption and cladding limit spectra. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜選定工作頻帶：觀察焦點：標記預定波段及可能吸收區。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜配置低損耗量測：觀察焦點：增加有效長差並保留漂移參考。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付低損耗主張：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：區分單顆最佳值與跨晶片分布。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Choose operating band: Observation focus: Mark operating and possible absorption bands. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Plan low-loss measurement: Observation focus: Increase effective length difference and retain a drift reference. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a low-loss claim: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Separate best-device results from cross-die distributions. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「配置低損耗量測」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付低損耗主張：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plan low-loss measurement: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a low-loss claim: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：負載 Q 可不經校正直接當內部 Q。本步先檢查「選定工作頻帶」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到低損耗需連到特定波長，鍵結吸收與包覆會形成頻譜限制。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：負載 Q 可不經校正直接當內部 Q。本步先檢查「配置低損耗量測」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到損耗很低時，短測試線差值接近量測漂移。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Loaded Q directly equals intrinsic Q. First check whether evidence for choose operating band actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Low loss is wavelength-specific; bond absorption and cladding limit spectra.

Misinterpretation to reject: Loaded Q directly equals intrinsic Q. First check whether evidence for plan low-loss measurement actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: At very low loss, short-length differences approach measurement drift.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Edge-coupler design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 邊緣模式轉換與端面品質共同決定耦合。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Mode conversion and facet quality jointly set edge coupling. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：邊緣模式轉換與端面品質共同決定耦合。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：掃描橫向偏移與端面間隙的插入損耗。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Mode conversion and facet quality jointly set edge coupling. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Scan insertion loss against lateral offset and facet gap. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「掃描橫向偏移與端面間隙的插入損耗」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Scan insertion loss against lateral offset and facet gap, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Edge-coupler design: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「比較晶片與光纖模場」建立判讀邊界。模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Compare chip and fiber modes to define the interpretation boundary. Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜比較晶片與光纖模場：觀察焦點：畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 2｜建立橫向容差：觀察焦點：重算 1 μm 偏移的 1.09 dB 例。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
觀察站 3｜交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收：觀察焦點：把模場半徑與直徑寫成兩個不同欄位。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Compare chip and fiber modes: Observation focus: Draw two equal-power normalized fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 2 | Build lateral tolerance: Observation focus: Recalculate 1.09 dB loss at 1 μm offset. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.

Observation station 3 | Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance: Observation focus: Record mode radius and diameter as separate fields. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立橫向容差」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付耦合器規格：反證與驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build lateral tolerance: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver coupler specification: challenge and acceptance to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「比較晶片與光纖模場」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到模式尺寸差異會限制耦合，即使幾何中心完全重合。所指出的物理限制。
需排除的錯判：錐尖越窄就一定越低損耗。本步先檢查「建立橫向容差」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到較大模場可增加偏移容忍，但也改變封裝尺寸需求。所指出的物理限制。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for compare chip and fiber modes actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.

Misinterpretation to reject: A narrower taper tip always gives lower loss. First check whether evidence for build lateral tolerance actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Larger modes tolerate offset but alter package requirements.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 光纖陣列主動對準：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Active alignment of fiber arrays: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 主動對準尋找光功率最大值而非影像中心。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Active alignment maximizes optical power, not image centering. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：主動對準尋找光功率最大值而非影像中心。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：保留搜尋軌跡、多通道功率及固定後損失。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Active alignment maximizes optical power, not image centering. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Record search trajectories, channel powers and post-fixation loss. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「保留搜尋軌跡、多通道功率及固定後損失」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record search trajectories, channel powers and post-fixation loss, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光纖陣列主動對準：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Active alignment of fiber arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義光功率參考面：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。輸出讀值同時含雷射、纖線、耦合與晶片路徑；搜尋目標須先正規化。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define optical power reference planes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Output includes source, fiber, coupling and chip paths; normalize the objective before searching. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義光功率參考面：模型與設計：使用分光參考同步記錄輸入與輸出，判別源漂移與耦合變化。
觀察站 2｜設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計：以一強一弱通道比較總和最大與最差通道最大兩解。
觀察站 3｜交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別：重複卸載重裝並比較每通道分布，不只報一次最佳值。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define optical power reference planes: model and design: Record input reference and output together to separate source drift from coupling change.
Observation station 2 | Set an array objective: model and design: Compare maximum sum and maximum worst-channel solutions for unequal channels.
Observation station 3 | Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis: Repeat unload/reload and compare channel distributions, not one best result.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設定陣列目標函數：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可重複定位結果：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Set an array objective: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver repeatable alignment results: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「輸出變亮一定表示位置更準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「總功率最大即每通道都最佳」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Higher output always means better position" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Maximum total power means every channel is optimum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：被動對準依靠機械基準與統計容差。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Passive alignment depends on datums and statistical tolerances. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測裝配後分布並与耦合容差窗口比較」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare assembly distributions with coupling tolerance windows, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光纖陣列被動對準：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Passive alignment of fiber arrays: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「設定機械與光學基準：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。晶片邊緣不一定與波導端點共線；裝配需定義可量測的基準轉換。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Set mechanical and optical datums: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. The chip edge need not coincide with waveguide endpoints; assembly requires measurable datum transforms. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜設定機械與光學基準：模型與設計：把圖面基準、視覺標記與模態中心標在同一圖上。
觀察站 2｜分配纖距公差：模型與設計：繪製通道序號對位置誤差並擬合斜率。
觀察站 3｜交付可製造性證據：量測與判別：比較跨批次合格比例與返工原因，標記未量測的公差。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Set mechanical and optical datums: model and design: Mark drawing datums, vision marks and mode centers in one coordinate map.
Observation station 2 | Allocate fiber-pitch tolerances: model and design: Plot position error by channel number and fit the slope.
Observation station 3 | Deliver manufacturability evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare cross-lot pass fractions and rework causes, marking unmeasured tolerances.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分配纖距公差：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付可製造性證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Allocate fiber-pitch tolerances: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver manufacturability evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「晶片切邊就是光學中心的精確基準」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「只測中間纖芯足以驗證整排」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "A diced edge is an exact optical-center datum" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Testing the middle core validates the entire array" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 偏振分光旋轉器：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Polarization splitter-rotators: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 偏振分光與偏振旋轉是兩種功能。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Polarization splitting and rotation are distinct functions. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：偏振分光與偏振旋轉是兩種功能。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：建立 TE/TM 輸入與兩個輸出的功率矩陣。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Polarization splitting and rotation are distinct functions. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Build a power matrix for TE/TM inputs and both outputs. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「建立 TE/TM 輸入與兩個輸出的功率矩陣」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Build a power matrix for TE/TM inputs and both outputs, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「定義偏振端口：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。TE/TM 標籤以波導主電場和傳播軸定義，不能直接沿用光纖接頭的上下方向。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define polarization-resolved ports: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. TE/TM labels depend on waveguide field and propagation axes, not simply connector orientation. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義偏振端口：模型與設計：畫座標及每個端口允許的模式，核對注入模式名稱。
觀察站 2｜量測偏振串擾：模型與設計：在兩端口分別量 TE/TM，形成四項功率矩陣。
觀察站 3｜交付模式可追溯資料：量測與判別：用保存的多模 S 參數重建兩種入射偏振測試。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define polarization-resolved ports: model and design: Draw coordinates and supported modes at each port and check excitation labels.
Observation station 2 | Measure polarization crosstalk: model and design: Measure TE/TM at both outputs to form a four-entry power matrix.
Observation station 3 | Deliver mode-traceable data: measurement and diagnosis: Reconstruct both input-polarization tests from saved multimode S-parameters.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「量測偏振串擾：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付模式可追溯資料：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Measure polarization crosstalk: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver mode-traceable data: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「TE 就是任何照片中的水平方向」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「只量一個端口就能取得完整偏振矩陣」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "TE always means horizontal in a photograph" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "One port yields a complete polarization matrix" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 馬赫曾德爾調變器：從圖像建立驗證證據

guides.concept: MZM 的光學相位與電極傳播都影響頻寬。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Optical phase and electrode propagation both affect MZM bandwidth. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。

建立量測計畫：分別驗證 VπL、插入損耗及電光 S21。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。

procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Build a measurement plan: Validate VπL, insertion loss and electro-optic S21 separately. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.

guides.title: 鍺光偵測器整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Germanium photodetector integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光偵測器材料要由來源與結構確認。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Detector material requires provenance and structure evidence. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。右側為雷射小晶粒，左側較大晶粒為監測光二極體；不是整合鍺光偵測器的材料證據。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光偵測器材料要由來源與結構確認。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：分別量測響應度、暗電流與頻寬。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The smaller right-hand die is the laser and the larger left-hand die the monitor photodiode; this does not establish an integrated germanium detector.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Detector material requires provenance and structure evidence. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure responsivity, dark current and bandwidth separately. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「分別量測響應度、暗電流與頻寬」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure responsivity, dark current and bandwidth separately, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 鍺光偵測器整合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Germanium photodetector integration: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義吸收區與光路：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。矽波導把光模態引入 Ge 吸收區，重疊與長度共同決定吸收。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define absorber and optical path: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. A silicon guide delivers a mode to the Ge absorber; overlap and length jointly set absorption. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義吸收區與光路：模型與設計：畫模態在 Ge 與 Si 的分布，分開耦入與吸收損失。
觀察站 2｜校準功率參考面：模型與設計：以參考波導量耦入損失，再分别報外部與去嵌響應。
觀察站 3｜交付光電模型：量測與判別：以獨立功率與溫度點驗證電流及頻率預測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define absorber and optical path: model and design: Map the mode in Ge/Si and separate coupling from absorption loss.
Observation station 2 | Calibrate the power reference plane: model and design: Use a reference guide to assess coupling and report external/de-embedded response separately.
Observation station 3 | Deliver an optoelectronic model: measurement and diagnosis: Validate current and frequency predictions at independent power/temperature points.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「校準功率參考面：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付光電模型：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Calibrate the power reference plane: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver an optoelectronic model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「只要有 Ge 就能吸收所有入射光」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「功率計讀值可直接當吸收區入射功率」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Any Ge region absorbs all incident light" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Power-meter readings directly equal absorber input power" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜劃分吸收與乘增區：模型與設計：畫材料、光生成與高場位置，核對載子走向。
觀察站 2｜建立完整噪聲預算：模型與設計：在相同噪聲頻寬比較低增益和高增益的總 SNR。
觀察站 3｜交付接收器適用性：量測與判別：在同一資料速率與誤碼定義下比較數個增益工作點。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Separate absorption and multiplication regions: model and design: Map materials, photogeneration and high field and check carrier travel.
Observation station 2 | Build a full noise budget: model and design: Compare total SNR at low/high gain using the same noise bandwidth.
Observation station 3 | Deliver receiver suitability evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare gain operating points at common data rate and error definition.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「建立完整噪聲預算：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付接收器適用性：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Build a full noise budget: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver receiver suitability evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「吸收與乘增必須在同一材料同一位置」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「信號增加十倍就表示 SNR 增加十倍」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Absorption and multiplication must occur at one material/location" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "Tenfold signal always means tenfold SNR" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.title: 矽光子熱光相移器：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Silicon-photonic thermo-optic phase shifters: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 熱光調相效率與熱串擾要一起評估。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Thermo-optic efficiency and thermal crosstalk must be assessed together. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：熱光調相效率與熱串擾要一起評估。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較 Pπ、響應時間及鄰近光路漂移。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Thermo-optic efficiency and thermal crosstalk must be assessed together. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare Pπ, response time and neighboring-path drift. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較 Pπ、響應時間及鄰近光路漂移」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare Pπ, response time and neighboring-path drift, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.concept: 先用「定義加熱與光學區：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。加熱器位置決定熱流路徑，金屬靠近波導也可能增加光吸收。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define heater and optical regions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Heater placement sets heat-flow paths, while metal near a guide can increase optical absorption. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義加熱與光學區：模型與設計：在截面同時標電流、熱流和光模態。

觀察站 3｜交付控制模型：量測與判別：以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define heater and optical regions: model and design: Mark current, heat flow and optical mode on one cross-section.
Observation station 2 | Calculate a lumped time constant: model and design: Recalculate 2.00 ms and check the 63.2% step-response time.
Observation station 3 | Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「求集總時間常數：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付控制模型：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Calculate a lumped time constant: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a control model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「加熱器越靠近光芯只有好處」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「時間常數等於達到完全穩態的時間」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Moving a heater closer to the optical core has only benefits" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "The time constant is the time to full steady state" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

guides.concept: 載子耗盡調變同時改變相位與損耗。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Carrier-depletion modulation changes phase and loss. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：載子耗盡調變同時改變相位與損耗。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以偏壓掃描相位、吸收與接面電容。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Carrier-depletion modulation changes phase and loss. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Sweep phase, absorption and junction capacitance versus bias. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以偏壓掃描相位、吸收與接面電容」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Sweep phase, absorption and junction capacitance versus bias, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 載子耗盡相位調變：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Carrier-depletion phase modulation: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「定義接面與反向偏壓：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。反向偏壓擴大耗盡區，改變與光模態重疊的自由載子，不是注入大量少數載子。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define junction and reverse bias: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Reverse bias widens depletion and changes free carriers overlapping the mode, rather than injecting many minority carriers. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義接面與反向偏壓：模型與設計：畫 p/n 區、電壓極性與耗盡變化方向。
觀察站 2｜界定串聯電阻：模型與設計：用等效電路標出源、接觸與接面，檢查去嵌位置。
觀察站 3｜交付一致偏壓模型：量測與判別：用同一器件資料集預測 MZI 或微環響應並留獨立驗證點。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define junction and reverse bias: model and design: Draw p/n regions, voltage polarity and depletion expansion.
Observation station 2 | Define series resistance: model and design: Map source, contacts and junction in the equivalent circuit and check de-embedding planes.
Observation station 3 | Deliver a consistent bias model: measurement and diagnosis: Predict MZI/ring response from one consistent dataset and reserve independent validation points.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「界定串聯電阻：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付一致偏壓模型：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Define series resistance: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a consistent bias model: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 錯誤推論「耗盡調變就是正向注入載子」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
錯誤推論「50 Ω 儀器介面代表元件內部電阻一定 50 Ω」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: The incorrect inference "Depletion modulation is forward carrier injection" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.

The incorrect inference "A 50 Ω instrument implies a 50 Ω internal device" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: III-V 雷射與矽晶片接合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: III-V laser bonding to silicon chips: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: III-V 增益區與矽波導的光轉接不可省略。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: III-V gain-to-silicon optical transfer is an essential interface. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：III-V 增益區與矽波導的光轉接不可省略。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較接合層厚度、耦合損耗及熱阻。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: III-V gain-to-silicon optical transfer is an essential interface. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare bonding-layer thickness, coupling loss and thermal resistance. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較接合層厚度、耦合損耗及熱阻」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare bonding-layer thickness, coupling loss and thermal resistance, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: III-V 雷射與矽晶片接合：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: III-V laser bonding to silicon chips: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「混合與異質整合：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。對接已製成雷射與先接合材料再製作元件，是不同的流程與良率邊界。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Hybrid versus heterogeneous integration: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Attaching a completed laser and bonding material before device fabrication have different process and yield boundaries. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜混合與異質整合：模型與設計：繪出兩條流程並標示可以做 known-good-die 檢查的位置。
觀察站 2｜電流展布：模型與設計：將電壓降與熱像位置對照，區分光學吸收和接觸發熱。
觀察站 3｜量產可測試性：量測與判別：設計封裝前後同參考面的測試矩陣，區分新失效與原有裸晶缺陷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Hybrid versus heterogeneous integration: model and design: Draw both flows and mark where known-good-die screening is possible.
Observation station 2 | Current spreading: model and design: Correlate voltage drop with thermal position to distinguish absorption from contact heating.
Observation station 3 | Production testability: measurement and diagnosis: Design pre/post-package tests at matched planes to separate new failures from pre-existing die defects.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「電流展布：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「量產可測試性：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Current spreading: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Production testability: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：封裝外殼溫度永遠等於接面溫度。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Case temperature always equals junction temperature. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

Observation station 3 | Traceability coding: measurement and diagnosis: Link donor position, screening result, stamp batch and target position, then perform a reverse trace.

guides.title: 矽上量子點雷射研究：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Quantum-dot lasers on silicon research: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 量子點雷射研究成果要區分材料和系統層級。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Distinguish material- and system-level quantum-dot laser results. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。辨認雷射裸晶尺度；這不是矽上量子點雷射或微轉印製程的實拍。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：量子點雷射研究成果要區分材料和系統層級。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較閾值、斜率效率與老化條件。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Orient laser-die scale; this is not a quantum-dot-on-silicon laser or a micro-transfer-printing process photograph.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Distinguish material- and system-level quantum-dot laser results. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Compare threshold, slope efficiency and aging conditions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較閾值、斜率效率與老化條件」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare threshold, slope efficiency and aging conditions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use System integration acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.concept: 外接雷射移出熱源但增加光路與連接損失。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An external laser moves heat but adds optical and connector loss. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察晶粒、接線與封裝；不應模仿拆殼通電，照片沒有提供雷射安全分類的量測。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：外接雷射移出熱源但增加光路與連接損失。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：列出連接器、分光器及冗餘光源的功率預算。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe die, wires and package; do not infer laser classification from the photograph or reproduce powered operation of a decapped laser.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An external laser moves heat but adds optical and connector loss. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Budget connector, splitter and redundant-source power. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「列出連接器、分光器及冗餘光源的功率預算」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Budget connector, splitter and redundant-source power, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 外接光源光引擎：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: External-laser optical engines: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「光源與調變分工：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。外接雷射提供連續光，資料可在光引擎內調變；兩者的頻寬與管理責任不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Source-modulator partition: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. An external laser supplies CW light while an engine may modulate data; their bandwidth and management roles differ. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜光源與調變分工：模型與設計：畫出光源、分光、調變與接收參考面，標出哪些線承載資料。
觀察站 2｜冗餘光源：模型與設計：畫最小割集，分開雷射、供電與共用光纖的失效域。
觀察站 3｜備品與恢復：量測與判別：建立更換前後基線和回復測試，記錄服務中斷及降級容量。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Source-modulator partition: model and design: Draw source, splitter, modulator and receiver planes and mark which paths carry data.
Observation station 2 | Redundant sources: model and design: Draw minimal cut sets separating lasers, power and shared-fiber failure domains.
Observation station 3 | Spares and restoration: measurement and diagnosis: Create pre/post-replacement baselines and restoration tests, recording interruption and degraded capacity.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「冗餘光源：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「備品與恢復：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Redundant sources: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Spares and restoration: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：每路都保有原光源完整功率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：每路都保有原光源完整功率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Every branch retains full source power. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 光子晶片光開關矩陣：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Photonic-chip optical-switch matrices: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光開關矩陣的路徑數增加累積損耗。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: More switch stages accumulate path loss. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光開關矩陣的路徑數增加累積損耗。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：針對每條路徑記錄插入損耗與串音。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.
Mark this question on your own diagram: More switch stages accumulate path loss. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Record insertion loss and crosstalk for each route. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「針對每條路徑記錄插入損耗與串音」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record insertion loss and crosstalk for each route, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子晶片光開關矩陣：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Photonic-chip optical-switch matrices: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「非阻塞定義：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。嚴格非阻塞與可重排非阻塞不同；後者可能需改變既有連線。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Nonblocking definitions: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Strictly nonblocking and rearrangeably nonblocking differ; the latter may need existing connections changed. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜非阻塞定義：模型與設計：用四埠圖列兩種需求，檢查新連線是否迫使舊路由搬移。
觀察站 2｜監測埠配置：模型與設計：畫每個可疑單元到監測埠的路徑，找出无法區分的一對故障。
觀察站 3｜抽測覆蓋：量測與判別：選最長、最短、最大共用及相鄰高負載路徑，說明選樣理由。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Nonblocking definitions: model and design: Use a four-port graph to test whether a new connection forces an existing route to move.
Observation station 2 | Monitor placement: model and design: Trace suspect units to monitors and find an indistinguishable fault pair.
Observation station 3 | Sampled test coverage: measurement and diagnosis: Select longest, shortest, most shared and heavily loaded adjacent routes and justify coverage.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「監測埠配置：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「抽測覆蓋：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Monitor placement: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Sampled test coverage: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：可重排非阻塞表示永不需要改變舊路由。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：可重排非阻塞表示永不需要改變舊路由。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Rearrangeably nonblocking means old routes never change. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Complex-field representation: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Linear photonic networks act on complex fields; power retains squared amplitude but loses phase. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜複數場表示：模型與設計：比較等功率、不同相位的兩組輸入干涉結果。
觀察站 2｜相位規約：模型與設計：在固定規約下比對複數矩陣，避免把可忽略全域相位當元件故障。
觀察站 3｜任務層驗收：量測與判別：比較同一網格的路由與濾波任務，列對各任務最敏感的誤差。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Complex-field representation: model and design: Compare interference for two inputs with equal powers but different phases.
Observation station 2 | Phase convention: model and design: Compare complex matrices under a fixed convention rather than treating irrelevant global phase as failure.
Observation station 3 | Task-level acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Compare routing and filtering on the same mesh and identify each task's most sensitive errors.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「相位規約：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「任務層驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Phase convention: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Task-level acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: 相干光接收器整合：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Coherent optical-receiver integration: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 同調接收要同時維持振幅、相位及偏振資訊。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Coherent receivers preserve amplitude, phase and polarization. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察光學平台和量測鏈的組織；不是某一課的同調接收器、光達或頻率梳實測。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：同調接收要同時維持振幅、相位及偏振資訊。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：比較 I/Q 不平衡、雜訊與星座圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe the organization of an optical bench and measurement chain; not a measured coherent receiver, lidar or frequency-comb dataset for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Coherent receivers preserve amplitude, phase and polarization. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare I/Q imbalance, noise and constellations. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「比較 I/Q 不平衡、雜訊與星座圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare I/Q imbalance, noise and constellations, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子晶片量子光源：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Quantum light sources on photonic chips: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：量子光源要驗證光子統計與多光子機率。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Quantum sources require photon-statistics and multiphoton checks. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「量測符合計數、背景與 g² 及不確定度」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Measure coincidences, background and g² with uncertainties, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Spontaneous four-wave mixing can create correlated pairs; classical gain or bright spectra alone are not quantum evidence. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜自發與受激：模型與設計：將平均功率、單光子計數與符合計數分為三種不同觀察。
觀察站 2｜符合視窗：模型與設計：比較三種視窗的原始符合、旁窗背景及淨符合。
觀察站 3｜可擴展性證據：量測與判別：比較兩顆獨立源的干涉與跨晶片重複性，列尚未驗證的整合項。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Spontaneous versus stimulated processes: model and design: Separate mean power, singles and coincidences as three different observations.
Observation station 2 | Coincidence window: model and design: Compare raw, side-window background and net coincidences for three windows.
Observation station 3 | Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis: Compare interference from two independent sources and cross-chip repeatability, listing unverified integration items.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「符合視窗：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「可擴展性證據：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Coincidence window: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Scaling evidence: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：觀測符合率一定等於光子對產生率。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.title: 光子晶片晶圓級光測試：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Wafer-level optical testing of photonic chips: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 晶圓光測試要分離耦合器與元件損耗。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Wafer optical tests must separate coupler and device loss. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：晶圓光測試要分離耦合器與元件損耗。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用參考結構、重複探測及晶圓位置圖。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Wafer optical tests must separate coupler and device loss. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use reference structures, repeated probing and wafer-position maps. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用參考結構、重複探測及晶圓位置圖」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use reference structures, repeated probing and wafer-position maps, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子晶片晶圓級光測試：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer-level optical testing of photonic chips: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「晶圓座標：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。缺口方向、晶粒索引與探測台座標需一致，否則缺陷可能被歸到錯誤晶粒。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Wafer coordinates: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Notch orientation, die indices and stage coordinates must agree to avoid assigning defects to the wrong die. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜晶圓座標：模型與設計：以未參與校正的標記檢查旋轉與平移殘差，保留原始晶粒圖。
觀察站 2｜電光同步：模型與設計：同步保存電壓、電流、光功率與時間戳，量測等待時間敏感度。
觀察站 3｜資料交接：量測與判別：交付可追溯的原始譜、晶粒圖、校正檔與不確定度，並重算一個抽樣晶粒。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Wafer coordinates: model and design: Check rotation and translation on withheld marks and retain the raw die map.
Observation station 2 | Electro-optic synchronization: model and design: Record voltage, current, power and timestamps; test sensitivity to settling time.
Observation station 3 | Data handoff: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver raw spectra, die maps, calibration files and uncertainty; independently recalculate a sampled die.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「電光同步：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「資料交接：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Electro-optic synchronization: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Data handoff: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：未測晶粒應自動算通過。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Untested dies automatically count as passes. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「模型分區：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。電路功耗、熱傳、機械變形和光學模態的網格及時間尺度不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Model partition: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. Power, heat transport, deformation and optical modes have different meshes and time scales. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜模型分區：模型與設計：畫出單向或雙向耦合流程，標出傳遞溫度、位移與材料張量的介面。
觀察站 2｜光彈與幾何：模型與設計：分別關閉幾何及材料項作敏感度比較，避免重複計入。
觀察站 3｜模型驗收：量測與判別：保留一組不同功耗及邊界條件資料作盲驗證，報告殘差位置。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Model partition: model and design: Draw one- or two-way coupling and mark transfer of temperature, displacement and material tensors.
Observation station 2 | Photoelasticity and geometry: model and design: Toggle geometric and material terms separately in sensitivity analysis to avoid double counting.
Observation station 3 | Model acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Withhold a different power/boundary dataset for blind validation and map residuals.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「光彈與幾何：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「模型驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Photoelasticity and geometry: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Model acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: 光路溫度漂移補償：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical-path thermal-drift compensation: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：漂移補償必須考慮感測雜訊及控制穩定度。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Drift compensation includes sensor noise and loop stability. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「對照開迴路漂移及閉迴路殘差」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Compare open-loop drift with closed-loop residuals, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

Use Recalibration: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Graph model: model and design: Tag failures separately for sources, couplers, controllers and cooling.
