guides.title: 封裝應力對光學相位的影響：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Package-stress effects on optical phase: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 應力致相位包含幾何變化及光彈效應。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Stress-induced phase includes geometry and photoelasticity. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：應力致相位包含幾何變化及光彈效應。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：使用應變、偏振及相位差量測分離機制。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Stress-induced phase includes geometry and photoelasticity. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Separate mechanisms using strain, polarization and phase measurements. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「使用應變、偏振及相位差量測分離機制」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Separate mechanisms using strain, polarization and phase measurements, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光子晶片製程設計套件：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Photonic process-design kits: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: PDK 模型須對應製程版本與統計角落。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: PDK models must match process versions and statistical corners. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：PDK 模型須對應製程版本與統計角落。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以版圖規則、測試結構及模型版本驗證。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: PDK models must match process versions and statistical corners. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Verify layout rules, test structures and model versions. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以版圖規則、測試結構及模型版本驗證」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Verify layout rules, test structures and model versions, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical I/O chiplets: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 光學 I/O 小晶片需有可比較的系統邊界。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Optical-I/O chiplets need comparable system boundaries. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。來源標示為光子晶片；不把未公開的材料、光源形式或電路功能當作照片可證明的事實。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：光學 I/O 小晶片需有可比較的系統邊界。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：標示是否計入雷射、驅動器及接收器功率。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. The source identifies a photonic chip; undisclosed materials, source architecture and circuit function cannot be inferred from appearance.
Mark this question on your own diagram: Optical-I/O chiplets need comparable system boundaries. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: State whether laser, driver and receiver power are included. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「標示是否計入雷射、驅動器及接收器功率」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: State whether laser, driver and receiver power are included, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

guides.title: 光學輸入輸出小晶片：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Optical I/O chiplets: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「單向與雙向：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。每方向容量要獨立列示，雙向相加只是特定總量定義。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Direction accounting: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. List capacities per direction; their sum is a particular aggregate convention. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜單向與雙向：模型與設計：依算例由通道數乘資料率重算，保留編碼及 FEC 開銷。
觀察站 2｜BER 統計：模型與設計：以測試位元數計算信賴上界，保留資料樣式與溫度。
觀察站 3｜比較展示：量測與判別：從官方案例做來源表，分開已展示、規劃和本課假設。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Direction accounting: model and design: Recalculate lanes times rate and retain coding/FEC overhead.
Observation station 2 | BER statistics: model and design: Compute a confidence bound from tested bits, retaining pattern and temperature.
Observation station 3 | Comparing demonstrations: measurement and diagnosis: Build a primary-source table separating demonstrated, planned and hypothetical claims.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「BER 統計：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「比較展示：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for BER statistics: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Comparing demonstrations: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：零錯誤測試等於證明 BER 精確為零。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Zero observed errors proves exactly zero BER. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.title: 光子與電子晶片共同設計：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Photonic-electronic co-design: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 電子與光子共同設計需要一致參考平面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Electronic-photonic co-design needs consistent reference planes. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。實體電光晶片與電接點接線；照片不足以辨別波導材料、調變頻寬或確定其為矽 PN 調變器。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：電子與光子共同設計需要一致參考平面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：連接電驅動、電光模型與光鏈路雜訊。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Physical electro-optic chip and electrical bonding; this photograph does not establish waveguide material, bandwidth or a silicon PN-modulator architecture.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Electronic-photonic co-design needs consistent reference planes. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Connect electrical drive, electro-optic models and link noise. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「連接電驅動、電光模型與光鏈路雜訊」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Connect electrical drive, electro-optic models and link noise, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Interface reference planes: model and design: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.

evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use End-to-end regression: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。

guides.title: 光收發器雷射安全與互鎖：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: Optical-transceiver laser safety and interlocks: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: 雷射安全必須依設備條件和聯鎖狀態驗證。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Laser safety depends on equipment conditions and interlock state. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。觀察晶粒、接線與封裝；不應模仿拆殼通電，照片沒有提供雷射安全分類的量測。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：雷射安全必須依設備條件和聯鎖狀態驗證。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以故障注入表檢查開蓋、斷線與失電的安全狀態。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Observe die, wires and package; do not infer laser classification from the photograph or reproduce powered operation of a decapped laser.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Laser safety depends on equipment conditions and interlock state. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Use a fault-injection table for cover opening, broken wires and power loss. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以故障注入表檢查開蓋、斷線與失電的安全狀態」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Use a fault-injection table for cover opening, broken wires and power loss, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Validation closure: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: 台積電 SoIC 堆疊整合案例：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: TSMC SoIC stacking case study: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: SoIC 案例不能以普通堆疊照片推定接合界面。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: An ordinary stacked assembly cannot establish a SoIC bond interface. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。以實際多晶片排列比較封裝幾何；不是 Foveros、SoIC 或混合接合剖面。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：SoIC 案例不能以普通堆疊照片推定接合界面。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：以公開平台資料標示接合、測試及熱邊界。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare physical multi-chip geometry; this is not a Foveros, SoIC or hybrid-bond cross-section.

Mark this question on your own diagram: An ordinary stacked assembly cannot establish a SoIC bond interface. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Annotate bonding, testing and thermal boundaries from public platform sources. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「以公開平台資料標示接合、測試及熱邊界」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Annotate bonding, testing and thermal boundaries from public platform sources, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.title: 台積電 SoIC 堆疊整合案例：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: TSMC SoIC stacking case study: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「平台與證據：模型與設計」建立判讀邊界。SoIC 公開架構說明垂直晶粒整合，不能由品牌名稱推出未公布的清洗或接合配方。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Platform and evidence: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. The public SoIC architecture describes vertical integration, not undisclosed cleaning or bonding recipes. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜平台與證據：模型與設計：建立公開來源與未知參數表，將設計假設分開記錄。
觀察站 2｜垂直寄生：模型與設計：以相同參考面比較 RLC 和頻率響應，不能僅看幾何長度。
觀察站 3｜後段封裝交接：量測與判別：把堆疊輸出接到 CoWoS 概念流程，重查熱、翹曲和測試責任。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Platform and evidence: model and design: Separate public evidence, unknown parameters and design assumptions.
Observation station 2 | Vertical parasitics: model and design: Compare RLC/frequency response at equal reference planes, not length alone.
Observation station 3 | Downstream packaging: measurement and diagnosis: Connect the stack to a CoWoS concept and recheck thermal, warpage and test ownership.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「垂直寄生：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「後段封裝交接：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Vertical parasitics: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Downstream packaging: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：已知良品表示晶粒在所有條件下絕對無缺陷。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：已知良品表示晶粒在所有條件下絕對無缺陷。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Known good means defect-free under every condition. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: Foveros 公開平台描述與產品結構要對照。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: Match Foveros platform descriptions to the specific product. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。以實際多晶片排列比較封裝幾何；不是 Foveros、SoIC 或混合接合剖面。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：Foveros 公開平台描述與產品結構要對照。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：記下基底晶粒、上層晶粒及電源路徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Compare physical multi-chip geometry; this is not a Foveros, SoIC or hybrid-bond cross-section.

Mark this question on your own diagram: Match Foveros platform descriptions to the specific product. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.
Build a measurement plan: Record base die, top die and power paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。

evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Record base die, top die and power paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.

Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜局部橋接架構：模型與設計：重畫原創概念剖面，標出橋、晶粒與有機基板，不複製廠商圖。
觀察站 2｜返回路連續：模型與設計：追蹤返回電流路徑並分析轉換點的共模與串音。
觀察站 3｜組合封裝驗收：量測與判別：用相同工作負載驗收完整路徑，不只測局部橋的傳遞。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Local bridge architecture: model and design: Draw an original section marking bridge, dies and organic substrate rather than copying vendor figures.
Observation station 2 | Return continuity: model and design: Trace return currents and inspect common mode/crosstalk at transitions.
Observation station 3 | Composite-package acceptance: measurement and diagnosis: Accept complete paths under a matched workload, not only bridge transmission.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「返回路連續：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「組合封裝驗收：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Return continuity: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Composite-package acceptance: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台：從圖像建立驗證證據
guides.titleEn: imec iSiPP silicon-photonics platform: from visual context to verification evidence
guides.concept: iSiPP 平台可用元件與服務版本需一致。照片能幫助定位元件和界面，但功能與可靠度需要可重複的量測。本工作單把「看見的物件」、「推論的機制」及「尚缺的證據」分成三欄，再與課內原創架構圖核對。
guides.conceptEn: iSiPP components must match the service/platform version. A photograph locates components and interfaces; function and reliability require repeatable measurements. This worksheet separates visible objects, inferred mechanisms and missing evidence before comparing the original course diagram.
procedure: 開啟圖片原檔及其授權來源，記錄作者、日期與是否有比例尺。代表性照片；不是本課量產配方或驗收資料。
在自己的架構圖標出這個觀察問題：iSiPP 平台可用元件與服務版本需一致。把確實可見的邊界畫實線，推定結構畫虛線；保留未知標籤。
建立量測計畫：查對官方元件清單、封裝介面及測試途徑。每一項都填入量測單位、儀器解析度、基準與重複次數；沒有資料就列為待量測。
選一個你可控制的因素，做標稱、偏低與偏高三種模擬情境。預先寫出哪些觀察可推翻你的解釋，再與課程算例或你自行提供的資料比較；示範數值一律標為假設。
回到所列的官方來源，確認原文描述的是平台能力、模擬範例、實測結果或驗收標準。交付一頁含來源、架構圖、觀察矩陣與未解問題的工程筆記。
procedureEn: Open the full image and license source; record author, date and whether a scale is provided. Representative photograph, not production instructions or acceptance data for this course.

Mark this question on your own diagram: iSiPP components must match the service/platform version. Draw visible boundaries as solid lines and inferred structures as dashed lines; retain unknown labels.

Build a measurement plan: Check official component lists, packaging interfaces and test paths. Specify units, instrument resolution, baseline and repetitions for each quantity; mark missing data as not yet measured.

Choose one controllable factor and model nominal, lower and higher cases. State in advance which observations would falsify your explanation. Compare with the course example or data you supply; label all illustrative numbers as assumptions.

Return to the official references and identify whether each statement describes platform capability, simulation, measurement or acceptance criteria. Deliver a one-page engineering note containing provenance, a diagram, observation matrix and unresolved questions.
evidence: 可見結構與原創架構圖之間的對照表；不以漂亮圖片代替量測。
針對「查對官方元件清單、封裝介面及測試途徑」列出的可執行量測計畫、單位與不確定度來源。
evidenceEn: A cross-reference between visible structure and the original diagram; attractive images do not substitute for measurement.
An actionable measurement plan for: Check official component lists, packaging interfaces and test paths, including units and sources of uncertainty.
pitfalls: 把代表性照片標成某廠商專有製程的實拍。
由單張外觀圖推論材料、內部結構或合格與否。
pitfallsEn: Relabeling a representative photograph as a proprietary vendor process.
Inferring materials, internal structure or acceptance from one exterior image.
guides.scope: 原創觀察與驗證工作單，可離線閱讀。照片為代表性情境；未附本題專屬實測資料或生產配方。
guides.scopeEn: Original observation and verification worksheet readable offline. Photos provide representative context; no dedicated measured dataset or production recipe is bundled.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Platform and wafer size: model and design to define the interpretation boundary. iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 are distinct platforms; diameter is not their only difference and libraries are not interchangeable. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜平台與晶圓尺寸：模型與設計：將公開功能、接合選項與可取得設計套件分開列示並標日期。

觀察站 3｜設計釋出：量測與判別：交付可追溯 manifest、已知限制和回歸結果，不宣稱公開文件等於完整流片許可。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Platform and wafer size: model and design: Date a table of public capabilities, integration options and available design kits.
Observation station 2 | Transfer-printed materials: model and design: Compare loss, phase and electrical behavior before/after integration, not merely function presence.
Observation station 3 | Design release: measurement and diagnosis: Deliver a traceable manifest, known limits and regression results; public documentation is not fabrication authorization.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「轉印材料：模型與設計」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「設計釋出：量測與判別」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Transfer-printed materials: model and design: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Design release: measurement and diagnosis to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.

guides.concept: 先用「辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界」建立判讀邊界。裸矽整備處理基板本體；薄膜 CMP 還須保護已形成的材料與圖案。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP to define the interpretation boundary. Bare-wafer finishing shapes the substrate; film CMP must also preserve existing layers and patterns. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜辨認裸矽晶圓與薄膜 CMP 的邊界：觀察「厚度達標」與「保留薄膜達標」是否指向不同的量測。
觀察站 2｜分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動：比較材料容易反應但接觸不良，以及接觸充分但漿料狀態不合適的兩種情境。
觀察站 3｜整合晶圓放行與異常處置：確認「尚無證據」沒有被寫成「已證明合格」，不同量測仍保留其基準。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish bare-wafer finishing from film CMP: Notice whether target wafer thickness and target remaining film require different measurements.
Observation station 2 | Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: Compare a reactive surface with poor contact against good contact with unsuitable slurry condition.
Observation station 3 | Integrate wafer release and disposition: Ensure missing evidence is not recorded as demonstrated compliance and each measurement retains its reference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「分解研磨墊、漿料與相對運動」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「整合晶圓放行與異常處置」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Separate pad, slurry and relative motion: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integrate wafer release and disposition to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若把金屬 CMP 的選擇性直接當成裸矽拋光規格，先退回材料清單重新界定。
把所有變化歸因於轉速會忽略墊面或漿料；重新建立一因一變的比較。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If metal-CMP selectivity is treated as a bare-silicon specification, revisit the material inventory.
Attributing every change to speed ignores the pad or slurry; restore a one-factor comparison.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify crystal orientation: Check whether the evidence supports: Orientation marks require ingot coordinates and diffraction evidence, not appearance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Measure total thickness variation: Check whether the evidence supports: TTV is maximum minus minimum thickness, not roughness. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release a slicing lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Release requires thickness, damage, edge and traceability evidence together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Identify the three-layer stack: Check whether the evidence supports: Top silicon, buried oxide and handle wafer have different roles. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Map top-silicon thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Thickness nonuniformity can translate into threshold-voltage variation. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Release the SOI stack: Check whether the evidence supports: Isolation, layer uniformity, bonding and thermal behavior require joint review. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

pitfalls: 常見錯判：TTV 與表面粗糙度可以互換。 應回到「辨認三層結構」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。

pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: TTV and surface roughness are interchangeable. Revisit assumptions and sampling for identify the three-layer stack and add discriminating evidence.

觀察站 3｜閘氧驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「厚度圖、介面、漏電與可靠度缺一不可。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。

Observation station 2 | Interpret ellipsometric thickness: Check whether the evidence supports: Optical thickness extraction requires index and stack assumptions. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the gate oxide: Check whether the evidence supports: Acceptance needs thickness mapping, interface quality, leakage and reliability. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「橢偏膜厚」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「閘氧驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Interpret ellipsometric thickness: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the gate oxide to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「分辨成長與沉積」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「橢偏膜厚」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate growth and deposition and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for interpret ellipsometric thickness and add discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Define vacuum work function to define the interpretation boundary. Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜定義真空功函數：檢查結果是否能支持「金屬真空功函數不必等於器件中的有效功函數。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 2｜區域保護層：檢查結果是否能支持「選擇處理一種元件時需保護另一種閘堆疊。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
觀察站 3｜金屬閘極驗收：檢查結果是否能支持「功函數、覆蓋、電阻、分布及老化需聯合判讀。」；若證據不足，標記尚未確定並寫出缺少的量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Define vacuum work function: Check whether the evidence supports: Vacuum work function need not equal effective work function in a device. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 2 | Plan regional protection: Check whether the evidence supports: Processing one device polarity requires protecting the other stack. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Accept the metal gate: Check whether the evidence supports: Jointly assess work function, coverage, resistance, distributions and aging. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「區域保護層」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「金屬閘極驗收」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Plan regional protection: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Accept the metal gate to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：沉積循環數總能從第一循環精確線性外推。 應回到「定義真空功函數」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：高介電常數保證沒有漏電及陷阱。 應回到「區域保護層」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Thickness always extrapolates linearly from the first cycle. Revisit assumptions and sampling for define vacuum work function and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: High permittivity guarantees no leakage or traps. Revisit assumptions and sampling for plan regional protection and add discriminating evidence.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Observation station 2 | Map collision damage: Check whether the evidence supports: Post-implant chemical concentration is not active carrier concentration. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

Observation station 3 | Review the implant lot: Check whether the evidence supports: Review dose, depth, uniformity, damage and activation together. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「碰撞損傷」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map collision damage: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review the implant lot to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 常見錯判：峰值溫度相同便有相同擴散預算。 應回到「劑量與濃度」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
常見錯判：降溫期間不可能再發生擴散。 應回到「碰撞損傷」的假設與採樣範圍，補足能區分機制的證據。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: Common misinterpretation: Equal peak temperatures imply equal diffusion budgets. Revisit assumptions and sampling for separate dose and concentration and add discriminating evidence.
Common misinterpretation: No diffusion can occur during cooling. Revisit assumptions and sampling for map collision damage and add discriminating evidence.

Observation station 3 | Accept STI integration: Check whether the evidence supports: Fill, planarity, leakage and channel stress require joint acceptance. If insufficient, mark the conclusion unresolved and name the missing measurement.

guides.concept: 先用「將晶圓目標依縮小倍率轉成光罩座標」建立判讀邊界。光罩與晶圓座標必須註明尺度。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Convert wafer targets into mask coordinates using reduction to define the interpretation boundary. Mask and wafer coordinates require explicit scales. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜將晶圓目標依縮小倍率轉成光罩座標：光罩與晶圓座標必須註明尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜畫出前向與背向散射的作用範圍：鄰近效應包含不同空間尺度。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付資料、曝光與量測的完整鏈結：追溯性讓異常能回到對應來源。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Convert wafer targets into mask coordinates using reduction: Mask and wafer coordinates require explicit scales. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Sketch forward- and backscatter ranges: Proximity effects span different spatial scales. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a linked data-writing-metrology record: Traceability links anomalies to their sources. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「畫出前向與背向散射的作用範圍」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付資料、曝光與量測的完整鏈結」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Sketch forward- and backscatter ranges: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a linked data-writing-metrology record to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「把晶圓尺寸直接當作光罩尺寸。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「平均劑量相同即可忽略拼接。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Use wafer dimensions directly as mask dimensions.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Equal mean dose makes stitching irrelevant.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

觀察站 2｜將位錯、橋接與缺失線分開：不同缺陷代表不同失敗機制。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜提交模板、材料與缺陷證據鏈：可整合性需要位置、缺陷與轉移共同證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Distinguish microphase separation from macroscopic mixing: Covalent linkage prevents complete block separation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Separate dislocations, bridges and missing lines: Different defect classes indicate different failure mechanisms. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain: Integrability needs combined placement, defect and transfer evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Use Deliver a guide–material–defect evidence chain to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Associate OES peaks with candidate species to define the interpretation boundary. Peak assignments need overlap and background checks. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜把 OES 發光峰對應至可能物種：峰值指認需排除重疊與背景。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜設計持續時間確認以避免誤觸發：確認時間也增加停止延遲。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付具回溯資料的端點控制計畫：每次停止應能對應訊號與膜厚證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Associate OES peaks with candidate species: Peak assignments need overlap and background checks. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Require persistence to reduce false triggers: Persistence confirmation adds stop delay. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver an endpoint plan with traceable data: Each stop should link to signal and thickness evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「設計持續時間確認以避免誤觸發」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付具回溯資料的端點控制計畫」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Require persistence to reduce false triggers: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver an endpoint plan with traceable data to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「所有亮度變化都等於材料已蝕刻完。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「偵測到端點後所有反應立即停止。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Every brightness change means etching is complete.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "All reactions stop instantly when endpoint is detected.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Observation station 2 | Compare evidence for amorphous and polycrystalline silicon: The same element does not imply the same microstructure. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver thermal history, uniformity and material acceptance: LPCVD integration must include batch management. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

若報告假設「所有 LPCVD 膜都具有相同低應力。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。

guides.title: 金屬有機化學氣相沉積：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Metal-organic chemical vapor deposition: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出金屬有機源到晶體薄膜的路徑」建立判讀邊界。氣相分解與表面反應不是同一階段。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Trace metal-organic sources into crystalline films to define the interpretation boundary. Gas decomposition and surface reaction are different stages. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出金屬有機源到晶體薄膜的路徑：氣相分解與表面反應不是同一階段。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用 XRD 概念分開晶格常數與應變：峰位改變可能有多種來源。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付反應器、結構與性能的證據鏈：可重現成長需要完整條件與量測範圍。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Trace metal-organic sources into crystalline films: Gas decomposition and surface reaction are different stages. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Use XRD concepts to distinguish lattice parameter and strain: Peak shifts can have multiple origins. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver reactor, structure and performance evidence: Reproducible growth needs complete conditions and measurement scope. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用 XRD 概念分開晶格常數與應變」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付反應器、結構與性能的證據鏈」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

Build a controlled comparison for Use XRD concepts to distinguish lattice parameter and strain: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver reactor, structure and performance evidence to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「氣相混合均勻就能保證晶體完全無缺陷。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「發光強度相同就代表晶體品質完全相同。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Uniform gas mixing guarantees defect-free crystals.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Equal emission intensity proves identical crystal quality.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出元件到第一層金屬的接點：垂直接點包含多個材料介面。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。

Observation station 3 | Review fill, planarization and contact resistance: Plug validation must cover geometry and interfaces. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.

guides.title: 銅雙鑲嵌互連：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Copper dual-damascene interconnects: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽」建立判讀邊界。垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw a via and trench between metal levels to define the interpretation boundary. Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出兩金屬層之間的通孔與線槽：垂直與水平連接具有不同幾何。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充：超共形填充可避免過早封口。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查：局部製程合格仍需跨層功能驗證。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw a via and trench between metal levels: Vertical and horizontal connections have different geometry. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
Observation station 2 | Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: Superconformal fill can avoid premature closure. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Deliver a two-level RC and failure review: Local process acceptance still needs cross-layer functional validation. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「用截面追蹤自底向上的銅填充」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付兩層互連的 RC 與失效審查」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Trace bottom-up copper fill in sections: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Deliver a two-level RC and failure review to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「雙鑲嵌就是直接蝕刻厚銅形成所有線孔。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「表面平坦可排除內部空洞。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "Dual damascene directly etches thick copper into all lines and vias.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "A planar surface rules out internal voids.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 阻障層與種子層沉積：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Barrier and seed-layer deposition: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「畫出介電層、阻障、種子與銅主體」建立判讀邊界。不同層負責不同物理功能。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Draw dielectric, barrier, seed and bulk copper to define the interpretation boundary. Different layers serve different physical functions. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜畫出介電層、阻障、種子與銅主體：不同層負責不同物理功能。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 2｜以片電阻地圖檢查種子連續性：低平均電阻仍可能伴隨局部斷點。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
觀察站 3｜交付覆蓋、導通、擴散與附著評審：阻障種子整合需要四類證據。 本步須保留至少一項直接觀測與一項推論的區別。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Draw dielectric, barrier, seed and bulk copper: Different layers serve different physical functions. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 2 | Map sheet resistance to assess seed continuity: Low mean resistance can coexist with local discontinuities. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.

Observation station 3 | Review coverage, continuity, diffusion and adhesion: Barrier–seed integration needs four classes of evidence. Preserve the distinction between at least one direct observation and one inference.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「以片電阻地圖檢查種子連續性」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「交付覆蓋、導通、擴散與附著評審」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Map sheet resistance to assess seed continuity: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Review coverage, continuity, diffusion and adhesion to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若報告假設「有種子層就不需要任何擴散阻障。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
若報告假設「種子表面氧化不會影響電鍍。」，回到本階段原理重畫因果鏈，並補上反例或未量測項。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If the report assumes "A seed layer eliminates all need for a diffusion barrier.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.
If the report assumes "Seed oxidation cannot affect plating.", revisit the stage principle, redraw the causal chain and add a counterexample or unmeasured quantity.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜移除量與平坦度：建立模型：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
觀察站 2｜研磨墊狀態：建立模型：墊表面演化會改變移除與均勻度；修整器磨耗也會改變墊狀態。
觀察站 3｜整合驗收：故障判讀與驗證：CMP 驗收必須連到後續整合要求；微影焦深需求與局部地形有關。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
Observation station 2 | Pad condition: construct and analyze: Pad evolution changes removal and uniformity; Conditioner wear also changes pad state.
Observation station 3 | Integration acceptance: diagnose and verify: CMP acceptance must connect to downstream integration; Lithographic focus needs depend on local topography.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「研磨墊狀態：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。

evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Pad condition: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Integration acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

若採用「只記累積片數而忽略墊狀態」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。

guides.title: CMP 漿料與磨粒控制：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: CMP slurry and abrasive control: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「磨粒族群：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Abrasive populations: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Rare large particles can dominate scratching. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜磨粒族群：建立模型：稀少大顆粒可能主導刮傷；尾端估計需足夠取樣體積。
觀察站 2｜過濾取捨：建立模型：去除團聚物也可能改變有效磨粒族群；濾壓差可能提示堵塞與旁通。
觀察站 3｜批次放行：故障判讀與驗證：放行應使用多項與失效相關的證據；保存條件也是批次追溯欄位。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Abrasive populations: construct and analyze: Rare large particles can dominate scratching; Tail estimates require sufficient sampled volume.
Observation station 2 | Filtration tradeoff: construct and analyze: Removing agglomerates can also change useful abrasive populations; Pressure drop may reveal clogging or bypass.
Observation station 3 | Lot release: diagnose and verify: Release requires several failure-relevant evidence types; Storage conditions belong in lot traceability.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「過濾取捨：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「批次放行：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Filtration tradeoff: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Lot release: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只用平均粒徑核准漿料」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「把濾後越少顆粒一律視為越好」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Qualifying slurry from mean particle size alone", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Treating fewer particles after filtration as universally better", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

Observation station 3 | Use-condition transfer: diagnose and verify: Peak, average and thermal time scale are not interchangeable; Pulsed thermal peaks can exceed averages.

guides.title: 垂直 NAND 記憶體堆疊：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Vertical NAND memory stacking: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「垂直字串：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Vertical strings: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜垂直字串：建立模型：堆疊層數不同於每顆單元可儲存位元數；選擇閘與儲存單元的功能不同。
觀察站 2｜通道連續：建立模型：垂直導通需要整段連續的通道路徑；通道晶界可能影響傳輸變異。
觀察站 3｜良率地圖：故障判讀與驗證：單一晶圓二維圖可能隱藏深度資訊；層選擇失效和通道失效有不同圖樣。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Vertical strings: construct and analyze: Layer count differs from bits stored per cell; Select gates differ from storage cells.
Observation station 2 | Channel continuity: construct and analyze: Vertical conduction requires a continuous channel path; Channel grain boundaries can affect transport variability.
Observation station 3 | Yield map: diagnose and verify: A two-dimensional wafer map can hide depth information; Layer-select and channel faults have different patterns.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「通道連續：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「良率地圖：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Channel continuity: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Yield map: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把 3D 層數當成單元位元數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「只測頂部膜厚就保證整串導通」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Equating stack layers with bits per cell", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Guaranteeing string conduction from top thickness", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 電荷捕捉記憶體閘極工程：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Charge-trap memory gate engineering: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「電荷儲存層：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜電荷儲存層：建立模型：電荷捕捉層和導電浮閘的儲存方式不同；局域捕捉電荷可具有不同能階。
觀察站 2｜阻擋層：建立模型：阻擋層服務的界面不同於穿隧層；閘極注入可和通道注入競爭。
觀察站 3｜記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證：平均記憶窗不能代表最弱單元裕量；錯誤更正能力不能取代元件量測。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Charge-storage layer: construct and analyze: Charge-trap layers store charge differently from conductive floating gates; Localized trapped charges occupy different energies.
Observation station 2 | Blocking layer: construct and analyze: The blocking layer serves a different interface from the tunnel layer; Gate injection can compete with channel injection.
Observation station 3 | Memory-window acceptance: diagnose and verify: Mean window does not represent weakest-cell margin; Error correction does not replace device measurements.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「阻擋層：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「記憶窗驗收：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Blocking layer: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Memory-window acceptance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把捕捉層畫成等電位金屬浮閘」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「互換兩層而假定能帶條件不變」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Drawing a trap layer as an equipotential metallic floating gate", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Swapping the layers while assuming unchanged bands", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.conceptEn: Begin with Phase and resistance: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜相態與電阻：建立模型：電阻對比來自材料狀態而非永久斷路；電阻讀取應避免再次加熱改態。
觀察站 2｜受限相變體積：建立模型：外圍材料未必每次都完成相變；有效熱區可小於電極覆蓋面積。
觀察站 3｜陣列耐久度：故障判讀與驗證：單元展示和整陣列可靠度證據不同；耐久與保持通常需不同測試序列。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Phase and resistance: construct and analyze: Resistance contrast reflects material state, not necessarily permanent rupture; Read bias should avoid reheating the state.
Observation station 2 | Confined active volume: construct and analyze: Surrounding material need not transform each cycle; Active thermal volume can be smaller than electrode area.
Observation station 3 | Array endurance: diagnose and verify: Single-cell demonstrations and array reliability are different evidence; Endurance and retention need different test sequences.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「受限相變體積：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「陣列耐久度：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Confined active volume: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Array endurance: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.

guides.concept: 先用「MTJ 分層：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with MTJ stack: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜MTJ 分層：建立模型：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
觀察站 2｜障壁均勻度：建立模型：局部薄點可能支配穿隧與崩潰；障壁缺口可形成平行漏電路徑。
觀察站 3｜記憶體用途：故障判讀與驗證：不同用途下最佳磁記憶體架構可不同；快取保持需求可不同於長期儲存。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | MTJ stack: construct and analyze: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
Observation station 2 | Barrier uniformity: construct and analyze: Thin spots can dominate tunneling and breakdown; Barrier defects can add parallel leakage.
Observation station 3 | Memory application: diagnose and verify: The best magnetic-memory architecture depends on use; Cache retention needs differ from archival storage.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「障壁均勻度：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「記憶體用途：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Barrier uniformity: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Memory application: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「平均厚度相同便推定障壁電性等效」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.

guides.title: 二維半導體轉移與接觸：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Two-dimensional semiconductor transfer and contacts: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「單層與晶粒：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜單層與晶粒：建立模型：連續覆蓋不保證單晶或無缺陷；晶粒取向也會改變接合邊界。
觀察站 2｜接觸抽取：建立模型：長度系列需要可比通道與閘偏壓；尺寸縮放使接觸占比上升。
觀察站 3｜晶圓可製造性：故障判讀與驗證：高覆蓋率不等於高功能良率；形貌良率不涵蓋接觸及介電缺陷。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | Monolayer and grains: construct and analyze: Continuous coverage does not imply single crystal or no defects; Grain orientation changes boundary character.
Observation station 2 | Contact extraction: construct and analyze: Length-series extraction needs comparable channels and gate bias; Scaling increases the contact contribution.
Observation station 3 | Wafer manufacturability: diagnose and verify: High coverage yield is not high functional yield; Morphology yield omits contact and dielectric failures.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「接觸抽取：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「晶圓可製造性：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Contact extraction: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Wafer manufacturability: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「全片覆蓋便視為所有載子路徑相同」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「混合不同載子密度樣本直接回歸」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating full coverage as identical transport everywhere", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Regressing samples with mixed carrier densities", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 晶圓薄膜橢圓偏光量測：影像判讀與證據工作簿
guides.titleEn: Wafer thin-film ellipsometry: visual evidence workbook
guides.concept: 先用「p/s 偏振：建立模型」建立判讀邊界。機制：偏振定義需相對於入射平面。 照片說明外觀，概念圖說明學習關係；真正材料組成、性能與製程窗口需由本課的獨立量測與官方資料確認。
guides.conceptEn: Begin with p/s polarization: construct and analyze to define the interpretation boundary. Mechanism: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane. Photographs show appearance and the map shows learning relationships; composition, performance and process windows require independent measurements and course references.
procedure: 觀察站 1｜p/s 偏振：建立模型：偏振定義需相對於入射平面；偏振器零點誤差會混入相位。
觀察站 2｜色散模型：建立模型：透明模型不能無條件延伸到吸收能帶；色散模型需檢查物理一致性。
觀察站 3｜報告與限制：故障判讀與驗證：厚度結果是條件化的模型推論；參數信賴區間應包含模型限制。
procedureEn: Observation station 1 | p/s polarization: construct and analyze: Polarization definitions are relative to incidence plane; Polarizer-zero errors contaminate phase.
Observation station 2 | Dispersion model: construct and analyze: Transparent models cannot be extended blindly into absorption; Dispersion models require physical-consistency checks.
Observation station 3 | Report and limits: diagnose and verify: Thickness is a model-conditioned inference; Confidence reporting should include model limitations.
evidence: 逐圖記錄來源、材料身分、可見結構、不可見界面與可用尺度；未知處填「未證實」。
為「色散模型：建立模型」建立對照：同一基準下比較兩個樣本，列出單位、採樣位置、誤差來源及競爭解釋。
以「報告與限制：故障判讀與驗證」整理接受／暫緩證據；保留原始觀察及推論兩欄，不以模擬畫面當成實測。
evidenceEn: For each image record source, material identity, visible structures, hidden interfaces and available scale; mark unknowns as unverified.
Build a controlled comparison for Dispersion model: construct and analyze: use a common reference, two samples, units, sampling locations, uncertainty sources and competing explanations.
Use Report and limits: diagnose and verify to organize accept/hold evidence. Separate raw observations from inference; a simulation image is not a measurement.
pitfalls: 若採用「把水平與垂直永遠當 p 和 s」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
若採用「同一透明模型適用所有波長」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
官方展示影片的畫面與本課專有製程不必相同；不要把通用示例當成產品認證。
pitfallsEn: If using the claim "Treating horizontal/vertical as universally p/s", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
If using the claim "Applying one transparency model at every wavelength", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
An official demonstration need not show this course’s exact process; a general example is not product qualification.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：CPU 管線與分支預測
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: CPU pipelines and branch prediction
guides.concept: 以指令相依、投機與精確提交連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect instruction dependencies, speculation and precise retirement through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ISA 與微架構」的資料、控制與時間關係。相同指令集可用不同管線實作。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較同一指令序列的兩種時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「管線深度」的資料、控制與時間關係。深管線可能提高時脈卻增加復原代價。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「固定程式比較延遲與週期數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「暫存器重新命名」的資料、控制與時間關係。重新命名消除名稱相依而非真資料相依。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「拆分 WAR、WAW 與 RAW。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「目標預測」的資料、控制與時間關係。方向正確仍可能得到錯誤目標。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分開記錄方向與目標命中。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「記憶體順序」的資料、控制與時間關係。投機讀取須驗證與先前寫入相容。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立相同位址的讀寫時序。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「架構驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。效能改善不能犧牲可見程式語義。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比對提交軌跡與參考結果。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for isa and microarchitecture. The same ISA permits different pipelines. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare two schedules for one instruction sequence. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for pipeline depth. Deeper pipelines may raise clock and recovery cost. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare latency and cycle counts for one program. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for register renaming. Renaming removes name, not true data dependencies. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Separate WAR, WAW and RAW cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for target prediction. Correct direction may still have a wrong target. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Count direction and target hits separately. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for memory ordering. Speculative loads require checks against older stores. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Construct same-address load/store timing. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for architecture acceptance. Speedups must preserve visible program semantics. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare retirement traces with reference results. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「量測基準」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「固定輸入與暖機再比較。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「架構驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「效能改善不能犧牲可見程式語義。」。
提交「架構驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比對提交軌跡與參考結果。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit measurement baseline input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit architecture acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit architecture acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：寬解碼保證所有程式 CPI 同比下降。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Wider decode guarantees proportional CPI reduction. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
