guides.concept: 以L2 學習、VLAN 與有限交換容量連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect l2 learning, vlans and finite switching capacity through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「框架欄位」的資料、控制與時間關係。來源與目的 MAC 屬於框架而非 IP 路由。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「分類 L2 與 L3 位址。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Unknown flooding」的資料、控制與時間關係。未知單播可在允許域內泛洪。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對 ingress 與其他 port。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「環路風險」的資料、控制與時間關係。L2 環路可持續複製泛洪框架。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「紙上追蹤三交換器環路。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「隊頭阻塞」的資料、控制與時間關係。單一隊頭可能阻擋其他可送框架。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較單隊列與目的地隊列。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「最小框架率」的資料、控制與時間關係。小框架耗用固定線路 overhead。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「重算本課 14.881 Mframes/s。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「隔離驗收」的資料、控制與時間關係。正向可通與負向拒絕均需測試。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用虛構框架檢查 VLAN 規則。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for frame fields. Source/destination MACs belong to frames, not IP routes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Classify L2 and L3 addresses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for unknown flooding. Unknown unicast may flood within permitted domains. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check ingress and other ports. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for loop risks. L2 loops can keep replicating flooded frames. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace a three-switch loop on paper. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for head-of-line blocking. One head may block other feasible frames. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare single and destination queues. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for minimum-frame rates. Small frames pay fixed wire overhead. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Recalculate 14.881 Mframes/s. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for isolation acceptance. Allowed and denied paths both need testing. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check VLAN rules with fictional frames. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「Link 聚合」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「比較多流與單流 hash。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「隔離驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「正向可通與負向拒絕均需測試。」。
提交「隔離驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「用虛構框架檢查 VLAN 規則。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit link aggregation input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit isolation acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit isolation acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：緩衝增加就能長期突破出口頻寬。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: More buffers permanently exceed egress bandwidth. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect longest prefixes, forwarding pipelines and traffic accounting through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「RIB 與 FIB」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制路由資料與實際轉送表不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「核對路由選擇到 FIB 安裝。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「本地遞送」的資料、控制與時間關係。目的本機與需要轉送是不同路徑。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫兩條目的地處理路徑。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「MTU」的資料、控制與時間關係。出口 MTU 可能小於輸入封包。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較允許片段與禁止片段。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「ECMP」的資料、控制與時間關係。等價下一跳通常按流分配。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較單流與多流分佈。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「表格更新」的資料、控制與時間關係。更新期間需避免不一致的部分狀態。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫兩路由一起更新的時程。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驗收向量」的資料、控制與時間關係。查表邊界、錯格式與禁止流都需檢查。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立純離線封包向量。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for rib and fib. Control routes differ from actual forwarding tables. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Audit route selection to FIB installation. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for local delivery. Local delivery differs from forwarding. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw two destination-processing paths. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for mtus. Egress MTU may be smaller than input packets. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare fragmentable/nonfragmentable cases. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for ecmp. Equal-cost next hops commonly hash flows. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare single/multiflow distribution. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for table updates. Updates avoid inconsistent partial state. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw timing for two-route updates. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acceptance vectors. Prefix edges, malformed and denied flows need checks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build offline-only packet vectors. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「Counter 範圍」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「配對查表、丟棄與傳送數。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「驗收向量」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「查表邊界、錯格式與禁止流都需檢查。」。
提交「驗收向量」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立純離線封包向量。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit counter scope input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit acceptance vectors two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit acceptance vectors input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Lookup success proves delivery to the final destination. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Table pipeline」的資料、控制與時間關係。跨表 goto 與 metadata 形成資料管線。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫三表的封包狀態。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for plane separation. Control decisions and packet execution can be separated. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw management/control/data layers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for control identity. Southbound authority limits devices/actions. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build device/control-role matrices. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for table pipelines. Goto/metadata create cross-table pipelines. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw packet state across three tables. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for multidevice updates. Single-device success does not establish network consistency. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Enumerate update order/transient paths. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for controller ha. Replicas need consistent state/device ownership. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw takeover and duplicate commands. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for offline acceptance. Tests check reachability, denial and loop freedom. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Review policy on fictional topology. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「更新量」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「核算本課 1.2 MB payload。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「離線驗收」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「需檢查可達、禁止與無環路條件。」。
提交「離線驗收」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「用虛構 topology 做政策判讀。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit update volume input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit offline acceptance two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit offline acceptance input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：多控制器自動保證狀態與裝置擁有權一致。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Multiple controllers automatically ensure state/ownership consistency. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：IPv6 網路部署
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IPv6 network deployment
guides.concept: 以位址規劃、鄰居探索與雙棧驗收連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect address planning, neighbor discovery and dual-stack acceptance through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「位址長度」的資料、控制與時間關係。IPv6 位址為 128-bit 且前綴定義網路。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「展開壓縮表示並核對位數。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「介面識別」的資料、控制與時間關係。介面 ID 政策與 MAC 綁定不是唯一選擇。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較穩定與暫時識別。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「DAD」的資料、控制與時間關係。重複位址偵測需解讀鏈路上的回應。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較重複與無回應模型。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「Path MTU」的資料、控制與時間關係。端點依路徑資訊選擇合適大小。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較正常與遺失 too-big 回應。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「雙棧政策」的資料、控制與時間關係。IPv4 防禦規則不自動涵蓋 IPv6。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立兩棧一致允許矩陣。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「驗收矩陣」的資料、控制與時間關係。位址、MTU、政策及失效需分項檢查。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「用純離線範例建立測試表。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for address length. IPv6 addresses have 128 bits and network prefixes. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Expand compressed notation and check width. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for interface identifiers. Interface IDs need not always bind MACs. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare stable/temporary identifiers. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for dad. Duplicate detection interprets link responses. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare duplicates/no-response models. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for path mtu. Endpoints size packets from path information. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare valid/lost too-big responses. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for dual-stack policies. IPv4 defenses do not automatically cover IPv6. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build a two-stack permission matrix. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for acceptance matrix. Addresses, MTUs, policies and failures need separate checks. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build checks from offline-only examples. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「前綴變更」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「畫 preferred 與 valid 期限。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「驗收矩陣」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「位址、MTU、政策及失效需分項檢查。」。
提交「驗收矩陣」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「用純離線範例建立測試表。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。

Submit acceptance matrix two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

pitfallsEn: Common mistake: 65,536 from /48-to-/64 subdivision counts hosts. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：網域名稱系統架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Domain-name-system architecture
guides.concept: 以分散式命名、快取一致性與驗證鏈串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect distributed naming, cache consistency and validation chains through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「樹狀命名空間」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：域名是標籤路徑，管理區域不必等於整個子樹。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「解析器責任」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「委派與 glue」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：glue 協助找到委派伺服器，不能取代權威答案。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改 TTL，比較更新後舊值最長保留時間。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「快取 TTL」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「區域序號」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：序號供次要伺服器辨識更新，不是實際經過的秒數。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定名稱，只改委派點的 NS 與 glue 內容。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「分割視圖」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「簽章時窗」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：簽章有效性依賴時間基準，時鐘錯誤可能造成 bogus。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：只改簽章有效期，區分不存在與驗證失敗。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「不存在證明」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「冗餘權威服務」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：多台服務若共用故障域，數量增加不代表獨立可靠性。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定負載，只改失去一台權威伺服器的情境。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「容量與尾延遲」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

Principle: Slow clients can consume more shared airtime per payload. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep client count and vary co-channel APs to analyze shared airtime. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat channel reuse as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Principle: Wireless capacity can be limited by uplinks and PoE capability. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix transmit power and change attenuation/SNR. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat controller boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around certificate checks, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Accepting arbitrary server certificates weakens enterprise authentication. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid versus expired EAP server certificates. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat network segmentation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Principle: Clients drive roaming; APs cannot guarantee identical device transitions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat hidden nodes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around change rollback, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Channel and authentication changes need recoverable prior configurations. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reauthentication latency and packet interruption during roaming. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat demand and concurrency as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「訂閱與認證」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：訂閱資料與認證交換是相關但不同的責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料流量，只改 UPF 到應用的位置。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「政策控制」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「QoS flow」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：QoS flow 與承載資源映射需同時驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較正常與失效的服務註冊資料。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「邊緣 UPF」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「容量模型」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：註冊率、session 率及資料吞吐要分別估計。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「容錯重試」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：以合成用戶驗證狀態轉換及資料路徑後才能放行。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬 SMF 重啟後有與沒有狀態恢復。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「控制與用戶平面」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around control and user planes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Control messages establish state; the user plane carries application data. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep users fixed and vary session-setup arrival rate. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat amf responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around upf responsibilities, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: UPF forwards data under rules; it is not an identity database. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep users fixed and vary session-setup arrival rate. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service-based interfaces as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around subscription and authentication, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Subscription data and authentication exchange are related but distinct responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix traffic and vary UPF/application placement. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat policy control as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around qos flows, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Verify both QoS-flow definitions and resource mappings. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare valid and stale service-registry data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat edge upf placement as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around capacity models, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Estimate registration rate, session rate and data throughput separately. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat fault retries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Accept only after synthetic users verify state transitions and data paths. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model SMF restart with and without state recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat control and user planes as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：開放式無線接取網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Open radio-access networks
guides.concept: 以解耦無線元件、開放介面與閉迴路控制串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect disaggregated radio components, open interfaces and closed-loop control through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「解耦邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：元件解耦增加介面驗證與版本管理責任。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「O-RU 與 O-DU」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「前傳同步」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：前傳資料與時基需協同，容量足夠不代表同步足夠。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：保留功能切分，只改 fronthaul 延遲。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「管理平面」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Non-RT RIC」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：慢時間尺度政策與學習不能替代低層即時處理。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定 xApp 輸入，只改控制更新週期。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「xApp/rApp」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「A1 政策」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：政策意圖需要可驗證映射至可執行動作。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較兩供應商能力宣告重疊及缺項。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「雲端資源」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「安全邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：開放介面仍需相互驗證與最小權限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「互通能力」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「降階驗證」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：應用撤除時應保留可描述的基線服務。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬控制器斷線，觀察降階而非失控。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「解耦邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around disaggregation boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disaggregation adds interface-verification and version-management responsibilities. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat o-ru and o-du as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around fronthaul synchronization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fronthaul data and timing must cooperate; capacity does not prove synchronization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep the split and vary fronthaul delay. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat management plane as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around non-real-time ric, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Slow-timescale policy/learning cannot replace low-layer real-time processing. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix xApp inputs and vary control update interval. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat xapps and rapps as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around a1 policies, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Policy intent needs a verifiable mapping to executable actions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare overlaps and omissions in two vendor capability declarations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat cloud resources as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around security boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Open interfaces still need mutual authentication and least privilege. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat interoperability capabilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around fallback evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Removing a control application should preserve a defined baseline service. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controller loss and verify degradation rather than uncontrolled action. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat disaggregation boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「閉迴路穩定」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect slice identity, resource contracts and isolation evidence through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「服務合約」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：吞吐、延遲與可靠性需要分開且可測的要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「切片識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「接取與核心」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：端到端切片需要協調無線、傳輸與核心資源。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：改單一切片突發量而固定其他需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「網路功能共用」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「Admission control」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：新增需求要通過可用資源及服務限制審查。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較共用與分離 UPF 的故障域。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「QoS 映射」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「隔離層次」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：邏輯權限、資源排程與物理隔離提供不同保證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資源，只改 admission 需求。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「生命週期」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「策略授權」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：管理切片的權限不應等於存取其資料權限。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「故障域」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「解配置證據」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：撤除後需確認路由、憑據及資源都已清理。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬授權失效是否影響其他切片。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「服務合約」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around service contracts, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Throughput, latency and reliability need separate measurable requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat slice identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around access and core, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: End-to-end slicing coordinates radio, transport and core resources. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Vary one slice burst while fixing other demands. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat shared network functions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around admission control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: New demand needs available-resource and service-bound checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare shared and separated UPF failure domains. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat qos mapping as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around isolation layers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Logical permissions, scheduling and physical separation provide different guarantees. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Keep resources fixed and change admission demand. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat lifecycle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around policy authorization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Slice-management permissions should differ from data-access permissions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat failure domains as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around deprovisioning evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: After removal, verify cleanup of routes, credentials and resources. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model whether one authorization failure affects other slices. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service contracts as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「SLA 尾端」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。

提交「解配置證據」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for sla tails. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for deprovisioning evidence. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

pitfalls: 同一切片的平均吞吐可證明所有用戶 SLA。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
pitfallsEn: A slice mean throughput proves every user’s SLA. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：蜂巢式基地台整合
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cellular base-station integration
guides.concept: 以基地台功能切分、射頻指標與同步串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect base-station splits, rf metrics and synchronization through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「系統功能圖」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：射頻、基頻、傳輸及管理是相連但不同子系統。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「功能切分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「時鐘參考」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：頻率與時間同步要求必須分別驗證。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定頻寬，只改可用空間層數。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「射頻鏈路」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「線性與峰值」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：峰均比使平均功率合格仍可能發生削波。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定射頻訊號，只改取樣時鐘偏差。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「MIMO 通道秩」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「傳輸網路」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：前傳與回傳承載不同資料與延遲要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：比較本地模型中不同功能切分的傳輸時限。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「基地台管理」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「交遞邊界」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：覆蓋重疊與觸發門檻共同影響交遞中斷。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一個同步源中斷後的降階。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「熱與供電」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「授權與版本」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：實際無線發射須依當地授權，本課僅離線建模。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬一個同步源中斷後的降階。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「系統功能圖」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around system functional map, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RF, baseband, transport and management are connected but distinct subsystems. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat functional splits as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around clock reference, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Frequency and time synchronization requirements need separate checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix bandwidth and vary usable spatial layers. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat rf chain as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around linearity and peaks, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Peak-to-average ratio allows clipping despite acceptable mean power. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix RF signals and vary sampling-clock error. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mimo channel rank as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around transport network, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fronthaul and backhaul carry different data and timing requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare transport deadlines for different local-model splits. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat base-station management as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around handover boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Coverage overlap and trigger thresholds jointly affect handover interruption. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model degradation after one timing-source outage. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat thermal and power budget as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around authorization and versions, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Live RF transmission needs local authorization; this course models offline only. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model degradation after one timing-source outage. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat system functional map as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
evidence: 提交「合成驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「授權與版本」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
提交「授權與版本」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for synthetic acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for authorization and versions. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mission data flows, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Telemetry, mission data and commands have different permissions/deadlines. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat orbit and visibility as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around effective radiated power, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: EIRP combines transmitter power, losses and antenna gain. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix frequency and vary slant range/path loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat receive g/t as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around doppler shift, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Radial relative velocity shifts received frequency. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix range and vary radial relative velocity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat sampling and synchronization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around atmospheric loss, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rain/elevation effects vary with frequency and conditions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic blockage/atmospheric loss at different elevations. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat contact schedules as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around ground network, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Terrestrial backhaul may bottleneck the satellite downstream path. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reduced contact-window duration and transferable data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat command authorization as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around authorization boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: This course analyzes public models without transmitting or operating satellites. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reduced contact-window duration and transferable data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat mission data flows as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

guides.concept: 以時變拓撲、交遞與星間路由串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around constellation graph, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Node positions and link availability both vary over time. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat space and ground edges as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around propagation bounds, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Geometric distance divided by light speed bounds propagation time. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix constellation and change routing-cost weights. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat contact prediction as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around load distribution, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Shortest-path concentration can create queuing congestion. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix load and remove one intersatellite edge. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distributed state as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around congestion control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Changing path delay affects transport-feedback interpretation. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare present-only and contact-aware routing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat multipath tradeoffs as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around failure detours, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Detours require renewed capacity and latency checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model inconsistent route updates during handover. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat service priorities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around performance reports, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report handover loss separately from steady-state throughput. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model inconsistent route updates during handover. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat constellation graph as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around dtn overlay, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: DTN overlays continuous/intermittent networks with store-and-forward service. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat bundle structure as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around convergence layers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Adapters carry bundles; their responsibility differs from routing algorithms. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix generation rate and vary contact duration. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat persistent storage as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around data lifetime, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Stored data is not valid merely because it remains after expiry. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare lifetimes shorter/longer than contact gaps. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat store-carry behavior as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around duplicates and retries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Retransmission can duplicate data; applications need idempotent handling. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix contact plan and vary storage capacity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat routing responsibilities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around timebase limitations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Lifetime/age handling requires clock-reliability checks. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model intermediary restart with preserved versus lost persistent data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat storage occupancy as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around mission acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance tests disruptions, expiry and restart, not just continuous delivery. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model intermediary restart with preserved versus lost persistent data. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat dtn overlay as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: Quantum states and classical control information have different copying constraints. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat no-cloning principle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around entanglement distribution, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Entanglement establishment needs defined success events and quality. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix source rate and vary one-arm loss. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat coincidence measurements as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around detection efficiency, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: The product of endpoint efficiencies limits observed paired events. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix loss and vary dark counts/coincidence window. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat time tags as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around quantum memories, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Memory lifetime must cover waiting and protocol-feedback delay. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare records with/without classical time tags. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat swapping and repeaters as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around coexistence noise, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Classical optical channels can affect quantum channels through scattering noise. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat qkd versus quantum networks as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around testbed acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Report optical loss, timing error and state quality separately. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model memory lifetime shorter than protocol waiting time. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat quantum/classical resources as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「資源盤點」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定保護資源與動作，才有可審查的政策。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改裝置健康證據是否新鮮。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「主體身分」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around resource inventory, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define protected resources/actions before reviewable policy. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat subject identities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around least privilege, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Permission scope should match tasks rather than permanent total access. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix user and vary device-health evidence freshness. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat device evidence as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around network segmentation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Segmentation restricts reachability, not resource authorization. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix policy and vary resource sensitivity. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat workload identities as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around continuous evaluation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: State changes can trigger reevaluation beyond initial login. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare cached decisions before/after revocation. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat revocation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around exception lifecycle, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Exceptions need scope, expiry and approval records. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat audit correlation as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around migration acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Resource-by-resource migration checks closure of old bypass paths. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model unavailable policy service with fail-closed and governed exceptions. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat resource inventory as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedure: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「身分證明」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：聲稱身分與驗證聲稱的證據需要分開。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改角色集合。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「唯一識別」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「驗證與授權」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：驗證回答是誰，授權回答能做什么。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定使用者，只改角色集合。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「角色模型」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around identity proofing, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Separate claimed identity from evidence validating that claim. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix users and vary role sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat stable identifiers as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around authentication/authorization, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Authentication identifies subjects; authorization permits actions. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix users and vary role sets. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat role models as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around separation of duties, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Conflicting-grant constraints limit single-person high-risk chains. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare synthetic tokens with correct/incorrect audiences. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat federation boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around oauth scopes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Scopes constrain delegated access, not complete identity proof. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix organization and vary leaver-revocation timing. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat session lifecycle as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around access reviews, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reviews check necessity, not merely continued existence. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled recovery after identity-provider failure. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat recovery boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around leaver acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Login removal also checks tokens, keys and shared secrets. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model controlled recovery after identity-provider failure. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat identity proofing as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around factor categories, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Knowledge, possession and biometrics are distinct factor categories. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare two knowledge factors with distinct factor categories. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat factor independence as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

procedureEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around module boundaries, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Security-module and application-process boundaries differ. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix keys and vary caller privileges. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat tokens and sessions as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Principle: In-module generation can avoid plaintext keys leaving the boundary. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around key wrapping, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Wrapping protects transported material and needs explicit export policy. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

Model standby-module unavailability and approved recovery. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat audit events as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Principle: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat key state machine as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around entropy and generation, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Key material needs suitable randomness, not predictable identifiers. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat distribution channels as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around version identifiers, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Ciphertext must identify the correct key version. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Compare rotating data keys with wrapping keys. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat envelope encryption as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around revocation/destruction, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Disallowing new use and permanent destruction are distinct states. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix algorithms and vary data retention years. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat recovery policies as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around incident scope, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Trace which data a compromised key protects. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat backup consistency as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.

After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around destruction evidence, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Deleting an index does not clear every backed-up secret. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model historical reads after one key is revoked. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat asset associations as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
