procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for reference versions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Comparisons pin reference data, windows and model versions. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Build versions for self-made monitoring data. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for concept drift. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: P(y∣x) can change while the input distribution remains fixed. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Keep toy input distributions and change labeling rules. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for effect size. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Small differences in large samples can be significant yet immaterial. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Report differences, intervals and effect sizes together. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for classification metrics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Precision, recall and prevalence affect error costs. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate a synthetic confusion matrix beyond accuracy. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for alert suppression. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Deduplication and persistence reduce noise but may delay detection. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one-window and three-window toy alerts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for monitoring acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance tests misses, false alarms and action value. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two monitoring policies on self-made fixed cases. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「再訓練門檻」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「一檢測到 drift 就必須立即上線重訓模型。」為何不成立。
提交「監測驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「用自製固定題集比較兩種監測策略。」如何辨別它們。
提交「監測驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「告警越多就表示監測越有效。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for retraining gates; explain why this claim fails: Every drift alert requires immediate model release.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for monitoring acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for monitoring acceptance; explain why this claim fails: More alerts mean more effective monitoring.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：告警越多就表示監測越有效。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More alerts mean more effective monitoring. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedure: 先觀察師傅的「域分解」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：空間分塊決定計算與跨塊依賴。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「把自製二維格網分為四塊。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Spatial partitioning defines compute and interblock dependencies. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Partition a self-made 2D grid into four blocks. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for boundary conditions. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Physical and interdomain boundaries are handled differently. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark both boundary types on a toy diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for nonblocking completion. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Buffers may remain in use after nonblocking calls return. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark buffer reuse only after completion on a toy timeline. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for reduction numerics. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Nonassociative floating addition makes reduction order affect low bits. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare two orders with large, small and negative-large values. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for strong/weak scaling. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Fixed total and per-rank problem sizes are different tests. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate both efficiencies from synthetic timings. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for result validation. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Parallel results compare with serial, small-scale and conserved constraints. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate mass and errors on a self-made diffusion grid. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「檢查點一致」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「每 rank 任意時刻各自存檔就能正確恢復。」為何不成立。
提交「結果驗證」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「重算自製小擴散網格的質量與誤差。」如何辨別它們。
提交「結果驗證」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「能用更多 rank 就證明結果更準確。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for checkpoint consistency; explain why this claim fails: Arbitrary independent rank saves always restore correctly.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for result validation; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for result validation; explain why this claim fails: More ranks prove more accurate results.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：能用更多 rank 就證明結果更準確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: More ranks prove more accurate results. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect fluid pdes, data assimilation and ensemble forecasts with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
procedure: 先觀察師傅的「預報邊界」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：預測變數、空間域與時距定義任務。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「指定玩具溫度場的範圍與預報時段。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for forecast boundaries. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Variables, domain and lead time define the task. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Define a toy temperature field and forecast window. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for observation errors. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Instrument, representation and sampling affect errors. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare synthetic point and grid-mean temperatures. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for background and innovations. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Assimilation innovations compare observations and background in observation space. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compute y−Hx for a toy linear H. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for domain decomposition. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Grid and spectral transforms can need different communication patterns. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare toy neighbor and global-transpose flows. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for deterministic verification. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: RMSE, bias and regional means measure different properties. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Calculate errors and bias of synthetic forecasts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for release scope. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Educational models give no operational hazard-decision guarantee. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Label toy forecast errors and unvalidated scope. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「資料版本」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「同日期預測都用了完全相同觀測。」為何不成立。
提交「釋出範圍」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「標註玩具預報誤差與未驗證範圍。」如何辨別它們。
提交「釋出範圍」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「完成模擬便有正式災害預報資格。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for data versions; explain why this claim fails: All forecasts on one date use identical observations.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for release scope; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for release scope; explain why this claim fails: Completing a simulation qualifies operational hazard forecasts.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：完成模擬便有正式災害預報資格。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Completing a simulation qualifies operational hazard forecasts. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific chains. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Frontier 超級電腦架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Frontier supercomputer architecture
guides.concept: 以Frontier 異質節點、HBM 與通訊拓撲串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect frontier heterogeneous nodes, hbm and interconnect topology with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.

procedureEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for heterogeneous roles. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Frontier compute nodes combine EPYC CPUs and MI250X accelerators. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Redraw original functional relationships from official descriptions. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for hbm hierarchy. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Accelerator HBM and host memory have different access paths. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Mark host and device placement of toy arrays. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for register pressure. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Per-thread resources limit resident threads. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare occupancy for two toy register budgets. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for rank mapping. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Rank-to-GCD/core binding affects locality. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw a one-rank-per-GCD toy placement. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for roofline. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Attainable bounds combine compute peaks and bandwidth. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Recalculate bounds for both example intensities. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific acceptance. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Architecture performance does not replace correctness and error checks. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Retain errors, versions and assumptions for a small local case. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
evidence: 提交「檢查點 I/O」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有 GPU 記憶體每步寫盤沒有成本。」為何不成立。
提交「科學驗收」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「以本地小題保留誤差、版本與假設。」如何辨別它們。
提交「科學驗收」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「在 Frontier 執行就保證科學模型正確。」為何不成立。
evidenceEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for checkpoint i/o; explain why this claim fails: Writing every GPU state each step is free.
Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for scientific acceptance; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for scientific acceptance; explain why this claim fails: Running on Frontier guarantees correct scientific models.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：在 Frontier 執行就保證科學模型正確。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Running on Frontier guarantees correct scientific models. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.

State an observable prediction before planning this check: Estimate hypothetical checkpoint-write duration. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific review. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reproduction retains tasks and errors, not just platform names. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：IBM Heron 超導量子處理器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor
guides.concept: 以可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制解析IBM Heron 超導量子處理器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor through tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識transmon 能階。約瑟夫森接面提供非線性電感；非諧性使兩個能階可從其他能階分開控制。 建立超導電路與非諧性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較理想諧振器與非諧振子的能階及洩漏。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Heron 耦合圖。原生可用的雙位元連線限制編譯；SWAP 路由增加深度與噪聲暴露。 建立耦合圖與路由的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對相同邏輯電路比較兩張耦合圖的路由深度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識微波控制線。控制脈衝的頻譜可同時激發鄰近模態；閘錯誤不只是振幅偏差。 建立微波控制與串擾的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較單獨與同時操作的假想錯誤矩陣。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識色散讀出鏈。讀出將位元狀態映射到共振器響應；混淆矩陣與相干誤差是不同證據。 建立色散讀出與指派誤差的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由標籤資料重算讀出混淆矩陣並保留樣本數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多溫層熱路。每條控制線帶入熱與雜訊；低溫層的冷卻能力需按溫度分開預算。 建立低溫熱路與訊號負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。建立各溫層的負載、裕度與線數假想表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IBM Heron 超導量子處理器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識邏輯錯誤證據。邏輯錯誤率與物理錯誤率不同；閾值行為需跨碼距且控制實驗條件。 建立錯誤更正與邏輯證據的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是可調耦合、耦合圖與量子控制。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較碼距增加時的每循環邏輯錯誤與置信區間。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify transmon levels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Josephson junctions supply nonlinear inductance; anharmonicity separates a controlled two-level subspace from other levels. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of superconducting circuits and anharmonicity, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare oscillator/anharmonic level spacings and leakage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify heron coupling graph in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Native two-qubit connectivity constrains compilation; SWAP routing increases depth and noise exposure. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of coupling graphs and routing, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Route the same circuit on two graphs and compare depth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify microwave control lines in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Control spectra can excite neighboring modes; gate error is not only amplitude error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microwave control and crosstalk, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare hypothetical isolated and simultaneous-operation error matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dispersive readout chain in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Readout maps states to resonator response; a confusion matrix differs from coherent-error evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dispersive readout and assignment error, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate a labeled readout confusion matrix with sample counts. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multistage heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Each control line carries heat and noise; cooling capacity is budgeted separately by temperature stage. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cryogenic heat paths and signal loads, focusing on tunable coupling, coupling graphs and quantum control. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build an assumed load, margin and line-count table per stage. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify logical-error evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IBM Heron superconducting quantum processor. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Readout uses photon-count statistics; reset, spectator qubits and duration affect mid-circuit measurement. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of fluorescence readout and reuse, focusing on racetrack traps, zoned transport and mid-circuit readout. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recompute small-system eigenvalues as control parameters change. Identify aquila channel constraints in the mentor diagram and primary sources for QuEra Aquila neutral-atom analog machine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Correlations are estimated from repeated shots; spatial structure and finite-sample bias both matter. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of correlators and finite samples, focusing on reconfigurable geometry and rydberg many-body simulation. guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：ResNet 殘差視覺網路
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: ResNet residual vision network
guides.concept: 以殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵解析ResNet 殘差視覺網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore ResNet residual vision network through residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識卷積stem與shape。殘差區塊輸出 y=F(x)+x；形狀不一致時需明確投影，不能直接相加。 建立殘差映射與恆等路徑的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對等形與降採樣區塊各核對維度和投影參數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識F(x)+x殘差連接。堆疊卷積擴大理論感受野；stride改變解析度及對齊，不能只看kernel尺寸。 建立卷積感受野與解析度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。逐層追蹤stride、padding、特徵尺寸及感受野。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識跨層梯度路徑。等形區塊雅可比含 I+JF，恆等項提供梯度路徑但不保證所有方向穩定。 建立殘差雅可比與梯度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以小矩陣比較JF、I+JF的特徵方向和有限差分。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識feature map記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識羣組分割與資料洩漏。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「ResNet 殘差視覺網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識類別與移轉失效。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是殘差跳接、梯度路徑與影像表徵。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify convolutional stem and shapes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A residual block gives y=F(x)+x; incompatible shapes require explicit projection rather than direct addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual maps and identity paths, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dimensions/projection parameters for same-shape and downsampling blocks. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify f(x)+x residual connection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Stacked convolutions expand theoretical receptive fields; stride changes resolution/alignment beyond kernel size alone. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of convolutional receptive field and resolution, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace stride, padding, feature size and receptive field layer by layer. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cross-layer gradient paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. A same-shape block has Jacobian I+JF; the identity supplies a path without guaranteeing stability in every direction. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual jacobians and gradients, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare JF/I+JF directions and finite differences on small matrices. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify feature-map memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify grouped splits and leakage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify class and transfer failures in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ResNet residual vision network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on residual skips, gradient paths and visual representations. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交羣組分割與資料洩漏的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交類別與移轉失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交類別與移轉失效的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for grouped splits and leakage.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for class and transfer failures.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for class and transfer failures.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：高confidence就足以認定答案正確。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High confidence establishes correctness.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Transformer 注意力編解碼器
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Transformer attention encoder-decoder
guides.concept: 以QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算解析Transformer 注意力編解碼器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Transformer attention encoder-decoder through qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識token與位置張量。QKᵀ/√d 經softmax形成逐query權重，再乘V；Q、K與V不是三個可任意互換的輸入。 建立縮放點積注意力的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用兩個token手算權重，核對每列和為1及輸出維度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識softmax(QKᵀ/√d)V。因果遮罩排除未來位置；padding遮罩處理無效token，兩者服務不同條件。 建立遮罩與資訊流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在小型score矩陣分別畫兩種遮罩並檢查可見位置。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識殘差與層歸一化。無位置資訊的自注意力對置換具有對應性；位置表徵將順序條件加入token。 建立位置表徵與順序的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。交換token後比較有無位置表徵的輸出對應。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識L平方attention記憶。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識時間與來源切分。訓練與測試需按實際部署關係隔離；重複樣本或時間穿越可高估成績。 建立資料切分與洩漏的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用羣組／時間切分比較隨機切分的假想結果。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Transformer 注意力編解碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識長序列與分佈移轉。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是QKV、遮罩、位置與平行序列運算。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify token and position tensors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Softmax of QKᵀ/sqrt(d) forms per-query weights applied to V; Q, K and V are not arbitrary interchangeable inputs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scaled dot-product attention, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate two-token weights, row sums and output dimensions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify softmax(qkᵀ/sqrt(d))v in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Causal masks exclude future positions; padding masks exclude invalid tokens and serve different conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of masks and information flow, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw both masks on a small score matrix and inspect visible positions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residuals and layer normalization in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Self-attention without positions is permutation-equivariant; positional representations add order conditions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of position representations and order, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare permuted outputs with/without position representations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify quadratic attention memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify temporal/source splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify long-sequence distribution shift in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Transformer attention encoder-decoder. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on qkv, masks, position and parallel sequence computation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

procedureEn: Identify images and pixel labels in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. The encoder gathers multiscale context and the decoder restores spatial outputs; upsampling creates no new original-image information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of contracting and expanding paths, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace scale shapes/output alignment and mark cropping/padding. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multiscale encoding/decoding in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. U-Net skips often concatenate encoder/decoder features; spatial shapes/coordinates must align, unlike residual addition. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cross-scale skips and alignment, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare channels/alignment for concatenation versus addition. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify skips and boundary gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Class imbalance can hide small objects; boundary reconstruction differs from mean pixel accuracy. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of pixel loss and object scale, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compute confusion, overlap and regional errors for one small mask. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify skip-feature buffers in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify subject-group splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dice and small-object errors in the mentor diagram and primary sources for U-Net multiscale segmentation network. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on contraction, expansion, skips and pixel-level validation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Plot an ideal roofline and separately count minimum bytes. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check dependency graphs beside execution timelines. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify nvlink hierarchy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of chip and interconnect hierarchy, focusing on simt, transformer engine and asynchronous memory. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check unidirectional/bidirectional and per-GPU/system units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify job energy and precision in the mentor diagram and primary sources for NVIDIA Hopper GPU architecture. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare elapsed time and integrated energy at equal result quality. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識vector與稀疏算子。矩陣算子外的向量、標量與稀疏存取可能成爲瓶頸。 建立向量純量與嵌入的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。拆分矩陣與embedding／逐元素的時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Neuron圖編譯。圖編譯與張量分片決定數據佈局；相同數學表達可形成不同通訊量。 建立編譯與分割的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較複製、資料分片及模型分片的bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識NeuronLink與EFA。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識集體傳輸與並行。all-reduce同步更新或統計；通信可部分重疊但仍有尾端依賴。 建立集體通訊與計算重疊的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較全串行與可重疊時間線。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EC2資源與device分配。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify neuroncore arithmetic paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Matrix units use supported shapes/precisions; low-precision throughput is not FP64 capability. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of matrix cores and precision, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error and supported paths at fixed matrix workload. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify vector/sparse operators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Vector, scalar and sparse work outside matrix operations can dominate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of vectors, scalars and embeddings, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate matrix and embedding/elementwise time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify neuron graph compilation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Graph compilation/sharding set layouts; equivalent mathematics can yield different traffic. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compilation and partitioning, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare replicated, data-sharded and model-sharded bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify neuronlink and efa in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify collectives and parallelism in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. All-reduce synchronizes updates/statistics; communication may overlap while retaining tail dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of collectives and overlap, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare serial and overlapping timelines. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify ec2 resources and allocation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AWS Trainium and Neuron system. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交集體傳輸與並行的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster
guides.concept: 以本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信解析Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster through local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識WSE本地core與SRAM。晶圓尺度將多核心與本地SRAM相連；避開部分離片搬運但仍有通信和容量限制。 建立晶圓網格與局部記憶的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較鄰近交換與跨片搬運的假想bytes。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MemoryX參數流。參數可存於獨立記憶系統並串流到計算；通信帶寬與更新一致性是關鍵邊界。 建立權重串流與分離的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫前傳、反傳及參數更新的方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識稀疏計算mapping。稀疏數據可減少算術，但不均勻分配可能形成局部瓶頸。 建立稀疏映射與負載的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較均勻與聚集稀疏分佈的最慢核心負載。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識晶圓冗餘繞路。大面積設計需面對缺陷；冗餘與繞路形成可用資源而非完美晶圓。 建立晶圓容錯與良率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在假想缺陷圖檢查重映射後的連通及容量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多CS系統梯度。多個系統共享參數與同步梯度，擴充效率還取決於網絡和批次。 建立叢集擴充與參數同步的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。固定全局批次比較單系統與多系統效率。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cerebras CS-3 晶圓尺度叢集」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識晶圓與設施散熱。芯片、供電與冷卻形成不同效率層；裸芯片性能不是完整系統能效。 建立冷卻與工作能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是本地 SRAM、權重串流與晶圓尺度通信。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把計算、通信與設施能量分別列表。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify wse local cores and sram in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Wafer-scale cores connect local SRAM; some off-chip traffic is avoided, with remaining capacity/communication limits. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wafer meshes and local memory, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed neighbor exchange and off-chip bytes. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify memoryx parameter streaming in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Separate memory can stream weights to compute; bandwidth and update consistency remain key. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of weight streaming and disaggregation, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw forward, backward and update directions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify sparse compute mapping in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Sparsity reduces arithmetic while uneven mapping can create local bottlenecks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sparse mapping and load, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare slowest-core load for uniform/clustered sparsity. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify wafer redundancy and rerouting in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Large-area designs face defects; redundancy/rerouting create usable resources, not flawless wafers. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wafer redundancy and yield, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check connectivity/capacity after remapping an assumed defect map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multi-cs system gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Systems share parameters/synchronize gradients; network and batches still limit scaling. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cluster scaling and synchronization, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare one/many-system efficiency at fixed global batch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify wafer/facility cooling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cerebras CS-3 wafer-scale cluster. Chip, power delivery and cooling have separate efficiencies; chip performance is not system energy efficiency. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of cooling and job energy, focusing on local sram, weight streaming and wafer-scale communication. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List compute, communication and facility energy separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.conceptEn: Explore Intel Loihi 2 spiking-compute platform through asynchronous events, programmable neurons and local synapses: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識graded spike事件。神經形態計算以事件與狀態演化表達信息；脈衝頻率只是可能編碼之一。 建立脈衝與時間編碼的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較頻率及事件時間對同一輸入的表示。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識膜狀態微碼。神經元模型積累、泄漏及發放；離散時間近似需要說明步長。 建立膜電位與閾值的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。重算小型leaky積分模型與兩種步長誤差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Intel Loihi 2 脈衝計算平臺」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識local synapse與學習。權重及學習規則儲存在本地狀態；在線學習與推論模式有不同數據流。 建立突觸記憶與可塑性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是非同步事件、可程式神經元及本地突觸。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開權重讀、狀態寫與學習更新事件。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

guides.conceptEn: Explore Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions through dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識A100與EPYC拓撲。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Dragonfly光銅連線。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識CPU/GPU分工。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識all-flash與metadata。暫存、容量與歸檔層服務不同I/O；檢查點需考慮寫入和恢復成本。 建立儲存階層與檢查點的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識機櫃與節點能量。設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。 建立供電冷卻與設施的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Perlmutter GPU 與 CPU 雙分區」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識排程與檢查點重啟。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是雙分區、Dragonfly 網路與全快閃暫存。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify a100/epyc topology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dragonfly optical/copper links in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cpu/gpu partitioning in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify all-flash and metadata in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of storage tiers and checkpoints, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cabinet/node energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of power, cooling and facilities, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify scheduling/checkpoint restart in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Perlmutter GPU and CPU partitions. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on dual partitions, dragonfly and all-flash scratch. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交機櫃與節點能量的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交排程與檢查點重啟的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交排程與檢查點重啟的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cabinet/node energy.

procedure: 在「AP1000 壓水式發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓水熱源與蒸汽發生器。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是主次迴路、被動排熱與民用電廠證據。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

procedureEn: Identify pwr heat source/steam generators in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify natural-circulation support in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify nuclear-island shared systems in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify public design/build evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on primary/secondary loops, passive heat removal and civil evidence. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine/generator island in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify post-shutdown heat in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify active/passive support in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multiplant shared interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify engineering qa/operation evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on thermal/electrical/support boundaries of large pwr plants. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture
guides.concept: 以壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程解析Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture through pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壓力管與熱傳邊界。和平發電以熱源、換熱與汽輪發電連接；壓水、沸水與重水架構的流體邊界不同。 建立核島與汽輪機島邊界的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創塊圖分開熱流、電流與流體連通。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識蒸汽與汽輪發電。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與持續支持。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識熱流與支援路徑。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多機組與更新界面。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Bruce CANDU 重水發電架構」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識生命週期更新證據。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是壓力管、蒸汽產生與大型更新工程。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify pressure-tube heat-transfer boundary in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify steam/turbine generation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residual heat/support in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify heat/support paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify units/refurbishment interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify lifecycle refurbishment evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Bruce CANDU heavy-water generation architecture. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on pressure tubes, steam generation and major refurbishment. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交多機組與更新界面的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交生命週期更新證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交生命週期更新證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for units/refurbishment interfaces.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for lifecycle refurbishment evidence.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：取得設計批准等同每個電廠已商轉。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Design approval means every plant is operating commercially.

在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊與汽輪轉換。熱電轉換受熱循環及輔機耗電共同影響；熱功率與淨電功率不同。 建立熱循環與淨電效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想熱平衡分別計算汽輪輸出、輔機與淨電。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識餘熱與熱容量。停止產熱鏈後仍有餘熱；熱容量與排熱路徑是安全架構分析的一部分。 建立餘熱與持續冷卻的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。只用給定假想衰減曲線計算熱量及冷卻邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識自然循環熱路。重力與自然循環可提供部分功能，但成功條件仍依設計邊界與可用路徑。 建立被動與主動支援的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。繪製熱路徑與單一支援不可用的概念比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識模塊共用基礎設施。小型與大型設備的模塊邊界不同；共用冷卻、電源及施工物流會形成依賴。 建立模組化與共用系統的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。做模塊—共用服務矩陣及共同原因概念圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Darlington BWRX-300 SMR 工程」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識許可與建造階段。設計批准、施工、運行與除役是不同階段；QA追溯和監管邊界不能以動畫代替。 建立建造證據與生命週期的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是小型沸水模組、自然循環與施工階段。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對公開文件支持的階段並標出未完成證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify small-bwr steam boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Civil generation connects a heat source, transfer and turbine generation; PWR, BWR and heavy-water layouts have different fluid boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nuclear and turbine-island boundaries, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate heat, electrical and fluid paths in an original block diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify module/turbine conversion in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Cycle efficiency and auxiliaries affect conversion; thermal and net electrical power differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of thermal cycles and net efficiency, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate turbine output, auxiliaries and net power in an assumed balance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify residual heat/capacity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Residual heat remains after the production chain stops; thermal storage/removal paths belong in safety architecture. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of residual heat and sustained cooling, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a supplied assumed decay curve and cooling boundaries only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify natural-circulation heat paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Gravity/natural circulation can support functions within boundaries and available paths. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of passive and active support, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw heat paths and a conceptual unavailable-support comparison. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify shared module infrastructure in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Small/large plants differ in module boundaries; shared cooling, power and logistics create dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of modularity and shared systems, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Build a module/shared-service matrix and common-cause concept map. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify licensing/build stages in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Darlington BWRX-300 SMR engineering. Design approval, construction, operation and decommissioning differ; animations do not replace QA traceability or regulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of construction evidence and lifecycle, focusing on small bwr modules, natural circulation and construction stages. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Record publicly supported stages and evidence still incomplete. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交模塊共用基礎設施的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交許可與建造階段的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交許可與建造階段的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for shared module infrastructure.
