procedureEn: Identify tokamak vacuum/magnetic fields in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Magnetic/inertial confinement differ in scales and energy delivery; a research device is not a power plant. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of confinement and system boundaries, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw plasma, heating, magnets/optics and facility boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify plasma/facility q boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Plasma/target gain compares specified inputs/outputs; facilities also need electrical/conversion losses. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heating and gain, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate Q, driver efficiency, conversion efficiency and assumed net power. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify superconducting-coil tolerances in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Magnetic geometry/optical errors affect confinement/coupling; averages do not describe every region. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of magnet or optical precision, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare error maps with affected physical boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify divertor heat loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Area, duration and paths control loads; longer pulses increase heat-management demands. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat exhaust and surface loads, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate heat flux from assumed power and wetted area. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify diagnostics/reconstruction in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Observations differ from inverse-model estimates; latency/occlusion changes control information. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of diagnostics and control evidence, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate direct measurements, reconstructions and error bars. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify research/plant gaps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering. Availability, repetition, maintenance and balance affect viability; one record does not cover lifecycle performance. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of research-to-power-plant gaps, focusing on large tokamak systems, cryogenic magnets and heat exhaust. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. List demonstrated research functions and remaining plant validations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交診斷與反演的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for diagnostics/reconstruction.

guides.conceptEn: Explore IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine through open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識15MW風速功率包絡。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識參考blade氣動。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識參考傳動與generator。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識固定浮式support模型。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識陣列與export cable概念。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「IEA 15 MW 參考風機」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識OpenFAST負載驗證。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是開放氣彈性模型與大型風輪設計。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify 15-mw wind/power envelope in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reference-blade aerodynamics in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reference drivetrain/generator in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify fixed/floating support models in the mentor diagram and primary sources for IEA 15 MW reference wind turbine. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on open aeroelastic models and large-rotor design. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Hywind Tampen 浮式風電
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Hywind Tampen floating wind
guides.concept: 以浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電解析Hywind Tampen 浮式風電：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Hywind Tampen floating wind through floating concrete supports and platform electricity: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Tampen風資源。可用風功率隨風速立方變化；風輪效率、額定及停機區間限制輸出。 建立風資源與功率包絡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把風速分佈與假想功率曲線積分爲年能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識浮式葉片載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識轉矩與平臺供電。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識繫泊與浮體模態。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識動態海纜與陣列。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海況與供電可用率。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify tampen wind resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify floating-rotor loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify torque/platform power in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify mooring/floater modes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dynamic cables/array in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify sea states/power availability in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on floating concrete supports and platform electricity. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交動態海纜與陣列的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交海況與供電可用率的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交海況與供電可用率的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for dynamic cables/array.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sea states/power availability.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for sea states/power availability.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識大型rotor與載荷。扭轉、弦長與來流角共同影響升阻；輸出最優與疲勞最小未必同點。 建立葉片氣動與載荷的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩組假想葉素的力與力矩方向。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識直驅與集電。齒輪、發電機與功率電子將低速力矩轉電；直驅與齒輪路線的負載分配不同。 建立傳動與發電轉換的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。由給定轉速與功率計算軸扭矩並區分效率層。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識支撐與海況。固定與浮式支撐有不同模態；風浪流與繫泊共同影響塔和電纜運動。 建立支撐繫泊與動態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較固定與浮式假想模態圖及載荷組合。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識海纜與岸上互連。上游尾流影響下游風輪；陣列及出口海纜產生電損與可用率依賴。 建立陣列尾流與海纜的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開氣動尾流損失、電纜損失及停機時數。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「大彰化離岸風電場」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識臺灣O&M與窗口。海上可達窗口及疲勞分佈影響可用率；一次滿功率測試不能驗證長期壽命。 建立監測維護與疲勞的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是遠岸直驅陣列、颱風環境與供應鏈。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用假想時間序列比較容量因數、可用率及負載循環。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify changhua resources/typhoons in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Available power scales cubically with speed; rotor efficiency, rating and shutdown regions limit output. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of wind resources and power envelopes, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Integrate a wind distribution with an assumed curve for annual energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify large rotors/loads in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Twist, chord and inflow set lift/drag; maximum output and minimum fatigue need not coincide. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of blade aerodynamics and loads, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare force/moment directions for two assumed blade elements. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify direct drive/collection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Gearboxes, generators and converters turn slow torque into electricity; direct/geared routes distribute loads differently. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of drivetrain and electrical conversion, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Calculate shaft torque from assumed speed/power and separate efficiencies. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify supports/sea states in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Fixed/floating supports differ in modes; wind, waves, currents and moorings affect motion. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of supports, mooring and dynamics, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed fixed/floating mode maps and load combinations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cables/onshore interconnection in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Upstream wakes affect downwind rotors; array/export cables add losses and dependencies. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of array wakes and cables, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate wake loss, cable loss and downtime. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify taiwan o&m/windows in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Greater Changhua Offshore Wind Farms. Access windows and fatigue distributions affect availability; one full-power test does not prove lifetime. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, maintenance and fatigue, focusing on farshore direct-drive arrays, typhoons and supply chains. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare capacity factor, availability and cycles from assumed time series. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交海纜與岸上互連的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交臺灣O&M與窗口的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交臺灣O&M與窗口的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cables/onshore interconnection.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for taiwan o&m/windows.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for taiwan o&m/windows.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：容量因數與可用率是同一比例。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Capacity factor and availability are the same ratio.

guides.concept: 以厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫解析胡佛水壩水力發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System through thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「胡佛水壩水力發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Hoover有效水頭。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是厚拱壩、水頭變動與多目標水庫。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

procedureEn: Identify hoover effective head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify turbine operating maps in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify penstock transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify thick-arch load paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify water/power scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on thick-arch dams, variable head and multipurpose reservoirs. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reservoir/sediment boundaries in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Hoover Dam Hydroelectric Power System. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：三峽水電站發電系統
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System
guides.concept: 以巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡解析三峽水電站發電系統：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System through large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識長江flow與head。有效水頭與流量共同給出水力功率；高程差需扣除流動損失。 建立水頭流量與能量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對rho g Q H與效率及單位。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識巨型水輪工況。Francis、Kaplan與Pelton適合不同水頭流量；離設計點效率與空蝕風險會變。 建立水輪機與工況的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想效率地圖而非只取最高效率點。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水道與機組暫態。快速流速改變產生壓力波；剛性水柱與彈性波模型有不同適用尺度。 建立水路暫態與水錘的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較兩種假想關閉時間下的時間尺度及波幅。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識壩體與發電洞室。壩體、基礎與水路承擔不同載荷；滲流與位移需聯合解釋。 建立土建機械與滲流的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫水壓、重力及支承路徑，另標監測量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識多目標水庫調度。抽蓄搬移電能並有循環損失；多目標水庫還需供水與生態約束。 建立發電儲能與調度的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分別覈對天然入流能量與抽蓄往返能量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「三峽水電站發電系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識水沙與生態證據。泥砂改變庫容及磨損；魚類、水質與下游流量不能由MW指標代替。 建立泥砂環境與壽命的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是巨型機組、聯合水庫與水沙平衡。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想泥砂收支、機組磨損與環境指標。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify yangtze flow/head in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Effective head/flow define hydraulic power; elevation differences need flow-loss corrections. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of head, flow and energy, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check rho g Q H, efficiencies and units. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify large-turbine envelopes in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Francis, Kaplan and Pelton target different envelopes; off-design efficiency/cavitation vary. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of turbines and operating envelopes, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed efficiency maps beyond the best point. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify waterway/unit transients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Rapid velocity changes launch pressure waves; rigid-column/elastic-wave models apply at different scales. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of water transients and water hammer, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare timescales/wave amplitudes for two assumed closing times. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dam/powerhouse in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Dam, foundation and waterways carry different loads; seepage/displacement need joint interpretation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of civil works, mechanics and seepage, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw pressure, gravity and support paths with separate observables. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify multipurpose scheduling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Pumped storage shifts energy with cycle losses; multipurpose reservoirs need water/ecological constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of generation, storage and scheduling, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate natural inflow energy from pumped-cycle energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify water/sediment/ecology in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Three Gorges Hydropower Generation System. Sediment changes storage/wear; fish, quality and downstream flows are not captured by MW. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of sediment, environment and life, focusing on large units, coordinated reservoirs and water/sediment balance. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sediment balance, wear and environmental metrics. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交多目標水庫調度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交水沙與生態證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交水沙與生態證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for multipurpose scheduling.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for water/sediment/ecology.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for water/sediment/ecology.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：高發電量可證明所有生態影響均可忽略。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High generation makes all ecological effects negligible.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research
guides.concept: 以公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環解析Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research through public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識EGS熱與連通。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識研究井完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識假想發電循環選擇。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識換熱與礦物證據。結垢降低熱傳且影響流阻；化學腐蝕與機械磨耗不是同一機制。 建立換熱結垢與腐蝕的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識示蹤與thermal return。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Utah FORGE 增強型地熱研究」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識公開microseismic目錄。地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。 建立微震監測與生態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是公開儲層觀測、井筒與熱循環。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify egs heat/connectivity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify research-well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify assumed-cycle choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify transfer/mineral evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tracer/thermal return in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify public microseismic catalogs in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Utah FORGE enhanced-geothermal research. Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on public reservoir observations, wells and heat cycles. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交示蹤與thermal return的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交公開microseismic目錄的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交公開microseismic目錄的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tracer/thermal return.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public microseismic catalogs.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for public microseismic catalogs.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：單一發電指標可替代地震及環境監測。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: One generation metric replaces seismic/environmental monitoring.

guides.conceptEn: Explore Krafla geothermal and reinjection system through volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識Krafla儲層觀測。地熱依賴熱、水與可連通通道；溫度高本身不證明足夠的循環能力。 建立儲層概念與可觀測量的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開溫度、壓力、流量與結構的不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識高溫井與完整性。井筒把地下流體連至地面；材料、熱變形與密封有不同失效證據。 建立井筒完整性與熱損的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。以給定假想記錄比較溫壓變化與完整性假說。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識高低壓steam循環。資源流體可直接供蒸汽或經換熱驅動另一工作流體；三種路線的邊界不同。 建立閃蒸乾蒸汽與雙循環的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在原創圖上區分資源流體、蒸汽及工作流體。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識結垢與材料。結垢降低熱傳且影響流阻；化學腐蝕與機械磨耗不是同一機制。 建立換熱結垢與腐蝕的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。把換熱性能、壓差與材料證據交叉比較。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識回注與溫度變化。回注維持部分質量循環，但短路徑可能使冷流體過早影響產出。 建立回注質量與熱突破的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想示蹤時間與長期溫度曲線的不同證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Krafla 地熱與回注系統」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識環境與微震證據。地下變化需按現場規則與監測解釋；微震、流體與生態數據有獨立指標。 建立微震監測與生態的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是火山儲層、蒸汽利用與回注。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。僅分析給定公開／假想目錄的時空變化與不確定度。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify krafla reservoir observations in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify high-temperature well integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify high/low-pressure steam in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify scaling/materials in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reinjection/temperature in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify environment/seismic evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Krafla geothermal and reinjection system. Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on volcanic resources, steam utilization and reinjection. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交回注與溫度變化的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交環境與微震證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交環境與微震證據的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for reinjection/temperature.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for environment/seismic evidence.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for environment/seismic evidence.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：單一發電指標可替代地震及環境監測。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: One generation metric replaces seismic/environmental monitoring.

procedureEn: Identify olkaria two-phase resources in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Geothermal resources need heat, water and connected paths; temperature alone does not prove circulation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir concepts and observables, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate temperature, pressure, flow and structural uncertainties. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify wellfield integrity in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Wells connect fluid to surface; materials, expansion and seals have different evidence. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well integrity and heat loss, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed temperature/pressure histories with integrity hypotheses. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify flash/wellhead units in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Resources can supply steam directly or heat a secondary fluid; the routes have different boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of flash, dry-steam and binary cycles, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate resource fluid, steam and working fluid in an original diagram. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify separation/heat transfer in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Scale reduces transfer/changes resistance; corrosion differs from mechanical wear. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of heat transfer, scaling and corrosion, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Cross-check heat-transfer performance, pressure drop and materials evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify reinjection/recharge in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Reinjection supports mass balance, while short paths can accelerate cold breakthrough. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reinjection, mass and thermal breakthrough, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed tracer timing with longer-term thermal histories. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify park ecology/evidence in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Olkaria Geothermal Power Stations. Subsurface changes need site rules/monitoring; seismic, fluid and ecological data have distinct metrics. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of microseismic monitoring and environment, focusing on two-phase resources, flash and phased wellhead generation. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Analyze supplied public/assumed catalogs for spatiotemporal changes and uncertainty only. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage
guides.concept: 以分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界解析Sleipner 油氣與碳封存：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage through separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識油氣與CO2物料。油氣儲層需區分孔隙流體、壓力與連通；累計產量與可採資源不同。 建立儲層模型與物料平衡的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按給定假想數據覈對流入、流出與庫存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識井筒完整性概念。多個屏障路徑與監測共同支持完整性；概念課不提供鑽井或井控操作參數。 建立井筒屏障與完整性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用原創功能圖區分承壓路徑與監測，不設計現場操作。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識分離與輸送相態。氣液相分佈影響流動及設備負載；單相近似只適合指定假設。 建立多相輸送與壓降的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想單相與兩相情境的模型失配。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識處理與儲層界面。立管、海底設備與上部處理各有壓力、運動及可維修邊界。 建立海底連接與平臺的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫平臺—海底接口並標海況及維護假設。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識capture能耗與減排。分離、壓縮與冷卻消耗能量；岸電改變部分排放邊界而不使全生命週期零排放。 建立處理能量與排放的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開現場、外購電與生命週期假想排放。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Sleipner 油氣與碳封存」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識封存monitoring與不確定度。可用率受維護、完整性與供能限制；只做公開報告和假想事件分析。 建立監測停機與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是分離、壓縮與封存監測邊界。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表比較停機、恢復及泄漏證據鏈。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify hydrocarbon/co2 balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Reservoirs distinguish pore fluids, pressure and connectivity; cumulative production differs from recoverable resources. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reservoir models and material balance, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check inflow, outflow and inventory using assumed data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify well-integrity concepts in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Multiple barriers/monitoring support integrity; conceptual courses supply no drilling or well-control settings. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of well barriers and integrity, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate containment and monitoring in an original functional diagram without field operations. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify separation/transport phases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Gas/liquid distributions affect flow/loading; single-phase approximations need bounded assumptions. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of multiphase transport and pressure drop, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare single/two-phase assumed cases for model mismatch. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify processing/reservoir interfaces in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Risers, subsea systems and topsides have distinct pressure, motion and serviceability boundaries. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of subsea links and platforms, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw platform/subsea interfaces with environmental/service assumptions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify capture energy/abatement in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Separation, compression and cooling use energy; shore power shifts some emissions without making lifecycle emissions zero. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of processing energy and emissions, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate onsite, purchased-power and lifecycle assumed emissions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify storage monitoring/uncertainty in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Sleipner oil/gas and carbon storage. Maintenance, integrity and energy affect availability; analyze public reports/assumed events only. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of monitoring, shutdown and recovery, focusing on separation, compression and storage-monitoring boundaries. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare downtime, recovery and containment evidence in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

提交封存monitoring與不確定度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交封存monitoring與不確定度的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for capture energy/abatement.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for storage monitoring/uncertainty.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for storage monitoring/uncertainty.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：恢復產量本身就證明所有安全狀態均正確。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Recovered production proves every safety state correct.

guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Boddington 自動化金銅礦
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Boddington automated gold/copper mine
guides.concept: 以露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收解析Boddington 自動化金銅礦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Boddington automated gold/copper mine through surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識金銅grade分佈。品位分佈與取樣支持不同置信度；局部高品位不能代替整礦估計。 建立資源品位與代表採樣的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較加權平均品位與未加權平均。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識露天autonomous haulage。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識粒度與解離。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識給料與精礦balance。密度、粒徑及形狀共同影響重力分離；精礦品位、產率與回收率不同。 建立重力選別與質量收支的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用給定假想給料與精礦計算金屬守恆。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識通信與人員隔離。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Boddington 自動化金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識礦水尾礦與覆育。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是露天礦、自治搬運與物料回收。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify gold/copper grades in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify surface autonomous haulage in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify size/liberation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify feed/concentrate balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Density, size and shape affect gravity separation; concentrate grade, yield and recovery differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gravity separation and mass balance, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify communications/people separation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify mine water/tailings/rehabilitation in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Boddington automated gold/copper mine. Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of tailings, water and rehabilitation, focusing on surface mining, autonomous haulage and material recovery. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

提交礦水尾礦與覆育的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交礦水尾礦與覆育的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。

Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for mine water/tailings/rehabilitation.

在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識panel caving物料路徑。露天、地下與重力砂金路徑的邊界不同；搬運與支撐影響能量和風險。 建立開坑地下與搬運的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫礦石、廢石與人員／設備分開的概念路徑。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識碎礦與磨礦能量。粒徑減小可能提高解離但增加能耗與細泥；粒度不是金屬回收率。 建立粒徑解離與破碎的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想粒度分佈、解離率與單位能耗。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識銅金回收balance。密度、粒徑及形狀共同影響重力分離；精礦品位、產率與回收率不同。 建立重力選別與質量收支的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用給定假想給料與精礦計算金屬守恆。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識地下ventilation供電。地下通風與電力是支援系統；自動搬運需感測、通信與人員隔離。 建立通風電力與自動化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較失去一項支援時的概念依賴，不操作真實礦井。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Cadia 地下金銅礦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識尾礦與長期水管理。尾礦與礦水需質量平衡、監測與長期管理；回收目標不替代環境約束。 建立尾礦水與復育的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是panel caving、地下支援與長期礦水。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較假想水與固體收支及修復證據。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify underground grades/sampling in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Grades/samples have different confidence; a rich local sample is not a mine-wide estimate. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of resources, grade and representative sampling, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare weighted and unweighted grade means. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify panel-caving material paths in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Surface, underground and placer routes differ; haulage/support affect energy and risks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of open-pit, underground and haulage, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw separate conceptual ore, waste and people/equipment paths. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify comminution energy in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Size reduction can improve liberation while increasing energy/slimes; size is not recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of particle size, liberation and comminution, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed size distributions, liberation and specific energy. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify copper/gold recovery balance in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Density, size and shape affect gravity separation; concentrate grade, yield and recovery differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of gravity separation and mass balance, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check metal balance from assumed feed/concentrate data. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify underground ventilation/power in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Ventilation/power support underground work; automated haulage needs sensing, communications and separation. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of ventilation, power and automation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare conceptual lost-support dependencies without operating a mine. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify tailings/long-term water in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Cadia underground gold/copper mine. Tailings/water need balance, monitoring and long-term management; recovery targets do not replace environmental constraints. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of tailings, water and rehabilitation, focusing on panel caving, underground support and long-term mine water. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed water/solids balance and rehabilitation evidence. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交地下ventilation供電的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交尾礦與長期水管理的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交尾礦與長期水管理的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for underground ventilation/power.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tailings/long-term water.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for tailings/long-term water.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：回收率高表示尾礦與礦水沒有影響。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: High recovery means tailings/water have no impact.

guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Deep MLP and autoencoder
guides.concept: 以全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建解析深度 MLP 與自動編碼器：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Deep MLP and autoencoder through dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識MLP weight與bias。單層y=Wx+b的參數數是輸入×輸出加輸出bias；權重共享假設需另列。 建立全連接層與參數的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對兩層小MLP逐矩陣核對參數及輸出shape。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識非線性與latent瓶頸。線性encoder-decoder組合的秩受瓶頸限制；非線性改變表達但不保證保留任務資訊。 建立線性瓶頸與非線性的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。用低秩矩陣與非線性小例比較可重建資訊。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識encoder-decoder梯度。低重建誤差可能保留背景而忽略小但關鍵訊號；latent表徵需用獨立任務驗證。 建立重建與任務效用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。構造相同平均重建誤差但不同關鍵訊號保留的兩案例。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識全連接參數與activation。參數、啟動值及中間工作區都是記憶體負載；低參數數未必低算力需求。 建立運算量與記憶體的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開計數參數、activation及理想算術成本。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「深度 MLP 與自動編碼器」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識潛在維度與失效。平均指標可掩蓋少數類與分佈漂移；模型信心不等於正確率。 建立失效分析與泛化的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是全連接層、非線性與潛在瓶頸重建。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較分組誤差、校準與未見情境表現。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify mlp weights/biases in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. For y=Wx+b, parameters equal input times output plus output bias; shared weights need separate specification. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of dense layers and parameters, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check each parameter matrix and output shape in a small two-layer MLP. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify nonlinearity/latent bottleneck in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. A linear encoder-decoder has bottleneck-limited rank; nonlinearity changes expression without ensuring task information survives. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of linear bottlenecks and nonlinearities, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare recoverable information in low-rank and nonlinear examples. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify encoder-decoder gradients in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Low reconstruction error may preserve background but omit small critical signals; validate latents on independent tasks. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of reconstruction and task utility, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Construct equal-mean-error cases with different critical-signal preservation. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify dense parameters/activations in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Parameters, activations and workspace use memory; few parameters need not imply little compute. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of compute and memory, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Count parameters, activations and ideal arithmetic separately. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify sample/reconstruction splits in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Splits should match deployment; duplicate examples and temporal leakage inflate scores. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of data splits and leakage, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped/temporal and random splits on assumed results. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify latent dimensions/failure in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Deep MLP and autoencoder. Means hide minority classes and distribution shifts; confidence is not correctness. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of failure analysis and generalization, focusing on dense layers, nonlinearities and latent-bottleneck reconstruction. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare grouped errors, calibration and withheld scenarios. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Common LSTMs separate input/forget/output gates and candidate updates; cell and hidden state differ. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of memory and three gates, focusing on gated memory, shared weights and long-sequence gradients. guides.conceptEn: Explore DDPM diffusion-generation network through forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識clean sample與noise。DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 建立前向加噪與邊際的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：ASML 微影投影光學工程
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: ASML lithography projection-optics engineering
guides.concept: 以 ASML TWINSCAN 的 4 倍縮小投影鏡頭為對象，從 CD = k₁·λ/NA 與景深出發，拆解熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片的面形預算、NA 1.35 折反射浸潤架構與偏振、原位波前量測與 Zernike 分解、鏡片熱漂移與操縱器校正，最後整合成套刻預算與成像驗收記錄。
guides.conceptEn: Taking the 4× reduction projection lens of an ASML TWINSCAN as the object, this course starts from CD = k₁·λ/NA and depth of focus, then works through figure budgets for fused-silica and CaF₂ elements, the NA 1.35 catadioptric immersion layout and polarization, in-situ wavefront metrology with Zernike decomposition, lens-heating drift and manipulator correction, and ends with the overlay budget and imaging acceptance record.
procedure: 投影光學把光罩圖形縮小 4 倍成像到晶圓，能印出的最小特徵由 Rayleigh 關係 CD = k₁·λ/NA 決定：λ 是曝光波長，NA 是像方數值孔徑，k₁ 是由照明、光罩與光阻製程共同決定的製程因子，物理下限為 0.25。景深則隨 NA 平方縮小，DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA²，所以提高 NA 換來解析度的同時，晶圓平坦度、對焦控制與鏡頭場曲的預算都被壓縮。ArF 浸潤式以水的折射率 1.437 把 NA 推到 1.35，EUV 則以 13.5 nm 波長在 NA 0.33 與 0.55 上取得更小的 CD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「投影鏡頭數值孔徑與像方空間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

照明系統把雷射光整形成光瞳上的特定分佈，用 σ 表示照明 NA 與投影 NA 的比值；離軸照明（環形、雙極）讓零階與一階繞射光對稱落入光瞳，能把可解析間距推到 λ/(2NA)。投影鏡頭在像方必須遠心：主光線垂直於晶圓，否則離焦會轉成放大率變化與套刻位移。光罩側也接近遠心，以降低光罩高度變化造成的位移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「照明光瞳與部分同調」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

193 nm 可用的透鏡材料只有高純度熔融石英（n ≈ 1.560）與氟化鈣（n ≈ 1.501），兩者在深紫外的色散都很大，所以鏡頭幾乎無法消色差，必須靠雷射線寬窄化到 0.3 pm 等級來避免色像差。折射面的面形誤差 h 轉成波前誤差時乘上 (n − 1)，約為 0.56h，比反射鏡的 2h 寬鬆近四倍，但鏡頭有數十片元件，總波前預算仍須分配到次奈米。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熔融石英與 CaF₂ 鏡片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NA 超過 1 時，光在像方介質中的角度極大，純折射設計需要巨大的鏡片直徑與難以修正的場曲，因此高 NA 鏡頭採用折反射架構：以凹面鏡提供負 Petzval 貢獻並壓縮鏡片尺寸。末端鏡片以平面接觸水膜，水的折射率 1.437 把像方 NA 提高。在這麼大的角度下，TM 偏振的兩束干涉對比隨 cos(2θ) 下降甚至反相，因此照明必須以 TE 偏振為主並由鏡頭保持偏振純度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「折反射浸潤式末端鏡組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

微影機在晶圓台上裝有干涉式波前感測器，以鏡頭本身的曝光光經過光罩側的針孔或光柵，在像方量測整個出瞳的波前，並分解成 Zernike 多項式係數 Z₂ 到 Z₃₇ 以上。低階的傾斜與離焦對應套刻位移與最佳焦面，彗差與球差造成圖形位移隨間距改變與 CD 隨焦距不對稱，像散造成水平與垂直線最佳焦面分離。每個場點都要量，因為像差隨場變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「波前感測器與 Zernike 係數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

曝光光在鏡片材料與鍍膜中的微量吸收會讓鏡片升溫，熔融石英在 193 nm 的 dn/dT 約 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹，溫度分佈又跟照明光瞳形狀相關：雙極照明只加熱光瞳上的兩個區域，於是產生與時間相關的像散與高階像差。這種漂移在每批晶圓曝光期間以分鐘尺度變化，必須以熱模型預測並由鏡頭操縱器即時補償，誤差預算要同時包含量測不確定度與模型殘差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片熱負載與熱透鏡效應」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡頭內有若干片可由致動器沿軸向移動、傾斜或橫向平移的元件，另有可變形或可加熱的波前操縱元件；每個自由度對各 Zernike 項的靈敏度在出廠時以干涉量測建立成矩陣。校正時把量測到的像差向量以最小平方法反解成操縱器動作，同時要控制交叉耦合：修正球差的軸向移動也會改變離焦與放大率，必須由其他自由度同時抵消。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡片操縱器與靈敏度矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

投影光學的最終驗收不是看鏡頭報告，而是看印出的結果：以測試光罩在整個場內量 CD 均勻性、H-V bias、通焦 CD 曲線與套刻畸變，並把鏡頭畸變、晶圓台、對準與光罩的貢獻合成一張套刻預算表。交接文件必須包含各場點的 Zernike 基準值、操縱器狀態、熱模型參數與允許的漂移範圍，讓後續維護能判斷鏡頭是否仍在預算內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「成像驗收與製程窗口報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The projection optics image the reticle pattern onto the wafer at 4× reduction, and the smallest printable feature follows the Rayleigh relation CD = k₁·λ/NA, where λ is the exposure wavelength, NA the image-side numerical aperture and k₁ a process factor set jointly by illumination, mask and resist with a physical floor of 0.25. Depth of focus shrinks with the square of NA, DOF ≈ k₂·λ/NA², so every gain in resolution from NA compresses the budget left for wafer flatness, focus control and lens field curvature. ArF immersion uses water with index 1.437 to reach NA 1.35, while EUV reaches smaller CD at 13.5 nm with NA 0.33 and 0.55. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Projection-lens NA and image space”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The illuminator shapes the laser beam into a chosen pupil distribution, with σ denoting the ratio of illumination NA to projection NA; off-axis schemes such as annular or dipole illumination place the zeroth and first diffraction orders symmetrically in the pupil, pushing the resolvable pitch toward λ/(2NA). The projection lens must be telecentric on the image side, with chief rays normal to the wafer, otherwise defocus turns into magnification change and overlay shift. The reticle side is also nearly telecentric to suppress placement errors from reticle height variation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Illumination pupil and partial coherence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Only high-purity fused silica (n ≈ 1.560) and calcium fluoride (n ≈ 1.501) transmit well enough at 193 nm, and both disperse strongly in the deep UV, so the lens can barely be achromatised and instead relies on a laser linewidth narrowed to the 0.3 pm level to avoid chromatic aberration. A refracting surface converts a figure error h into wavefront error (n − 1)h, about 0.56h, nearly four times more forgiving than the 2h of a mirror, but with tens of elements the total wavefront budget still has to be split into sub-nanometre shares. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fused-silica and CaF₂ lens elements”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Above NA 1 the ray angles in the image medium become extreme, and an all-refractive design would need huge element diameters and uncorrectable field curvature, so high-NA lenses use a catadioptric layout in which a concave mirror supplies negative Petzval contribution and shrinks the elements. The final element touches the water film with a flat face, and the water index of 1.437 raises the image-side NA. At such angles the two-beam interference contrast for TM polarization falls as cos(2θ) and can even invert, so illumination must be predominantly TE polarized and the lens must preserve that polarization purity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Catadioptric immersion final group”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The scanner carries an interferometric wavefront sensor on the wafer stage that uses the exposure light itself, passing through a pinhole or grating on the reticle side, to measure the full exit-pupil wavefront at the image and decompose it into Zernike coefficients from Z₂ up to Z₃₇ and beyond. Low-order tilt and defocus map to overlay shift and best-focus position, coma and spherical aberration produce pitch-dependent pattern shift and asymmetric CD through focus, and astigmatism separates the best focus of horizontal and vertical lines. Every field point must be measured because aberrations vary across the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Wavefront sensor and Zernike coefficients”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Weak absorption of the exposure light in element materials and coatings heats the elements, and fused silica has dn/dT of about 2×10⁻⁵ K⁻¹ at 193 nm; because the heating pattern follows the illumination pupil, a dipole heats only two zones of a pupil-plane element and generates time-dependent astigmatism and higher-order aberrations. The drift evolves on a minute scale during each lot, so it must be predicted by a thermal model and compensated in real time by lens manipulators, with the error budget covering both measurement uncertainty and model residuals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens thermal load and thermal lensing”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Several elements inside the lens can be moved axially, tilted or translated by actuators, and deformable or heated wavefront manipulators add further degrees of freedom; the sensitivity of each degree of freedom to every Zernike term is established interferometrically at the factory as a matrix. During correction the measured aberration vector is inverted by least squares into manipulator moves while cross-coupling is managed, because an axial move that corrects spherical aberration also changes focus and magnification and must be cancelled simultaneously by other degrees of freedom. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lens manipulators and sensitivity matrix”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Final acceptance of projection optics is judged on printed results rather than the lens report: a test reticle is used to measure CD uniformity across the field, H-V bias, CD through focus and overlay distortion, and the contributions of lens distortion, wafer stage, alignment and reticle are combined into a single overlay budget table. The handoff record must contain the baseline Zernike values at every field point, manipulator states, thermal-model parameters and permitted drift ranges, so that later maintenance can judge whether the lens is still within budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Imaging acceptance and process-window record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Choosing NA from the CD formula alone while ignoring the shrinking depth of focus lets wafer topography and focus noise consume the whole process window, so lines at the field edge randomly break or bridge even though the lens aberration data pass every specification.

If the sensor and exposure coordinate sign conventions disagree, the correction doubles the aberration instead of cancelling it; measuring only at field centre leaves edge astigmatism and coma unseen, so CD uniformity across the field fails.
