guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：光纖陀螺儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Fiber-optic gyroscopes
guides.concept: 以 1 km 線圈的干涉式光纖陀螺儀為對象，從薩格納克相位 Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc) 與最小互易架構出發，建置寬頻光源、鈮酸鋰積體光學晶片、保偏光纖四極線圈與本徵頻率偏壓調制，再用轉台校正、艾倫偏差分離角度隨機漫步與零偏不穩定性，並以閉迴路鋸齒波回授與 IEEE 952 式測試完成導航級陀螺的驗收。
guides.conceptEn: Taking a 1 km coil interferometric fiber-optic gyroscope as the object, this course starts from the Sagnac phase Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc) and the minimum reciprocal configuration, builds the broadband source, lithium-niobate integrated-optic chip, quadrupole-wound polarization-maintaining coil and proper-frequency bias modulation, then separates angle random walk from bias instability with rate-table calibration and Allan deviation, and closes with closed-loop serrodyne feedback and IEEE 952-style tests for navigation-grade acceptance.
procedure: 在一個旋轉的閉合光路中，順時針與逆時針傳播的兩束光回到起點所需的時間不同，相位差 Δφ = 4π·A·Ω/(λc)，其中 A 是光路包圍的面積、Ω 是垂直於面積的旋轉速率。這個效應極小，但光纖可以把同一面積繞 N 圈：N 圈直徑 D 的線圈總面積 N·πD²/4，光纖長度 L = NπD，於是 Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc)。光纖陀螺就是把一個長達公里的薩格納克干涉儀捲進手掌大小的線圈，比例因子由 L、D 與 λ 三個幾何與波長量決定，而與光纖折射率無關——這是薩格納克效應的相對論性本質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薩格納克相位與線圈比例因子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

要讓 10⁻⁸ 波長等級的非互易相位被看見，兩束光除了旋轉以外必須走完全相同的路：同一個單模、單偏振的空間濾波器（偏振器）、同一個耦合器埠進出、同一條光纖。這就是 Ulrich 的最小互易架構：任何互易的相位（溫度、壓力、波長變化）對兩束光相同而相消，只剩薩格納克相位。但干涉訊號 I ∝ 1 + cosΔφ 在 Δφ = 0 處斜率為零，於是在線圈一端加相位調制器，以線圈傳播時間 τ 為半週期的方波或正弦波調制，兩束光因在不同時刻經過調制器而獲得相差 π/2 的偏壓，工作點移到 cos 曲線的最大斜率處，並以同步解調讀出正負號。這個調制頻率 f_p = 1/(2τ) 稱為線圈的本徵頻率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「最小互易架構與本徵頻率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光纖陀螺故意使用低相干的寬頻光源（摻鉺光纖 ASE 光源或超輻射二極體 SLD），因為瑞利背向散射、光纖中的偏振交叉耦合與克爾效應都會產生與主光束干涉的寄生波；相干長度短到數十微米時，只有在線圈正中央極短一段內的散射才會相干相加，其餘全部變成非相干背景。核心元件是鈮酸鋰多功能積體光學晶片（MIOC）：質子交換波導同時做偏振器（消光比 > 60 dB）、Y 分支分束器與兩個電光相位調制器，頻寬達 GHz，使閉迴路運作成為可能。偵測器為 InGaAs PIN 光二極體加跨阻放大器，工作在 10–50 µW 的回光功率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ASE 寬頻光源與 LiNbO₃ 積體光學晶片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

最小互易架構消除的是靜態的互易相位；若溫度在光傳播的 τ 期間改變，兩束光在不同時刻經過同一段光纖，看到的折射率不同，產生非互易相位——這就是舒佩效應，它正比於溫度變化速率沿光纖的不對稱分佈。對策是把線圈繞成四極對稱：把光纖從中點對折，兩半以 +−−+ 的順序交替成層，使距中點等距的兩段光纖在空間上相鄰、溫度幾乎相同。線圈用保偏光纖（熊貓或領結型）、低應力膠固化，並控制張力與層間交叉點，因為每一個交叉都是偏振耦合點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「保偏光纖四極繞法線圈與舒佩效應」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

陀螺的校正有三件事：比例因數（輸出對輸入速率的斜率與線性度，在速率轉台上以 ±0.1 到 ±500°/s 的多點量測）、零偏及其溫度模型（在溫箱中靜置，扣除地球自轉分量後對溫度與溫度速率擬合多項式）、以及雜訊指標。雜訊以艾倫偏差 σ(τ) 分解：斜率 −1/2 的區段是角度隨機漫步（ARW，單位 °/√h），平坦區是零偏不穩定性（閃爍雜訊，單位 °/h），斜率 +1/2 是速率隨機漫步。ARW 的理論下限由偵測器光電流的散粒雜訊決定，是評估光學設計是否達標的第一個數字。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「速率轉台、溫箱與艾倫偏差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

散粒雜訊之外，寬頻光源的相對強度雜訊（RIN）是 ARW 的主要來源：ASE 光源的 RIN 約等於光學頻寬的倒數，在工作點上強度起伏與相位起伏 1:1 對應。零偏誤差則來自：殘餘相干背向散射、克爾效應（兩方向功率不等時非線性折射率造成的非互易相位，可用方波調制與 50% 佔空比抑制）、法拉第效應（地磁場經光纖扭轉耦合產生非互易相位，需 µ 金屬屏蔽）、偏振非互易（由偏振器消光比與光纖 h 參數決定）以及電子學的解調偏移。預算表把每一項以 °/h 或 °/√h 列出，均方根合成後對照等級要求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光源 RIN、背向散射、克爾與法拉第效應」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

開迴路陀螺的輸出是 sinΔφ，只在小角度線性；閉迴路把薩格納克相位用 MIOC 的相位調制器即時抵消：每個傳播時間 τ 把回授相位增加一個台階 Δφ_S（數位相位斜坡），累積到 2π 時重置，斜坡的頻率就正比於旋轉速率，而干涉儀永遠工作在零相位附近。這樣輸出對速率的線性度不再依賴 cos 曲線，而只依賴 2π 重置的準確度，所以第二個伺服迴路持續校正調制器的 V_2π，把電光係數的溫漂（約 0.1%/K）消除。三軸陀螺與三軸加速度計組成 IMU，軸間正交性以轉台校正到 100 µrad 內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「數位相位斜坡與閉迴路回授」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光纖陀螺的驗收遵循公開的測試標準（IEEE Std 952 為單軸干涉式光纖陀螺的測試程序）：以艾倫偏差報告 ARW 與零偏不穩定性、以轉台報告比例因數及其線性度與重複性、以溫箱報告零偏與比例因數的溫度係數、以磁場與振動測試報告環境靈敏度。等級由這些數字共同決定：導航級通常指零偏不穩定性 ≤ 0.01°/h、ARW ≤ 0.002°/√h、比例因數 ≤ 50 ppm。交接文件包含每台陀螺的序號、所有校正係數（比例因數、零偏溫度模型、軸對準矩陣）、艾倫偏差圖、以及可追溯的轉台與溫箱校正證書。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「IEEE 952 式測試與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: In a rotating closed optical path the clockwise and counter-clockwise beams need different times to return to their starting point, with a phase difference Δφ = 4π·A·Ω/(λc), where A is the enclosed area and Ω the rotation rate normal to it. The effect is tiny, but fiber can wind the same area N times: a coil of N turns and diameter D encloses N·πD²/4 with fiber length L = NπD, so Δφ = 2πLD·Ω/(λc). A fiber-optic gyroscope is a kilometre-long Sagnac interferometer coiled into a palm-sized package; the scale factor is set by the geometric and wavelength quantities L, D and λ alone and not by the fiber's refractive index, which is the relativistic nature of the Sagnac effect. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sagnac phase and coil scale factor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

To see a non-reciprocal phase of 10⁻⁸ wavelengths, the two beams must travel exactly the same path apart from rotation: the same single-mode, single-polarization spatial filter (polarizer), the same coupler port in and out, the same fiber. This is Ulrich's minimum reciprocal configuration: every reciprocal phase (temperature, pressure, wavelength change) is identical for both beams and cancels, leaving only the Sagnac phase. But the interference signal I ∝ 1 + cosΔφ has zero slope at Δφ = 0, so a phase modulator at one end of the coil, driven by a square or sine wave whose half-period equals the coil transit time τ, biases the two beams by π/2 because they pass the modulator at different times; the operating point moves to the steepest part of the cosine and synchronous demodulation reads out the sign. This modulation frequency f_p = 1/(2τ) is the coil's proper frequency. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Minimum reciprocal configuration and the proper frequency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A FOG deliberately uses a low-coherence broadband source (an erbium-fiber ASE source or a superluminescent diode) because Rayleigh backscatter, polarization cross-coupling in the fiber and the Kerr effect all produce parasitic waves that interfere with the main beams; with a coherence length of tens of micrometres, only scatter from a very short segment at the exact centre of the coil adds coherently and everything else becomes incoherent background. The core component is the lithium-niobate multifunction integrated-optic chip (MIOC): proton-exchanged waveguides act simultaneously as polarizer (extinction above 60 dB), Y-junction splitter and two electro-optic phase modulators with gigahertz bandwidth, which makes closed-loop operation possible. The detector is an InGaAs PIN photodiode with a transimpedance amplifier operating at 10–50 µW of returned power. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ASE broadband source and the LiNbO₃ integrated-optic chip”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The minimum reciprocal configuration removes static reciprocal phase; if temperature changes during the transit time τ, the two beams pass the same fiber segment at different instants, see different refractive indices and acquire a non-reciprocal phase, the Shupe effect, proportional to the asymmetric distribution of the temperature rate along the fiber. The countermeasure is quadrupole-symmetric winding: the fiber is folded at its midpoint and the two halves are layered alternately in a +−−+ sequence so that segments equidistant from the midpoint lie spatially adjacent at nearly the same temperature. The coil uses polarization-maintaining fiber (PANDA or bow-tie), low-stress potting and controlled tension and layer crossovers, because every crossover is a polarization-coupling point. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quadrupole-wound PM coil and the Shupe effect”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Calibrating a gyroscope covers three things: the scale factor (slope and linearity of output versus input rate, measured at many points from ±0.1 to ±500°/s on a rate table), the bias and its temperature model (static in a thermal chamber, fitting a polynomial in temperature and temperature rate after removing the Earth-rate component), and the noise metrics. Noise is decomposed with the Allan deviation σ(τ): the −1/2 slope region is angle random walk (ARW, in °/√h), the flat region is bias instability (flicker noise, in °/h), and the +1/2 slope is rate random walk. The theoretical ARW floor is set by shot noise of the detector photocurrent and is the first number used to judge whether the optical design is adequate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rate table, thermal chamber and Allan deviation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Beyond shot noise, the relative intensity noise (RIN) of the broadband source is the main contributor to ARW: an ASE source's RIN is roughly the inverse of its optical bandwidth, and at the operating point intensity fluctuations map one to one onto phase. Bias errors come from residual coherent backscatter, the Kerr effect (non-reciprocal phase from the nonlinear index when the two directions carry unequal power, suppressed by square-wave modulation at 50% duty cycle), the Faraday effect (non-reciprocal phase from the geomagnetic field coupled through fiber twist, requiring mu-metal shielding), polarization non-reciprocity (set by polarizer extinction and the fiber h-parameter) and demodulation offsets in the electronics. The budget lists each item in °/h or °/√h and compares the root-sum-square with the grade requirement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source RIN, backscatter, Kerr and Faraday effects”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An open-loop gyroscope outputs sinΔφ, linear only at small angles; closed loop cancels the Sagnac phase in real time with the MIOC phase modulator: every transit time τ the feedback phase steps by Δφ_S (a digital phase ramp) and resets when 2π is reached, the ramp frequency is proportional to the rotation rate, and the interferometer always works near zero phase. Linearity then no longer depends on the cosine curve but only on the accuracy of the 2π reset, so a second servo loop continuously calibrates the modulator's V_2π and removes the electro-optic coefficient's temperature drift (about 0.1%/K). Three gyroscopes with three accelerometers form an IMU whose inter-axis orthogonality is calibrated on a rate table to within 100 µrad. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Digital phase ramp and closed-loop feedback”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

FOG acceptance follows public test standards (IEEE Std 952 for single-axis interferometric fiber-optic gyros): ARW and bias instability are reported from the Allan deviation, scale factor with its linearity and repeatability from the rate table, temperature coefficients of bias and scale factor from the thermal chamber, and environmental sensitivity from magnetic and vibration tests. The grade follows from these numbers together: navigation grade usually means bias instability ≤ 0.01°/h, ARW ≤ 0.002°/√h and scale factor ≤ 50 ppm. The handoff file contains each gyroscope's serial number, all calibration coefficients (scale factor, bias temperature model, axis-alignment matrix), the Allan deviation plot and traceable calibration certificates for the rate table and thermal chamber. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “IEEE 952-style tests and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把線圈直徑從 100 mm 縮到 50 mm 以求小型化，卻沒有加長光纖，比例因子減半、相同雜訊下的角度隨機漫步加倍，原本導航級的設計變成戰術級。
校正時以 1 s 平均的資料估 ARW，卻沒注意資料已被輸出濾波器限頻，艾倫偏差在短 τ 處被人為壓低，報出比散粒雜訊極限還好的 ARW，上機後導航誤差比預測大三倍。
pitfallsEn: Shrinking the coil diameter from 100 mm to 50 mm for compactness without adding fiber halves the scale factor, doubles the angle random walk at the same noise, and a navigation-grade design becomes tactical grade.

Estimating ARW from 1 s averaged data without noticing that the output filter has already band-limited it artificially lowers the Allan deviation at short τ, an ARW better than the shot-noise limit is reported, and navigation error in service is three times the prediction.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：環形雷射陀螺儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Ring-laser gyroscopes
guides.concept: 從主動環形雷射腔中兩道反向行進光束的頻率差出發，推導比例因子 4A/(λL)，理解背向散射鎖定為何需要機械抖動，再把 Zerodur 腔體、超低損耗鏡、對稱放電、路徑長度控制與 Allan 偏差誤差預算整合成可交付的慣性量測單元工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the frequency difference between the two counter-propagating beams of an active ring-laser cavity, derive the 4A/(λL) scale factor, see why backscatter lock-in demands mechanical dither, then integrate the Zerodur block, ultralow-loss mirrors, symmetric discharge, path-length control and an Allan-deviation error budget into a deliverable inertial-measurement-unit engineering record.
procedure: 環形雷射陀螺儀的環形腔內同時振盪順時針與逆時針兩道 HeNe 雷射模態；腔體不轉動時兩者頻率相同，腔體以角速率 Ω 繞法線旋轉時，順轉方向的有效周長變長、逆轉方向變短，兩模態的諧振頻率因此分裂。把兩道光在合光稜鏡上疊加，光電二極體看到的條紋移動速率就是拍頻 Δf，它與 Ω 成正比，比例常數只取決於幾何面積、周長與波長，所以它是一個不含運動件的角速率積分器：累計條紋數就是累計轉角。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反向行進光束與拍頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鏡面上奈米級的散射把一小部分順時針光耦合到逆時針模態，兩個振盪器因而互相牽引；當拍頻低於耦合強度時，兩模態鎖成同一頻率，陀螺儀對小角速率完全沒有輸出。這個死區由 Adler 鎖定方程 dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ 描述，ω_L 正比於每圈的背向散射振幅 r_s 乘以自由光譜範圍 c/L。工程解法是讓整個腔體以數百赫茲作微小扭轉抖動，使瞬時角速率絕大部分時間遠高於鎖定門檻，只在每次過零時留下隨機相位誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背向散射與抖動馬達」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

腔體由單塊 Zerodur 玻璃陶瓷鑽孔而成，三面或四面鏡以光學接觸直接貼在拋光的端面上，不用黏膠，使腔長與鏡面角度不隨溫度與時間漂移。鏡子是離子束濺鍍的多層介電質超鏡，單鏡散射加吸收只有數 ppm，因為 HeNe 在 632.8 nm 的單程增益只有千分之幾，整圈損耗必須遠小於增益才能起振，同時低散射又直接壓低鎖定門檻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Zerodur 腔體與超低損耗鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

腔內以直流放電激發 He-Ne 混合氣，一個陰極配兩個對稱的陽極，使兩段放電的氣體流動方向相反而相互抵消；放電中離子拖動中性氣體產生的 Langmuir 流會透過 Fresnel 拖曳效應讓兩方向光速不同，若不對稱就變成假旋轉。氖氣採用 Ne-20 與 Ne-22 約等比例混合，使兩同位素的增益峰錯開，避免兩反向模態在同一組原子上競爭而互相熄滅。路徑長度控制以壓電驅動一面鏡子，鎖住總光強最大的腔長，使雷射始終工作在增益曲線中心。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對稱放電與路徑長度控制」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

合光稜鏡讓兩道輸出光以極小夾角重疊，形成空間條紋，兩個相隔四分之一條紋的光電二極體給出正交訊號，條紋移動方向決定旋轉方向，每個條紋邊緣都可計數，四倍解碼後角度解析度是條紋週期的四分之一。比例因子的校正在速率轉台上進行：轉台用自身的角度編碼器提供整數圈的精確轉角，陀螺儀累計的計數除以轉角就是 S，再分別在正反轉、不同速率與溫度下重複，建立比例因子的線性度與溫度係數表。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「速率轉台與正交讀出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

靜態長時間資料的 Allan 偏差把雜訊按時間尺度拆開：短平均時間下斜率 −1/2 的段落是白雜訊角速率，即角度隨機漫步 ARW；曲線底部的平坦段是零偏不穩定度，來自放電、溫度與磁場的慢變；更長時間若斜率轉為 +1/2，是速率隨機漫步或溫度趨勢。導航級規格通常要求零偏不穩定度 0.01 °/h 等級、ARW 0.005 °/√h 等級，並把各項按均方根合成，再換算成航向與位置誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Allan 偏差曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

三顆環形雷射陀螺儀與三顆加速度計裝在一個共用的感測器座上，輸入軸互相正交；每顆陀螺儀各自有抖動撓性件，抖動頻率刻意錯開數十赫茲，避免互相拍頻並透過底座耦合成假訊號。整機的誤準矩陣（非正交與相對於外殼基準面的旋轉）在多位置、多速率測試中解算，與比例因子、零偏一起寫入補償韌體；環形雷射陀螺儀對加速度不敏感，是它優於機械陀螺的關鍵，但抖動座的共振與振動整流仍必須在整機層級驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三軸抖動座與誤準矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整機最嚴格的功能驗證是靜態陀螺羅經對準：單元只靠量到的地球自轉水平分量 Ω_E·cosφ 找出真北，航向誤差直接由水平軸的零偏與一段對準時間內的 ARW 平均決定，因此這一項同時檢驗零偏、隨機漫步與誤準。驗收還包括溫度循環、振動、衝擊與電磁相容後重複上述測試，並比較校正參數在試驗前後的漂移。交接文件必須含比例因子、零偏、誤準矩陣、溫度係數、Allan 偏差曲線與鎖定門檻，使用者才能設定濾波器與判斷可用壽命。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「陀螺羅經對準與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A ring-laser gyroscope sustains clockwise and counter-clockwise HeNe modes in one ring cavity. At rest they share one frequency; when the block rotates at rate Ω about its normal, the effective perimeter grows for the co-rotating beam and shrinks for the counter-rotating one, so the two resonances split. Recombined on a prism, the beams give photodiodes a fringe-motion rate equal to the beat frequency Δf, which is proportional to Ω with a constant set only by enclosed area, perimeter and wavelength. The device is therefore a rate integrator with no moving parts: counting fringes counts angle. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Counter-propagating beams and beat frequency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Nanometre-scale scatter at the mirrors couples a little clockwise light into the counter-clockwise mode, and the two oscillators pull on each other; when the beat falls below the coupling strength the modes lock to one frequency and the gyro reads zero for small rates. The dead band follows the Adler equation dψ/dt = Δω − ω_L·sinψ, with ω_L proportional to the per-round-trip backscatter amplitude r_s times the free spectral range c/L. The engineering remedy twists the whole block at a few hundred hertz so that the instantaneous rate stays far above threshold almost all the time, leaving only a random phase error at each zero crossing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Backscatter and dither motor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The block is a single piece of Zerodur glass-ceramic with bored channels; three or four mirrors are optically contacted to polished end faces without adhesive, so cavity length and mirror angles do not drift with temperature or time. The mirrors are ion-beam-sputtered dielectric supermirrors with a few ppm of scatter plus absorption per mirror, because the single-pass HeNe gain at 632.8 nm is only a few tenths of a percent: round-trip loss must stay well below gain for oscillation, and low scatter also directly lowers the lock-in threshold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Zerodur block and ultralow-loss mirrors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A dc discharge excites the He-Ne mixture with one cathode and two symmetric anodes so that gas flow in the two discharge legs runs in opposite directions and cancels; ions dragging neutral gas produce Langmuir flow, and through Fresnel drag the two beams then see different light speeds, which reads as false rotation if asymmetric. Neon is a near-equal mix of Ne-20 and Ne-22 so the isotopes' gain peaks are offset and the two counter-propagating modes do not compete for the same atoms and quench each other. Path-length control drives one mirror with a piezo to hold the cavity length at maximum total intensity, keeping the laser at the centre of the gain curve. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Symmetric discharge and path-length control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The combining prism overlaps the two output beams at a tiny angle to form spatial fringes; two photodiodes a quarter fringe apart give quadrature signals, the direction of fringe motion gives the sign of rotation, every fringe edge can be counted, and fourfold decoding resolves a quarter of a fringe period. Scale factor is calibrated on a rate table whose own angle encoder provides exact whole-turn angles: accumulated gyro counts divided by the table angle give S, repeated in both directions, at several rates and temperatures, to build linearity and temperature-coefficient tables. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rate table and quadrature readout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An Allan deviation of long static data separates noise by time scale: the slope −1/2 segment at short averaging times is white rate noise, the angle random walk ARW; the flat floor is bias instability from slow discharge, temperature and magnetic changes; a later rise with slope +1/2 is rate random walk or a temperature trend. Navigation-grade specifications typically ask for bias instability of order 0.01 °/h and ARW of order 0.005 °/√h, combined root-sum-square and converted into heading and position error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Allan-deviation curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Three ring-laser gyros and three accelerometers sit on one shared sensor mount with mutually orthogonal input axes; each gyro has its own dither flexure and the dither frequencies are deliberately staggered by tens of hertz so they do not beat against each other and couple through the base as false signals. The unit's misalignment matrix (non-orthogonality and rotation relative to the housing reference faces) is solved from multi-position, multi-rate tests and written into compensation firmware alongside scale factors and biases; insensitivity to acceleration is the ring-laser gyro's key advantage over spinning-mass gyros, but dither-mount resonances and vibration rectification must still be verified at unit level. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-axis dithered mount and misalignment matrix”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The most demanding functional check of the finished unit is static gyrocompass alignment: using only the measured horizontal Earth-rate component Ω_E·cosφ the unit finds true north, and the heading error follows directly from horizontal-axis bias and the ARW averaged over the alignment time, so this one test exercises bias, random walk and misalignment together. Acceptance repeats it after thermal cycling, vibration, shock and electromagnetic-compatibility exposure and compares calibration parameters before and after. The handoff package must contain scale factors, biases, misalignment matrix, temperature coefficients, Allan-deviation curves and lock-in thresholds so the user can tune filters and judge usable life. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gyrocompass alignment and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把腔長計算成實體周長而忽略氣體折射率與鏡面相位深度，S 會偏差數十 ppm；在一小時 10,000° 的累計轉動中，50 ppm 的比例因子誤差等於 0.5° 的航向誤差，遠超過導航級允收。

pitfallsEn: Computing cavity length as the physical perimeter while ignoring gas refractive index and mirror phase depth biases S by tens of ppm; over 10,000° accumulated in an hour, a 50 ppm scale-factor error equals 0.5° of heading error, far beyond navigation-grade acceptance.

Quadrature phase off 90° or unequal channel gains make the decoder miss or double-count edges at high rate, so the scale factor appears rate dependent; compensating this readout fault as optical non-linearity fails as soon as the table rate changes.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：雷射干涉位移量測
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Laser-interferometric displacement metrology
guides.concept: 以穩頻 HeNe 雙頻雷射與平面鏡干涉儀為對象，從每條紋 λ/4 的相位計數推到次奈米解析度，再把 Edlén 空氣折射率、死程、Abbe 與餘弦誤差、偏振洩漏的週期性非線性整合成可追溯到波長標準的位移量測不確定度預算。
guides.conceptEn: Using a frequency-stabilised two-frequency HeNe laser with a plane-mirror interferometer, go from λ/4-per-fringe phase counting to sub-nanometre resolution, then fold Edlén air index, dead path, Abbe and cosine errors and polarisation-leakage periodic non-linearity into a displacement uncertainty budget traceable to the wavelength standard.
procedure: 雷射干涉儀把一道相干光分成參考臂與量測臂，量測臂的反射鏡隨待測物移動，兩臂重新合光後的干涉強度隨光程差作週期變化。角隅稜鏡干涉儀中位移 d 使光程差改變 2d，每移動 λ/2 走過一個條紋；平面鏡（雙程）干涉儀讓光束在量測鏡上反射兩次，光程差改變 4d，每 λ/4 一個條紋，對鏡面傾斜不敏感且解析度加倍。電子相位計把一個條紋再細分成數千等分，位移就是條紋數加上相位餘數乘以條紋週期，整個量測的長度單位來自雷射波長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「量測臂、參考臂與相位計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

外差式干涉儀的雷射輸出兩個頻率相差 f_s 的正交偏振分量，一個進參考臂、一個進量測臂；光電偵測器看到的是 f_s 的拍頻訊號，位移資訊藏在這個拍頻相對於參考拍頻的相位差中。鏡子移動時量測光束帶都卜勒頻移，拍頻變成 f_s ± 4v/λ；相位用交流訊號量測，對雷射強度漂移與偵測器偏壓不敏感，這是外差優於零差（直流）方案的關鍵。但拍頻不能降到零或翻轉，所以分頻 f_s 直接決定可量測的最高速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙頻雷射與都卜勒拍頻」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

位移的尺就是波長，所以雷射頭必須把頻率鎖住：常見作法是讓 HeNe 管內兩個正交偏振縱模的強度相等以鎖定腔長，或以 Zeeman 效應在軸向磁場中產生相差約 2 MHz 的左右旋圓偏振模態；需要更高速度時改用單頻雷射配聲光調制器移頻 20 MHz 以上。波長值由製造商對照碘穩頻 HeNe（CIPM 建議的 632.99 nm 參考）校正，商用雷射頭的波長準確度與長期穩定度通常在 10⁻⁸ 到 10⁻⁷ 量級，開機後需要數十分鐘熱平衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「穩頻 HeNe 雷射頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

偏振分光鏡依偏振把兩個頻率分到參考臂與量測臂，四分之一波片讓每次往返的偏振旋轉 90°，使光束在平面鏡干涉儀中走完第二程後才離開；角隅稜鏡則靠三面正交反射把光原路送回。任何偏振洩漏——分光鏡消光比不足、波片相位誤差、鏡面應力雙折射或雷射兩頻率的偏振不正交——都會讓一部分參考頻率混進量測臂，拍頻相位出現隨位移週期變化的誤差，週期等於一個條紋，這就是外差干涉儀的週期性非線性，無法靠平均消除。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏振分光鏡、波片與平面鏡光學」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉儀量的是空氣中的波長數，長度 = 條紋數×λ_vac/(4n)，因此空氣折射率 n 必須即時已知。n − 1 在標準狀態約 2.7×10⁻⁴，隨溫度、壓力、濕度與二氧化碳變化，Edlén 公式及其修正版（Birch–Downs、Bönsch–Potulski）或 Ciddor 公式用這些量算出 n，NIST 的工程計量工具箱提供公開的線上計算。死程是干涉儀歸零時量測鏡與分光鏡之間已存在的距離：歸零後若 n 改變，這段未被計數的光程也會跟著變，造成與位移無關的讀值偏移，必須以死程長度另外補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「環境感測器與 Edlén 補償」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉儀的光束就是量測線，Abbe 原則要求它與被測位移共線；若量測線與功能點之間有偏距 h，平台的俯仰或偏擺角 θ 會造成 h·θ 的一階誤差，而且不隨平台改善而消失。光束與運動軸之間的夾角 θ 則造成餘弦誤差 L(1 − cosθ) ≈ Lθ²/2，是二階但隨行程線性放大。平面鏡干涉儀還要加上量測鏡的平面度：平台側向移動時光束落在鏡面不同位置，鏡面起伏直接變成讀值。這些幾何項通常比干涉儀本身的解析度大兩到三個數量級，是預算的主體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Abbe 偏距與光束對準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在晶圓台或精密機台上，一支雷射頭透過分光器供應多條量測軸，每軸有自己的干涉儀、接收器與相位計，所有軸的資料必須在同一時刻取樣，否則平台在運動中各軸讀值對應不同位置。干涉儀訊號到控制器的延遲乘以速度就是位置錯誤，所以高速平台要求確定性的延遲與硬體觸發。光纖傳輸雷射雖然避免雷射頭的熱源靠近平台，但保偏光纖的偏振串擾會增加週期性非線性；光束在長行程上的走離、強度下降與空氣擾動也要在整合階段用擋風罩與短光路處理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「多軸光路、延遲與同步觸發」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合後的驗證不是再量一次解析度，而是把整條鏈與獨立的、溯源到國家標準的實體標準比對：以校正過的步距規或量塊組在全行程上做雙向重複量測，依 ISO 230-2 的方式分出系統誤差、反向差與重複性；另一種方法是反轉測試，把干涉儀與量測鏡對調位置，幾何誤差換號而干涉儀誤差不變，兩者可分離。所有量測不確定度依 GUM 列成預算表，包含波長、折射率、死程、Abbe、餘弦、非線性、解析度與實體標準本身的熱膨脹，交接文件還要寫明對準程序、暖機時間與環境感測器位置。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「步距規比對與不確定度預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A laser interferometer splits one coherent beam into a reference arm and a measurement arm whose mirror moves with the target; after recombination the interference intensity varies periodically with the optical-path difference. In a retroreflector interferometer a displacement d changes the path by 2d, one fringe per λ/2; a plane-mirror (double-pass) interferometer reflects the beam twice from the measurement mirror, so the path changes by 4d, one fringe per λ/4, insensitive to mirror tilt and with doubled resolution. An electronic phase meter subdivides each fringe into thousands of parts, and displacement is fringe count plus phase remainder times fringe period, so the unit of length comes from the laser wavelength. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Measurement arm, reference arm and phase meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A heterodyne interferometer's laser emits two orthogonally polarised components separated by f_s; one goes to the reference arm, the other to the measurement arm, and the photodetector sees a beat at f_s whose phase relative to a reference beat carries the displacement. A moving mirror Doppler-shifts the measurement beam so the beat becomes f_s ± 4v/λ; because phase is read on an ac signal it is immune to laser-intensity drift and detector offset, the key advantage over homodyne (dc) schemes. The beat may not fall to zero or reverse, so the split frequency f_s directly sets the maximum measurable velocity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Two-frequency laser and Doppler beat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The ruler is the wavelength, so the laser head must lock its frequency: common schemes balance the intensities of two orthogonally polarised longitudinal modes of the HeNe tube to lock cavity length, or use the Zeeman effect in an axial magnetic field to create left- and right-circular modes about 2 MHz apart; for higher speeds a single-frequency laser is shifted by 20 MHz or more with an acousto-optic modulator. The wavelength value is calibrated by the manufacturer against an iodine-stabilised HeNe, the 632.99 nm reference recommended by the CIPM, and commercial heads reach wavelength accuracy and long-term stability of order 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻⁷ after tens of minutes of thermal settling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Frequency-stabilised HeNe laser head”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The polarising beamsplitter routes the two frequencies by polarisation into reference and measurement arms; quarter-wave plates rotate the polarisation by 90° on each round trip so that in a plane-mirror interferometer the beam leaves only after its second pass, while a corner cube returns the beam along its path through three orthogonal reflections. Any polarisation leakage, from limited beamsplitter extinction, waveplate retardance error, stress birefringence in the optics or imperfect orthogonality of the laser's two frequencies, mixes some reference frequency into the measurement arm; the beat phase then carries an error that cycles once per fringe with displacement, the periodic non-linearity of heterodyne interferometers, which averaging cannot remove. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Polarising beamsplitter, waveplates and plane-mirror optics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The interferometer counts wavelengths in air, so length = fringes×λ_vac/(4n) and the air index n must be known in real time. At standard conditions n − 1 is about 2.7×10⁻⁴ and varies with temperature, pressure, humidity and carbon dioxide; the Edlén equation and its revisions (Birch–Downs, Bönsch–Potulski) or the Ciddor equation compute n from those quantities, and the NIST Engineering Metrology Toolbox offers a public online calculator. Dead path is the distance already present between beamsplitter and measurement mirror when the counter is zeroed: if n changes afterwards, that uncounted path changes too and produces a reading offset unrelated to displacement, which must be compensated separately from the dead-path length. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Environmental sensors and Edlén compensation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The interferometer beam is the measuring line, and the Abbe principle requires it to be collinear with the displacement being measured; with an offset h between the measuring line and the functional point, stage pitch or yaw θ produces a first-order error h·θ that does not shrink as the stage improves. An angle θ between beam and motion axis gives the cosine error L(1 − cosθ) ≈ Lθ²/2, second order but growing linearly with travel. A plane-mirror interferometer adds mirror flatness: as the stage moves laterally the beam lands on different parts of the mirror and the surface figure enters the reading directly. These geometric terms are typically two to three orders larger than the interferometer's own resolution and dominate the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Abbe offset and beam alignment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On a wafer stage or precision machine one laser head feeds several measurement axes through beamsplitters, each with its own interferometer, receiver and phase meter, and all axes must be sampled at the same instant or a moving stage yields readings from different positions per axis. Signal latency from interferometer to controller times velocity is position error, so fast stages demand deterministic latency and hardware triggering. Fibre delivery keeps the laser's heat away from the stage but polarisation cross-talk in polarisation-maintaining fibre raises periodic non-linearity; beam walk-off over long travel, falling signal strength and air turbulence are handled at integration with shrouds and short paths. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Multi-axis optics, latency and synchronous trigger”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Post-integration validation does not re-measure resolution; it compares the whole chain with an independent physical standard traceable to the national institute: a calibrated step gauge or gauge-block set measured bidirectionally over full travel, separating systematic error, reversal error and repeatability in the manner of ISO 230-2. A reversal test, swapping interferometer and mirror positions so that geometric errors change sign while interferometer errors do not, separates the two. All uncertainties are tabulated per GUM, covering wavelength, air index, dead path, Abbe, cosine, non-linearity, resolution and the thermal expansion of the physical standard itself, and the handoff document states alignment procedure, warm-up time and sensor placement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Step-gauge comparison and uncertainty-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 光束被遮斷或訊號強度瞬間低於門檻時計數器掉一個或多個條紋，之後所有讀值都偏移 158.2 nm 的整數倍且無法事後修正；在機台校正中這會表現為突然出現的台階狀誤差。
溫度感測器放在機台外殼而不是光束路徑旁，空調循環造成光路與感測器之間 0.5 K 的差異，每公尺出現 470 nm 的週期性誤差，被誤判為機台導軌誤差而反覆修機。
pitfallsEn: A beam interruption or a momentary drop of signal strength below threshold makes the counter lose one or more fringes, after which every reading is offset by an integer multiple of 158.2 nm with no possibility of later correction; in machine calibration this appears as a sudden step in the error plot.

A temperature sensor placed on the machine casing rather than beside the beam path sees a 0.5 K difference from the light path under air-conditioning cycles, producing a 470 nm per metre periodic error that is misread as guideway error and triggers repeated mechanical rework.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：白光干涉表面輪廓儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: White-light interferometric profilometers
guides.concept: 以相干掃描干涉術（CSI）為核心，理解寬頻光源為何只在零光程差附近產生條紋、包絡與相位如何合成次奈米高度，再把干涉物鏡的數值孔徑、壓電掃描器、相機雜訊、蝙蝠翼邊緣誤差與異材相位差整合成可依 ISO 25178-600 校正與交付的表面輪廓量測工程。
guides.conceptEn: Built around coherence scanning interferometry (CSI), understand why a broadband source produces fringes only near zero optical-path difference and how envelope and phase combine into sub-nanometre height, then integrate objective numerical aperture, the piezo scanner, camera noise, batwing edge artefacts and dissimilar-material phase offsets into surface-topography metrology that can be calibrated and delivered per ISO 25178-600.
procedure: 白光干涉輪廓儀用 LED 或鹵素燈這類頻寬上百奈米的光源照明一個干涉物鏡，物鏡內部的分光膜把光分到待測表面與內建參考鏡。因為每個波長的條紋週期不同，只有在兩臂光程差接近零的位置各波長的條紋才同相疊加，離開零光程差幾個條紋後就互相抵消；於是條紋被一個寬度約等於相干長度的包絡包住，包絡的位置直接標記表面高度，沒有單色干涉儀每 λ/2 的相位模糊。整個表面高度圖由物鏡沿光軸掃描、每個像素各自找出包絡位置而得。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個像素的相干圖可寫成 I(z) = I₀[1 + V·g(z − h)·cos(4π(z − h)/λ₀ + φ)]，g 是包絡、h 是表面高度、φ 是反射相位。只用包絡峰值定高度，重複性約在幾奈米；再利用包絡內條紋的相位可把高度精修到次奈米，但必須用包絡解開 λ/2 的整數模糊。頻域分析法對相干圖做傅立葉轉換，相位對波數的斜率給出高度（群速度等效），截距給出相位高度，兩者互相校驗。掃描取樣必須每個條紋至少四個點，否則相位會混疊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相干圖訊號與頻域分析」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

干涉物鏡有三種構型：Michelson 型在物鏡前方放分光立方體與側向參考鏡，只適合低倍率；Mirau 型把半透膜與一個小參考鏡疊在物鏡前方的玻璃板上，結構緊湊，覆蓋 10× 到 100×；Linnik 型用兩支相同物鏡分別對著樣品與參考鏡，可達最高數值孔徑但對準困難。橫向解析度由數值孔徑決定，可量測的最大表面斜率也由數值孔徑決定，因為鏡面反射光必須回到物鏡孔徑內；粗糙表面靠散射可略超過此限。Mirau 的參考鏡會遮住光瞳中心，使有效數值孔徑略小於標示值，並使高數值孔徑下的等效波長變長。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Mirau 干涉物鏡與數值孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

垂直掃描由壓電致動器帶動物鏡或整個干涉頭，以電容感測器閉迴路線性化，行程從 100 µm 到 1 mm 以上，長行程機型改用馬達配光學尺。掃描器的線性度直接變成高度比例誤差，因此儀器要以步高標準片校正放大係數。相機的滿井容量與讀出雜訊決定相位高度的雜訊底，大像素、高幀率與全域快門是優先選項。參考鏡的面形會原封不動加到每一張高度圖上，所以參考鏡用 λ/20 以上的超平面，或以多次平均的平面量測建立參考面扣除檔。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「壓電掃描器、相機與參考鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

ISO 25178-600 把面輪廓儀的校正拆成幾個計量特性：量測雜訊、平面度偏差、放大係數、線性度偏差、x/y 尺度、解析度與垂直對準，各自有對應的實體標準片與程序，ISO 25178-604 則專門描述相干掃描干涉儀。放大係數用步高標準片校正，橫向尺度用已知節距的光柵或網格校正，平面度用超平面，雜訊用重複量測相減。這些結果合起來才能寫出高度、Sa、Sq 與節距等參數的不確定度，而且各特性必須在實際使用的物鏡與視場下分別做。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ISO 25178-600 計量特性與標準片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

當台階高度小於相干長度時，台階上下兩側的光在邊緣處繞射並互相干涉，包絡被扭曲，高度圖在邊緣兩側出現向外翹起的假尖峰，形狀像蝙蝠翼，幅度可達數十到上百奈米、寬度約等於橫向解析度。不同材料反射時的相位變化不同，例如金屬與介電質，使相位法高度產生與真實幾何無關的偏移。透明薄膜會在上表面與基板界面各產生一組包絡：膜的光學厚度大於相干長度的一半時兩組可分離並可同時量膜厚，否則合併成一個偏移且變寬的包絡，高度與膜厚都錯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「台階邊緣蝙蝠翼與異材相位差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相干掃描需要數秒，掃描期間任何相對於樣品的垂直振動都會扭曲相干圖，條紋相位對振動的靈敏度是 4π/λ₀，所以儀器安放在被動或主動隔振平台上並封在防風罩內；產線機型用高幀率相機縮短掃描時間，使振動更難進入。大面積量測以自動平台把多個視場拼接，相鄰視場重疊 20% 左右，用重疊區的高度差解出每個視場的活塞與傾斜，但誤差會沿拼接鏈累積。自動化還包含自動對焦找包絡、自動光強與自動樣品辨識，產能由掃描長度、幀率與拼接數決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隔振平台、拼接與自動化」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

交付前要用獨立方法驗證：觸針式輪廓儀與原子力顯微鏡對材料相位不敏感，可用來比對台階高度與粗糙度；兩者的差異若落在合成不確定度內，表示材料修正與校正都正確。粗糙度參數還依賴濾波：ISO 25178 的 S 濾波（去除雜訊）與 L 濾波（去除形狀）截止值必須與比對方法一致，否則 Sa 與 Sq 不可比。交接報告列出每個計量特性的校正值與日期、各物鏡的不確定度預算、材料修正表、濾波設定與禁用條件（斜率、薄膜、台階高度範圍）。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「不確定度預算與交接報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A white-light profilometer illuminates an interference objective with an LED or halogen source of bandwidth above one hundred nanometres; a beamsplitter film inside the objective divides light between the test surface and a built-in reference mirror. Because every wavelength has a different fringe period, fringes of all wavelengths add in phase only where the two arms' optical paths nearly match and cancel a few fringes away; the fringes are therefore wrapped in an envelope about one coherence length wide whose position marks the surface height directly, with none of the λ/2 phase ambiguity of a monochromatic interferometer. A height map results from scanning the objective along its axis and locating the envelope independently in every pixel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each pixel's correlogram is I(z) = I₀[1 + V·g(z − h)·cos(4π(z − h)/λ₀ + φ)], with g the envelope, h the surface height and φ the reflection phase. Locating the envelope peak alone gives height with a repeatability of a few nanometres; using the fringe phase inside the envelope refines it to sub-nanometre, but the envelope must resolve the λ/2 integer ambiguity. Frequency-domain analysis Fourier-transforms the correlogram: the slope of phase against wavenumber gives a group-velocity height and the intercept gives a phase height, and the two cross-check each other. Scan sampling needs at least four points per fringe or the phase aliases. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Correlogram signal and frequency-domain analysis”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Interference objectives come in three forms: Michelson puts a beamsplitter cube and side reference mirror ahead of the objective and suits only low magnification; Mirau stacks a semi-reflective film and a small reference mirror on a glass plate in front of the objective, compact and covering 10× to 100×; Linnik uses two matched objectives for sample and reference, reaching the highest numerical aperture but hard to align. Lateral resolution is set by numerical aperture, and so is the maximum measurable slope, because specularly reflected light must return inside the objective's aperture; rough surfaces exceed this slightly through scatter. The Mirau reference mirror obscures the pupil centre, making the effective numerical aperture a little below the nominal value and lengthening the equivalent wavelength at high aperture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mirau interference objective and numerical aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Vertical scanning moves the objective or the whole interferometric head with a piezo actuator linearised by a capacitive sensor in closed loop, with travel from 100 µm to over 1 mm; long-range instruments switch to a motor with an optical scale. Scanner linearity becomes a height scale error directly, so instruments are calibrated with step-height standards for the amplification coefficient. Camera full-well capacity and read noise set the phase-height noise floor, favouring large pixels, high frame rate and global shutter. The reference mirror's figure is added unchanged to every height map, so the reference is a λ/20 or better superflat, or an averaged flat measurement builds a reference-subtraction file. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Piezo scanner, camera and reference mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

ISO 25178-600 breaks profilometer calibration into metrological characteristics: measurement noise, flatness deviation, amplification coefficient, linearity deviation, x/y scales, resolution and perpendicularity, each with its own physical standard and procedure, while ISO 25178-604 addresses coherence scanning interferometers specifically. Amplification is calibrated with step-height standards, lateral scale with gratings or grids of known pitch, flatness with a superflat and noise by subtracting repeated measurements. Only together do these results support uncertainty statements for height, Sa, Sq and pitch parameters, and every characteristic must be determined separately for each objective and field of view actually used. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ISO 25178-600 metrological characteristics and standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When a step is lower than the coherence length, light from the upper and lower levels diffracts at the edge and interferes, the envelope is distorted and false spikes rise outward on both sides of the edge, shaped like bat wings, with amplitudes of tens to over a hundred nanometres and widths about one lateral resolution. Different materials, for example metal versus dielectric, impose different reflection phase changes, so phase-based heights carry offsets unrelated to real geometry. A transparent film produces one envelope at its top surface and another at the substrate interface: if the film's optical thickness exceeds half the coherence length the two separate and thickness can be measured too, otherwise they merge into one shifted, broadened envelope and both height and thickness are wrong. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Batwings at step edges and dissimilar-material phase offset”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A coherence scan takes seconds, and any vertical vibration between instrument and sample during that time distorts the correlogram, the fringe phase being sensitive to vibration by 4π/λ₀, so instruments sit on passive or active isolation inside draught enclosures; production models use high-frame-rate cameras to shorten scans and shut vibration out. Large areas are covered by stitching fields with an automated stage, overlapping neighbours by about 20% and solving each field's piston and tilt from the overlap, but errors accumulate along the stitching chain. Automation adds auto-focus to find the envelope, auto-intensity and sample recognition, and throughput follows scan length, frame rate and the number of fields. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vibration isolation, stitching and automation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Before handoff, validate with independent methods: stylus profilers and atomic-force microscopes are insensitive to material phase and serve to compare step heights and roughness; agreement within the combined uncertainty shows that material corrections and calibrations are right. Roughness parameters also depend on filtering: the ISO 25178 S-filter (noise removal) and L-filter (form removal) cut-offs must match the comparison method or Sa and Sq are not comparable. The handoff report lists each metrological characteristic with its calibrated value and date, an uncertainty budget per objective, the material-correction table, filter settings and exclusion conditions (slope, thin films, step-height range). Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uncertainty budget and handoff report”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Calibrating amplification only with the 10× objective and then measuring with 50×: at high numerical aperture the Mirau equivalent wavelength lengthens, the amplification coefficient is off by over 1%, a 10 µm step reads 10.1 µm, and the calibration record looks complete.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：掃描電子顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Scanning electron microscopes
guides.concept: 從電子波長與作用體積出發，把 Schottky 場發射源亮度、繞射、球面與色像差合成探針直徑，理解 Everhart–Thornley 偵測器與 Rose 判準如何決定停留時間，再把充電、EDS 激發體積、雜散磁場與驗收測試整合成可交付的掃描電子顯微鏡工程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from electron wavelength and interaction volume, combine Schottky field-emission brightness, diffraction, spherical and chromatic aberration into a probe diameter, see how the Everhart–Thornley detector and the Rose criterion set dwell time, then integrate charging, EDS excitation volume, stray magnetic fields and acceptance tests into deliverable scanning-electron-microscope engineering.
procedure: 掃描電子顯微鏡不成像於透鏡，而是把聚焦電子探針以光柵方式掃過樣品，逐點收集訊號強度後以同樣的掃描順序畫成影像；放大率只是掃描寬度與顯示寬度之比。電子在 1 到 30 kV 的波長為皮米等級，所以解析度不受繞射限制而受探針大小與作用體積限制。入射電子在樣品內散射成梨形的作用體積，二次電子（< 50 eV）只能從表面幾奈米逸出，帶表面形貌資訊；背向散射電子來自更深處，產率隨原子序上升，帶成分對比；特徵 X 光來自整個激發體積，用於成分分析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子束、作用體積與訊號」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

探針是電子源經聚光鏡與物鏡縮小後的像，直徑由四項以均方根合成：源的幾何縮小像 d_g 由亮度 β、探針電流 I_p 與會聚半角 α 決定，電流越大、角度越小則越大；繞射項 d_d = 0.61λ/α 隨角度變小而變大；球面像差 d_s = 0.5·C_s·α³ 隨角度三次方增長；色像差 d_c = C_c·(ΔE/E)·α 在低加速電壓時因 ΔE/E 變大而主導。工程上以終端光圈選 α，在繞射與球面項之間取最佳值，而低電壓下的色像差只能靠低能量散佈的源、減速或單色器壓低。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針直徑預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子源決定亮度、能量散佈、穩定度與真空需求。鎢絲熱發射在 2800 K 工作，亮度約 10⁵ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹、能量散佈 2 到 3 eV，便宜但探針粗；LaB₆ 亮度高一個數量級。Schottky 發射器是 ZrO 覆蓋的鎢 ⟨100⟩ 尖端，在約 1800 K 與強電場下工作，亮度約 10⁸ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹、散佈 0.6 到 0.9 eV、虛擬源約 20 nm、電流穩定且壽命超過一年，需要 10⁻⁷ Pa 等級的槍室真空。冷場發射在室溫以純場發射工作，散佈 0.3 eV、亮度更高、虛擬源約 5 nm，但需要 10⁻⁸ Pa 以下的真空並定期加熱清除吸附氣體以恢復電流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Schottky 場發射槍與超高真空」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子光學柱由槍、兩到三級聚光鏡、終端光圈、掃描線圈、像散校正器與物鏡組成；物鏡的 C_s 與 C_c 隨工作距離增加而變大，所以高解析度要短工作距離或把樣品浸在磁場中的浸沒式物鏡。Everhart–Thornley 偵測器是一個帶 +300 V 柵網的法拉第籠，把低能量的二次電子吸引過來，再由 +10 kV 的閃爍體加速成光，經光導與光電倍增管轉成電訊號；柵網加負壓時只收背向散射電子。鏡筒內偵測器則收集被物鏡磁場捲回柱內的二次電子，在短工作距離下效率最高。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡、光圈與 Everhart–Thornley 偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

影像上的長度由掃描線圈的電流對樣品面位移的比例決定，這個比例隨加速電壓、工作距離與線圈溫度變化，所以每個條件都要用節距已知且可溯源的光柵標準片校正；像素尺寸 = 掃描寬度/像素數，必須小於探針直徑的一半才算有效取樣，再放大只是「空放大」。解析度不應只看規格表，要用金顆粒碳膜樣品量最小可分辨間隙，或用兩張獨立影像的傅立葉環相關求出資訊極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「節距標準片與像素尺度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

絕緣樣品的總產率 σ = δ + η 隨能量變化，在第二交叉點 E₂（多數氧化物與高分子約 1 到 3 kV）等於 1；高於 E₂ 時電子淨流入、表面帶負電，影像變亮、漂移、甚至把入射束偏轉；低於 E₂ 時輕微帶正電而自限。對策是把電壓選在 E₂ 附近、鍍數奈米的導電膜、或用數十帕的低真空讓氣體離子中和表面。能量散佈 X 光譜（EDS）需要過電壓比 E₀/E_c ≥ 2 才有足夠激發，X 光來自整個激發體積，所以成分的空間解析度通常是微米等級，與影像的奈米解析度完全不同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「充電平衡點與 EDS 激發體積」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子束是帶電粒子，在物鏡與樣品之間的最後一段幾乎沒有屏蔽，環境的交流磁場會把探針以電源頻率左右搖擺，影像邊緣出現鋸齒；低電壓時電子動量小、偏轉更大。地板振動經由樣品台放大，使影像在掃描中錯位；聲音則直接搖動鏡筒。因此安裝前必須做場址調查，量 1 到 1000 Hz 的磁場、振動與聲壓，必要時加主動磁場消除器、主動隔振平台與隔音罩，並把顯微鏡遠離電梯、變壓器與空調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雜散磁場、振動與聲學環境」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收不是看一張漂亮影像，而是在約定條件下重現可量化的指標：在指定電壓與工作距離量解析度樣品、以節距光柵量放大率、以法拉第杯量探針電流、以 EDS 標準片量能量解析度，並量影像漂移與樣品台重現性。漂移來自樣品台熱平衡、鏡筒熱膨脹與充電，在長停留時間的高解析度影像中會把探針的優勢抹掉。交接文件包含各條件的校正表、場址量測、每月維護項目（光圈清潔、尖端閃熱、法拉第杯校正）、以及針對絕緣與高分子樣品的操作規範。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試與操作規範」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A scanning electron microscope does not form an image with lenses; it rasters a focused electron probe over the specimen, collects a signal intensity point by point and paints the image in the same scan order, so magnification is merely the ratio of display width to scan width. Electron wavelengths at 1 to 30 kV are picometres, so resolution is limited not by diffraction but by probe size and interaction volume. Incident electrons scatter into a pear-shaped interaction volume: secondary electrons (< 50 eV) escape only from the top few nanometres and carry topography; backscattered electrons come from deeper and their yield rises with atomic number, carrying composition contrast; characteristic X-rays come from the whole excited volume and serve composition analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron beam, interaction volume and signals”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The probe is the demagnified image of the source formed by condenser and objective lenses, and its diameter combines four terms in quadrature: the geometric source image d_g set by brightness β, probe current I_p and convergence semi-angle α, growing with current and shrinking angle; diffraction d_d = 0.61λ/α, growing as the angle shrinks; spherical aberration d_s = 0.5·C_s·α³, growing with the cube of angle; and chromatic aberration d_c = C_c·(ΔE/E)·α, dominant at low voltage because ΔE/E grows. The final aperture chooses α to balance diffraction against the spherical term, while low-voltage chromatic blur can only be reduced by a low-energy-spread source, beam deceleration or a monochromator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Probe-diameter budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The source sets brightness, energy spread, stability and vacuum demand. A tungsten hairpin emits thermionically at 2800 K with about 10⁵ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹ and 2 to 3 eV spread, cheap but coarse; LaB₆ is an order of magnitude brighter. A Schottky emitter is a ZrO-coated tungsten ⟨100⟩ tip at about 1800 K under a strong field, giving about 10⁸ A cm⁻² sr⁻¹, 0.6 to 0.9 eV spread, a roughly 20 nm virtual source, stable current and a lifetime over a year, and it needs a gun vacuum near 10⁻⁷ Pa. A cold field emitter works at room temperature by pure field emission with 0.3 eV spread, higher brightness and a 5 nm virtual source, but needs below 10⁻⁸ Pa and periodic flashing to desorb gas and restore current. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Schottky field-emission gun and ultrahigh vacuum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The column comprises the gun, two or three condenser lenses, a final aperture, scan coils, stigmators and the objective lens; the objective's C_s and C_c grow with working distance, so high resolution needs a short working distance or an immersion lens that bathes the specimen in its field. The Everhart–Thornley detector is a Faraday cage with a +300 V grid that draws in low-energy secondary electrons, a +10 kV scintillator that accelerates them into light, and a light guide to a photomultiplier; biasing the grid negative collects only backscattered electrons. In-lens detectors collect secondaries spiralled back up the column by the objective field and are most efficient at short working distance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective lens, aperture and Everhart–Thornley detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Length in the image comes from the ratio of scan-coil current to displacement on the specimen, and this ratio changes with accelerating voltage, working distance and coil temperature, so every condition is calibrated with a traceable grating of known pitch; pixel size = scan width/pixel count must be below half the probe diameter for useful sampling, and further magnification is empty. Resolution should not be read from a data sheet but measured as the smallest resolvable gap on gold-on-carbon or as the information limit from Fourier ring correlation of two independent images. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pitch standard and pixel scale”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An insulator's total yield σ = δ + η varies with energy and equals 1 at the second crossover E₂, about 1 to 3 kV for most oxides and polymers; above E₂ electrons accumulate, the surface charges negative, the image brightens, drifts and can even deflect the incoming beam, while below E₂ mild positive charging is self-limiting. Remedies are choosing the voltage near E₂, coating a few nanometres of conductor, or low vacuum at tens of pascals so gas ions neutralise the surface. Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) needs an overvoltage ratio E₀/E_c ≥ 2 for efficient excitation, and X-rays come from the whole excited volume, so compositional spatial resolution is usually micrometres, unlike the nanometre resolution of the image. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Charging crossover and EDS excitation volume”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The electron beam is a charged particle and its final path between objective and specimen is almost unshielded, so ambient ac magnetic fields rock the probe at mains frequency and image edges turn jagged; at low voltage the electron momentum is smaller and the deflection larger. Floor vibration, amplified through the stage, displaces the image during the scan, and sound shakes the column directly. A site survey measuring 1 to 1000 Hz magnetic field, vibration and sound pressure therefore precedes installation, with active field cancellation, active isolation and acoustic enclosures added when needed, and the microscope kept away from lifts, transformers and air handlers. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stray fields, vibration and acoustic environment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance is not one handsome image but reproducible, quantified indicators under agreed conditions: resolution on the standard specimen at specified voltage and working distance, magnification on a pitch grating, probe current in a Faraday cup, EDS energy resolution on a standard, plus image drift and stage repeatability. Drift arises from stage thermal settling, column expansion and charging, and in long-dwell high-resolution frames it erases the probe's advantage. The handoff package holds calibration tables per condition, site measurements, monthly maintenance items (aperture cleaning, tip flashing, Faraday-cup calibration) and operating procedures for insulating and polymer specimens. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance tests and operating procedures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfallsEn: Imaging particles on a 50 nm coating at 20 kV lets backscattered electrons from the substrate beneath swamp the particle contrast, so the coating is wrongly judged smooth; at 2 kV the same particles are clearly visible.

A magnification calibrated at 10 kV and 10 mm working distance is reused at 2 kV and 4 mm, the scale factor differs by 3%, every line-width measurement reads large, and the problem surfaces only when a customer re-measures by AFM.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：穿透電子顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Transmission electron microscopes
guides.concept: 以 300 kV 穿透電子顯微鏡為對象：從 1.97 pm 的電子波長與布拉格繞射出發，推導 Scherzer 解析度、對比傳遞函數與色像差資訊極限，理解六極 Cs 校正器為何把解析度推到 0.1 nm 以下，再把高壓與透鏡電流的 ppm 級穩定度、樣品厚度與撞擊損傷、場址環境與驗收測試整合成可交付的工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Taking a 300 kV transmission electron microscope: start from the 1.97 pm electron wavelength and Bragg diffraction, derive Scherzer resolution, the contrast transfer function and the chromatic information limit, see why a hexapole Cs corrector pushes resolution below 0.1 nm, then integrate ppm-level high-voltage and lens-current stability, specimen thickness and knock-on damage, site environment and acceptance tests into a deliverable engineering record.
procedure: 穿透電子顯微鏡讓高能電子穿過厚度數十奈米的薄樣品，物鏡把透射與散射電子在後焦面形成繞射圖、在像平面形成影像，後續的中間鏡與投影鏡選擇放大哪一個平面。對比有三種來源：質量厚度對比來自被物鏡光圈擋掉的高角散射；繞射對比來自晶體特定取向滿足布拉格條件；相位對比來自透射束與繞射束在像平面的干涉，是晶格影像的基礎。300 kV 的電子波長只有 1.97 pm，布拉格角只有幾個毫弧度，所以整個光學系統在極小角度內工作，像差成為主要限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薄樣品、繞射與影像平面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

薄樣品是弱相位物體，影像對比由對比傳遞函數 CTF(u) = sin χ(u) 決定，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴，u 是空間頻率。球面像差 C_s 讓相位隨 u⁴ 快速振盪，CTF 在第一個過零點之後正負交替，影像不再直觀；Scherzer 離焦把 Δf 選成讓低頻段形成最寬的負值通帶，第一個過零點定義點解析度。六極或八極 Cs 校正器產生負的球面像差抵銷物鏡的正值，使 C_s 可調到接近零甚至微負，過零點外推到色像差資訊極限，解析度由 0.17 nm 進入 0.1 nm 以下，並消除離域效應。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「對比傳遞函數與 Scherzer 離焦」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

校正球面像差後，解析度受色像差控制的時間相干性限制：電子能量散佈 ΔE、高壓漣波 ΔV/V 與物鏡電流漣波 ΔI/I 都讓焦距抖動，疊加成焦距散佈 Δ = C_c·√((ΔE/E)² + (ΔV/V)² + (2ΔI/I)²)，高頻資訊因此被阻尼包絡壓掉。所以 300 kV 的高壓發生器放在絕緣氣體槽內以 ppm 等級穩壓，透鏡電源用高精度電流源與恆溫，Schottky 槍的 0.7 eV 散佈成為最大項；需要更高極限時加單色器把散佈壓到 0.2 eV 以下，代價是損失大部分電流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高壓槽、Schottky 槍與單色器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

物鏡的 C_s 與 C_c 隨極靴間隙縮小而降低，但間隙也限制樣品傾轉角度與分析偵測器的空間，高解析極靴通常只允許 ±20° 到 ±35° 的傾轉。校正器由兩組六極與傳遞透鏡組成，六極產生的三階負球面像差抵銷物鏡，但同時引入必須以多個偏轉與弱透鏡抵銷的寄生像差，整組需要數十個電源在毫安等級下保持 ppm 穩定。樣品載台在真空中以側插式桿承載，熱漂移與機械鬆弛決定曝光期間的位移。偵測器從閃爍體耦合 CMOS 走向直接電子偵測，後者以計數模式把偵測量子效率提升到接近 1，並允許以短幀對齊消除漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「物鏡極靴、六極校正器與直接偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

影像上的長度尺度由物鏡與投影鏡的激磁決定，隨放大率檔位、高壓與鏡體溫度變化，必須以晶格間距已知的樣品校正：高倍用矽 (111) 0.3136 nm 或 (220) 0.1920 nm 晶格條紋，中低倍用溝槽光柵複製膜或奈米顆粒標準片；繞射模式的相機長度用多晶金環校正。像差量測本身也要校正：Zemlin 表假設束傾角已知，而束傾角由偏轉線圈的校正係數決定，所以先用繞射點位移校正偏轉線圈，再量像差。所有校正值都綁定高壓、放大率檔位與極靴，換任一項就要重做。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽晶格與金環校正樣品」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高解析成像要求樣品厚度在 10 到 50 nm，電子在樣品內的非彈性平均自由徑約 100 nm 等級，厚度與自由徑之比 t/λ 可由能量損失譜的零損失峰與總強度之比求得，是每張影像都應記錄的參數。電子束同時損傷樣品：撞擊位移發生在電子能把超過位移閾值的能量傳給原子核時，最大傳遞能量隨加速電壓升高而增加，輕元素最敏感；電離損傷則對高分子與某些氧化物主導，隨電壓降低反而變嚴重。因此加速電壓是依樣品而選的參數，不是越高越好。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「樣品厚度、劑量與撞擊損傷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

像差校正顯微鏡的解析度與穩定度綁在一起，場址必須把干擾壓到影像週期的十分之一以下：交流雜散磁場偏轉電子束並以電源頻率抖動影像；室溫漂移改變透鏡線圈電阻與鏡筒長度，使焦點與放大率緩慢漂移；地板振動與聲壓直接搖動樣品相對於物鏡的位置。對策包含鏡筒外的磁屏蔽與主動磁場消除、±0.1 °C 的房間溫控與鏡筒水冷恆溫、主動隔振基座與隔音外罩，以及把電子設備與操作者移到隔壁房間以遠端操作。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鏡筒外罩、磁場消除與溫控」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收必須用可重複的客觀指標：資訊極限以非晶材料的 Young 條紋量到的最高空間頻率表示；點解析度以矽 [110] 的 0.136 nm 啞鈴是否分開、或以 STEM-HAADF 影像中原子柱的傅立葉峰表示；穩定度以校正後的像差表在 30 分鐘內保持在容限內、以及高壓與透鏡電流的紀錄表示。EELS 與 EDS 另有能量解析度與偵測效率的驗收項。交接文件包含每個高壓與極靴組合的校正表、像差校正程序、場址環境紀錄、樣品損傷指引與每週的穩定度例行檢查，讓後續使用者能判斷儀器是否仍在驗收狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Young 條紋、啞鈴影像與驗收清單」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A transmission electron microscope sends high-energy electrons through a specimen tens of nanometres thick; the objective lens forms a diffraction pattern in its back focal plane and an image in the image plane, and intermediate and projector lenses choose which plane to magnify. Contrast has three origins: mass-thickness contrast from high-angle scattering stopped by the objective aperture; diffraction contrast from crystal orientations satisfying Bragg's condition; and phase contrast from interference of transmitted and diffracted beams in the image plane, the basis of lattice imaging. At 300 kV the electron wavelength is only 1.97 pm and Bragg angles are a few milliradians, so the whole optical system works within tiny angles and aberrations become the dominant limit. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thin specimen, diffraction and image planes”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A thin specimen is a weak phase object whose image contrast follows the contrast transfer function CTF(u) = sin χ(u) with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² + (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴ and u the spatial frequency. Spherical aberration C_s makes the phase oscillate rapidly with u⁴, so beyond the first zero the CTF alternates sign and the image stops being intuitive; Scherzer defocus chooses Δf to form the widest negative passband at low frequency, and the first zero defines point resolution. A hexapole or octupole Cs corrector produces negative spherical aberration to cancel the objective's positive value, letting C_s be tuned near zero or slightly negative, pushing the first zero out to the chromatic information limit, taking resolution from 0.17 nm to below 0.1 nm and removing delocalisation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Contrast transfer function and Scherzer defocus”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

With spherical aberration corrected, resolution is bounded by temporal coherence governed by chromatic aberration: energy spread ΔE, high-voltage ripple ΔV/V and objective-current ripple ΔI/I each jitter the focus and combine into a focal spread Δ = C_c·√((ΔE/E)² + (ΔV/V)² + (2ΔI/I)²), and a damping envelope suppresses high-frequency information. The 300 kV generator therefore sits in an insulating-gas tank regulated at the ppm level, lens supplies use precision current sources in temperature-controlled housings, and the 0.7 eV spread of a Schottky gun becomes the largest term; a monochromator brings the spread below 0.2 eV when a higher limit is needed, at the cost of most of the current. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-voltage tank, Schottky gun and monochromator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Objective C_s and C_c fall as the pole-piece gap shrinks, but the gap also limits specimen tilt and room for analytical detectors, so high-resolution pole pieces usually allow only ±20° to ±35° of tilt. The corrector consists of two hexapole groups with transfer lenses; the hexapoles create negative third-order spherical aberration that cancels the objective's, but introduce parasitic aberrations that must be nulled with many deflectors and weak lenses, so dozens of supplies must stay ppm-stable at milliamp levels. The specimen rides a side-entry holder in vacuum, and its thermal drift and mechanical relaxation set the displacement during exposure. Detectors have moved from scintillator-coupled CMOS to direct electron detection, whose counting mode raises detective quantum efficiency toward 1 and allows drift removal by aligning short frames. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Objective pole piece, hexapole corrector and direct detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Image scale depends on objective and projector excitation and changes with magnification step, high voltage and column temperature, so it is calibrated with specimens of known lattice spacing: silicon (111) 0.3136 nm or (220) 0.1920 nm fringes at high magnification, replica gratings or nanoparticle standards at lower magnification; camera length in diffraction mode is calibrated with polycrystalline gold rings. Aberration measurement must itself be calibrated: a Zemlin tableau assumes known beam tilts, which depend on deflector calibration coefficients, so deflectors are first calibrated from diffraction-spot shifts and only then are aberrations measured. Every calibration value is bound to high voltage, magnification step and pole piece, and changing any one requires redoing it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Silicon lattice and gold-ring calibration specimens”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High-resolution imaging needs specimens 10 to 50 nm thick; the inelastic mean free path is of order 100 nm, and the ratio t/λ, obtained from the zero-loss to total intensity ratio in an energy-loss spectrum, is a parameter that should be recorded with every image. The beam also damages the specimen: knock-on displacement occurs when an electron can transfer more than the displacement threshold to a nucleus, and the maximum transferable energy rises with accelerating voltage, light elements being most sensitive; radiolysis dominates in polymers and some oxides and worsens as voltage falls. Accelerating voltage is therefore chosen per specimen, not simply maximised. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Specimen thickness, dose and knock-on damage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Aberration-corrected microscopes tie resolution to stability, and the site must hold disturbances below a tenth of the image period: ac stray fields deflect the beam and jitter the image at mains frequency; room-temperature drift changes lens-coil resistance and column length so focus and magnification creep; floor vibration and sound pressure shake the specimen relative to the objective. Countermeasures include magnetic shielding and active field cancellation around the column, ±0.1 °C room control with temperature-stabilised lens cooling water, an active isolation base, acoustic enclosures, and moving electronics and operators to an adjacent room for remote operation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Column enclosure, field cancellation and temperature control”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance uses repeatable objective indicators: the information limit as the highest spatial frequency in Young's fringes on amorphous material; point resolution as whether the 0.136 nm silicon [110] dumbbells separate, or as Fourier peaks of atomic columns in STEM-HAADF images; stability as the corrected aberration table staying within tolerance for 30 minutes together with high-voltage and lens-current logs. EELS and EDS add energy-resolution and detection-efficiency items. The handoff package contains calibration tables for every high-voltage and pole-piece combination, the aberration-correction procedure, site environment records, specimen-damage guidance and a weekly stability routine, so later users can judge whether the instrument is still in its accepted state. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Young's fringes, dumbbell images and acceptance checklist”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 樣品厚度超過 100 nm 時多重散射與非彈性散射主導，晶格影像的相位對比消失、繞射點被動力學效應改寫，分析者用運動學公式解讀點強度而得到錯誤的結構結論。
用 200 kV 時建立的放大率表在切換到 300 kV 後繼續使用，透鏡激磁不同使比例差 4%，奈米顆粒粒徑統計全部偏小，論文發表後才被同行以 X 光繞射結果質疑。
pitfallsEn: A specimen thicker than 100 nm is dominated by multiple and inelastic scattering, lattice phase contrast vanishes and spot intensities are rewritten by dynamical effects; interpreting them with kinematic formulas yields wrong structural conclusions.

A magnification table built at 200 kV is kept after switching to 300 kV; different lens excitation shifts the scale by 4%, every nanoparticle size statistic reads small, and the discrepancy is raised by peers with X-ray diffraction results only after publication.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：低溫電子顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Cryogenic electron microscopes
guides.concept: 以 300 kV 單顆粒低溫電子顯微鏡為對象：從玻璃化與輻射損傷的劑量極限出發，理解離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點、Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移如何限制解析度，再把冷台防污染、直接電子偵測器、像素尺度校正、Rosenthal–Henderson 顆粒數估計與 FSC 驗收整合成設施級的工程交付。
guides.conceptEn: For a 300 kV single-particle cryo-electron microscope: start from vitrification and the dose limits of radiation damage, see how defocus phase contrast with CTF zeros, Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion bound resolution, then integrate cold-stage anti-contamination, direct electron detectors, pixel-scale calibration, Rosenthal–Henderson particle-number estimates and FSC acceptance into a facility-level engineering delivery.
procedure: 生物分子只有在水環境中才保持結構，但顯微鏡在真空中工作，所以把含水樣品以每秒十萬度的速率急凍成玻璃態冰：水分子來不及結晶，分子被原位固定，低溫同時減緩電子束造成的自由基擴散。即使如此，每個電子穿過樣品都會沉積能量，高解析資訊在幾個電子每平方埃之後就消失，所以每張影像的總劑量被限制在數十 e⁻/Å²，影像極度缺乏訊號，必須靠平均成千上萬個相同顆粒把訊噪比補回來。劑量也要分配成多幀電影，讓後段處理能依每幀累積劑量加權。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「玻璃態冰與劑量預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

蛋白質在冰中幾乎不吸收電子，只改變穿透波的相位，正焦時影像幾乎沒有對比；把物鏡調到 1 到 3 µm 的欠焦，相位差經由 sin χ(u) 轉成強度對比，χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴。離焦越大，低頻對比越強、顆粒越容易辨認，但 CTF 的第一個零點越早出現，之後正負交替的傳遞必須在後處理中依每張影像擬合的離焦與像散做相位翻轉或 Wiener 修正，而且離焦必須量得夠準，否則高頻相位會被錯誤翻轉。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離焦相位對比與 CTF 零點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

製備在溫濕度受控的急凍儀中進行：3 µL 樣品滴在帶孔碳膜或金膜網格上，濾紙吸去多餘液體只留幾十奈米的薄膜，隨即插入液態乙烷。冰厚是最關鍵的製備參數：太厚則背景的非彈性散射淹沒顆粒對比，太薄則顆粒被擠到孔邊或變性在氣液界面。金網格與金箔支撐膜在冷卻時收縮一致，減少束致漂移；塗石墨烯或親水處理用來控制顆粒分佈與取向。冰厚可用能量過濾器由非彈性散射比例估計。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「急凍儀、網格與冰厚」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

網格在液氮溫度下由自動載入器送入鏡筒，樣品台維持約 −190 °C；鏡筒內任何殘餘水氣都會凝在最冷的表面即樣品上，長出非晶冰層而增加厚度，所以樣品附近設有更冷的冷阱（抗污染器）吸走水氣，並要求超高真空。能量過濾器以 10 到 20 eV 的狹縫去除非彈性電子，提升厚冰與斷層掃描的對比。直接電子偵測器讓每個電子直接在 CMOS 中產生訊號，計數模式把偵測量子效率提升到接近 1 並記錄多幀電影，是 2013 年後解析度突破的硬體基礎；相位板則為小於 100 kDa 的分子提供正焦附近的對比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「自動載入器、冷阱與直接偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重建的絕對尺度來自像素尺寸，錯 1% 就讓整個原子模型縮放 1%，因此用已知結構（例如去鐵蛋白的 2.0 Å 重建或金晶格 2.355 Å）校正，並檢查放大率的方向性差異。劑量率在偵測器上以計數校正，再換算到樣品面；劑量過高進入計數非線性區，過低則浪費時間。束傾使彗差把 CTF 變成非對稱，必須做無彗差對準並在資料處理中精修；自動收集用影像位移在多個孔間移動時會引入束傾，所以需要事先校正像移與束傾的補償關係。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「像素尺度、劑量與彗差校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

投影近似假設顆粒上下表面的散射在同一平面，實際上繞射發生在半徑 1/λ 的 Ewald 球面上，球面相對於平面的凹陷在高空間頻率與大顆粒時造成上下表面的相位差，必須在重建時依顆粒厚度與離焦做曲率修正。電子束照射的前幾個 e⁻/Å² 會讓冰膜膨脹與翹曲，顆粒在幾埃內移動並旋轉，所以每張電影的幀先做全域與局部對齊，再依劑量加權。再往下是三階以上的像差：三重像散與四階球面像差在 2 Å 以下成為限制，需要以資料本身精修出的像差係數校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Ewald 球曲率與束致漂移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

國家級設施把顯微鏡當成全天候運轉的產線：自動載入器一次裝入十二片網格，自動收集軟體用像移在孔陣列間每幾秒拍一部電影，一天可產出數千部；液氮以自動補給系統連續供應樣品台、冷阱與載入器，中斷即造成樣品損失。資料流是另一個瓶頸：每部電影數十幀的 4k 影像未壓縮超過 1 GB，一天數 TB，必須在收集同時做漂移修正、CTF 擬合與顆粒挑選的即時處理，把回饋在數分鐘內送回操作者以決定是否更換網格。設施還要管理使用者培訓、網格篩選顯微鏡與高解析顯微鏡的分流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「設施排程、液氮供應與資料管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

重建解析度以黃金標準傅立葉殼相關（FSC）定義：把顆粒分成兩半獨立重建，兩圖在各空間頻率的相關降到 0.143 的頻率即為解析度，避免過擬合把雜訊當訊號。設施驗收用去鐵蛋白這類高對稱、高穩定的標準樣品：在規定的收集時間內達到 2 Å 以下證明顯微鏡、偵測器、製備與管線全部正常。交接文件要包含像素尺度與束傾校正、污染速率、偵測器 DQE、標準樣品的 ResLog 曲線與 B 因子、每日檢查清單，以及資料處理的參考流程，讓使用者能用同樣的程序判斷儀器狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「FSC 0.143 與去鐵蛋白基準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Biological molecules keep their structure only in water, yet the microscope works in vacuum, so hydrated specimens are frozen at about 10⁵ K/s into vitreous ice: water has no time to crystallise, molecules are fixed in place, and the low temperature slows radical diffusion caused by the beam. Even so, every electron deposits energy, high-resolution information vanishes after a few electrons per square ångström, and the total dose per image is capped at tens of e⁻/Å², leaving images starved of signal that only averaging tens of thousands of identical particles can recover. The dose is also split into a multi-frame movie so later processing can weight each frame by its accumulated exposure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vitreous ice and the dose budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Proteins in ice barely absorb electrons and only shift the phase of the transmitted wave, so an in-focus image has almost no contrast; underfocusing the objective by 1 to 3 µm converts phase into intensity through sin χ(u), with χ(u) = πλΔf·u² − (π/2)·C_s·λ³·u⁴. Larger defocus strengthens low-frequency contrast and makes particles easier to see, but the first CTF zero arrives earlier, and the alternating transfer beyond it must be phase-flipped or Wiener-corrected in processing using defocus and astigmatism fitted per image; the defocus must be known accurately or high-frequency phases are flipped the wrong way. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Defocus phase contrast and CTF zeros”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Preparation happens in a temperature- and humidity-controlled plunge freezer: 3 µL of sample is applied to a holey carbon or gold-film grid, filter paper blots away excess liquid leaving a film tens of nanometres thick, and the grid is plunged into liquid ethane. Ice thickness is the decisive preparation parameter: too thick and inelastic background swamps particle contrast, too thin and particles are pushed to hole edges or denature at the air-water interface. Gold grids with gold-foil supports contract uniformly on cooling and reduce beam-induced motion; graphene coatings or hydrophilic treatments control particle distribution and orientation. Ice thickness can be estimated with an energy filter from the inelastic-scattering fraction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Plunge freezer, grids and ice thickness”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Grids enter the column from a liquid-nitrogen autoloader and the stage stays near −190 °C; any residual water vapour in the column condenses on the coldest surface, the specimen, growing amorphous ice that thickens it, so a colder cryo-shield (anti-contaminator) near the specimen captures vapour and ultrahigh vacuum is required. An energy filter with a 10 to 20 eV slit removes inelastic electrons and raises contrast in thick ice and tomography. Direct electron detectors register each electron directly in CMOS; counting mode lifts detective quantum efficiency toward 1 and records multi-frame movies, the hardware basis of the post-2013 resolution leap, while phase plates provide near-focus contrast for molecules below 100 kDa. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Autoloader, cold trap and direct detector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The absolute scale of a reconstruction comes from pixel size, and a 1% error scales the whole atomic model by 1%, so it is calibrated with a known structure (for example a 2.0 Å apoferritin reconstruction or the 2.355 Å gold lattice) and checked for magnification anisotropy. Dose rate is calibrated on the detector in counts and converted to the specimen plane; too high a rate enters counting non-linearity, too low wastes time. Beam tilt introduces coma that makes the CTF asymmetric, so coma-free alignment is performed and refined in processing; automated collection that moves between holes by image shift introduces beam tilt, so the compensation between image shift and beam tilt must be calibrated beforehand. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pixel scale, dose and coma-free calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The projection approximation assumes scattering from a particle's top and bottom lies in one plane, but diffraction actually occurs on an Ewald sphere of radius 1/λ, whose sag relative to the plane creates a phase difference between the two surfaces at high spatial frequency and for large particles, requiring curvature correction during reconstruction according to particle thickness and defocus. The first few e⁻/Å² of exposure make the ice film expand and buckle, particles move several ångströms and rotate, so each movie's frames are aligned globally and locally and then dose-weighted. Beyond that, third-order and higher aberrations such as threefold astigmatism and fourth-order spherical aberration become limiting below 2 Å and need aberration coefficients refined from the data themselves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ewald-sphere curvature and beam-induced motion”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A national facility runs the microscope as a round-the-clock production line: the autoloader holds twelve grids, automated software records a movie every few seconds across hole arrays by image shift, and thousands of movies are produced per day; liquid nitrogen is supplied continuously by an automatic refill system to stage, cryo-shield and loader, and any interruption costs specimens. Data flow is another bottleneck: a movie of tens of 4k frames exceeds 1 GB uncompressed, days reach several terabytes, and motion correction, CTF fitting and particle picking must run on the fly so that feedback reaches the operator within minutes to decide whether to swap grids. The facility also manages user training and the split between screening and high-resolution microscopes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Facility scheduling, nitrogen supply and data pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Reconstruction resolution is defined by the gold-standard Fourier shell correlation (FSC): particles are split into two halves reconstructed independently, and the frequency where their correlation falls to 0.143 is the resolution, which prevents overfitting from passing noise off as signal. Facility acceptance uses a highly symmetric, stable standard such as apoferritin: reaching better than 2 Å within a specified collection time proves microscope, detector, preparation and pipeline all work. The handoff package must hold pixel-scale and beam-tilt calibrations, contamination rate, detector DQE, the standard sample's ResLog curve and B-factor, a daily checklist and a reference processing workflow so users can judge instrument state by the same procedure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “FSC 0.143 and the apoferritin benchmark”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
