pitfalls: 轉移樣品時冷卻鉗短暫離開液氮，網格升溫超過 −137 °C，玻璃態冰轉成立方冰，顆粒被擠壓變形且背景出現繞射環，整批網格資料不可用而且往往在收完數千張影像後才發現。
像移式自動收集沒有校正束傾補償，離中心 10 µm 的孔帶有 1 mrad 的束傾，這些影像的高頻相位被彗差破壞，重建解析度卡在 3.5 Å，直到依孔位置分組精修束傾才恢復到 2.8 Å。
pitfallsEn: Tweezers leaving liquid nitrogen briefly during transfer let the grid warm above −137 °C, vitreous ice turns cubic, particles are crushed and diffraction rings appear in the background; the whole grid's data are unusable, often discovered only after thousands of images are collected.

Image-shift collection without beam-tilt compensation leaves holes 10 µm off-centre with 1 mrad of tilt; coma corrupts their high-frequency phases, the reconstruction stalls at 3.5 Å, and only grouping by hole position and refining beam tilt restores 2.8 Å.

guides.concept: 從 30 keV 鎵離子在固體中的碰撞串級出發，理解聚焦離子束如何以奈米精度移除與沉積材料，再把離子源、靜電離子柱、SEM／FIB 雙束幾何、TEM 薄片的非晶化與鎵植入、束流與切削速率校正以及切片斷層重建整合成可交接的分析工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the collision cascade of 30 keV gallium ions in a solid to see how a focused ion beam removes and deposits material with nanometre precision, then integrate the ion source, electrostatic ion column, SEM/FIB dual-beam geometry, amorphisation and gallium implantation in TEM lamellae, beam-current and milling-rate calibration and slice-and-view tomography into a transferable analytical engineering record.
procedure: 30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級；靠近表面的原子若獲得超過表面結合能（矽約 4.7 eV）的向外動量便離開表面，這就是濺射。鎵在矽中的投射射程約 27 nm，橫向散布約 10 nm，所以切削的最小尺度與損傷深度都由此決定。濺射產率隨入射角上升、在約 75–80° 附近達到最大後下降，並隨材料、晶粒方向（通道效應）而變；同一次撞擊也放出離子誘發二次電子與二次離子，可用於成像與分析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子碰撞串級與濺射原子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。液態金屬離子源的能量散布約 5 eV，在小束流時色差主導，色差盤 d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E 與收斂半角 α 成正比，而束流 I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) 與 α² 成正比，所以光點約隨 √I 成長；到 nA 等級時球差與源像放大接手，光點擴大到數百 nm。工程上以一排不同孔徑的束限光闌在「快速移除」與「精細修整」之間切換，氙電漿源則以較低亮度換取 µA 等級的束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束限光闌與離子探針光點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鎵液態金屬離子源是一根尖端半徑數 µm 的鎢針，由儲槽中的液態鎵潤濕；萃取電極施加數 kV 電壓，強電場把液面拉成泰勒錐，錐尖只有數 nm，在約 10 V/nm 的場下發生場蒸發而放出 Ga⁺。鎵熔點 29.8 °C、蒸氣壓低、質量適中，是最常用的源材料。離子柱由萃取極、抑制極、聚光鏡、束限光闌條、遮斷器、八極偏轉／消像散器與物鏡組成，全部使用靜電透鏡，因為重離子的磁剛度比同能量電子大數百倍，磁透鏡難以聚焦。氙電漿 FIB 則以感應耦合電漿源取代液態金屬，沒有鎵污染並可給出 µA 束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎵液態金屬離子源與靜電透鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

雙束系統把垂直的 SEM 柱與傾斜 52°（Thermo Fisher）或 54°（ZEISS）的 FIB 柱對準在同一個共焦點，平台傾到該角度時離子束垂直切入表面，SEM 則從斜上方觀察剛切出的截面，所以截面上的垂直尺寸被縮短為 sin θ 倍。氣體注入系統把有機金屬或碳氫前驅物噴到表面，由電子或離子束分解成鉑、鎢或碳的保護層與導線；電子束沉積不傷表面但慢，離子束沉積快但含鎵與碳並會破壞最上層。偵測器包含 Everhart–Thornley、柱內二次電子與背散射電子、離子誘發二次電子（晶粒通道對比），以及 EDS、EBSD 與微操作器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共焦點、氣體注入針與偵測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

提取法製備 TEM 薄片的流程是：保護層、兩側粗切溝槽、底切、以微操作器焊接取出、轉移到銅格，再以逐步降低的束流與 1–2° 過傾角補償束流錐度把薄片減薄到 100 nm 以下，高解析觀察常需 20–50 nm。每一道離子都會在兩側表面留下厚度約等於射程的非晶損傷層並植入鎵，所以最後以 5 kV 與 2 kV 低能量離子清潔，把損傷層從二十幾 nm 降到數 nm。減薄終點以 SEM 低能量影像判斷，電子穿透時二次電子對比改變；實際厚度則以 TEM 的 EELS 對數比法量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TEM 薄片與非晶損傷層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FIB 交給圖形的劑量是束流乘以時間，而實際束流會隨源老化、光闌磨損與聚光鏡設定而偏離標示值，所以每個光闌都要以法拉第杯量測並記錄。切削深度還取決於材料的產率表與入射角，SEM 量測又取決於像素尺寸校正與傾斜修正；長時間圖形化期間的熱漂移與帶電漂移，則以表面上的基準標記做影像相關修正。這些項目一起構成截面量測與終點判斷的不確定度預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「法拉第杯、校正方塊與基準標記」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

切片斷層把 FIB 切一層、SEM 拍一張的循環重複數百到數千次，重建出奈米解析度的三維體積，並可同步取得 EDS 成分或 EBSD 晶向。系統整合的關鍵是：切片厚度要等於或接近影像像素以得到等向體素，SEM 影像在傾斜下的 y 方向需做 1/sin θ 修正，整段數小時的漂移要靠基準標記追蹤，而離子源穩定度、帶電與簾幕效應會在整個體積中留下系統誤差。資料量與時間預算也必須在開始前算好，否則實驗會在半途因儲存或源壽命而中斷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「切片—成像循環與體素」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

FIB 分析系統的驗收把前面的模型逐一轉成測試：錫球或金顆粒樣品驗證離子與電子影像解析度，法拉第杯驗證每個光闌的束流，矽標準方塊驗證切削速率，共焦點與傾斜修正以已知膜層截面驗證，對照薄片驗證損傷層與鎵殘留，長時間圖形化驗證漂移，切片斷層以基準線驗證切片厚度。交接紀錄須包含光闌束流表、材料切削速率表、源的累計 µA·h 與萃取電壓趨勢、氣體注入系統的沉積參數，以及每種分析流程的標準作業參數，任何一項更新都要重新驗證。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收樣品與光闌束流表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. Gallium's projected range in silicon is about 27 nm with about 10 nm lateral straggle, setting both the smallest milling scale and the damage depth. Sputter yield rises with incidence angle to a maximum near 75–80° and then falls, and it varies with material and grain orientation through channelling; the same impacts emit ion-induced secondary electrons and secondary ions used for imaging and analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. A liquid-metal ion source has an energy spread of about 5 eV, so chromatic aberration dominates at small currents: the chromatic disc d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E grows linearly with the convergence half-angle α while the current I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) grows with α², so the spot grows roughly as √I; at nanoampere currents spherical aberration and source magnification take over and spots reach hundreds of nanometres. A strip of beam-defining apertures switches between fast removal and fine polishing, while a xenon plasma source trades lower brightness for microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A gallium liquid-metal ion source is a tungsten needle with an apex radius of a few micrometres wetted by liquid gallium from a reservoir; an extractor several kilovolts away pulls the liquid into a Taylor cone whose tip is only a few nanometres across, where a field near 10 V/nm field-evaporates Ga⁺. Gallium's 29.8 °C melting point, low vapour pressure and moderate mass make it the usual choice. The column consists of extractor, suppressor, condenser lens, beam-defining aperture strip, blanker, octupole deflector/stigmator and objective lens, all electrostatic, because a heavy ion's magnetic rigidity is hundreds of times that of an electron of the same energy and magnetic lenses cannot focus it efficiently. A xenon plasma FIB replaces the liquid metal with an inductively coupled plasma source, avoiding gallium contamination and delivering microampere currents. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Gallium LMIS and electrostatic lenses”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A dual-beam system aligns the vertical SEM column and an FIB column tilted at 52° (Thermo Fisher) or 54° (ZEISS) on one coincident point; with the stage tilted to that angle the ion beam mills perpendicular to the surface while the SEM views the freshly cut face obliquely, so vertical dimensions in the cross-section are foreshortened by sin θ. The gas-injection system jets organometallic or hydrocarbon precursors onto the surface, where the electron or ion beam decomposes them into platinum, tungsten or carbon caps and conductors; electron-beam deposition is gentle but slow, while ion-beam deposition is fast but contains gallium and carbon and damages the top layer. Detectors include Everhart–Thornley, in-column secondary and backscattered electron detectors, ion-induced secondary electrons with grain-channelling contrast, plus EDS, EBSD and a micromanipulator. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coincident point, gas-injection needles and detectors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Lift-out preparation of a TEM lamella proceeds through a protective cap, rough trenches on both sides, an undercut, attachment and extraction with a micromanipulator, transfer to a copper grid, and thinning with stepwise lower currents and a 1–2° over-tilt that compensates the beam taper until the lamella is below 100 nm, often 20–50 nm for high-resolution work. Every pass leaves an amorphous damage layer about one ion range thick on each face and implants gallium, so the final step cleans with 5 kV and 2 kV ions to cut the damage from twenty-odd nanometres to a few. The thinning end-point is judged from low-voltage SEM images whose secondary-electron contrast changes once electrons transmit, and the actual thickness is measured in the TEM by the EELS log-ratio method. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TEM lamella and amorphous damage layer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The dose an FIB pattern receives is beam current times time, and the real current drifts from the labelled value with source ageing, aperture wear and condenser settings, so every aperture must be measured and logged with a Faraday cup. Milling depth further depends on the material yield table and incidence angle, SEM measurement depends on pixel calibration and tilt correction, and thermal or charging drift during long patterning is corrected by image correlation on a fiducial mark. Together these items form the uncertainty budget of cross-section metrology and end-point decisions. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Faraday cup, calibration box and fiducial mark”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Slice-and-view tomography repeats a cycle of one FIB slice and one SEM image hundreds to thousands of times to reconstruct a nanometre-resolution volume, optionally with simultaneous EDS composition or EBSD orientation. The integration keys are a slice thickness equal or close to the image pixel for isotropic voxels, a 1/sin θ correction of the tilted SEM image's y axis, fiducial tracking of drift over many hours, and awareness that source stability, charging and curtaining leave systematic errors throughout the volume. The data volume and time budget must be calculated before starting, or the run stops halfway on storage or source life. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Slice-and-view cycle and voxels”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of an FIB analysis system turns each earlier model into a test: tin-sphere or gold-particle samples verify ion and electron image resolution, the Faraday cup verifies every aperture current, standard silicon boxes verify milling rate, a known film-stack cross-section verifies the coincident point and tilt correction, control lamellae verify damage layers and gallium residue, long patterning verifies drift, and fiducial lines verify slice thickness in tomography. The handoff record must hold the aperture-current table, the material milling-rate table, the source's accumulated µA·h and extractor-voltage trend, gas-injection deposition parameters and the standard settings of each analytical workflow, and any update requires re-verification. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance samples and aperture-current table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。
軟硬交替的膜層造成簾幕效應，薄片厚度出現條紋狀起伏，定量 EDS 與應變分析失真；鋁或銅合金在鎵植入後沿晶界形成富鎵相甚至晶界脆化，TEM 看到的析出物其實是製樣產物，若據此判定材料失效將得出錯誤結論。
pitfallsEn: In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces.

Alternating hard and soft layers cause curtaining, striping the lamella thickness and distorting quantitative EDS and strain analysis; in aluminium or copper alloys implanted gallium forms gallium-rich phases along grain boundaries or even embrittles them, so precipitates seen in the TEM are preparation artefacts and a failure analysis built on them reaches the wrong conclusion.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：掃描穿隧顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Scanning tunneling microscopes
guides.concept: 從穿隧電流對間隙的指數依賴出發，理解 STM 為何能看到單一原子，再把壓電管掃描器、探針製作、隔振、電流雜訊、晶格校正與超高真空低溫系統整合成可驗收的原子級量測工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the exponential dependence of tunneling current on gap to see why an STM resolves single atoms, then integrate the piezo tube scanner, tip preparation, vibration isolation, current noise, lattice calibration and the ultrahigh-vacuum cryogenic system into an acceptable atomic-scale metrology record.
procedure: 掃描穿隧顯微鏡把一支金屬探針逼近導電樣品到約 0.5 到 1 nm，施加 mV 到 V 等級的偏壓後，電子以量子穿隧穿過真空位障，形成 pA 到 nA 的電流。穿隧機率隨位障寬度指數衰減，衰減常數 κ 由有效功函數決定，典型值約 1 Å⁻¹，因此探針高度每改變 1 Å，電流就變化將近一個數量級。這個指數關係是 STM 垂直解析度達到皮米等級的根本原因，也是整台儀器對振動與漂移極度敏感的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針—樣品穿隧接面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 Tersoff–Hamann 近似下，低偏壓的穿隧電流正比於探針位置處樣品局域態密度在費米能階附近的積分，因此微分電導 dI/dV 與能量為 eV 的局域態密度成正比。實作上在直流偏壓上疊加 kHz 等級、振幅零點幾 mV 的正弦調變，用鎖相放大器取出一階諧波。能量解析度受到探針費米分佈的熱展寬與調變振幅限制，這是把 STM 冷到液氦溫度的主要動機之一。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「dI/dV 鎖相訊號」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

多數 STM 用一支外電極分成四象限的 PZT 壓電管當掃描器：在對向象限施加反相電壓，管子一側伸長一側縮短而彎曲，帶動探針做 x、y 掃描；全部電極共同施加電壓則改變長度做 z 方向控制。壓電陶瓷是鐵電材料，位移對電壓有遲滯，電壓階躍後還會隨時間對數潛變；液氦溫度下 d₃₁ 係數降到室溫的約五分之一，掃描範圍相應縮小，但遲滯與潛變也顯著減弱。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「PZT 壓電管掃描器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

鎢探針通常以 0.25 mm 鎢絲在約 2 M NaOH 中電化學蝕刻而成，巨觀曲率半徑數十 nm，但真正決定解析度的是尖端最末端的單一原子或原子團；進入真空後再以電子束加熱或場發射去除氧化層。隔振採取兩個層次：STM 本體做得極小、極剛，使其最低機械共振在 kHz 以上，讓低頻地板振動只造成探針與樣品的共模運動；整個本體再掛在共振頻率 1 到 2 Hz 的彈簧上並用渦電流阻尼，把地板振動在共振以上以 1/f² 衰減。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎢探針與彈簧隔振平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

STM 沒有內建的長度基準，所有尺寸都來自壓電靈敏度與回授高度的換算，因此必須用已知晶格校正：橫向用 Si(111)-7×7 的 2.69 nm 晶胞或 HOPG 的 0.246 nm 原子間距，垂直用單原子台階高度，例如 Au(111) 0.235 nm、Cu(111) 0.208 nm、Si(111) 雙層 0.314 nm。熱漂移來自探針、樣品與掃描器之間的溫差與不等的熱膨脹，表現為影像的剪切與拉伸；低溫下漂移可降到每小時數十 pm，室溫下常達每分鐘 nm 等級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Si(111)-7×7 標準晶格」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

pA 等級的穿隧電流由轉阻放大器轉成電壓，回授電阻通常為 10⁸ 到 10⁹ Ω。雜訊來源有三：回授電阻的 Johnson 熱雜訊、穿隧電流本身的散粒雜訊，以及放大器輸入電壓雜訊透過接面與纜線電容在高頻轉成的電流雜訊；此外還有 50/60 Hz 干擾與 1/f 雜訊。因為電流與間隙是指數關係，任何電流雜訊都可以換算成等效的間隙雜訊，與振動、漂移放在同一張預算表比較。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1 GΩ 轉阻前置放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

原子級乾淨的表面只能在超高真空維持：在 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 下殘氣分子形成一層單分子層需要數小時，足夠完成製備與成像。製備腔配備離子濺射、加熱台、蒸鍍源與 LEED，樣品以傳送桿在不破真空下送入 STM 腔。低溫 STM 把本體懸掛在液氦槽內，外層再以液氮槽隔熱，兩層輻射屏遮住 300 K 熱輻射；槽的持冷時間由熱負載與液氦蒸發潛熱決定，商用系統超過 65 h。整合的關鍵是讓製備、傳送、冷卻、隔振與訊號線在同一真空與熱設計下互不妨礙。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「UHV 製備腔與液氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收不是看單一張漂亮的原子影像，而是一組可重複的量化指標：標準樣品的晶格尺寸與台階高度、穿隧狀態下的 z 雜訊頻譜、漂移速度、能譜解析度以及持冷時間，每一項都對應前面各單元的模型。交接文件要記錄校正係數隨溫度與掃描範圍的表、隔振傳遞率量測、前置放大器雜訊底、探針製備參數與樣品製備配方的來源，讓下一位使用者能重建同樣的性能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試矩陣」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A scanning tunneling microscope brings a metal tip within roughly 0.5 to 1 nm of a conducting sample; with a bias from millivolts to volts, electrons tunnel through the vacuum barrier and produce a current of picoamperes to nanoamperes. The tunneling probability decays exponentially with barrier width, with a decay constant κ set by the effective work function, typically about 1 Å⁻¹, so a 1 Å change in tip height changes the current by nearly an order of magnitude. This exponential law is the root of picometre vertical resolution and of the instrument's extreme sensitivity to vibration and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tip–sample tunneling junction”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In the Tersoff–Hamann picture the low-bias tunneling current is proportional to the sample's local density of states at the tip position integrated near the Fermi level, so the differential conductance dI/dV tracks the local density of states at energy eV. In practice a sinusoidal modulation of a few hundred microvolts at kilohertz frequency is added to the dc bias and a lock-in amplifier extracts the first harmonic. Energy resolution is limited by thermal broadening of the tip's Fermi distribution and by the modulation amplitude, which is a main reason for cooling the STM to liquid-helium temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “dI/dV lock-in signal”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Most STMs scan with a PZT tube whose outer electrode is split into four quadrants: opposite quadrants driven with opposite voltages make one side extend and the other contract, bending the tube to move the tip in x and y, while a common voltage changes the length for z control. Piezoceramics are ferroelectric, so displacement shows hysteresis against voltage and creeps logarithmically in time after a voltage step; at liquid-helium temperature the d₃₁ coefficient drops to roughly one fifth of its room-temperature value, shrinking the scan range but also suppressing hysteresis and creep. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “PZT piezo tube scanner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Tungsten tips are usually electrochemically etched from 0.25 mm wire in about 2 M NaOH to a macroscopic radius of tens of nanometres, but resolution is decided by the single atom or small cluster at the very apex; in vacuum the oxide is removed by electron-beam heating or field emission. Vibration isolation works on two levels: the STM body is made small and stiff so its lowest mechanical resonance lies above a kilohertz and low-frequency floor motion moves tip and sample together, and the whole body hangs on springs with a 1 to 2 Hz resonance damped by eddy currents, attenuating floor vibration above resonance as 1/f². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Tungsten tip and spring isolation stage”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An STM has no built-in length standard; every dimension comes from piezo sensitivity and feedback height conversion, so known lattices must calibrate it: laterally the 2.69 nm Si(111)-7×7 unit cell or the 0.246 nm HOPG atomic spacing, vertically single-atom step heights such as Au(111) at 0.235 nm, Cu(111) at 0.208 nm and the Si(111) bilayer at 0.314 nm. Thermal drift arises from temperature differences and unequal expansion among tip, sample and scanner and appears as shear and stretch in images; cold it can fall to tens of picometres per hour, while at room temperature nanometres per minute are common. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Si(111)-7×7 reference lattice”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The picoampere tunneling current is converted to a voltage by a transimpedance amplifier with a feedback resistor of 10⁸ to 10⁹ Ω. Three noise sources matter: Johnson noise of the feedback resistor, shot noise of the tunneling current itself, and the amplifier's input voltage noise converted to current noise at high frequency through junction and cable capacitance, plus mains interference and 1/f noise. Because current and gap are exponentially linked, any current noise converts to an equivalent gap noise that can sit in one budget table beside vibration and drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1 GΩ transimpedance preamplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Atomically clean surfaces survive only in ultrahigh vacuum: at 10⁻¹⁰ mbar residual gas needs hours to build one monolayer, long enough for preparation and imaging. The preparation chamber carries ion sputtering, a heating stage, evaporators and LEED, and a transfer arm moves samples into the STM chamber without breaking vacuum. A low-temperature STM hangs the body inside a liquid-helium bath surrounded by a liquid-nitrogen bath, with two radiation shields blocking 300 K radiation; the hold time is set by heat load and the latent heat of helium, and commercial systems exceed 65 h. Integration means that preparation, transfer, cooling, isolation and signal lines coexist within one vacuum and thermal design without interfering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “UHV preparation chamber and LHe bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance is not one pretty atomic image but a repeatable set of quantified indicators: lattice dimensions and step heights on reference samples, the z-noise spectrum while tunneling, drift velocity, spectroscopic resolution and hold time, each tied to a model from the earlier units. The handoff record lists calibration factors versus temperature and scan size, the measured isolation transmissibility, the preamplifier noise floor, tip-preparation parameters and the provenance of sample recipes, so the next user can rebuild the same performance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance test matrix”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 探針撞上表面或沾到污染後，接面變成點接觸或透過吸附分子導電，I–z 曲線斜率變平、影像出現重影或對比反轉；工程後果是整張影像的高度刻度失真，而操作者可能把 κ 偏低誤以為是樣品特性。
在室溫校正而在 5 K 使用，靈敏度差了數倍，所有量測尺寸同步縮水；更隱蔽的是 x 與 y 靈敏度不同造成晶格角度失真，六方晶格看起來像菱形，被誤解為表面重構。
pitfallsEn: After a tip crash or contamination pickup the junction becomes a point contact or conducts through an adsorbed molecule; the I–z slope flattens and images show double tips or inverted contrast. The engineering consequence is a distorted height scale across the whole image, while the operator may misread the low κ as a sample property.

Calibrating at room temperature and using the scanner at 5 K leaves a several-fold sensitivity error that shrinks every measured dimension; more insidiously, unequal x and y sensitivities distort lattice angles so that a hexagonal lattice looks rhombic and is misread as a surface reconstruction.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：原子力顯微鏡
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Atomic force microscopes
guides.concept: 以懸臂為奈牛頓等級的力感測器出發，理解 AFM 如何用光槓桿把皮米偏折放大成可量測的訊號，再把懸臂製作、共振模式、彈簧常數校正、熱雜訊、閉迴路掃描與標準樣品驗收整合成可交接的表面計量工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the cantilever as a nanonewton force sensor to see how an AFM amplifies picometre deflections into measurable signals with an optical lever, then integrate cantilever fabrication, resonance modes, spring-constant calibration, thermal noise, closed-loop scanning and reference-sample acceptance into a transferable surface-metrology record.
procedure: 原子力顯微鏡不需要導電樣品，它把一支末端帶尖銳探針的微懸臂靠近表面，由探針與表面之間的作用力使懸臂彎曲。遠距離時以凡得瓦吸引力與靜電力為主，接觸後以泡利排斥與彈性變形為主，液體中還有毛細力與雙電層力。懸臂依虎克定律 F = k·Δz 把力轉成偏折，彈簧常數從 0.01 N/m 的軟懸臂到 40 N/m 的硬懸臂，對應可量測的力從 pN 到 µN。成像時回授系統維持偏折（接觸模式）或振幅、頻率（動態模式）為定值，Z 軸的回授輸出即為地形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「懸臂—探針—表面作用力」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

動態模式讓懸臂在共振頻率附近振動，探針只在每個週期最低點短暫接觸或完全不接觸表面，橫向力幾乎為零。小振幅時作用力梯度 ∂F/∂z 會改變有效彈簧常數，使共振頻率移動 Δf ≈ −(f₀/2k)·∂F/∂z；振幅調變（輕敲）模式維持振幅定值，頻率調變模式用鎖相迴路直接追蹤 Δf。空氣中品質因數 Q 約數百，液體中只有個位數，真空中可達 10⁴ 以上；Q 越高振幅反應越慢，時間常數 τ = Q/(π f₀)，這是真空中必須改用頻率調變的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共振懸臂的振幅與頻率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

懸臂以單晶矽或氮化矽經微影與各向異性蝕刻批次製作，探針由矽柱經氧化銳化而成，尖端半徑約 5 到 20 nm。矩形懸臂的彈簧常數 k = E·w·t³/(4L³) 與厚度的三次方成正比，而晶圓厚度控制只有 ±10% 等級，所以同一批懸臂的 k 可相差 30% 以上，必須逐支校正。探針並非理想的點，影像是表面與探針形狀的膨脹（dilation）結果：任何比探針半徑更陡的特徵都會被探針輪廓取代。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「矽懸臂與探針尖端」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

最常見的偏折偵測是光槓桿：雷射聚焦在懸臂背面，反射光打到四象限光電二極體，懸臂末端傾角的變化讓光點在二極體上移動，上下象限的差訊號正比於偏折，左右差訊號則對應扭轉（摩擦力）。幾何放大比由光路長度與懸臂長度決定，可把 1 nm 的偏折變成數百 nm 的光點位移。掃描器方面，現代儀器把 XY 做成帶電容式位置感測器的撓性平台，閉迴路消除壓電遲滯與潛變，Z 軸則維持高頻寬的壓電驅動，並常以獨立感測器記錄真實高度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光槓桿與四象限光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

力的量測需要兩個校正：光槓桿靈敏度（V 到 nm）與彈簧常數（nm 到 nN）。彈簧常數最常用熱雜訊法：由能量均分定理，懸臂的熱振動均方位移 ⟨z²⟩ 與 k_B·T/k 成正比，量頻譜中第一共振峰的面積即可求 k；光槓桿偵測的是斜率而非位移，加上第一模態只佔總能量的 97%，因此需要 Butt–Jaschke 修正係數 0.817。高度尺度則靠可溯源的台階高度標準片與節距光柵校正，Z 感測器與壓電的非線性要分段記錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱雜訊頻譜與台階高度標準片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AFM 的垂直解析度由三類雜訊決定：懸臂本身的熱布朗運動、光槓桿與光電二極體的散粒與電子雜訊，以及掃描器與環境的機械雜訊。在遠低於共振的頻率，熱雜訊密度為 √(4k_B·T/(k·ω₀·Q))，所以軟而低頻、低 Q 的接觸懸臂最吵；硬而高頻的懸臂熱雜訊可低於 1 fm/√Hz，此時偵測器雜訊（典型 10 到 50 fm/√Hz）反而是主因。輕敲與 FM 模式工作在共振上，熱雜訊被 Q 放大，但訊號也被放大，真正的限制變成頻率或振幅雜訊。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏折訊號雜訊底」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整機性能由機械迴路決定：從探針經懸臂座、掃描器、機架到樣品座的所有零件構成一個結構迴路，溫度變化會讓迴路各段不等膨脹而造成漂移，聲音與地板振動會激發迴路共振。因此 AFM 放在隔音罩與隔振平台上，整機熱平衡後才取像。回授增益需與掃描速度、樣品起伏匹配：增益太低地形被低通濾掉且探針撞上陡坡，太高則回授自激，影像出現高頻條紋；誤差訊號影像是判斷回授是否跟得上的直接證據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隔音罩、溫控與回授增益」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AFM 的驗收把前面的模型變成可重複的測試：可溯源的台階高度與節距光柵驗證 Z 與 XY 尺度，懸臂熱頻譜驗證彈簧常數與雜訊底，尖刺樣品驗證探針半徑，長時間重複成像驗證漂移，硬表面的力曲線驗證靈敏度與線性度。交接紀錄要包含每個掃描範圍的校正係數、感測器雜訊、所用懸臂型號與量得的 k、f₀、Q，以及環境條件，因為任何一項改變都會讓後續量測的不確定度失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收標準片與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An atomic force microscope needs no conducting sample: a microcantilever carrying a sharp tip approaches the surface and the tip–surface force bends it. At long range van der Waals attraction and electrostatic forces dominate, in contact Pauli repulsion and elastic deformation take over, and in liquid capillary and double-layer forces appear as well. The cantilever converts force to deflection through Hooke's law F = k·Δz, with spring constants from 0.01 N/m for soft levers to 40 N/m for stiff ones, spanning measurable forces from piconewtons to micronewtons. During imaging the feedback holds the deflection (contact mode) or the amplitude or frequency (dynamic modes) constant, and the Z feedback output is the topography. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cantilever–tip–surface force”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dynamic modes drive the cantilever near resonance so the tip touches the surface only briefly at the bottom of each cycle or not at all, almost eliminating lateral force. For small amplitudes the force gradient ∂F/∂z modifies the effective spring constant and shifts the resonance by Δf ≈ −(f₀/2k)·∂F/∂z; amplitude-modulation (tapping) mode holds the amplitude constant, while frequency-modulation mode tracks Δf directly with a phase-locked loop. The quality factor Q is a few hundred in air, single digits in liquid and above 10⁴ in vacuum; the higher the Q the slower the amplitude responds, with time constant τ = Q/(π f₀), which is why vacuum work switches to frequency modulation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Resonant cantilever amplitude and frequency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Cantilevers are batch-fabricated from single-crystal silicon or silicon nitride by lithography and anisotropic etching, and tips are sharpened from silicon pillars by oxidation to an apex radius of about 5 to 20 nm. A rectangular lever has k = E·w·t³/(4L³), proportional to the cube of thickness, while wafer thickness control is only at the ±10% level, so levers from one batch can differ in k by more than 30% and each must be calibrated. The tip is not an ideal point: the image is the dilation of the surface by the tip shape, and any feature steeper than the tip profile is replaced by the tip's own outline. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Silicon cantilever and tip apex”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The commonest deflection sensor is the optical lever: a laser is focused on the back of the cantilever and the reflected beam lands on a quadrant photodiode, so a change in end slope moves the spot across the diode; the top-minus-bottom difference signal is proportional to deflection and the left-minus-right difference to torsion, hence friction. The geometric gain is set by the optical path length and the lever length and turns a 1 nm deflection into hundreds of nanometres of spot motion. For scanning, modern instruments build the XY stage as a flexure platform with capacitive position sensors whose closed loop removes piezo hysteresis and creep, while Z keeps a high-bandwidth piezo drive and often an independent sensor records true height. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Optical lever and quadrant photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Force measurement needs two calibrations: the optical-lever sensitivity (volts to nanometres) and the spring constant (nanometres to nanonewtons). The thermal-noise method is the usual route to k: by equipartition the mean-square thermal displacement ⟨z²⟩ of the lever scales as k_B·T/k, so integrating the first resonance peak of the measured spectrum yields k; because the optical lever senses slope rather than displacement and the first mode carries only 97% of the energy, the Butt–Jaschke correction factor 0.817 is applied. The height scale is calibrated with traceable step-height standards and pitch gratings, and the nonlinearity of the Z sensor and piezo is recorded range by range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal spectrum and step-height standard”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Vertical resolution is set by three noise classes: the lever's own thermal Brownian motion, shot and electronic noise of the optical lever and photodiode, and mechanical noise from the scanner and environment. Well below resonance the thermal noise density is √(4k_B·T/(k·ω₀·Q)), so soft, low-frequency, low-Q contact levers are the noisiest; stiff high-frequency levers fall below 1 fm/√Hz and the detector noise, typically 10 to 50 fm/√Hz, dominates instead. Tapping and FM modes operate on resonance where thermal noise is amplified by Q, but so is the signal, and the true limit becomes frequency or amplitude noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deflection-signal noise floor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Whole-instrument performance is set by the mechanical loop: every part from tip through lever holder, scanner and frame to sample holder forms a structural loop, temperature changes expand its segments unequally and cause drift, and sound or floor vibration excites its resonances. The AFM therefore sits under an acoustic hood on an isolation platform and images only after thermal equilibrium. Feedback gains must match scan speed and surface relief: too little gain low-pass filters the topography and the tip collides with steep slopes, too much gain makes the loop oscillate with high-frequency stripes, and the error-signal image is the direct evidence of whether feedback keeps up. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acoustic hood, temperature control and feedback gains”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

AFM acceptance turns the earlier models into repeatable tests: traceable step heights and pitch gratings verify the Z and XY scales, the lever's thermal spectrum verifies spring constant and noise floor, a spike sample verifies tip radius, long repeated imaging verifies drift, and force curves on a hard surface verify sensitivity and linearity. The handoff record must contain calibration factors for each scan range, sensor noise, the lever type with its measured k, f₀ and Q, and the environmental conditions, because a change in any of them invalidates the uncertainty of later measurements. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance standards and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 設定力過大會讓探針在軟樣品上犁出溝槽或把生物分子推走，影像看起來平整卻是被壓平後的假象；在空氣中忽略毛細力，則實際作用力比設定值高出數 nN，探針磨損加快、解析度隨時間變差。
把廠商標示的 k 直接拿來算力，誤差可達 ±50%，彈性模數結果相差一倍；若熱法頻譜中混入 50 Hz 諧波或聲學尖峰而未排除，擬合面積被高估，k 被低估，所有力值跟著縮小。
pitfallsEn: An excessive set-point force ploughs grooves into soft samples or sweeps biomolecules away, so the image looks smooth only because the surface has been flattened; ignoring capillary force in air means the real load exceeds the set point by several nanonewtons, accelerating tip wear so resolution degrades over time.

Using the vendor's nominal k for force calculations can err by ±50% and double or halve modulus results; if mains harmonics or acoustic peaks contaminate the thermal spectrum and are not excluded, the fitted area is overestimated, k is underestimated and every force value shrinks with it.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：X 光光電子能譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: X-ray photoelectron spectrometers
guides.concept: 從光電效應的能量守恆與電子的非彈性平均自由徑出發，理解 XPS 為何只看最表面 10 nm 並能分辨化學態，再把 Al Kα 單色器、半球型能量分析器、能量尺度校正、定量與偵測極限、超高真空與深度剖析整合成可驗收的表面分析儀器工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from photoelectric energy conservation and the electron inelastic mean free path to see why XPS probes only the top 10 nm yet resolves chemical states, then integrate the Al Kα monochromator, hemispherical energy analyser, energy-scale calibration, quantification and detection limits, ultrahigh vacuum and depth profiling into an acceptable surface-analysis instrument record.
procedure: 單色 X 光打在樣品上，把內層電子激發出來；量到的光電子動能 E_k 與結合能 E_b 由能量守恆連結：E_b = hν − E_k − φ，其中 φ 是分析器的功函數，因為樣品與分析器電性連接時以共同的費米能階為能量零點。每個元素的內層能階是指紋，而同一元素在不同化學環境下結合能會移動零點幾到數 eV，氧化態越高位移越正，這就是 XPS 能分辨 Si 與 SiO₂、C–C 與 C=O 的根據。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光電子動能與結合能」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

X 光可穿入樣品數微米，但只有沒有損失能量就逃出表面的光電子才形成特徵峰；電子在固體中發生非彈性散射前平均走的距離稱為非彈性平均自由徑 λ，在 1 keV 附近多數材料為 1 到 4 nm。來自深度 z 的訊號以 exp(−z/(λ·cosθ)) 衰減，θ 是出射角相對表面法線，95% 的訊號來自 3λ·cosθ 以內。因此 XPS 的資訊深度約 10 nm，傾斜樣品可以把它縮到幾 nm，這是角解析 XPS 量超薄膜厚度的基礎。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非彈性平均自由徑 λ」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電子束轟擊鋁陽極產生 Al Kα 特徵線，但原始譜線寬約 0.85 eV，還伴隨 Kα₃,₄ 衛星峰與連續的制動輻射。單色器用彎曲的石英單晶以布拉格繞射只挑出 Kα₁,₂ 核心，線寬縮到約 0.25 eV，並去除衛星與背景；陽極、晶體與樣品位於同一個 Rowland 圓上，晶體經彎曲與研磨使聚焦同時滿足布拉格條件。微聚焦的電子束讓 X 光斑小到 10 µm 等級，可做小區域分析與影像。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Al 陽極與石英單色器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光電子先由靜電透鏡收集並減速到固定的通能 E_p，再進入兩個同心半球之間的徑向電場；只有能量等於 E_p 的電子沿中央軌道到達出口，能量偏高或偏低者打到內外球。分析器的絕對解析度與通能成正比，與狹縫寬度、球半徑和入射角展寬有關，所以高解析譜用 10 到 20 eV 的通能，巡掃用 100 到 160 eV 以換取計數率。出口處以多通道電子倍增器或延遲線偵測器平行記錄一段能量範圍，提高效率並支援能量分散的快照模式。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「半球型分析器與通能」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

能量尺度以 ISO 15472 規定的三個金屬參考峰校正：Au 4f₇/₂ = 83.96 eV、Ag 3d₅/₂ = 368.21 eV、Cu 2p₃/₂ = 932.62 eV，涵蓋 85 到 933 eV 的範圍，可同時決定零點偏移與線性誤差。絕緣樣品在 X 光下持續失去電子而帶正電，峰向高結合能移動數 eV 並變寬，需要低能電子與離子的電荷中和槍補償；殘餘位移通常以外來碳 C 1s = 284.8 eV 做參考，但這個方法本身有 ±0.3 eV 的不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Au/Ag/Cu 能量尺度基準」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

峰面積 I_i 正比於元素濃度 n_i、光游離截面 σ_i、非彈性平均自由徑 λ_i 與分析器傳輸函數 T(E_k)；把這些合併成相對靈敏度因子 S_i 後，原子百分比為 (I_i/S_i)/Σ(I_j/S_j)。面積必須先扣除 Shirley 或 Tougaard 背景，因為非彈性散射電子形成的階梯背景比峰本身還大。偵測極限由背景的 Poisson 統計決定，典型為 0.1 到 1 原子百分比，與元素截面、譜線重疊及取樣時間有關；均勻性假設不成立時，定量只代表資訊深度內的加權平均。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「相對靈敏度因子與背景扣除」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

XPS 只看最表面幾奈米，所以分析腔必須在 10⁻⁹ mbar 以下，否則殘氣在一次長時間取樣內就會在表面累積碳與氧；樣品經傳送腔進入，表面清潔用低能 Ar⁺ 濺射。深度剖析交替進行濺射與取譜，用單原子 Ar⁺ 可剖析無機層，氣體團簇離子（Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ 等）可剖析有機層而不破壞化學態；濺射速率由束流密度、濺射產率與材料原子密度決定。整合時要安排 X 光斑、分析器視野與離子濺射坑的同心與尺寸關係，否則剖析深度解析度被坑壁效應破壞。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「UHV 分析腔與離子槍」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

XPS 的驗收把能量尺度、解析度、靈敏度、電荷補償、空間解析與深度剖析能力各自定義成可量化的測試：ISO 15472 三點校正、Ag 3d₅/₂ 在指定通能的峰寬與計數率、絕緣標準片的峰位與峰寬、刀口或網格的 X 光斑尺寸、Ta₂O₅ 參考層的深度解析度。交接時要留下校正時間表、每項測試的接受值與實測值、所用標準片的來源與清潔程序，以及靈敏度與能量尺度的長期趨勢圖，讓後續操作者能判斷儀器是否仍在受控狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「儀器驗收表與標準樣品組」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Monochromatic X-rays eject core electrons from the sample; the measured kinetic energy E_k and the binding energy E_b are linked by energy conservation, E_b = hν − E_k − φ, where φ is the analyser work function because a sample in electrical contact with the analyser shares its Fermi level as the energy zero. Each element's core levels are a fingerprint, and the same element shifts by a few tenths to several electronvolts in different chemical environments, more positive for higher oxidation states, which is how XPS separates Si from SiO₂ or C–C from C=O. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photoelectron kinetic and binding energy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

X-rays penetrate micrometres into a sample, but only photoelectrons that escape without losing energy form the characteristic peaks; the mean distance an electron travels before an inelastic event is the inelastic mean free path λ, between 1 and 4 nm for most materials near 1 keV. Signal from depth z is attenuated as exp(−z/(λ·cosθ)), with θ the emission angle from the surface normal, and 95% of the signal comes from within 3λ·cosθ. The information depth is therefore about 10 nm, and tilting the sample shrinks it to a few nanometres, the basis of angle-resolved XPS thickness measurement of ultrathin films. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Inelastic mean free path λ”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Electron bombardment of an aluminium anode produces the Al Kα line, but the raw line is about 0.85 eV wide and comes with Kα₃,₄ satellites and a bremsstrahlung continuum. A monochromator uses a bent quartz single crystal in Bragg diffraction to select only the Kα₁,₂ core, narrowing the width to about 0.25 eV and removing satellites and background; anode, crystal and sample lie on one Rowland circle, and the crystal is bent and ground so that focusing and the Bragg condition hold together. A microfocused electron beam makes X-ray spots down to the 10 µm scale for small-area analysis and imaging. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Al anode and quartz monochromator”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Photoelectrons are collected by an electrostatic lens and retarded to a fixed pass energy E_p before entering the radial field between two concentric hemispheres; only electrons at E_p follow the central orbit to the exit, while faster or slower ones strike the outer or inner sphere. The absolute resolution scales with pass energy and depends on slit width, sphere radius and angular spread, so high-resolution spectra use 10 to 20 eV pass energy and survey scans use 100 to 160 eV to buy count rate. At the exit a multichannel electron multiplier or delay-line detector records an energy window in parallel, raising efficiency and enabling energy-dispersive snapshot modes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hemispherical analyser and pass energy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The energy scale is calibrated with the three metal reference peaks prescribed by ISO 15472, Au 4f₇/₂ = 83.96 eV, Ag 3d₅/₂ = 368.21 eV and Cu 2p₃/₂ = 932.62 eV, which span 85 to 933 eV and determine both the zero offset and the linearity error. Insulating samples lose electrons under X-rays and charge positively, shifting peaks several electronvolts to higher binding energy and broadening them, so a charge-neutraliser supplying low-energy electrons and ions is required; residual shift is usually referenced to adventitious carbon C 1s = 284.8 eV, a method that itself carries about ±0.3 eV uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Au/Ag/Cu energy-scale references”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A peak area I_i is proportional to the element's concentration n_i, photoionisation cross-section σ_i, inelastic mean free path λ_i and the analyser transmission T(E_k); folding these into a relative sensitivity factor S_i gives the atomic fraction (I_i/S_i)/Σ(I_j/S_j). Areas must first be freed of a Shirley or Tougaard background, because the step-like background of inelastically scattered electrons is larger than the peak itself. The detection limit is set by Poisson statistics of the background, typically 0.1 to 1 atomic percent depending on cross-section, line overlap and acquisition time; when the homogeneity assumption fails, the result is only a weighted average over the information depth. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Relative sensitivity factors and background subtraction”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because XPS sees only the top few nanometres, the analysis chamber must stay below 10⁻⁹ mbar or residual gas deposits carbon and oxygen within one long acquisition; samples enter through a load lock and surfaces are cleaned by low-energy Ar⁺ sputtering. Depth profiling alternates sputtering and spectra, using monatomic Ar⁺ for inorganic layers and gas-cluster ions such as Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ for organic layers without destroying chemical states; the sputter rate is set by current density, sputter yield and the material's atomic density. Integration must keep the X-ray spot, analyser field of view and sputter crater concentric and correctly sized, or crater-wall effects ruin the depth resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “UHV analysis chamber and ion gun”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

XPS acceptance defines energy scale, resolution, sensitivity, charge compensation, spatial resolution and depth-profiling capability as separate quantified tests: the three-point ISO 15472 calibration, Ag 3d₅/₂ width and count rate at a specified pass energy, peak position and width on insulating standards, X-ray spot size from a knife edge or grid, and depth resolution on a Ta₂O₅ reference layer. The handoff leaves a calibration schedule, acceptance and measured values for every test, the provenance and cleaning procedure of each standard, and trend charts of sensitivity and energy scale, so later operators can judge whether the instrument remains in control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Instrument acceptance table and reference-sample set”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把譜圖中的歐傑峰（如 O KLL 在 Al Kα 下落在約 978 eV 結合能處）誤認為某元素的光電子峰，會報告根本不存在的元素；或者把樣品接觸不良造成的整體位移解釋成化學態變化。
導電樣品以 C 1s = 284.8 eV 強行參考，會把本來正確的能量尺度平移 0.2 到 0.5 eV，化學態判讀全錯；絕緣樣品中和不足時，同一元素的峰因局部充電不均分裂成兩個，被誤判為兩種化學態。
pitfallsEn: Mistaking an Auger peak, such as O KLL appearing near 978 eV on the binding-energy scale under Al Kα, for a photoelectron peak reports an element that is not there; likewise a rigid shift caused by poor sample contact can be misread as a chemical-state change.

Forcing C 1s = 284.8 eV referencing on a conducting sample shifts an already correct scale by 0.2 to 0.5 eV and corrupts every chemical-state assignment; an under-neutralised insulator shows peaks split in two by non-uniform local charging, which are mistaken for two chemical states.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：次級離子質譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Secondary-ion mass spectrometers
guides.concept: 從一次離子的碰撞級聯與二次離子化機率出發，理解 SIMS 為何能偵測 ppb 等級的摻雜卻受基質效應支配，再把靜態與動態模式、一次離子源、磁扇與飛行時間質量分析、植入標準片的靈敏度因子校正、偵測極限、電荷補償與濺射坑效應整合成可驗收的深度剖析工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the collision cascade of primary ions and the secondary ionisation probability to see why SIMS detects ppb-level dopants yet is ruled by matrix effects, then integrate static and dynamic modes, primary ion sources, magnetic-sector and time-of-flight mass analysis, sensitivity-factor calibration with implant standards, detection limits, charge compensation and crater effects into an acceptable depth-profiling record.
procedure: 能量 0.25 到 30 keV 的一次離子打進固體後引發碰撞級聯，把動量傳回表面，使最上面一到兩個原子層的原子被濺射出來；每個一次離子濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，典型為 1 到 10。被濺射的粒子只有一小部分帶電，離子化機率 α⁺ 或 α⁻ 從 10⁻⁵ 到 10⁻¹，而且強烈依賴表面化學：O₂⁺ 轟擊或氧氣吹掃把表面氧化，大幅提高正離子產率；Cs⁺ 降低表面功函數，提高負離子產率。這種基質效應是 SIMS 定量困難的根源，也是它靈敏度極高的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「碰撞級聯與二次離子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

靜態 SIMS 把一次離子總劑量限制在約 10¹² 到 10¹³ ions/cm²，遠低於表面一個單層的 10¹⁵ atoms/cm²，使大多數分析區域在被量到時仍未被先前的離子損傷，因此能保留分子碎片與完整分子離子的資訊，適合有機表面與單層分析。動態 SIMS 刻意用高劑量連續濺射，以每秒零點幾奈米的速率剝除材料並持續記錄各質量的強度，把時間軸換算成深度軸，用於半導體摻雜分佈與多層膜的深度剖析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「一次離子劑量與靜態極限」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

動態 SIMS 常用雙電漿管產生 O₂⁺、表面離子化源產生 Cs⁺，束流從 nA 到 µA、束徑數微米到數十微米，追求高濺射速率與穩定電流。靜態與影像 TOF-SIMS 用液態金屬離子源產生 Bi⁺、Bi₃⁺ 等團簇，亮度高到能聚焦到 50 nm 以下，而團簇離子把能量分散在表面淺層，二次離子產率比單原子離子高一個數量級。氣體團簇離子源（Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ 到 Ar₅₀₀₀⁺）每個原子只帶幾 eV，低於原子位移閾值，能剖析有機多層而不累積化學損傷。離子柱包含質量過濾、靜電透鏡、偏轉與掃描板，並配備法拉第杯量束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「O₂⁺/Cs⁺ 離子槍與 Bi 液態金屬離子源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二次離子被數 kV 的萃取電場收集後送入質量分析器。雙聚焦磁扇儀器（靜電扇加磁扇）在高傳輸率下提供 m/Δm 數千到上萬的解析度，可連續監測少數幾個質量，是動態深度剖析的主力；飛行時間分析器在一次脈衝內記錄全部質量，搭配反射鏡可達 m/Δm 30 000 以上，適合靜態與影像分析；四極桿簡單便宜但解析度只到單位質量。質量解析度的實際意義在分離同標稱質量的干擾，例如 ³¹P⁺ 與 ³⁰Si¹H⁺、⁵⁶Fe⁺ 與 ²⁸Si₂⁺，而干擾的強度往往比痕量元素高幾個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「磁扇與飛行時間質量分析器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

因為基質效應，SIMS 定量必須靠與未知樣品相同基質的標準片：把已知劑量的元素離子植入矽、鍺或 GaAs，以相同條件剖析，積分訊號對深度即可得到相對靈敏度因子 RSF，定義為濃度 = RSF × (痕量離子強度/基質離子強度)。深度尺度來自濺射坑深度與時間的線性換算，坑深以觸針輪廓儀或干涉儀量測；當剖析跨越不同材料層時，各層的濺射速率不同，必須分段校正。RSF 隨一次離子種類、能量、入射角與氧氣吹掃條件改變，所以標準片必須在同一個分析配方下量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子植入標準片與 RSF」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二次離子以電子倍增器脈衝計數偵測，強訊號改用法拉第杯以避免飽和，兩者在重疊區交叉校正，動態範圍可達 8 到 9 個數量級。偵測極限由背景決定：殘氣吸附的 H、C、O，離子柱與腔壁的記憶效應，質量干擾的拖尾，以及倍增器的暗計數。痕量元素的計數遵循 Poisson 統計，訊號必須高於背景的 3σ；延長每個資料點的停留時間或增加一次束流都能改善，但束流增加同時加快濺射，深度解析度與總分析時間隨之改變。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子倍增器計數與背景」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

深度剖析的解析度受三個因素限制：一次離子把原子推向更深處的離子混合，深度約為投影射程的 2 倍；濺射造成的表面粗糙化；以及濺射坑壁斜面持續貢獻尚未剖析到的淺層訊號。低能量（250 eV 到 1 keV）與斜入射減少混合，旋轉樣品抑制粗糙化，電子閘控只接受來自掃描區中央一小部分的二次離子以排除坑壁。絕緣樣品在正離子轟擊下累積正電荷，二次離子能量偏移、訊號消失，必須以低能電子槍中和，負一次離子（O⁻）或 TOF 的脈衝電子中和也是常用手段。整合這些機制與腔體真空、樣品台精度，才能同時達到奈米深度解析與 ppb 靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「濺射坑、電子閘控與電子中和槍」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SIMS 的性能完全綁定在分析配方上：一次離子種類、能量、入射角、束流、掃描尺寸、閘控比例、質量解析度、氧氣吹掃與中和條件任一改變，RSF、偵測極限與深度解析度都隨之改變。驗收因此以配方為單位：每個配方用植入標準片驗證 RSF 的重現性、用 δ 層樣品驗證深度解析度、用高純矽驗證偵測極限、用質量雙峰驗證解析度、用絕緣樣品驗證中和。交接文件把每個配方的參數、對應標準片、驗收結果與趨勢圖綁在一起，任何人換配方時必須重走驗收流程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「參考樣品組與配方紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Primary ions of 0.25 to 30 keV entering a solid start a collision cascade that returns momentum to the surface and sputters atoms from the top one or two atomic layers; the number of atoms sputtered per primary ion, the sputter yield Y, is typically 1 to 10. Only a small fraction of the sputtered particles are charged, with ionisation probabilities α⁺ or α⁻ from 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻¹ that depend strongly on surface chemistry: O₂⁺ bombardment or oxygen flooding oxidises the surface and greatly raises positive-ion yields, while Cs⁺ lowers the surface work function and raises negative-ion yields. This matrix effect is the root of SIMS quantification difficulty and also the source of its extreme sensitivity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collision cascade and secondary ions”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Static SIMS limits the total primary-ion dose to roughly 10¹² to 10¹³ ions/cm², far below the 10¹⁵ atoms/cm² of a surface monolayer, so most of the analysed area is still undamaged by earlier ions when it is sampled; molecular fragments and intact molecular ions survive, which suits organic surfaces and monolayers. Dynamic SIMS deliberately sputters continuously at high dose, removing material at a fraction of a nanometre per second while recording the intensity of each mass, converting the time axis into depth for semiconductor dopant distributions and multilayer profiles. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Primary-ion dose and the static limit”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dynamic SIMS commonly uses a duoplasmatron for O₂⁺ and a surface-ionisation source for Cs⁺, with beams from nanoamperes to microamperes and diameters from a few to tens of micrometres, aiming at high sputter rate and stable current. Static and imaging TOF-SIMS use liquid-metal ion sources producing Bi⁺ and Bi₃⁺ clusters bright enough to focus below 50 nm, and cluster ions deposit their energy in a shallow layer so secondary-ion yields exceed those of monatomic ions by an order of magnitude. Gas-cluster sources (Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ to Ar₅₀₀₀⁺) carry only a few electronvolts per atom, below the atomic displacement threshold, and profile organic multilayers without accumulating chemical damage. The column holds a mass filter, electrostatic lenses, deflection and raster plates, and a Faraday cup for current measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “O₂⁺/Cs⁺ guns and Bi liquid-metal ion source”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Secondary ions collected by a several-kilovolt extraction field enter the mass analyser. Double-focusing magnetic-sector instruments (electrostatic plus magnetic sectors) provide m/Δm of thousands to tens of thousands at high transmission and monitor a few masses continuously, the workhorse for dynamic depth profiling; time-of-flight analysers record all masses from each pulse and with a reflectron exceed m/Δm of 30 000, suiting static and imaging work; quadrupoles are simple and cheap but reach only unit mass resolution. Mass resolution matters for separating isobaric interferences such as ³¹P⁺ from ³⁰Si¹H⁺ or ⁵⁶Fe⁺ from ²⁸Si₂⁺, where the interference is often orders of magnitude stronger than the trace element. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Magnetic-sector and time-of-flight analysers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because of the matrix effect, SIMS quantification relies on standards with the same matrix as the unknown: a known dose of the element is ion-implanted into silicon, germanium or GaAs and profiled under identical conditions, and integrating the signal over depth yields the relative sensitivity factor RSF, defined by concentration = RSF × (trace-ion intensity/matrix-ion intensity). The depth scale comes from a linear conversion of crater depth and time, with the crater depth measured by a stylus profilometer or interferometer; when a profile crosses different material layers each has its own sputter rate and must be calibrated separately. RSF changes with primary-ion species, energy, incidence angle and oxygen flooding, so the standard must be measured under the same analytical recipe. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion-implanted standard and RSF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Secondary ions are detected by pulse counting on an electron multiplier, with a Faraday cup taking over for strong signals to avoid saturation and the two cross-calibrated in their overlap, giving a dynamic range of 8 to 9 orders of magnitude. The detection limit is set by background: H, C and O adsorbed from residual gas, memory effects from the ion column and chamber walls, tails of mass interferences and the multiplier's dark counts. Trace counts follow Poisson statistics and the signal must exceed 3σ of the background; longer dwell per data point or higher primary current helps, but higher current also sputters faster, changing depth resolution and total analysis time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-multiplier counting and background”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Depth resolution is bounded by three effects: ion mixing that pushes atoms deeper, to about twice the projected range of the primary ions; sputter-induced surface roughening; and the sloping crater walls that keep contributing shallow signal not yet profiled. Low energy (250 eV to 1 keV) and oblique incidence reduce mixing, sample rotation suppresses roughening, and electronic gating accepts secondary ions only from a central fraction of the raster to exclude the walls. Insulators charge positively under positive-ion bombardment, shifting secondary-ion energies and killing the signal, so a low-energy electron gun neutralises them; negative primary ions (O⁻) or pulsed electron flooding in TOF instruments are common alternatives. Integrating these mechanisms with chamber vacuum and stage precision is what delivers nanometre depth resolution together with ppb sensitivity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crater, electronic gating and electron flood gun”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SIMS performance is bound to the analytical recipe: changing the primary species, energy, incidence angle, current, raster size, gate fraction, mass resolution, oxygen flooding or neutralisation changes the RSF, detection limit and depth resolution. Acceptance is therefore organised per recipe: each recipe verifies RSF reproducibility on an implant standard, depth resolution on a δ-layer sample, detection limits on high-purity silicon, resolution on a mass doublet and neutralisation on an insulator. The handoff binds every recipe's parameters, its matching standards, acceptance results and trend charts together, and anyone who changes a recipe must repeat the acceptance sequence. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reference-sample set and recipe records”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 在氧化層與矽的界面，氧覆蓋突然改變使 α⁺ 跳變數倍，深度剖析在界面出現假的濃度峰或谷；若不認識這個基質效應，會把儀器假象報告為界面偏析。
把矽基質的 RSF 套用到 SiGe 或 GaAs，濃度誤差可達數倍；深度剖析跨越氧化層時若沿用矽的濺射速率，氧化層被錯算得太厚或太薄，摻雜峰位置全部錯置。
pitfallsEn: At an oxide–silicon interface the sudden change in oxygen coverage jumps α⁺ by several times, so depth profiles show a false concentration peak or dip at the interface; without recognising the matrix effect this artefact is reported as interfacial segregation.

Applying a silicon-matrix RSF to SiGe or GaAs produces concentration errors of several times; carrying the silicon sputter rate through an oxide layer misplaces the oxide thickness and shifts every dopant peak position.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：飛行時間質譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Time-of-flight mass spectrometers
guides.concept: 從同一電位加速後離子速度與質量平方根成反比出發，理解飛行時間質譜儀如何把質量量測轉成奈秒級計時，再把初始能量散布、反射器聚焦、微通道板偵測、時間數位轉換、溫度與高壓漂移造成的 ppm 誤差、MALDI 與 ESI 的離子注入整合成可驗收的質量量測鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the fact that ions accelerated through one potential travel at speeds inversely proportional to the square root of mass to see how a time-of-flight mass spectrometer turns mass measurement into nanosecond timing, then integrate initial energy spread, reflectron focusing, microchannel-plate detection, time-to-digital conversion, ppm errors from temperature and high-voltage drift, and MALDI and ESI ion injection into an acceptable mass-measurement chain.
procedure: 離子在電位差 U 中加速後獲得動能 zeU = ½mv²，進入長度 L 的無場漂移管等速飛行，到達偵測器的時間 t = L·√(m/(2zeU))，所以飛行時間與 √(m/z) 成正比。一次脈衝就讓所有質量同時出發，輕離子先到、重離子後到，偵測器只要記錄整段時間序列就得到完整質譜，這是飛行時間儀器沒有掃描、理論上質量範圍不受限的原因。代價是質量差距被壓縮成時間差：相鄰整數質量在高質量端只差數奈秒，整台儀器的本質是一個精密的碼表。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「加速區與無場漂移管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

解析力 m/Δm = t/(2Δt)，因為 m ∝ t²，時間的相對展寬會加倍成質量的相對展寬。Δt 來自多個獨立來源：離子形成位置與時間不同、初始速度與能量散布、雷射脈衝寬度、偵測器與電子計時抖動，各項以平方和相加。線性模式中能量散布 ΔU/U 直接造成 Δt/t = ½·ΔU/U，通常是最大項；1955 年 Wiley 與 McLaren 以雙段加速場做空間聚焦，並提出延遲萃取的前身「時間延遲聚焦」，讓位置與速度相關的散布在偵測器處互相抵消。MALDI 以 100–300 ns 的延遲萃取處理雷射羽流的初速分布，但無法消除所有能量散布。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子起始位置與能量散布」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

反射器是一組逐級升壓的環形電極，形成略高於加速電位的減速場；能量較高的離子跑得快，但穿入反射場較深、在裡面待較久，能量較低的離子路徑較短，兩者在偵測器處同時到達。1973 年 Mamyrin 提出此設計。單段均勻場反射器的一階能量聚焦條件是總無場長度 L 等於穿透深度 d 的四倍；雙段反射器以前段大幅減速、後段反射，可縮短長度並聚焦到二階。代價是柵網造成散射與穿透損失，以及離子必須走入反射場而限制了最大可接受的能量範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射器減速場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

到達的離子撞擊微通道板，通道內壁放出二次電子並在數 kV 偏壓下倍增，雙片 V 形堆疊的增益約 10⁶，輸出脈衝寬度小於 1 ns。脈衝可由時間數位轉換器（TDC）以 25–100 ps 的時間格記錄單一離子事件，或以每秒數 GS 的類比數位轉換器（ADC）記錄完整波形並累加；TDC 計時精細、雜訊低，但每個時間格每次脈衝只能計一次，ADC 動態範圍較大卻有基線雜訊。MCP 的偵測效率取決於離子撞擊速度，重離子速度低時效率明顯下降，所以大分子儀器常在偵測器前加後加速。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「微通道板與時間數位轉換器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

實際儀器以 t = t₀ + k·√(m/z) 校正：k 包含飛行長度與加速電壓，t₀ 包含觸發、纜線與電子延遲；高精度時還會加入高階項修正場的非理想。校正後的誤差主要來自兩種漂移：飛行管熱膨脹讓 L 改變，加速與反射器高壓的相對漂移讓 U 改變；由 m ∝ U·t²/L² 可知長度的相對變化在質量上加倍，而電壓的相對變化一比一進入質量。因此高解析儀器使用低膨脹材料與溫控飛行管、ppm 級穩定的高壓電源，並以持續注入的鎖定質量離子即時修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「t₀、k 校正與飛行管溫度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

質量準確度不只取決於校正，也取決於每個峰的質心能定得多準：對高斯峰，質心的標準差約為 (FWHM/2.355)/√N，N 是構成該峰的離子數，所以弱峰的質量本來就不準。TDC 系統在每次推送中每個時間格最多記一個離子，當平均到達數 μ 接近 1 時事件被漏記，觀察到的機率為 1 − e^(−μ)，強峰被壓扁、質心往早到的一側偏移；可用泊松修正 μ = −ln(1 − f) 還原，但在 f 接近 1 時失效。動態範圍因此受限於推送次數與飽和，ADC 或混合式採集與自動增益控制用來擴展。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「質心統計與死時間飽和」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

飛行時間分析器需要脈衝式的起點：MALDI 本身就是雷射脈衝，以 337 或 355 nm 雷射在基質晶體上每秒數百到上萬發，適合點樣與組織成像；ESI 產生連續離子流，必須先經離子導引與碰撞冷卻，再以正交加速推送器把一段離子束側向推入飛行管。正交加速的工作週期等於推送器長度除以每個推送週期內離子束前進的距離，與 √(m/z) 成正比；離子束的橫向速度散布在推送場中造成轉向時間 Δt = 2mΔv/(qE)，這是反射器無法修正的計時項。與液相層析耦合時，譜圖速率需在每個層析峰內取足夠點數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「正交推送器與離子源介面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

飛行時間質譜儀的驗收把前面的模型轉成固定測試：以標準品量各質量段的解析力（FWHM 定義），以多點校正與長時間鎖定質量量測驗證 ppm 準確度與漂移，以稀釋序列驗證線性與死時間修正，以已知同位素比例驗證偵測器飽和，以 MCP 單離子脈衝高度驗證增益，並以層析測試驗證取樣速率。交接紀錄須包含校正係數與殘差、飛行管溫度與高壓監測趨勢、MCP 電壓與累計計數、反射器與推送器電壓、鎖定質量設定，以及各項允收值，使任何一項劣化都能追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「解析力、質量準確度與線性的驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: An ion accelerated through a potential difference U gains kinetic energy zeU = ½mv², then coasts through a field-free drift tube of length L and reaches the detector at t = L·√(m/(2zeU)), so flight time scales with √(m/z). One pulse launches all masses together, light ions arriving first and heavy ions later, and recording the whole time trace yields a complete spectrum, which is why time-of-flight instruments need no scanning and have an essentially unlimited mass range. The price is that mass differences are compressed into time differences: adjacent integer masses at high mass differ by only a few nanoseconds, so the instrument is at heart a precision stopwatch. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceleration region and field-free drift tube”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Resolving power is m/Δm = t/(2Δt) because m ∝ t², so a relative time spread doubles into a relative mass spread. Δt comes from independent contributions added in quadrature: differences in formation position and time, initial velocity and energy spread, laser pulse width, and detector and electronic timing jitter. In linear mode an energy spread ΔU/U produces Δt/t = ½·ΔU/U directly and is usually the largest term; in 1955 Wiley and McLaren used a two-stage acceleration field for space focusing and introduced time-lag focusing, the forerunner of delayed extraction, so position- and velocity-correlated spreads cancel at the detector. MALDI uses 100–300 ns of delayed extraction to handle the initial velocity distribution of the laser plume, but cannot remove every energy spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Initial ion position and energy spread”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A reflectron is a stack of ring electrodes graded in voltage to form a retarding field slightly above the acceleration potential; faster, higher-energy ions penetrate deeper and spend longer inside, slower ions take a shorter path, and both reach the detector together. Mamyrin proposed the design in 1973. A single-stage uniform-field reflectron achieves first-order energy focusing when the total field-free length L equals four times the penetration depth d; a two-stage reflectron decelerates strongly in the first stage and reflects in the second, shortening the device and focusing to second order. The costs are scattering and transmission loss on grids and a limited accepted energy window, since every ion must turn around inside the field. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflectron retarding field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Arriving ions strike a microchannel plate, whose channel walls emit secondary electrons that multiply under a bias of a few kilovolts; a two-plate chevron stack gives a gain of about 10⁶ and output pulses narrower than 1 ns. Pulses are either recorded by a time-to-digital converter (TDC) as single-ion events in 25–100 ps bins or digitised as full waveforms by an analogue-to-digital converter (ADC) running at several gigasamples per second and summed; the TDC offers fine timing and low noise but counts at most once per bin per pulse, while the ADC has more dynamic range but baseline noise. MCP detection efficiency depends on impact velocity and drops markedly for slow heavy ions, so large-molecule instruments often post-accelerate ions in front of the detector. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Microchannel plate and time-to-digital converter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Real instruments calibrate with t = t₀ + k·√(m/z), where k contains flight length and acceleration voltage and t₀ contains trigger, cable and electronic delays; high-accuracy work adds higher-order terms for non-ideal fields. After calibration the errors come mainly from two drifts: thermal expansion of the flight tube changes L, and relative drift of the acceleration and reflectron high voltages changes U; since m ∝ U·t²/L², a relative length change doubles in mass while a relative voltage change enters mass one to one. High-resolution instruments therefore use low-expansion, temperature-controlled flight tubes, ppm-stable high-voltage supplies and a continuously infused lock-mass ion for real-time correction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “t₀, k calibration and flight-tube temperature”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mass accuracy depends not only on calibration but on how well each peak centroid is defined: for a Gaussian peak the centroid standard deviation is about (FWHM/2.355)/√N with N the number of ions in the peak, so weak peaks are intrinsically less accurate. A TDC system records at most one ion per time bin per push, so as the mean arrival number μ approaches 1 events are lost and the observed probability is 1 − e^(−μ); strong peaks are flattened and their centroids shift toward earlier arrival. Poisson correction μ = −ln(1 − f) restores them but fails as f approaches 1, so dynamic range is limited by push count and saturation, and ADC or hybrid acquisition with automatic gain control extends it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Centroid statistics and dead-time saturation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A time-of-flight analyser needs a pulsed start: MALDI is inherently pulsed, firing a 337 or 355 nm laser at matrix crystals hundreds to tens of thousands of times per second, suited to spotted samples and tissue imaging; ESI produces a continuous ion stream that must pass through ion guides and collisional cooling before an orthogonal-acceleration pusher kicks a segment of the beam sideways into the flight tube. The orthogonal duty cycle equals the pusher length divided by the distance the beam advances per push period and scales with √(m/z); the beam's transverse velocity spread in the push field creates a turnaround time Δt = 2mΔv/(qE), a timing term the reflectron cannot correct. Coupled to liquid chromatography, the spectral rate must give enough points across every chromatographic peak. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Orthogonal pusher and ion-source interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of a time-of-flight mass spectrometer turns the earlier models into fixed tests: standards measure FWHM resolving power across mass ranges, multipoint calibration and long lock-mass runs verify ppm accuracy and drift, dilution series verify linearity and dead-time correction, known isotope ratios verify detector saturation, single-ion MCP pulse heights verify gain, and chromatographic tests verify sampling rate. The handoff record must contain calibration coefficients and residuals, flight-tube temperature and high-voltage trends, MCP voltage and accumulated counts, reflectron and pusher voltages, lock-mass settings and each allowance, so that any degradation can be traced. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance table of resolution, accuracy and linearity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把質量與時間當成線性關係做內插，或忽略觸發延遲 t₀，整個質量軸在高低端各自彎曲，低質量碎片與高質量前驅物的指認同時出錯；漂移管的屏蔽網破損或絕緣表面帶電讓區域不再無場，離子速度在途中改變，峰形拖尾且位置隨使用時間漂移。
空調週期讓實驗室溫度擺動 ±0.5 K，未溫控的鋁飛行管產生 ±23 ppm 的週期性質量誤差，代謝物以 5 ppm 窗口搜尋資料庫時一半以上的正確化合物被排除；鎖定質量離子被樣品中的同質量干擾污染，修正把整段資料往錯誤方向拉偏。
pitfallsEn: Interpolating mass as linear in time or ignoring the trigger delay t₀ bends the mass axis differently at the low and high ends, mis-assigning both low-mass fragments and high-mass precursors; a damaged screening mesh or charged insulating surfaces leave the drift tube no longer field-free, changing ion speed in flight so peaks tail and wander with use.

Air-conditioning cycles swing the laboratory ±0.5 K and an uncontrolled aluminium flight tube produces periodic ±23 ppm mass errors, so a metabolite database search with a 5 ppm window rejects more than half of the correct compounds; a lock-mass ion contaminated by an isobaric sample interference pulls the whole data set the wrong way.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：核磁共振光譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Nuclear magnetic-resonance spectrometers
guides.concept: 從原子核在強磁場中以拉莫頻率進動、卻只有百萬分之幾十淨極化出發，理解核磁共振光譜儀如何以超導磁體、勻場線圈、低溫探頭與數位接收器把 ppb 級的頻率差轉成化學結構資訊，再把漂移、線形、脈衝校正、T₁ 弛豫與場地振動整合成可交接的定量量測紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from nuclei precessing at the Larmor frequency in a strong field yet carrying only tens of parts per million of net polarisation to see how an NMR spectrometer uses a superconducting magnet, shim coils, a cryogenic probe and a digital receiver to turn ppb-level frequency differences into chemical structure, then integrate drift, line shape, pulse calibration, T₁ relaxation and site vibration into a transferable quantitative measurement record.
procedure: 具有自旋的原子核（¹H、¹³C、¹⁵N、¹⁹F、³¹P）帶有磁矩，放在靜磁場 B₀ 中會繞磁場以拉莫頻率 ω = γB₀ 進動，並分裂成能量差 ħγB₀ 的能階。室溫下這個能差遠小於 k_BT，兩能階的佈居只差百萬分之幾十，淨磁化非常微弱，這是 NMR 先天低靈敏度的根源。射頻脈衝把淨磁化扳離 B₀ 方向後，它在線圈中感應出以拉莫頻率振盪、逐漸衰減的電壓，也就是自由感應衰減（FID）。訊噪比大約隨 B₀^(3/2) 成長，這是 NMR 不斷追求更強超導磁體的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主磁場中的核自旋」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

分子中的電子在外磁場下產生感應電流，局部屏蔽原子核，使其實際感受的場為 B₀(1 − σ)，不同化學環境的核因此有不同的共振頻率。化學位移定義為 δ = (ν − ν_ref)/ν_ref × 10⁶ ppm，以 TMS 或 DSS 為零點而與場強無關；經由化學鍵傳遞的純量耦合 J 則以 Hz 表示，也與場強無關。所以高場把以 Hz 計的位移差拉開而耦合寬度不變，Δν/J 變大後強耦合的二階譜型逐漸變回容易解讀的一階多重峰。最後能否分辨兩個峰還取決於線寬 Δν½ = 1/(πT₂*)，它同時包含樣品的橫向弛豫與磁場不均勻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「化學位移與耦合多重峰」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

高解析 NMR 磁體以 NbTi 與 Nb₃Sn 超導線繞成多段螺管，浸在 4.2 K 液氦中，外層以液氮或冷頭冷卻的輻射屏與真空層隔熱；約 1 GHz 以上的磁體還加入高溫超導內插線圈。充磁後以超導開關把線圈與超導接點閉合成迴路進入持續模式，電流以 L/R 時間常數衰減，由於接點電阻極小，磁場漂移只有每小時數 Hz。剩餘漂移與環境擾動由氘鎖場迴路修正：儀器持續觀測溶劑的 ²H 訊號，以 Z0 線圈的微小電流把 ²H 頻率鎖住。主動遮蔽線圈則把外部雜散場的 0.5 mT（5 G）線縮到磁體附近。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「超導線圈、超導接點與液氦槽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

探頭把射頻線圈放在磁體中心，溶液 NMR 多用鞍形線圈產生垂直於 B₀ 的 B₁；線圈與電容組成共振電路，必須調諧到觀測核的拉莫頻率並匹配到 50 Ω。訊噪比約正比於 √(ηQ/T_noise)，η 是填充因子，Q 是電路品質因數，T_noise 包含線圈、樣品與前置放大器的雜訊溫度。低溫探頭把線圈與前置放大器冷卻到約 20 K（氦冷）或液氮溫度，同時提高 Q 並降低熱雜訊，可得數倍訊噪比；但樣品仍在室溫，含鹽水溶液的導電與介電損耗會讓樣品雜訊成為主導項，使增益大幅縮水。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「射頻線圈、調諧電路與低溫前置放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

超導磁體本身的均勻度不足以給出次 Hz 線寬，樣品、樣品管與探頭材料的磁化率也會扭曲局部磁場，所以磁體孔內放置數十組依球諧函數設計的室溫勻場線圈（Z1–Z5、X、Y、XZ、XY 等），以電流抵銷各階梯度。現代儀器以脈衝場梯度量出磁場分布圖，自動求解勻場電流，再手動微調高階項。線形不只看半高寬，還要看接近基線的裙擺：偶數階 Z 項錯誤造成對稱展寬，奇數階造成不對稱，樣品旋轉時的橫向不均勻則產生旋轉邊帶。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「室溫勻場線圈與線形」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

射頻脈衝在旋轉座標中讓磁化繞 B₁ 轉動 θ = γB₁t_p，90° 脈衝把全部縱向磁化轉到橫向，訊號最大；脈衝寬度隨探頭調諧、樣品導電度與功率而變，必須每個樣品校正。FID 以正交偵測取樣，取樣間隔 1/SW 決定譜寬，擷取時間 AQ 決定數位解析度 1/AQ，再經切趾函數與傅立葉轉換成頻譜。定量時兩次掃描之間必須讓縱向磁化依 1 − e^(−t/T₁) 回復，T₁ 不同的訊號若回復不完全，積分比就偏離真實的質子數比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「90° 脈衝、FID 取樣與弛豫延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NMR 的系統整合從場地開始：雜散磁場 0.5 mT 線內須管制心律調節器使用者與鐵磁物件，鄰近電梯、車輛與鋼構移動會擾動磁場；地板振動經磁體腳架與探頭傳到樣品，在殘餘梯度中調變共振頻率，於主峰兩側形成以振動頻率為間距的旁帶。液氦與液氮補充週期、冷頭或零蒸發系統維護、失超排氣管與氧氣監測屬於設計階段就要確定的安全基礎設施。變溫單元以加熱氣流控制樣品溫度，溫度梯度會引起對流並劣化線形，實際溫度需以甲醇或乙二醇的化學位移差校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「磁體場地、振動與變溫單元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NMR 驗收把前面各單元的模型逐一轉成測試：漂移與鎖場穩定度驗證磁體，標準樣品的 ¹H 與 ¹³C 訊噪比驗證探頭與接收鏈，CHCl₃ 線形驗證勻場，90° 脈衝寬度與功率驗證發射鏈與調諧，甲醇溫度計驗證變溫單元，脈衝場梯度回復與旁帶高度驗證整合。交接紀錄須包含每個探頭與溶劑的勻場檔、各核的 90° 脈衝與功率、量到的訊噪比與線形、磁體漂移與冷媒液位趨勢，以及定量方法所用的 T₁ 與重複時間，使任何異常都能追溯到具體元件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「靈敏度、線形與溫度驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Nuclei with spin (¹H, ¹³C, ¹⁵N, ¹⁹F, ³¹P) carry magnetic moments that, in a static field B₀, precess about the field at the Larmor frequency ω = γB₀ and split into levels separated by ħγB₀. At room temperature this splitting is far below k_BT, so the populations differ by only tens of parts per million and the net magnetisation is tiny, the root of NMR's inherent insensitivity. After a radio-frequency pulse tips the net magnetisation away from B₀, it induces in the coil a decaying voltage oscillating at the Larmor frequency, the free induction decay (FID). Signal-to-noise grows roughly as B₀^(3/2), which is why NMR keeps pushing toward stronger superconducting magnets. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Nuclear spins in the main field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Electrons in a molecule respond to the applied field with induced currents that shield each nucleus locally, so it experiences B₀(1 − σ) and nuclei in different chemical environments resonate at different frequencies. The chemical shift is δ = (ν − ν_ref)/ν_ref × 10⁶ ppm, referenced to TMS or DSS and independent of field, while scalar coupling J transmitted through bonds is expressed in hertz and is also field-independent. A higher field therefore spreads shift differences in hertz while coupling widths stay fixed, and as Δν/J grows, strongly coupled second-order patterns relax toward easily read first-order multiplets. Whether two peaks can be separated finally depends on the linewidth Δν½ = 1/(πT₂*), which contains both transverse relaxation and field inhomogeneity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Chemical shifts and coupling multiplets”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High-resolution NMR magnets are multi-section solenoids wound from NbTi and Nb₃Sn superconductor, immersed in 4.2 K liquid helium and insulated by radiation shields cooled with liquid nitrogen or a cryocooler and by vacuum spaces; magnets above about 1 GHz add high-temperature-superconductor inserts. After energising, a superconducting switch closes the coil and its superconducting joints into a persistent loop whose current decays with the time constant L/R, and because the joint resistance is minute the field drifts only a few hertz per hour. Residual drift and environmental disturbances are corrected by the deuterium lock, which continuously observes the solvent ²H signal and holds its frequency with small currents in a Z0 coil. Active shielding coils pull the external 0.5 mT (5 G) stray-field line close to the magnet. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Superconducting coil, joints and helium bath”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The probe places the RF coil at the magnet centre; solution NMR usually uses a saddle coil producing B₁ perpendicular to B₀, and the coil with its capacitors forms a resonant circuit that must be tuned to the observed nucleus's Larmor frequency and matched to 50 Ω. Signal-to-noise scales roughly as √(ηQ/T_noise), with η the filling factor, Q the circuit quality factor and T_noise the combined noise temperature of coil, sample and preamplifier. A cryogenic probe cools the coil and preamplifier to about 20 K with helium or to liquid-nitrogen temperature, raising Q and cutting thermal noise for several-fold gains; but the sample stays at room temperature, and conductive and dielectric losses of a salty aqueous solution make sample noise dominant and shrink the gain sharply. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF coil, tuning circuit and cryogenic preamplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A superconducting magnet alone is not homogeneous enough for sub-hertz linewidths, and the magnetic susceptibility of sample, tube and probe materials distorts the local field, so the bore holds dozens of room-temperature shim coils designed as spherical harmonics (Z1–Z5, X, Y, XZ, XY and others) whose currents cancel each gradient order. Modern instruments map the field with pulsed field gradients and solve for shim currents automatically before high orders are refined manually. Line shape is judged not only by half-height width but also by the skirt near the baseline: even-order Z errors broaden symmetrically, odd orders skew the line, and transverse inhomogeneity with sample spinning produces spinning sidebands. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Room-temperature shim coils and line shape”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A radio-frequency pulse rotates the magnetisation about B₁ in the rotating frame by θ = γB₁t_p, and a 90° pulse turns all longitudinal magnetisation into the transverse plane for maximum signal; the pulse width varies with probe tuning, sample conductivity and power and must be calibrated per sample. The FID is sampled with quadrature detection, the dwell 1/SW sets the spectral width and the acquisition time AQ sets the digital resolution 1/AQ before apodisation and Fourier transformation produce the spectrum. For quantitation the longitudinal magnetisation must recover as 1 − e^(−t/T₁) between scans, and incompletely recovered signals with different T₁ give integral ratios that depart from the true proton-count ratios. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “90° pulse, FID sampling and relaxation delay”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

NMR integration starts with the site: inside the 0.5 mT stray-field line pacemaker wearers and ferromagnetic objects must be controlled, and nearby lifts, vehicles and moving steelwork disturb the field; floor vibration travels through the magnet legs and probe to the sample and modulates its resonance in residual gradients, producing sidebands spaced by the vibration frequency on both sides of every main peak. Helium and nitrogen fill intervals, cryocooler or zero-boil-off maintenance, quench vent lines and oxygen monitoring are safety infrastructure to be fixed at the design stage. The variable-temperature unit controls sample temperature with a heated gas flow, temperature gradients drive convection and degrade line shape, and the actual temperature must be calibrated from the shift difference of methanol or ethylene glycol. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Magnet site, vibration and variable-temperature unit”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

NMR acceptance turns each earlier model into a test: drift and lock stability verify the magnet, ¹H and ¹³C signal-to-noise on standards verify the probe and receiver chain, the CHCl₃ line shape verifies shimming, 90° pulse widths and powers verify the transmit chain and tuning, a methanol thermometer verifies the variable-temperature unit, and pulsed-field-gradient recovery and sideband height verify integration. The handoff record must contain shim files per probe and solvent, 90° pulses and powers per nucleus, measured signal-to-noise and line shapes, magnet drift and cryogen-level trends, and the T₁ values and repetition times used in quantitative methods, so that any anomaly can be traced to a specific component. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensitivity, line-shape and temperature acceptance table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
