guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：閃爍體粒子偵測器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Scintillation particle detectors
guides.concept: 以 NaI(Tl)、LYSO 晶體與 EJ-200 塑膠閃爍體為例，追蹤一個 662 keV 伽瑪光子如何變成數萬個閃爍光子、數千個光電子與一個可校正的脈衝，並把 Birks 淬滅、光學耦合與反射層、PMT 與 SiPM、能量解析度分解、溫度增益漂移與符合計時整合成可交接的偵測器工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using NaI(Tl), LYSO crystals and EJ-200 plastic, the course follows a 662 keV gamma ray as it becomes tens of thousands of scintillation photons, thousands of photoelectrons and one calibratable pulse, then integrates Birks quenching, optical coupling and reflectors, PMTs and SiPMs, energy-resolution decomposition, temperature-driven gain drift and coincidence timing into a transferable detector engineering record.
procedure: 無機晶體中，游離粒子產生的電子電洞對在晶格中遷移，被 Tl⁺ 或 Ce³⁺ 等活化劑捕獲後以可見光釋放能量，光產額高但衰減時間從數十到數百奈秒；有機與塑膠閃爍體則由苯環 π 電子的螢光發光，光產額較低但衰減只有數奈秒。發光波長必須落在晶體本身透明且光偵測器敏感的範圍內，塑膠閃爍體因此加入波長轉換劑。選材時光產額決定能量解析度，衰減時間決定計數率與計時能力，密度與原子序決定攔截效率，三者必須同時權衡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「活化劑發光中心與衰減時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

閃爍光輸出並不嚴格正比於沉積能量：沿徑跡的游離密度越高，激發分子彼此淬滅與復合的機率越大，單位能量產生的光越少，這就是 Birks 淬滅。電子與最小游離粒子幾乎不受影響，但質子、α 粒子與重離子的光輸出被大幅壓低，所以能量刻度必須以電子等效能量 keVee 表示，並針對每種粒子另做換算。有機閃爍體中不同粒子的慢成分比例也不同，這正是脈衝形狀鑑別分辨中子與伽瑪的物理基礎。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「高 dE/dx 徑跡與電子等效能量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

閃爍光向各方向發射，晶體折射率高（LYSO 約 1.82、NaI 約 1.85），大部分光在出光面因全內反射被困在晶體內，必須經多次反射才能逃出。出光面以折射率接近的光學膠或矽膠墊耦合到光偵測器，可大幅擴大逃逸錐；其餘五面以 PTFE 擴散反射層或多層膜鏡面反射層包覆，把光送回出光面。表面拋光或粗化、反射層與晶體之間是否留空氣隙，都會改變光收集效率與沿長度方向的均勻性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射層、光學膠與出光面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光電倍增管以雙鹼光電陰極把光子轉成光電子，量子效率約 25% 到 43%，再經十級左右打拿極倍增到 10⁶ 至 10⁷ 倍，雜訊低、面積大，但需要高壓且怕磁場。矽光電倍增器由數千到數萬個工作在崩潰電壓以上的微單元並聯而成，每個微單元被觸發後輸出固定電荷，光子偵測效率約 40% 到 50%，體積小、低電壓、不受磁場影響，但有暗計數、串擾與後脈衝，且同一微單元在恢復前無法再計數，強光下會飽和失去線性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光電倍增管與矽光電倍增器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

能量解析度以光電峰的半高寬除以峰位表示。光電子數服從泊松統計，再乘上倍增過程的超額雜訊因子，構成統計項；但無機晶體的光產額隨電子能量並不嚴格成比例，這種非比例性讓不同路徑的電子串產生不同光量，形成無法靠增加光電子數消除的本質項；另外還有光收集不均勻與電子雜訊。工程上要把量到的解析度分解成這幾項，才知道改善應該投資在光偵測器、包覆還是晶體本身。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「¹³⁷Cs 光電峰與能量刻度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

閃爍偵測器的峰位會隨溫度與偏壓漂移：晶體光產額本身有溫度係數，PMT 增益隨高壓呈冪次關係，SiPM 的崩潰電壓隨溫度上升，固定偏壓下過電壓變小、增益與 PDE 同時下降。長時間運轉的系統因此需要溫度感測與偏壓補償，並以穩定的 LED 光脈衝或內建參考放射源持續監測增益，把光偵測器漂移與晶體變化分開判斷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓、溫度感測與 LED 監測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

閃爍事件的到達時間由最早幾個光電子決定，因此計時解析度取決於光產額、上升與衰減時間、光偵測器的單光子時間抖動以及晶體內光程差。兩個偵測器同時觸發才記錄的符合量測能抑制背景，但窗口內兩個無關事件也會被誤認為符合，形成隨機符合，其速率與兩路單計數率的乘積成正比。正子斷層掃描以 511 keV 光子對的符合定位反應線，飛行時間差進一步把事件定位在線上的某一段，所以符合時間解析度直接換算成影像訊雜比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「符合時間窗與時間拾取」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

把晶體、反射層、光偵測器、前端電子與冷卻組成模組時，晶體厚度與材料必須先滿足攔截效率，再兼顧光收集、計時與成本；符合量測的效率是單一偵測器效率的平方，所以厚度不足的代價會被放大。量產時每個模組的增益、解析度與時間偏移都不同，需要逐模組校正表，並以均勻性、死時間、計數率線性與長期穩定度作為驗收項目，連同包覆規格與材料批號寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偵測器模組與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: In inorganic crystals the electron–hole pairs created by an ionising particle migrate through the lattice until activators such as Tl⁺ or Ce³⁺ capture them and release the energy as visible light, giving high yield with decay times from tens to hundreds of nanoseconds; organic and plastic scintillators emit by fluorescence of π electrons in aromatic rings, with lower yield but decay of only a few nanoseconds. Emission must fall where the material is transparent and the photodetector is sensitive, which is why plastics include wavelength shifters. Light yield sets energy resolution, decay time sets count rate and timing, and density and atomic number set stopping efficiency, so material choice balances all three. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Activator luminescence centre and decay time”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Scintillation output is not strictly proportional to deposited energy: the higher the ionisation density along the track, the more excited molecules quench and recombine with one another and the less light each unit of energy produces, which is Birks quenching. Electrons and minimum-ionising particles are barely affected, but light from protons, alphas and heavy ions is strongly suppressed, so the energy scale is quoted in electron-equivalent keVee and converted separately for each particle type. In organic scintillators the slow-component fraction also differs between particles, which is the physical basis of pulse-shape discrimination between neutrons and gammas. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “High-dE/dx track and electron-equivalent energy”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Scintillation light is emitted in all directions, and with a high crystal index (about 1.82 for LYSO and 1.85 for NaI) most of it is trapped by total internal reflection at the exit face and must bounce many times before escaping. Coupling the exit face to the photodetector with index-matched optical grease or a silicone pad greatly widens the escape cone, while the other five faces are wrapped in diffuse PTFE or specular multilayer reflectors that return light toward the exit face. Polished versus roughened surfaces and whether an air gap is left between reflector and crystal both change light-collection efficiency and its uniformity along the length. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflector, optical grease and exit face”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A photomultiplier tube converts photons to photoelectrons on a bialkali photocathode with quantum efficiency of about 25% to 43% and multiplies them through about ten dynodes by 10⁶ to 10⁷, offering low noise and large area but needing high voltage and fearing magnetic fields. A silicon photomultiplier consists of thousands to tens of thousands of microcells biased above breakdown in parallel, each delivering a fixed charge when fired, with photon detection efficiency of about 40% to 50%; it is compact, low-voltage and immune to magnetic fields, but shows dark counts, crosstalk and afterpulsing, and a microcell cannot count again until it recovers, so it saturates and loses linearity under bright light. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photomultiplier tube and silicon photomultiplier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Energy resolution is the photopeak FWHM divided by its position. The photoelectron number follows Poisson statistics, multiplied by the excess noise factor of the multiplication, which forms the statistical term; but inorganic crystals do not yield light strictly in proportion to electron energy, and this non-proportionality makes different electron cascades produce different amounts of light, an intrinsic term that more photoelectrons cannot remove; light-collection non-uniformity and electronic noise add further terms. Engineers must decompose the measured resolution into these terms to know whether to invest in the photodetector, the wrapping or the crystal itself. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “¹³⁷Cs photopeak and energy calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Peak positions drift with temperature and bias: crystal light yield has its own temperature coefficient, PMT gain follows a power law in high voltage, and the SiPM breakdown voltage rises with temperature so that at fixed bias the overvoltage shrinks and gain and PDE fall together. Long-running systems therefore need temperature sensing with bias compensation and continuous gain monitoring with a stable LED pulser or an embedded reference source, distinguishing photodetector drift from crystal changes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias, temperature sensing and LED monitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The arrival time of a scintillation event is set by the first few photoelectrons, so timing resolution depends on light yield, rise and decay times, the photodetector's single-photon time jitter and optical path differences in the crystal. Coincidence counting, which records only when two detectors fire together, suppresses background, but two unrelated events within the window are also accepted as random coincidences at a rate proportional to the product of the two singles rates. Positron emission tomography locates lines of response from coincident 511 keV photon pairs, and the time-of-flight difference further confines the event to a segment of the line, so coincidence time resolution translates directly into image signal-to-noise. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Coincidence window and time pick-off”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When crystals, reflectors, photodetectors, front-end electronics and cooling are assembled into a module, crystal material and thickness must first meet stopping efficiency before light collection, timing and cost are balanced; coincidence efficiency is the square of single-detector efficiency, so insufficient thickness is penalised twice. In production every module differs in gain, resolution and time offset and needs its own calibration table, and acceptance covers uniformity, dead time, count-rate linearity and long-term stability, filed with wrapping specifications and material batch numbers in the handoff record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Detector module and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: NaI(Tl) 會吸濕，封裝漏氣後表面潮解變黃，光產額與均勻性逐漸下降，光電峰向低能漂移並變寬；若只用定期能量刻度修正而不檢查封裝，數月後才會發現解析度已不可接受。
只用單一 ¹³⁷Cs 點做線性刻度而忽略晶體非比例性與 SiPM 飽和，低能 X 光與高能伽瑪的能量會偏差數個百分比，核種鑑別可能把峰指認錯誤。
pitfallsEn: NaI(Tl) is hygroscopic: once the housing leaks the surface hydrates and yellows, light yield and uniformity fall, and the photopeak drifts down and broadens; correcting only with periodic energy recalibration without inspecting the housing reveals the unacceptable resolution months later.

A single-point linear calibration at ¹³⁷Cs that ignores crystal non-proportionality and SiPM saturation misplaces low-energy X-rays and high-energy gammas by several percent, so nuclide identification may assign peaks wrongly.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：矽像素粒子追蹤器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Silicon-pixel particle trackers
guides.concept: 以 CMS 與 ALICE 的像素追蹤器為參照，從最小游離粒子在 285 µm 矽中釋放約兩萬兩千個電子出發，把空乏與 Lorentz 偏移、混合式與 MAPS 架構、輻射損傷、位置解析度、物質量、觸發緩衝與軌跡式對準串成一份可驗收、可交接的追蹤器工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using the CMS and ALICE pixel trackers as references, start from the roughly 22,000 electrons a minimum-ionising particle frees in 285 µm of silicon, then connect depletion and Lorentz drift, hybrid versus MAPS architectures, radiation damage, spatial resolution, material budget, trigger buffering and track-based alignment into an acceptable, transferable tracker engineering record.
procedure: 帶電粒子穿過矽時以游離方式損失能量，最小游離粒子（MIP）的平均能損約 1.66 MeV·cm²/g，每產生一對電子—電洞需要 3.62 eV。少數高能 δ 電子會一次帶走大量能量，使能損分佈成為右尾很長的 Landau 分佈，最可能值只有平均值的約七成，因此門檻與信噪比必須用最可能值而非平均值設計。像素追蹤器的任務，就是在 LHC 25 ns 的束團間隔內把這數千到兩萬多個電子收集進讀出電路，並判斷它是否越過門檻。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「MIP 游離軌跡與訊號電荷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

矽感測器是一個大面積的反向偏壓 p–n 二極體，只有空乏區內產生的電荷會在電場中漂移並在讀出電極感應出訊號，未空乏區的電荷只能慢慢擴散甚至被複合，所以感測器必須全空乏或至少讓集電側空乏。空乏深度隨偏壓的平方根增加，全空乏電壓與有效摻雜濃度及厚度平方成正比。在 CMS 3.8 T 螺線管磁場中，漂移的電子受 Lorentz 力偏轉，使電荷橫向散到相鄰像素；工程上反而利用這個偏轉做電荷分享內插。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反向偏壓空乏區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

混合式像素把高阻值感測器與 CMOS 讀出晶片分開製造，再以每像素一顆的焊錫或銦凸塊倒裝接合，因此感測器可採 n-in-n 或 n-in-p 的抗輻射設計，讀出晶片可用先進製程；CMS Phase-1 像素為 100×150 µm²、285 µm 厚，每顆讀出晶片 52×80 像素。單體式主動像素感測器（MAPS）把電荷收集層與前端電路做在同一片晶圓上，例如 ALICE ITS2 的 ALPIDE 以 180 nm CMOS 影像感測製程製作約 29×27 µm² 的像素並薄化到 50 µm，省去凸塊與第二層矽；代價是電荷主要來自數十微米的磊晶層，抗輻射能力與時間解析度不如混合式。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器、凸塊與讀出晶片」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

強子與高能粒子在矽晶格中造成位移損傷，以 1 MeV 中子等效通量 Φ_eq 計量，產生能隙中間的缺陷能階，帶來三種後果：漏電流依 ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V 線性增加；有效摻雜改變，使 n 型基體發生型別反轉並讓空乏電壓持續上升；以及載子被缺陷捕獲使收集電荷下降。漏電流依 T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) 強烈依賴溫度，約每降 7 K 減半，所以內層像素必須冷到攝氏零下十到二十度；漏電流發熱又會加熱感測器，冷卻不足就會形成熱失控。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器漏電流與冷卻迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

若每顆粒子只點亮一個像素，位置誤差在節距內均勻分佈，解析度為 p/√12；當電荷因 Lorentz 偏移、斜入射或擴散分到兩個像素時，用類比電荷資訊（ADC 或 ToT）做重心或 η 修正內插，解析度可比二元讀出好約三倍。良好的電荷分享需要低門檻與低雜訊，否則邊緣像素的小訊號會被切掉，叢集退化成單像素。驗證解析度需要比待測元件更準的參考，也就是由數層薄 MAPS 組成的測試束望遠鏡。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電荷分享叢集與測試束望遠鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

追蹤器每一層的矽、讀出晶片、冷卻管、碳纖維支撐與電纜都會讓粒子發生多重庫侖散射，散射角寬度依 Highland 公式與 √(x/X₀) 成正比、與動量成反比。低動量粒子的撞擊參數與頂點解析度通常由物質量而非像素解析度決定，所以內層設計的競賽是降低 X/X₀ 並縮小第一層半徑；只有在高動量時才回到幾何項，由命中解析度與層間槓桿臂決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「每層物質量與束管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

內層像素的命中率大致隨半徑按 1/r² 增加，在高亮度下達每平方公分數百 MHz。觸發式讀出必須把每個命中保留到第一級觸發決定到來（CMS 約 4 µs），讀出晶片以雙欄為單位暫存時間戳記與電荷，緩衝滿了新命中就遺失；被觸發的事件再經串列鏈路送出，鏈路頻寬決定可承受的觸發率。因此系統效率損失不只來自感測器，也來自數位架構的死時間與緩衝溢位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雙欄緩衝與資料鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

安裝後模組位置只知道到數十微米，遠差於約 10 µm 的命中解析度，所以最終幾何由大量軌跡決定：把每個模組的三個平移與三個轉動當作參數，與軌跡參數一起最小化殘差 χ²，例如 Millepede-II 的全域擬合。某些整體變形如扭轉、伸縮與弓形，讓所有軌跡仍然擬合良好卻系統性地偏移動量，稱為弱模態，只能靠宇宙射線、束暈軌跡或 Z→μμ 質量約束打破。試運轉交接必須包含幾何版本、Lorentz 角、門檻與遮罩像素表以及對準驗證圖。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「軌跡殘差與對準參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A charged particle crossing silicon loses energy by ionisation; a minimum-ionising particle (MIP) deposits on average about 1.66 MeV·cm²/g, and each electron–hole pair costs 3.62 eV. A few energetic delta electrons occasionally carry away a large share of the energy, so the loss follows a Landau distribution with a long upper tail whose most probable value is only about 70% of the mean; thresholds and signal-to-noise must therefore be designed on the most probable value, not the mean. The pixel tracker's job is to collect these several thousand to twenty-odd thousand electrons into the readout circuit within the 25 ns LHC bunch spacing and decide whether they cross threshold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “MIP ionisation track and signal charge”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A silicon sensor is a large-area reverse-biased p–n diode: only charge generated inside the depleted region drifts in the field and induces a signal on the readout electrode, whereas charge in undepleted silicon diffuses slowly or recombines, so the sensor must be fully depleted or at least depleted on the collecting side. Depletion depth grows with the square root of bias, and the full-depletion voltage scales with effective doping and the square of thickness. In the 3.8 T CMS solenoid field the drifting electrons are deflected by the Lorentz force and spread charge sideways into neighbouring pixels, an effect engineers exploit for charge-sharing interpolation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reverse-biased depletion region”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Hybrid pixels fabricate a high-resistivity sensor and a CMOS readout chip separately and flip-chip join them with one solder or indium bump per pixel, so the sensor can use radiation-hard n-in-n or n-in-p designs while the readout chip uses an advanced process; CMS Phase-1 pixels are 100×150 µm², 285 µm thick, with 52×80 pixels per readout chip. Monolithic active pixel sensors (MAPS) put the charge-collecting layer and front-end circuit in the same wafer; ALICE ITS2's ALPIDE uses a 180 nm CMOS imaging process with pixels of about 29×27 µm² thinned to 50 µm, eliminating bumps and a second silicon layer, at the cost of collecting charge mainly from an epitaxial layer tens of micrometres thick and having lower radiation tolerance and timing performance than hybrids. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor, bump bonds and readout chip”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Hadrons and energetic particles cause displacement damage in the silicon lattice, quantified by the 1 MeV neutron-equivalent fluence Φ_eq, creating mid-gap defect levels with three consequences: leakage current rises linearly as ΔI = α·Φ_eq·V; effective doping changes, inverting n-type bulk and steadily raising the depletion voltage; and carriers are trapped, reducing collected charge. Leakage follows T²·exp(−E_eff/(2k_B·T)) and roughly halves for every 7 K of cooling, so inner pixel layers must run at −10 to −20 °C; because the leakage current itself heats the sensor, insufficient cooling leads to thermal runaway. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor leakage current and cooling loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

If each particle fires only one pixel, the position error is uniformly distributed across the pitch and the resolution is p/√12; when charge is shared between two pixels through Lorentz drift, inclined incidence or diffusion, interpolating with analogue charge (ADC or ToT) by centre of gravity or an eta correction improves on binary readout by about a factor of three. Good sharing requires low threshold and low noise, otherwise the small signal in the edge pixel is cut and the cluster collapses to a single pixel. Verifying resolution needs a reference more precise than the device under test, which is a beam telescope built from several thin MAPS planes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Charge-sharing cluster and beam telescope”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every layer's silicon, readout chips, cooling pipes, carbon-fibre supports and cables cause multiple Coulomb scattering, with an angular width that by the Highland formula scales as √(x/X₀) and inversely with momentum. For low-momentum particles the impact-parameter and vertex resolution is usually set by material rather than by pixel resolution, so inner-layer design becomes a contest to cut X/X₀ and shrink the first-layer radius; only at high momentum does the geometric term, set by hit resolution and the lever arm between layers, dominate again. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Per-layer material and beam pipe”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Inner-layer hit rates rise roughly as 1/r² with radius, reaching hundreds of MHz per square centimetre at high luminosity. Triggered readout must hold every hit until the first-level trigger decision arrives, about 4 µs at CMS; the readout chip buffers timestamps and charge per double column and loses new hits once the buffer is full, and triggered events then leave over serial links whose bandwidth sets the sustainable trigger rate. System inefficiency therefore comes not only from the sensor but also from dead time and buffer overflow in the digital architecture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Double-column buffers and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After installation module positions are known only to tens of micrometres, far worse than the roughly 10 µm hit resolution, so the final geometry is determined from many tracks: each module's three translations and three rotations become parameters minimised together with track parameters in a residual χ², for example in a Millepede-II global fit. Certain global deformations such as twist, telescope and bowing leave every track well fitted yet bias momentum systematically; these weak modes are broken only with cosmic rays, beam-halo tracks or Z→μμ mass constraints. The commissioning handoff must include the geometry version, Lorentz angle, thresholds and masked-pixel tables, and alignment validation plots. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Track residuals and alignment parameters”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把平均值 30,500 e⁻ 當成設計值，門檻與增益看似留有大量餘裕；實際上落在 MPV 附近或更低的事件（斜入射把電荷分給相鄰像素、照射後電荷收集下降）會有一部分掉到門檻以下，命中效率從 99% 以上滑落，軌跡出現缺點，低動量軌跡的重建效率下降。
照射後電荷收集下降，邊緣像素的分享電荷跌到門檻以下，叢集變小，解析度從約 10 µm 退回接近二元值；若重建仍用照射前的 η 修正表，誤差還會帶有隨入射角變化的系統偏移。
pitfallsEn: Designing on the 30,500 e⁻ mean makes threshold and gain look comfortably margined; in reality events near or below the MPV, such as inclined tracks sharing charge with neighbours or irradiated sensors collecting less, partly fall below threshold, hit efficiency slips from above 99%, tracks acquire missing hits and low-momentum reconstruction efficiency drops.

After irradiation, reduced charge collection pushes the shared charge in edge pixels below threshold, clusters shrink and resolution degrades from about 10 µm towards the binary value; if reconstruction still uses the pre-irradiation eta-correction tables, the error also carries an angle-dependent systematic offset.

guides.concept: 以 CERN ALICE 的 90 m³ 時間投影室為範本：從 400 V/cm 下的電子漂移與擴散，到四層 GEM 讀出的增益與離子回流，再把雷射、氪校正、空間電荷畸變圖與 524,160 通道的連續讀出整合成可交接的偵測器效能紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using the 90 m³ ALICE TPC at CERN as the template: from electron drift and diffusion at 400 V/cm, through gain and ion back-flow of four-GEM readout, to laser and krypton calibration, space-charge distortion maps and continuous readout of 524,160 channels, integrated into a transferable detector performance record.
procedure: 帶電粒子穿過氣體時沿軌跡產生初級游離電子團。ALICE TPC 把中央電極保持在 −100 kV，兩端的讀出平面接近地電位，形成 400 V/cm 的軸向電場，電子以 2.58 cm/µs 的速度向端板漂移；墊片的二維位置給出 x、y，到達時間乘以漂移速度給出 z，三維軌跡因此由「把時間投影成空間」重建。Ne-CO₂-N₂（90-10-5）混合氣兼顧低原子序（多重散射小）、足夠的初級游離密度與較低的離子回流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「中央電極與漂移體積」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

漂移中的電子不斷與氣體分子碰撞，電子雲以隨機走動方式散開，橫向與縱向寬度都隨漂移時間按 √(2Dt) 成長，工程上常寫成 σ = D'·√L，D' 的單位是 µm/√cm。ALICE 的 0.5 T 螺線管磁場讓電子在兩次碰撞之間繞磁力線迴旋，橫向擴散按 1/√(1+ω²τ²) 縮小，縱向擴散則不受影響。擴散決定電子團抵達讀出面時的尺寸，再除以電子數的平方根才是重心定位的統計極限。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「擴散與磁場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

場籠用鍍鋁 Mylar 條帶環繞漂移體積，由電阻鏈把 −100 kV 逐級分壓，讓每一條帶的電位落在理想的線性分佈上，電場才能在 2.5 m 的全長保持均勻；靠近讀出面另有裙狀電極修正端部場。氣體系統以閉迴路循環並連續純化，氧與水必須壓在 ppm 等級，否則電子被電負性分子吸附而消失，而且漂移速度會隨 E/N、溫度與壓力改變。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「場籠與電阻鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

讀出室把漂移來的電子送進 50 µm 厚、佈滿 70 µm 微孔的 GEM 箔，孔內數十 kV/cm 的場讓電子雪崩倍增。ALICE 在 Run 3 把每個讀出室做成四層 GEM 疊（標準孔距與大孔距交替），總增益約 2000，同時把離子回流壓到 1% 以下，取代了需要閘極柵而產生死時間的多絲正比室，才能在 50 kHz 的鉛鉛碰撞率下連續讀出。雪崩的統計漲落與第一層 GEM 的電子收集效率共同決定能量解析度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四層 GEM 讀出室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

要把到達時間換成 z，必須隨時掌握漂移速度；ALICE 用 266 nm 脈衝雷射經鏡組在腔內產生 336 條直線軌跡，並以獨立的漂移速度監測器追蹤氣體狀態。高碰撞率下回流的離子以約 1.6 cm/ms 緩慢漂移，在腔內累積成空間電荷，其徑向電場把漂移電子推離真實位置；畸變與離子密度成正比，必須用軌跡殘差或電流讀出建立隨時間更新的畸變圖加以修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「雷射校正與畸變圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

TPC 的第二項任務是用沿軌跡的能損 dE/dx 鑑別粒子：每一列墊片各量一次叢集電荷，152 列以截斷平均合併以壓制 Landau 分佈的長尾，再與 Bethe–Bloch 曲線比對。前提是每一塊墊片的增益都已知：ALICE 把放射性 ⁸³ᵐKr 注入氣體，其 41.6 keV 的衰變在整個腔內均勻發生，每塊墊片上的峰值位置就是該墊片的增益刻度。dE/dx 解析度由樣本數、樣本長度、增益校正品質與擴散共同決定。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「氪增益圖與 dE/dx」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。524,160 個通道把數位化波形經光纖連續送出，沒有觸發也沒有死時間，再由 FPGA 讀出卡扣除共模雜訊並做零抑制，才把資料率壓到可儲存的範圍。前端的雜訊、基線穩定度與通道間串音直接決定叢集電荷與位置的品質。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「試運轉與校正資料庫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A charged particle crossing the gas leaves clusters of primary ionisation along its path. The ALICE TPC holds its central electrode at −100 kV with the two end-plate readout planes near ground, creating a 400 V/cm axial field along which electrons drift at 2.58 cm/µs; the two-dimensional pad position gives x and y, and arrival time multiplied by drift velocity gives z, so the three-dimensional track is reconstructed by projecting time into space. The Ne-CO₂-N₂ (90-10-5) mixture balances low atomic number for little multiple scattering, adequate primary ionisation density and low ion back-flow. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Central electrode and drift volume”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A drifting electron collides continuously with gas molecules, so the electron cloud spreads as a random walk whose transverse and longitudinal widths grow as √(2Dt), usually written σ = D'·√L with D' in µm/√cm. The 0.5 T solenoid field of ALICE makes electrons gyrate between collisions, shrinking transverse diffusion by 1/√(1+ω²τ²) while leaving longitudinal diffusion unchanged. Diffusion fixes the size of the cloud reaching the pad plane, and dividing that width by the square root of the electron count gives the statistical limit of centroid positioning. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Diffusion and magnetic field”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The field cage surrounds the drift volume with aluminised Mylar strips whose potentials are set by a resistor chain dividing the −100 kV step by step, so that every strip sits on the ideal linear potential and the field stays uniform over the 2.5 m drift; skirt electrodes near the readout plane correct the end field. The gas system runs as a closed, continuously purified loop with oxygen and water held at ppm level, because electrons attach to electronegative molecules and vanish, and drift velocity shifts with E/N, temperature and pressure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Field cage and resistor chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The readout chambers feed drifted electrons into 50 µm thick GEM foils pierced with 70 µm holes, where fields of tens of kV/cm drive avalanche multiplication. For Run 3 ALICE built each chamber as a four-GEM stack alternating standard and large-pitch foils, giving a total gain of about 2000 while holding ion back-flow below 1%; this replaced the multiwire chambers whose gating grid created dead time, and allows continuous readout at the 50 kHz Pb–Pb collision rate. Avalanche statistics together with electron collection efficiency in the first GEM set the energy resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Four-GEM readout chambers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Converting arrival time into z needs the drift velocity at all times; ALICE fires a pulsed 266 nm laser through mirror bundles to create 336 straight tracks inside the volume and follows gas condition with a separate drift-velocity monitor. At high rate the back-flowing ions drift slowly at about 1.6 cm/ms and accumulate as space charge whose radial field pushes drifting electrons off their true positions; the distortion scales with ion density and must be corrected with time-dependent maps built from track residuals or current readout. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laser calibration and distortion maps”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The second job of a TPC is particle identification from energy loss along the track: each pad row measures one cluster charge, the 152 rows are combined as a truncated mean to suppress the Landau tail, and the result is compared with Bethe–Bloch curves. This requires the gain of every pad to be known: ALICE injects radioactive ⁸³ᵐKr into the gas, its 41.6 keV decays occur uniformly throughout the volume, and the peak position on each pad is that pad's gain scale. The dE/dx resolution then depends on sample count, sample length, gain-calibration quality and diffusion. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Krypton gain map and dE/dx”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The 524,160 channels stream digitised waveforms continuously over optical links, with no trigger and no dead time, and FPGA readout cards subtract common-mode noise and apply zero suppression to bring the data rate into a storable range. Front-end noise, baseline stability and channel-to-channel cross-talk directly set cluster-charge and position quality. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SAMPA front end and readout chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database. The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Commissioning and calibration database”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若假設的漂移速度錯 1%，全長漂移的 z 座標偏 2.5 cm，TPC 兩半的軌跡在中央電極處無法對接，頂點與動量重建都失真。
若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。
pitfallsEn: A 1% error in the assumed drift velocity displaces full-drift z by 2.5 cm, so tracks from the two TPC halves fail to match at the central electrode and both vertex and momentum reconstruction degrade.

If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：低雜訊偵測器讀出
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Low-noise detector readout
guides.concept: 以矽微條與 HPGe 前端為例，從 Ramo 定理與電荷靈敏積分出發，推導 ENC 的串聯、並聯與 1/f 項如何隨電容與整形時間變化，再把脈衝校正、能量解析度分解、ASIC 數位化與門檻佔用率整合成可交接的讀出系統驗證紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using silicon-strip and HPGe front ends as examples, start from Ramo's theorem and charge-sensitive integration, derive how the series, parallel and 1/f terms of ENC scale with capacitance and shaping time, then integrate pulse calibration, resolution decomposition, ASIC digitisation and threshold occupancy into a transferable readout-validation record.
procedure: 偵測器送出的不是「到達電極的電荷」而是感應電流：依 Shockley–Ramo 定理，以速度 v 運動的電荷 q 在電極上感應的電流為 i = q·v·E_w，E_w 是把該電極設為 1 V、其餘接地時的加權場；電流對時間積分才等於訊號電荷。矽中一個最小游離粒子每微米約產生 80 個電子電洞對，300 µm 厚的感測器給出約 2.4×10⁴ 個電子，只有 3.8 fC。電荷靈敏前置放大器把這些電荷積分到回授電容 C_f 上，輸出 Q/C_f 與偵測器電容無關，前提是開迴路增益夠大。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器電荷與回授電容」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

把所有雜訊折算到輸入端，以等效雜訊電荷 ENC 表示：串聯（電壓）雜訊來自輸入電晶體的通道熱雜訊 e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m，經輸入總電容 C 轉成電荷，隨整形時間 τ 縮短而增大；並聯（電流）雜訊來自漏電流的散粒雜訊 2qI 與回授電阻的熱雜訊 4kT/R_f，隨 τ 加長而增大；1/f 雜訊與 τ 無關，只隨 C² 成長。ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C²，F 為整形器的形狀因子，CR-RC 整形的 F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC 公式與整形時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

串聯雜訊由輸入電晶體的跨導與閘極電容決定：JFET 在室溫到 120 K 之間 g_m 高、1/f 雜訊低，是 HPGe 與 Si(Li) 光譜儀的傳統選擇；深次微米 CMOS 讓每通道功耗降到毫瓦等級，適合數十萬通道的 ASIC。閘極電容會加進總電容 C，若 g_m ∝ √C_gs（強反轉、固定電流密度），最佳條件是 C_gs ≈ C_d，這就是電容匹配法則。回授元件必須極低漏電與低介電吸收：C_f 用 NP0/C0G 或晶片上的金屬電容，放電路徑用 GΩ 級電阻、脈衝重置或連續的電晶體回授。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸入電晶體與回授網路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

從偵測器到前置放大器輸入之間的每一 pF 雜散電容都直接加進串聯雜訊：打線、保護二極體、偏壓耦合電容與 PCB 走線都要計入。偏壓透過大電阻與 AC 耦合電容送到感測器，耦合電容必須承受全偏壓且漏電極低；接地採單點或星形，讓偵測器回流電流與數位地分開，否則切換式電源與時脈的 100 kHz–10 MHz 干擾正好落在整形器通帶內。低雜訊讀出有一半是機械與佈局工程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓網路、接地與佈局」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

校正從精密脈衝注入開始：階躍電壓 ΔV 經注入電容 C_inj 產生 Q = C_inj·ΔV，掃描 ΔV 得到增益、線性度與動態範圍；脈衝器峰的寬度只含電子雜訊，是分離雜訊來源的工具。對能譜儀而言，實測峰寬是三項的平方和：電子雜訊 FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε（ε 為每對電子電洞對的能量）、統計項 FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε)（F 為 Fano 因子）、以及電荷收集不完整項；把三項分開，才知道該改前端、偵測器還是整形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「脈衝注入與 HPGe 能譜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

串聯項與並聯項相等之處就是雜訊轉角，對應最佳整形時間 τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i)；轉角隨電容、漏電流與溫度移動，所以最佳 τ 不是固定值。整形時間同時決定計數率能力：一個脈衝佔用約數倍 τ，計數率 n 下的堆積機率約為 1 − exp(−n·T_p)，因此高計數率應用常犧牲 ENC 選較短的 τ，或改用梯形數位整形把雜訊濾波與彈道虧損分開處理。完整的雜訊預算要把串聯、並聯、1/f、量化與干擾各項列表後平方相加。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ENC–τ 曲線與雜訊轉角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

現代系統把前置放大、整形、ADC 與序列化放進同一顆 ASIC：ALICE TPC 的 524,160 個墊片各有一條 SAMPA 通道，CAEN FERS-5200 一類的讀出平台則把 Citiroc 或 picoTDC 前端做成 64–128 通道的卡，經光纖集中。數位化後常以梯形濾波取代類比整形，並做基線追蹤與共模扣除；ADC 的量化雜訊 LSB/√12 必須遠小於類比 ENC，動態範圍則由滿刻度電荷與 ENC 之比決定，通常以位元數換取功耗。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ADC、數位濾波與資料鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統層級的驗證是在完整安裝、接地與冷卻條件下重做雜訊量測，因為 ENC 在實驗室與實驗大廳常差一倍；接著用雜訊佔用率決定門檻：高斯雜訊超過門檻 k·ENC 的機率為 ½·erfc(k/√2)，乘上取樣率與通道數就是假訊號率，必須與效率要求折衷。交接文件必須含每通道的增益、ENC、門檻與遮蔽清單、溫度係數、注入電容常數與長期穩定度紀錄，讓後續校正可以追溯。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「門檻佔用率與驗收報告」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A detector does not deliver charge arriving at the electrode but an induced current: by the Shockley–Ramo theorem a charge q moving with velocity v induces i = q·v·E_w on an electrode, where E_w is the weighting field obtained by setting that electrode to 1 V and all others to ground; only the time integral of this current equals the signal charge. A minimum-ionising particle creates about 80 electron–hole pairs per micrometre of silicon, so a 300 µm sensor yields about 2.4×10⁴ electrons, only 3.8 fC. A charge-sensitive preamplifier integrates this charge onto its feedback capacitor C_f, giving an output Q/C_f that is independent of detector capacitance provided the open-loop gain is large enough. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor charge and feedback capacitor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

All noise is referred to the input as an equivalent noise charge (ENC): series (voltage) noise comes from the channel thermal noise of the input transistor, e_n² = 4kT·Γ/g_m, converted to charge through the total input capacitance C and growing as the shaping time τ shortens; parallel (current) noise comes from leakage-current shot noise 2qI and feedback-resistor thermal noise 4kT/R_f and grows as τ lengthens; 1/f noise is independent of τ and scales only with C². ENC² = F_v·e_n²·C²/τ + F_i·i_n²·τ + F_vf·A_f·C², where the F factors depend on the shaper, with F_v = F_i ≈ 0.92 for CR-RC shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC relation and shaping time”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Series noise is set by the transconductance and gate capacitance of the input transistor: a JFET between room temperature and 120 K offers high g_m and low 1/f noise and remains the traditional choice for HPGe and Si(Li) spectrometers, while deep-submicron CMOS brings per-channel power down to milliwatts for ASICs with hundreds of thousands of channels. The gate capacitance adds to the total C, and if g_m ∝ √C_gs (strong inversion at fixed current density) the optimum is C_gs ≈ C_d, the capacitive-matching rule. Feedback elements must have extremely low leakage and dielectric absorption: C_f is an NP0/C0G or on-chip metal capacitor, and discharge uses a GΩ-class resistor, pulsed reset or continuous transistor feedback. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Input transistor and feedback network”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Every picofarad of stray capacitance between detector and preamplifier input adds directly to series noise: bond wires, protection diodes, bias-coupling capacitors and PCB traces all count. Bias reaches the sensor through a large resistor and an AC-coupling capacitor that must hold the full bias with negligible leakage; grounding must be single-point or star so that detector return currents stay separate from the digital ground, otherwise switching-regulator and clock interference at 100 kHz–10 MHz lands exactly inside the shaper passband. Half of low-noise readout is mechanical and layout engineering. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias network, grounding and layout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Calibration starts with precise pulse injection: a voltage step ΔV through an injection capacitor C_inj creates Q = C_inj·ΔV, and sweeping ΔV yields gain, linearity and dynamic range; the pulser peak width contains only electronic noise, which makes it the tool for separating noise sources. For a spectrometer the measured peak width is the quadrature sum of three terms: electronic noise FWHM_e = 2.355·ENC·ε (ε the energy per electron–hole pair), the statistical term FWHM_F = 2.355·√(F·E·ε) (F the Fano factor), and incomplete charge collection; only when the three are separated do you know whether to improve the front end, the detector or the shaping. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pulse injection and HPGe spectrum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The noise corner is where the series and parallel terms are equal, corresponding to the optimum shaping time τ_opt = (C·e_n/i_n)·√(F_v/F_i); the corner moves with capacitance, leakage and temperature, so the optimum τ is not a fixed number. Shaping time also sets rate capability: a pulse occupies several τ, and at count rate n the pile-up probability is about 1 − exp(−n·T_p), so high-rate applications often sacrifice ENC for shorter τ or use trapezoidal digital shaping that separates noise filtering from ballistic deficit. A complete noise budget tabulates series, parallel, 1/f, quantisation and interference terms and adds them in quadrature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ENC–τ curve and noise corner”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Modern systems put preamplifier, shaper, ADC and serialiser on one ASIC: each of the 524,160 pads of the ALICE TPC has its own SAMPA channel, and readout platforms such as CAEN FERS-5200 integrate Citiroc or picoTDC front ends on 64–128-channel cards concentrated over optical links. After digitisation a trapezoidal filter often replaces analogue shaping, with baseline tracking and common-mode subtraction; the ADC quantisation noise LSB/√12 must stay well below the analogue ENC, and the dynamic range is the ratio of full-scale charge to ENC, usually traded against power through the bit count. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ADC, digital filtering and data links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System-level validation repeats the noise measurements with the full installation, grounding and cooling in place, because ENC in the lab and in the experimental hall often differ by a factor of two; the threshold is then set from noise occupancy: the probability that Gaussian noise exceeds a threshold k·ENC is ½·erfc(k/√2), and multiplied by sampling rate and channel count it gives the fake-hit rate, which must be traded against efficiency. The handoff record must include per-channel gain, ENC, threshold and masking list, temperature coefficients, injection-capacitor constants and long-term stability logs so that later calibrations remain traceable. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Threshold occupancy and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 開迴路增益不足或回授電容選得太大時，增益開始隨偵測器電容變化，電容不同的通道增益不一致，整個系統的能量刻度跟著溫度與偏壓漂移。
注入電容的實際值與標稱差 5% 時，所有通道的能量刻度一起偏 5%，而且線性度檢查看不出來；脈衝器上升時間若比電荷收集慢，校正出的增益會低估彈道虧損。
pitfallsEn: With insufficient open-loop gain or an oversized feedback capacitor the gain starts to depend on detector capacitance, channels with different capacitance disagree, and the system energy scale drifts with temperature and bias.

If the injection capacitor differs from nominal by 5%, every channel's energy scale is off by 5% in a way linearity checks cannot reveal; if the pulser rise time is slower than charge collection, the calibrated gain underestimates ballistic deficit.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文自適應光學
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Astronomical adaptive optics
guides.concept: 以 ESO VLT 自適應光學設施（1170 致動器的變形副鏡）與 ELT 的 2.4 m、5000 餘致動器 M4 為範本：從 r0、Greenwood 頻率與等暈角推出變形鏡與波前感測器的規格，再把擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊與非共光路像差整合成 Strehl 預算，最後以即時控制迴路與天上驗證完成工程交接。
guides.conceptEn: Using the ESO VLT Adaptive Optics Facility with its 1170-actuator deformable secondary and the 2.4 m, 5000-plus-actuator M4 of the ELT as templates: derive deformable-mirror and wavefront-sensor specifications from r0, the Greenwood frequency and the isoplanatic angle, assemble fitting, temporal, measurement and non-common-path terms into a Strehl budget, and close with real-time control dynamics and on-sky validation for engineering handoff.
procedure: 大氣折射率的隨機起伏由溫度微差造成，其結構遵循 Kolmogorov 統計，強度以 C_n²(h) 剖面描述。沿視線積分後得到 Fried 參數 r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5)，它是波前相位變異量達到 1 rad² 的孔徑直徑：直徑大於 r0 的望遠鏡，長曝光影像不再隨口徑變銳，而被視寧度 FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0 限制。因為 k = 2π/λ，r0 ∝ λ^(6/5)，所以同一片大氣在紅外線顯得平靜得多，這是近紅外成為自適應光學主戰場的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大氣湍流與 Fried 參數」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

湍流層被風以速度 v 吹過孔徑，相位圖樣以 Taylor 凍結流假設平移，波前的特徵頻率是 Greenwood 頻率 f_G = 0.427·v/r0；若控制迴路的 −3 dB 頻寬是 f_3dB，殘餘的時間誤差為 σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3)。另一個限制是角度：相隔 θ 的兩條視線穿過不同的湍流，殘差 σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3)，等暈角 θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ 由湍流的加權平均高度 h̄ 決定。這兩個量分別規定了波前感測器的幀率與參考星必須離目標多近，也直接引出雷射導星與多共軛 AO 的需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Greenwood 頻率與等暈角」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

變形鏡以一片薄殼承載連續反射面，由音圈致動器以電容感測閉迴路定位：VLT 的變形副鏡在約 1.1 m 的薄殼上有 1170 個致動器，ELT 的 M4 則是 2.4 m 平面鏡、六片 1.95 mm 厚的玻璃陶瓷薄殼、5000 餘個音圈致動器，每秒更新 1000 次、行程 ±50 µm。致動器投影到主鏡的間距 d 決定可校正的最高空間頻率，殘餘的擬合誤差 σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3)；致動器總數因此按 (D/d)² 隨口徑平方成長，行程則必須涵蓋湍流的峰谷值加上望遠鏡自身的像差與風擾。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「變形副鏡與 ELT M4」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Shack–Hartmann 感測器用微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個子孔徑的光點位移正比於該處的波前斜率；金字塔感測器則在焦點放一個四面稜鏡，以四個瞳影像的強度差量斜率，對小像差的靈敏度更高。光點位置的量測受光子雜訊限制，每個子孔徑每幀只有數十到數百個光子，所以必須用讀出雜訊低於 1 e⁻ 的 EMCCD 或專用低雜訊紅外偵測器（ELT 的 LISA 由 ESO 與 Teledyne 共同開發）。感測波長的相位誤差換算到科學波段要乘 (λ_s/λ_sci)²。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 與波前感測相機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

控制器需要知道每個致動器動作時感測器看到什麼：逐一（或以 Hadamard 圖樣）推拉致動器，記錄斜率向量，組成交互矩陣 D；以奇異值分解取偽逆得到控制矩陣，並截去奇異值過小、雜訊放大過大的模態。感測器與科學相機之間的光路不同，科學焦點上存在感測器看不見的非共光路像差（NCPA），必須用相位分集或 PSF 最佳化在科學相機上量出，再轉成感測器的參考斜率偏置。模態基底（Karhunen–Loève）讓每個模態可以有不同的增益。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交互矩陣與非共光路校正」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AO 的效能用 Strehl 比衡量：在小像差下 S ≈ exp(−σ²)，σ² 是所有殘餘相位變異的總和（以 rad² 計），各項彼此獨立時直接相加。主要項目是擬合、時間延遲、量測雜訊、混疊（感測器對高頻的錯誤取樣，約為擬合項的三成）、非等暈、NCPA 與色散；影像抖動（tip-tilt 與振動）不屬於小像差，另以 S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²] 的因子乘上。預算表讓工程師知道哪一項值得花錢，也決定哪種視寧度下系統值得開迴路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Strehl 預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

即時控制器每幀讀取相機、算出斜率、以控制矩陣做一次矩陣向量乘法得到致動器指令，再加上積分器；整個路徑的延遲包含曝光、讀出、計算與致動器響應。積分控制的開迴路交越頻率約為 g·f_s/(2π)，但純延遲 τ_d 在交越頻率處造成 360°·f·τ_d 的相位落後，疊加積分器的 90°，相位裕度隨增益上升而消失，所以迴路頻寬受延遲而非運算能力限制。ESO 的 SPARTA 平台與 ELT 的即時控制在 500–1000 Hz 下運作，ELT 的 M4 指令每秒 1000 次。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「即時控制器與迴路延遲」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統在天上的驗證包含：對不同星等與離軸角的參考星閉迴路，量 Strehl、FWHM 與包圍能量；同步記錄感測器與變形鏡遙測，重建殘餘相位的功率譜並反推 PSF；在一系列視寧度與相干時間下建立效能對台址條件的統計。交接文件必須給出操作限制（例如 τ0 下限、視寧度上限、星等範圍）、校正檔的版本（交互矩陣、NCPA 偏置、參考斜率）、振動與延遲的量測值，以及每次重新校正的觸發條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天上驗證與遙測紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Random refractive-index fluctuations of the air arise from small temperature differences and follow Kolmogorov statistics, with strength described by the C_n²(h) profile. Integrating along the line of sight gives the Fried parameter r0 = [0.423·k²·secζ·∫C_n²(h)dh]^(−3/5), the aperture diameter over which the wavefront phase variance reaches 1 rad²: a telescope larger than r0 gains no further sharpness in long exposures and is limited by the seeing FWHM ≈ 0.98λ/r0. Because k = 2π/λ, r0 ∝ λ^(6/5), so the same atmosphere looks far calmer in the infrared, which is why the near-infrared is the main arena of adaptive optics. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Atmospheric turbulence and the Fried parameter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Turbulent layers are carried across the aperture by wind at speed v, and under Taylor's frozen-flow hypothesis the phase pattern translates, giving the wavefront a characteristic Greenwood frequency f_G = 0.427·v/r0; with a control −3 dB bandwidth f_3dB, the residual temporal error is σ_t² = (f_G/f_3dB)^(5/3). The other limit is angular: two lines of sight separated by θ cross different turbulence, leaving σ_a² = (θ/θ0)^(5/3) with the isoplanatic angle θ0 = 0.314·r0/h̄ set by the turbulence-weighted mean height h̄. These two quantities fix the wavefront-sensor frame rate and how close the reference star must be, and lead directly to laser guide stars and multi-conjugate AO. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Greenwood frequency and isoplanatic angle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A deformable mirror carries a continuous reflective facesheet on a thin shell positioned in closed loop by voice-coil actuators with capacitive sensing: the VLT deformable secondary has 1170 actuators behind a shell of about 1.1 m, while the ELT M4 is a 2.4 m flat built from six 1.95 mm glass-ceramic shells with more than 5000 voice coils, updated 1000 times per second with ±50 µm of stroke. The actuator pitch d projected onto the primary sets the highest correctable spatial frequency, leaving a fitting error σ_fit² ≈ 0.28·(d/r0)^(5/3); the actuator count therefore grows as (D/d)², with the square of aperture, and the stroke must cover the turbulence peak-to-valley plus telescope aberrations and wind shake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Deformable secondary and ELT M4”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A Shack–Hartmann sensor divides the pupil into subapertures with a lenslet array, and the spot displacement in each subaperture is proportional to the local wavefront slope; a pyramid sensor instead places a four-sided prism at the focus and measures slopes from intensity differences between four pupil images, with higher sensitivity to small aberrations. Spot positioning is photon-noise limited, with only tens to hundreds of photons per subaperture per frame, so EMCCDs with sub-electron read noise or dedicated low-noise infrared detectors (the ELT's LISA was co-developed by ESO and Teledyne) are required. Phase error at the sensing wavelength scales to the science band by (λ_s/λ_sci)². Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Shack–Hartmann and wavefront-sensing camera”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The controller must know what the sensor sees when each actuator moves: push–pull each actuator (or Hadamard patterns), record the slope vector and assemble the interaction matrix D; a singular-value decomposition gives the pseudo-inverse control matrix after truncating modes whose small singular values would amplify noise. Because the optical paths to the sensor and to the science camera differ, non-common-path aberrations (NCPA) invisible to the sensor exist at the science focus; they are measured on the science camera by phase diversity or PSF optimisation and converted into reference-slope offsets for the sensor. A modal basis (Karhunen–Loève) allows each mode its own gain. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Interaction matrix and non-common-path calibration”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

AO performance is judged by the Strehl ratio: for small aberrations S ≈ exp(−σ²), where σ² is the sum of all residual phase variances in rad², added directly when the terms are independent. The main terms are fitting, temporal delay, measurement noise, aliasing (the sensor mis-sampling high frequencies, roughly 30% of the fitting term), anisoplanatism, NCPA and chromatic effects; image jitter from tip-tilt and vibration is not a small aberration and is applied as a separate factor S_j = 1/[1 + (π²/2)(σ_j/(λ/D))²]. The budget table tells the engineer which term is worth money and under what seeing the loop is worth closing. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Strehl budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each frame the real-time controller reads the camera, computes slopes, performs one matrix-vector multiply with the control matrix to obtain actuator commands and applies an integrator; the end-to-end latency includes exposure, readout, computation and actuator response. For integral control the open-loop crossover is about g·f_s/(2π), but a pure delay τ_d adds a phase lag of 360°·f·τ_d at crossover on top of the integrator's 90°, so phase margin vanishes as gain rises and loop bandwidth is limited by latency rather than computing power. ESO's SPARTA platform and the ELT real-time control run at 500–1000 Hz, with M4 commands issued 1000 times per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Real-time controller and loop latency”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On-sky validation closes the loop on reference stars of different magnitudes and off-axis angles, measuring Strehl, FWHM and encircled energy; sensor and deformable-mirror telemetry are recorded synchronously to reconstruct the residual-phase power spectrum and infer the PSF; performance statistics are built against site conditions across a range of seeing and coherence time. The handoff record must state operating limits (such as a τ0 floor, a seeing ceiling and the magnitude range), the versions of calibration files (interaction matrix, NCPA offsets, reference slopes), the measured vibration and latency, and the conditions that trigger recalibration. pitfalls: 把 r0 當成與波長無關的常數，用可見光的 r0 去設計紅外 AO，會把致動器數與迴路頻率高估數倍；反之用紅外的 r0 設計可見光感測器，則子孔徑太大而讓波前量測失效。
交互矩陣在望遠鏡水平位置量測，而觀測時重力改變了感測器與變形鏡的對位（註冊誤差），矩陣中的致動器與子孔徑錯位半格，迴路雖然收斂卻把能量推到錯誤的模態，Strehl 比預算低且隨高度角變化。
pitfallsEn: Treating r0 as wavelength-independent and designing an infrared AO system with the visible r0 overestimates actuator count and loop rate by several times; using the infrared r0 for a visible-light sensor instead makes the subapertures too large and the wavefront measurement fails.

An interaction matrix measured with the telescope horizontal no longer matches when gravity shifts the registration between sensor and deformable mirror during observation; actuators and subapertures are misaligned by half a cell, the loop converges but pushes energy into wrong modes, and the Strehl falls below budget and varies with elevation.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Active support of telescope primary mirrors
guides.concept: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.
procedure: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「彎曲模態與修正力分佈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「150 支軸向致動器與荷重元」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。溫度則有兩種效應：穿過厚度的溫度梯度使鏡面整體彎曲，主要表現為離焦；Zerodur 熱膨脹係數的不均勻則在整體溫變下產生高階變形。此外鏡面比夜間空氣暖時會在表面形成湍流邊界層，所以白天要把鏡子預冷到預期的夜間溫度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「側向支撐與鏡室熱環境」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。因為要量的是鏡面而不是大氣，曝光必須長到把湍流造成的光點隨機抖動平均掉，VLT 以約 30 秒積分、約每分鐘修正一次。量到的斜率再以最小平方法投影到主鏡彎曲模態與副鏡的離焦、彗差，換算成力與位置修正量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。控制器用矩陣的擬反把量到的模態係數轉成力修正，並截斷奇異值太小的模態，以免把雜訊放大。修正後的殘差要進入誤差預算：拋光殘差、支撐印痕、主動光學殘差、熱變形與風載各項以均方根相加，再換算成不同波長的 Strehl 或影像寬度，才能判斷主鏡是否滿足儀器需求。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影響矩陣與誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。主鏡負責像散、三葉形、球差等彎曲模態，副鏡以位置移動修正離焦與彗差，兩者共用同一組感測資料但頻寬不同；VLT 另有最高約 1 Hz 的快速修正，只處理最低階項。查找表的品質決定了換目標後多久才能開始科學曝光。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。運轉後，力圖是主鏡健康最直接的紀錄：每支致動器的力歷史、力總和與重量的一致性、主動力是否逐漸逼近極限，都能提前揭露卡滯、荷重元漂移或支撐墊脫膠。交接文件需包含影響矩陣版本、查找表、各致動器校正係數與安全限值。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「影像品質驗收與力圖監測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight. Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “8.2 m thin meniscus blank”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order. Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bending modes and correction-force patterns”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position. As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “150 axial actuators and load cells”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge; lateral forces that do not act through the plane of the centre of mass create bending moments that press astigmatism into the surface, so lateral-support placement and force sharing must be designed together with axial corrections. Temperature acts in two ways: a gradient through the thickness bends the whole mirror, mainly as defocus, while inhomogeneity of the Zerodur expansion coefficient produces higher-order deformation under uniform temperature change. A mirror warmer than the night air also grows a turbulent boundary layer above its surface, so it is pre-cooled during the day to the expected night temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lateral supports and cell thermal environment”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. Because the target is the mirror and not the atmosphere, exposures must be long enough to average out turbulence-induced spot jitter, so the VLT integrates for about 30 s and corrects roughly once a minute. The measured slopes are projected by least squares onto the primary's bending modes and the secondary's defocus and coma, then converted into force and position corrections. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The controller uses its pseudo-inverse to turn measured mode coefficients into force corrections, truncating modes with small singular values so that noise is not amplified. The corrected residual then enters the error budget: polishing residual, support print-through, active-optics residual, thermal deformation and wind load are added root-sum-square and converted into Strehl or image width at several wavelengths to judge whether the primary meets instrument needs. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Influence matrix and error-budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The primary handles bending modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and spherical aberration, while the secondary corrects defocus and coma by moving, both sharing the same sensor data at different bandwidths; the VLT also runs fast corrections up to about 1 Hz for the lowest-order terms only. Table quality decides how soon after a slew science exposures can start. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. In operation the force map is the most direct record of mirror health: each actuator's force history, the agreement of the force sum with the weight, and whether active forces creep towards their limits all reveal sticking, load-cell drift or debonding pads early. The handoff file must hold the influence-matrix version, look-up tables, per-actuator calibration coefficients and safety limits. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。
若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。
pitfallsEn: Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.

With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：分段鏡共相控制
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Segmented-mirror co-phasing control
guides.concept: 以 Keck 10 m 主鏡的 36 片段鏡、108 支致動器與 168 個邊緣感測器為主軸，並對照 ELT 的 798 片段鏡，理解如何把數十片獨立鏡面維持在同一個波前上：從 piston 誤差與 Strehl、可觀測性、感測器漂移、寬頻與雙波長共相，到控制迴路與段鏡更換後的重新共相。
guides.conceptEn: Built around the Keck 10 m primary with 36 segments, 108 actuators and 168 edge sensors, and compared with the ELT's 798 segments, this course shows how dozens of separate mirrors are held on one wavefront: from piston error and Strehl, observability and sensor drift, to broadband and dual-wavelength phasing, control loops and re-phasing after segment exchange.
procedure: Keck 的 10 m 主鏡由 36 片對角約 1.8 m、厚 75 mm 的六角段鏡拼成，每片都是同一個母非球面上不同離軸位置的切片。只有當所有段鏡的高度（piston）與傾斜誤差遠小於波長時，各段反射的光才會在焦點同相疊加，得到 10 m 口徑的繞射極限；否則每片只像一台 1.8 m 的獨立望遠鏡，能量散進寬度約 λ/d 的段鏡繞射暈。反射使表面高度誤差在波前上加倍，所以共相要求是奈米級的表面精度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「36 片六角段鏡的共相波前」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每片段鏡由三支位置致動器控制 piston、tip 與 tilt，相鄰段鏡共用的每條邊上裝兩個邊緣感測器，量兩片鏡緣的相對高度差。邊緣感測器只量相對值，所以整面鏡的整體 piston、tip、tilt 無法觀測，必須交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距；另有一種讓所有段鏡沿徑向微傾、等效改變主鏡曲率的模態，只靠感測器對兩鏡夾角的微弱靈敏度觀測，雜訊放大最大。感測器只能維持相對位置，絕對的共相零點必須由光學量測給定，而光學相位只在一個波長內唯一，這就是 2π 模糊的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「邊緣感測器與致動器的自由度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Keck 使用電容式邊緣感測器：一片段鏡邊緣裝驅動電極，相鄰段鏡裝感測電極，兩片的相對高度改變重疊面積或間隙，進而改變電容。奈米級解析對應的電容變化只有 aF 等級，所以感測器採差動或比例量測並以鎖相偵測抑制雜訊。真正困難的是長期穩定：支架熱膨脹、空氣濕度改變介電常數與電極污染都會產生看似真實的高度變化，而控制迴路會忠實地把這些漂移變成真實的段鏡移動。ELT 的感測器另外量測段鏡間隙與剪切。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電容式邊緣感測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每片段鏡坐在三支位置致動器上，致動器之上是把重量平均分到鏡背多點的 whiffletree（ELT 為 27 點），以免段鏡在自重下彎曲；另有 warping harness 以小彈簧力修正段鏡本身的低階面形，ELT 每片 9 支。位置致動器同時要有毫米級行程，以吸收鋼構在仰角與溫度變化下的變形，又要有奈米級解析度，通常以粗動加細動的兩級設計達成；它還必須夠剛，否則圓頂內的風壓擾動會直接變成 piston 抖動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「位置致動器、鏡座與 whiffletree」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Keck 的共相相機在瞳面放置跨越段鏡邊界的小圓孔，每個孔同時收集兩片段鏡的光並形成一個繞射影像，兩片之間的 piston 階差會改變干涉圖樣的形狀。單一窄頻波長下，相位只在 λ/2（表面）範圍內唯一，超出就產生 2π 模糊；寬頻光的相干長度短，干涉對比隨階差衰減，可在數十微米範圍內粗略定出零點；雙波長則以合成波長 Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| 擴大唯一範圍。實務上先寬頻捕獲，再窄頻精調。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「共相相機與瞳面次孔徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

共相相機只能在望遠鏡指向亮星時偶爾使用，平時主鏡靠邊緣感測器的設定點維持形狀：先以光學量測把主鏡共相，再記錄當時全部感測器的讀數作為目標值，迴路此後只負責維持這組讀數。因此誤差預算包含感測器雜訊經重建器放大的項、兩次校正之間的感測器漂移、共相相機的量測誤差、致動器解析度與風載擾動；各項以均方根相加後換算成 Strehl，並據此決定校正的頻率。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「感測器設定點與共相誤差預算」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

主鏡主動控制系統以固定頻率讀取全部邊緣感測器，乘上重建矩陣得到每支致動器的修正量；重建器排除三個不可觀測模態並對弱模態加權，整體 piston、tip、tilt 交給望遠鏡指向與副鏡焦距。迴路頻寬要高到能抑制重力與溫度造成的緩慢變形，又要遠低於段鏡支撐的結構共振，以免激發機構。下游自適應光學的 Shack–Hartmann 對段鏡邊界的階差幾乎不敏感，所以不能指望 AO 補救共相誤差，兩個系統的分工必須寫進介面文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主動控制系統與自適應光學介面」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

分段主鏡的鍍膜會老化，必須輪流把段鏡拆下重鍍再裝回；更換後新段鏡的位置只準到數十微米，必須先以寬頻共相捕獲、再以窄頻精調，並重新設定與它相關的所有邊緣感測器零點。驗收要同時看光學量測（共相相機殘差、焦面影像的段鏡繞射暈）與感測器健康（雜訊、漂移、失效感測器的處理），失效的感測器要從重建器移除並重算矩陣。交接文件需列出每片段鏡的序號與位置、感測器設定點版本、重建矩陣版本與更換紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「段鏡更換與影像驗收」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The Keck 10 m primary is tiled from 36 hexagonal segments about 1.8 m across corners and 75 mm thick, each an off-axis piece of the same parent asphere. Only when every segment's height (piston) and tilt errors are far below the wavelength does light from all segments add in phase at focus to give the diffraction limit of a 10 m aperture; otherwise each segment behaves like a separate 1.8 m telescope and energy spreads into a segment-diffraction halo of width about λ/d. Reflection doubles surface height errors in the wavefront, so phasing demands nanometre-level surface accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Co-phased wavefront of 36 hexagonal segments”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each segment has three position actuators for piston, tip and tilt, and every edge shared by neighbouring segments carries two edge sensors that measure the relative height of the two rims. Because edge sensors are relative, global piston, tip and tilt of the whole mirror are unobservable and are handed to telescope pointing and secondary focus; another mode, in which every segment tilts slightly radially to mimic a change of primary curvature, is seen only through the sensors' weak dihedral-angle sensitivity and suffers the largest noise amplification. Sensors only hold relative positions, so the absolute phasing zero must come from an optical measurement, and optical phase is unique only within one wavelength: this is the origin of the 2π ambiguity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Degrees of freedom of sensors and actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Keck uses capacitive edge sensors: a drive electrode on one segment's edge faces a sense electrode on its neighbour, and a change in relative height alters overlap area or gap and hence capacitance. Nanometre resolution corresponds to attofarad changes, so the sensors use differential or ratiometric measurement with lock-in detection to suppress noise. The real difficulty is long-term stability: bracket thermal expansion, humidity-driven changes in air permittivity and electrode contamination all create apparent height changes, and the control loop faithfully converts these drifts into real segment motion. The ELT sensors additionally measure intersegment gap and shear. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Capacitive edge sensor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each segment sits on three position actuators topped by a whiffletree that spreads its weight over many points on the back, 27 for the ELT, so the segment does not bend under self-weight; a warping harness applies small spring forces to correct the segment's own low-order figure, nine per ELT segment. The position actuators need millimetre stroke to absorb steel-structure deformation with elevation and temperature yet nanometre resolution, usually achieved with a coarse-plus-fine two-stage design; they must also be stiff, otherwise wind-pressure fluctuations inside the dome turn directly into piston jitter. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Position actuators, segment cell and whiffletree”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The Keck phasing camera places small circular apertures across intersegment edges in the pupil; each aperture collects light from two segments and forms one diffraction image whose shape changes with the piston step between them. At a single narrowband wavelength the phase is unique only within λ/2 of surface height, beyond which the 2π ambiguity appears; broadband light has a short coherence length, so fringe contrast decays with step size and locates the zero coarsely over tens of micrometres; two wavelengths form a synthetic wavelength Λ = λ₁λ₂/|λ₁ − λ₂| that extends the unique range. In practice segments are captured broadband first and then refined narrowband. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Phasing camera and pupil subapertures”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The phasing camera can be used only occasionally while the telescope points at a bright star, so most of the time the mirror is held by edge-sensor set points: the primary is phased optically, every sensor reading at that moment is recorded as its target, and the loop thereafter only maintains those readings. The error budget therefore contains sensor noise amplified by the reconstructor, sensor drift between calibrations, phasing-camera measurement error, actuator resolution and wind disturbance, added root-sum-square and converted to Strehl to decide how often to recalibrate. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sensor set-points and phasing budget”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The primary's active control system reads all edge sensors at a fixed rate and multiplies them by the reconstruction matrix to get each actuator's correction; the reconstructor excludes the three unobservable modes, weights the weak ones, and hands global piston, tip and tilt to telescope pointing and secondary focus. Loop bandwidth must be high enough to reject slow gravity and thermal deformation yet far below the structural resonances of the segment supports so as not to excite them. A downstream adaptive-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor is nearly blind to steps at segment edges, so AO cannot rescue phasing errors, and the division of labour must be written into the interface document. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Active control system and AO interface”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Segment coatings age, so segments are removed, recoated and reinstalled in rotation; after exchange a new segment is positioned only to tens of micrometres and must be captured broadband, refined narrowband, and have the zero points of every associated edge sensor reset. Acceptance looks at optical measurements, namely phasing-camera residuals and the segment halo in focal-plane images, and at sensor health, namely noise, drift and handling of failed sensors, which must be removed from the reconstructor with the matrix recomputed. The handoff file lists each segment's serial number and position, the set-point version, the reconstructor version and the exchange log. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Segment exchange and image acceptance”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 可見光觀測時段鏡 piston 誤差不易察覺，因為大氣視寧度主導了影像寬度；一旦接上自適應光學在近紅外觀測，影像核心被一圈六角形繞射暈包圍，Strehl 明顯低於預期，而且無論怎麼調 AO 增益都無法改善。
若只用窄頻量測一片剛裝上、piston 誤差 0.5 µm 的段鏡，波前誤差 1.0 µm 被折疊成看似 0.075 µm 的小誤差，控制器修正後段鏡穩定鎖在錯誤的條紋上，相鄰段鏡也被重建器拉偏，整面鏡出現難以診斷的階梯。
pitfallsEn: In seeing-limited visible observing, segment piston errors hide behind atmospheric seeing; once adaptive optics feeds a near-infrared camera, the core sits inside a hexagonal diffraction halo, Strehl falls well short of prediction, and no adjustment of the AO gains helps.

Measuring a newly installed segment with 0.5 µm of piston using narrowband light alone folds its 1.0 µm wavefront error into an apparent 0.075 µm, the controller locks the segment onto the wrong fringe, the reconstructor drags its neighbours off as well, and the mirror develops a hard-to-diagnose staircase.
