guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：超導奈米線單光子偵測器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors
guides.concept: 從偏置在臨界電流附近的 NbN 或 WSi 奈米線出發，說明一個 0.8 eV 的 1550 nm 光子如何讓整個截面失超並送出 mV 級脈衝，再把光學腔吸收、薄膜與奈米微影、L_k/R 重置、可溯源效率校正、暗計數與時間抖動、2.5 K 低溫整合與操作點選擇串成可交接的單光子接收機紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from an NbN or WSi nanowire biased near its critical current, show how one 0.8 eV photon at 1550 nm drives the whole cross-section normal and launches a millivolt pulse, then link optical-cavity absorption, film growth and nanolithography, L_k/R reset, traceable efficiency calibration, dark counts and timing jitter, 2.5 K cryogenic integration and operating-point choice into a transferable single-photon receiver record.
procedure: 超導奈米線通常是厚 5 到 7 nm、寬約 100 nm 的 NbN 或 WSi 曲折線，冷到臨界溫度以下並以直流偏置在臨界電流 Ic 的九成左右。吸收一個光子後，能量打斷庫柏對並產生大量準粒子與聲子，形成局部的抑制超導區；電流被迫繞過這個熱點，旁邊截面的電流密度超過臨界值，整段截面轉為約 kΩ 的電阻態。由於這個電阻遠大於 50 Ω 的讀出負載，偏置電流轉入放大器形成電壓脈衝，熱點冷卻後超導恢復、電流再經動態電感流回奈米線。偏置越靠近 Ic，能量越低的光子也能觸發，但暗計數同時上升。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏置中的 NbN 奈米線與熱點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統偵測效率是三項的乘積：光纖到奈米線的耦合、奈米線對光的吸收，以及吸收後產生脈衝的內部效率。數奈米厚的 NbN 單次通過只吸收約三成，因此把奈米線放在四分之一波長介電間隔層與金屬鏡或分散式布拉格反射鏡形成的光學腔中，讓吸收提高到九成以上。曲折線的填充因子與線方向造成偏振相依：電場平行於線時吸收較強。單模光纖在 1550 nm 的模場直徑約 10.4 µm，主動區必須大於光點並容納對準誤差，這又牽動線長與重置速度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光學腔與吸收堆疊」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NbN 以反應式磁控濺鍍沉積在矽、氧化矽或預先鍍好的反射鏡堆疊上，厚度與氮含量決定 Tc 與每方塊數百歐姆的片電阻；WSi 等非晶材料對基板晶格不敏感、內部效率平台寬，但 Tc 只有數 K，需要 1 K 以下操作。電子束微影與反應式離子蝕刻定義 100 nm 線寬、200 nm 節距的曲折線，轉角做成圓弧以減少電流擁擠。整條線的 Ic 由最窄或最薄的一點決定，單一縮頸就會限制整個偵測器能用的偏置。庫柏對的動能使奈米線具有動態電感，與長寬比成正比。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NbN 濺鍍薄膜與電子束曲折線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

熱點消失後，偏置電流以 I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)) 回流，時間常數 τ = L_k/R_L 由動態電感與讀出負載決定；電流還沒回到接近 I_b 前，偵測效率偏低，因此死時間約為數個 τ。縮短奈米線可降低 L_k 而加快重置，但若電流回流速度快於熱點冷卻，奈米線會被焦耳熱維持在電阻態而閂鎖，必須切斷偏置才能恢復。高計數率時 AC 耦合放大器的基線偏移也會分走偏置電流。交錯式多像素陣列把光分給多條較短的線，同時兼顧速度與耦合面積。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動態電感與 50 Ω 讀出」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

系統偵測效率必須定義在明確的參考面，通常是低溫恆溫器外的光纖接頭。做法是讓 1550 nm 雷射先經校正過的光功率計量測，再串接數個已校正的光纖衰減器把功率降到每秒約十萬個光子，於偏振控制器掃描下記錄計數率，扣除暗計數後除以光子通量。功率計需可溯源到國家計量標準，並在實際使用的功率與波長點驗證線性；衰減器的重複性、接頭插拔與光纖彎曲損失都要列入不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「校正衰減器與功率計」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

暗計數分為本質與外來兩類：本質暗計數來自靠近 Ic 時的磁通渦旋穿越與相位滑移，隨偏置指數上升；外來暗計數主要是室溫黑體輻射沿光纖傳進來的光子與雜散光，可用低溫端的光纖彎繞或濾波器抑制。時間抖動由放大器雜訊除以脈衝斜率、長奈米線上脈衝傳播位置不同造成的幾何抖動、熱點本身的隨機性，以及計時電子學共同決定，以平方和相加。雜訊等效功率 NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η 把效率與暗計數合成一個指標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「暗計數與時間抖動直方圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

NbN 元件通常在 Gifford–McMahon 或脈衝管冷頭的 2.5 K 級操作，WSi 或 MoSi 元件則需要吸附式 He-3 等附加級降到 0.8 K 左右。光纖與同軸線穿過 40 K 與 4 K 級時都要熱錨定，同軸線材質決定熱負載與訊號衰減；偏置透過 bias tee 注入，放大器可放在室溫或低溫級。冷頭以約 1 Hz 振動，若光纖與晶片沒有自對準封裝，振動會調變耦合效率。溫度變化直接改變 Ic，使固定偏置下的 I_b/Ic 漂移，進而改變效率與暗計數；接地迴路與射頻干擾則產生假計數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「2.5 K 閉循環低溫恆溫器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收把前面的模型逐項轉成量測：效率對偏置曲線與平台寬度、暗計數對偏置、操作點的時間抖動直方圖、事件間隔直方圖得到的重置時間、計數率飽和曲線、偏振比、降溫時間與溫度穩定度，以及閂鎖門檻。操作點不是單看最高效率，而是依應用指標選擇：量子金鑰分配看金鑰率與錯誤率，深空光通訊看抖動與脈衝位置調變時槽寬，光達看距離解析度。交接紀錄要列出每個通道的 Ic、偏置、溫度、放大器設定與參考面定義。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收曲線與應用鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: A superconducting nanowire is typically a meander of NbN or WSi 5 to 7 nm thick and about 100 nm wide, cooled below its critical temperature and DC-biased at about 90% of its critical current Ic. An absorbed photon breaks Cooper pairs and creates a cloud of quasiparticles and phonons, forming a local region of suppressed superconductivity; current is forced around this hotspot, the neighbouring cross-section exceeds the critical current density and the whole section turns resistive at about a kilohm. Because that resistance far exceeds the 50 Ω readout load, the bias current diverts into the amplifier as a voltage pulse; the hotspot then cools, superconductivity returns and current flows back into the wire through its kinetic inductance. Biasing closer to Ic lets lower-energy photons trigger but also raises dark counts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Biased NbN nanowire and hotspot”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System detection efficiency is the product of three terms: fibre-to-nanowire coupling, absorption in the nanowire and the internal efficiency of turning an absorption into a pulse. A few-nanometre NbN film absorbs only about 30% in a single pass, so the nanowire sits in an optical cavity formed by a quarter-wave dielectric spacer and a metal mirror or distributed Bragg reflector, raising absorption above 90%. The meander fill factor and wire direction make absorption polarisation-dependent, stronger with the electric field parallel to the wires. Single-mode fibre has a mode-field diameter of about 10.4 µm at 1550 nm, so the active area must exceed the spot and absorb alignment error, which in turn sets wire length and reset speed. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Optical cavity and absorber stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

NbN is grown by reactive magnetron sputtering on silicon, silicon oxide or a pre-deposited mirror stack, and thickness and nitrogen content set Tc and a sheet resistance of several hundred ohms per square; amorphous WSi is insensitive to substrate lattice and has a broad internal-efficiency plateau, but its Tc of a few kelvin requires sub-kelvin operation. Electron-beam lithography and reactive-ion etching define a meander with 100 nm lines on a 200 nm pitch, with rounded bends to reduce current crowding. The whole wire's Ic is set by its narrowest or thinnest point, so a single constriction limits the usable bias of the entire detector. The kinetic energy of Cooper pairs gives the wire a kinetic inductance proportional to its length-to-width ratio. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Sputtered NbN film and e-beam meander”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After the hotspot vanishes the bias current returns as I(t) = I_b(1 − e^(−t/τ)), with τ = L_k/R_L set by kinetic inductance and the readout load; until the current is close to I_b the efficiency is reduced, so the dead time is several τ. Shortening the wire lowers L_k and speeds reset, but if current returns faster than the hotspot cools, Joule heating holds the wire resistive and it latches until the bias is removed. At high count rates the baseline shift of an AC-coupled amplifier also steals bias current. Interleaved multi-pixel arrays share light among several shorter wires to combine speed with coupling area. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Kinetic inductance and 50 Ω readout”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

System detection efficiency must be defined at an explicit reference plane, usually the fibre connector outside the cryostat. A 1550 nm laser is first measured with a calibrated optical power meter, then passed through several calibrated fibre attenuators that reduce it to about one hundred thousand photons per second, and the count rate is recorded while a polarisation controller is scanned; dark counts are subtracted and the result divided by the photon flux. The power meter must be traceable to a national standard and verified for linearity at the power and wavelength used, while attenuator repeatability, connector remating and fibre-bend loss all enter the uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Calibrated attenuators and power meter”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dark counts are intrinsic or extrinsic: intrinsic counts come from vortex crossings and phase slips near Ic and grow exponentially with bias, while extrinsic counts are mostly room-temperature blackbody photons guided down the fibre plus stray light, suppressed by cold fibre loops or filters. Timing jitter combines amplifier noise divided by pulse slope, geometric jitter from where along a long wire the pulse starts, intrinsic hotspot randomness and the timing electronics, added in quadrature. The noise-equivalent power NEP = hν·√(2·DCR)/η merges efficiency and dark counts into one figure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Dark counts and jitter histogram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

NbN devices usually run on the 2.5 K stage of a Gifford–McMahon or pulse-tube cold head, while WSi or MoSi devices need an added sorption He-3 stage to reach about 0.8 K. Fibres and coaxial lines must be heat-sunk as they pass the 40 K and 4 K stages, and the coax material sets heat load and signal attenuation; bias enters through a bias tee and the amplifier may sit at room temperature or on a cold stage. The cold head vibrates at about 1 Hz, which modulates coupling unless fibre and chip are in a self-aligned package. Temperature changes shift Ic directly, so a fixed bias drifts in I_b/Ic and changes efficiency and dark counts, while ground loops and RF interference create false counts. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “2.5 K closed-cycle cryostat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: efficiency versus bias and plateau width, dark counts versus bias, the jitter histogram at the operating point, reset time from the inter-event histogram, the count-rate saturation curve, polarisation ratio, cooldown time and temperature stability, and the latching threshold. The operating point is chosen not for maximum efficiency alone but by the application metric: secret-key rate and error rate for quantum key distribution, jitter against pulse-position-modulation slot width for deep-space optical links, and range resolution for lidar. The handoff record lists each channel's Ic, bias, temperature, amplifier settings and reference-plane definition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance curves and application link”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 偏置設得太低時只有部分光子能形成跨越整個截面的電阻區，計數率對偏置仍陡峭上升，效率對溫度與偏置漂移極度敏感；偏置設得太接近 Ic 則暗計數呈指數上升，在低光量量測中被誤認為訊號。
只報告偏振最大時的效率，應用端使用非偏振光時實際效率少一成；衰減器只在 1310 nm 校正卻用在 1550 nm，衰減值偏差 0.2 dB，效率被系統性高估 5%，不同實驗室的數字無法比較。
pitfallsEn: Biasing too low lets only some photons create a resistive region across the full cross-section, so count rate still climbs steeply with bias and efficiency becomes hypersensitive to temperature and bias drift; biasing too close to Ic makes dark counts grow exponentially and they are mistaken for signal in low-light measurements.

Reporting only the polarisation-maximum efficiency leaves users with unpolarised light 10% short; attenuators calibrated only at 1310 nm but used at 1550 nm can be off by 0.2 dB, overstating efficiency by 5% so numbers from different laboratories cannot be compared.

guides.concept: 以天文與光譜用的背照式深冷 CCD 為對象，從矽吸收深度與三相時脈的電荷搬運出發，說明為何一個角落像素要經過 8192 次轉移仍不能掉電荷，再把浮動擴散輸出放大器、減薄與深空乏、暗電流溫度律、光子轉移與 Fe-55 增益、像素合併與宇宙射線、多輸出串擾整合成可驗收的相機紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Using back-illuminated, deep-cooled CCDs for astronomy and spectroscopy, start from silicon absorption depth and three-phase charge transport to show why a corner pixel must survive 8192 transfers without losing charge, then integrate the floating-diffusion output amplifier, thinning and deep depletion, the dark-current temperature law, photon-transfer and Fe-55 gain, binning and cosmic rays, and multi-output crosstalk into an acceptable camera record.
procedure: 矽的能隙 1.12 eV，可見光光子在矽中產生一個電子電洞對，X 光則平均每 3.65 eV 產生一對，因此 CCD 同時是光子計數器與能量計。前照式 CCD 的光要先穿過多晶矽電極，藍光與紫外在電極中被吸收，量子效率只有四成左右；背照式 CCD 把晶片減薄後從背面受光，加上抗反射膜可在可見光超過九成。但矽對紅光與近紅外的吸收長度很長，900 nm 約 33 µm、1000 nm 約 156 µm，薄元件的紅端效率下降，且前後表面反射形成干涉條紋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式矽吸收層」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

CCD 的每個像素是埋入式通道上的 MOS 電容，曝光時光電子被收集在電極下的電位井中。讀出時以三相時脈依序升降相鄰電極的電壓，把整排電荷包一行一行往水平暫存器平移，再一格一格移到輸出放大器。每次轉移留下的比例稱為電荷轉移無效率 CTI，來源是矽中的缺陷陷阱、太空中質子造成的位移損傷與表面態；陷阱先捕獲電子再延後釋放，使影像沿讀出方向拖尾。CTI 在低訊號、低背景時最嚴重，因為沒有其他電荷先把陷阱填滿。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三相時脈與電荷轉移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

電荷包被倒入輸出端的浮動擴散節點，電容 C 把電荷轉成電壓 q/C，再由源極隨耦器送出晶片。每次倒入電荷前節點要先重設，重設帶來 kTC 雜訊，所以讀出電路在重設後與電荷倒入後各取樣一次並相減，常用雙斜率積分器實作相關雙取樣。讀出雜訊由放大器的白雜訊與 1/f 雜訊組成：取樣時間越長白雜訊越低，但 1/f 雜訊不隨之下降，而且整張影像讀出時間按像素數除以像素速率線性增加。大面積相機因此把晶片分成多個輸出同時讀出。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「浮動擴散輸出放大器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

背照式 CCD 把晶圓減薄到 10 到 20 µm，背面必須以離子佈植加雷射退火、分子束磊晶 δ 摻雜等方式鈍化，建立把光電子推向前側電位井的內建電場，否則藍光產生的電子在背面復合。深空乏元件改用高電阻率矽並施加基板偏壓，使 40 到 200 µm 厚的矽全部空乏，紅端 QE 提高且條紋減弱，但未空乏區的電荷橫向擴散會放大點擴散函數，宇宙射線徑跡也變長。大面積焦面由多片晶片拼成，封裝要控制平整度、間隙與低溫下的熱膨脹匹配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「減薄、深空乏與焦面平整度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

暗電流來自熱激發的電子電洞對：空乏區的產生電流按 T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT) 變化，未空乏區的擴散電流按 T³·exp(−E_g/kT) 變化，矽與氧化層界面的表面態則在非反轉模式下貢獻最多。多釘扎相位（MPP）操作讓表面反轉，可把表面暗電流壓低約百倍。實驗室相機以多級熱電致冷到 −70 到 −100 °C，天文台常用液氮或閉循環冷頭到 −100 °C 以下；但溫度太低時部分陷阱釋放時間變長而使 CTE 變差，暗電流也會被時脈感應電荷與輝光等其他來源墊底。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「低溫恆溫器與暗電流」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相機增益 K（e⁻/DN）可由光子散粒雜訊的統計求得：訊號 S 個電子的變異數等於 S，兩張同條件平場相減可消去像素響應不均，差值變異數的一半等於 S/K 加上讀出雜訊平方。Fe-55 放射源的 Mn Kα 5.9 keV X 光在單一像素產生約 1616 個電子，提供獨立的絕對增益。厚 CCD 在高訊號時，已收集的電荷會把後來的電荷推向鄰近像素，造成相鄰像素正相關、單像素變異數低於泊松值的亮者變胖效應，必須把共變異數加回去。PTC 的轉折點同時給出滿井容量，要與 ADC 的量化範圍匹配。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「平場對與 Fe-55 X 光源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

科學影像依序扣除過掃描區估得的偏壓位準與主偏壓的結構、扣除依曝光時間縮放的暗場、除以正規化的主平場，再套用壞像素遮罩並剔除宇宙射線；剔除可用多張曝光的中位數或以拉普拉斯邊緣偵測找出比點擴散函數更銳利的事件。CCD 可在晶片上合併像素：在水平暫存器或加總井中把相鄰電荷先相加再讀一次，整組只付一次讀出雜訊，這是 CCD 相對於逐像素讀出感測器的特殊優勢，但受水平暫存器滿井與解析度損失限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「偏壓、暗場、平場與宇宙射線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

相機驗收把前面的模型逐項變成量測：各輸出的 PTC 增益與讀出雜訊、以 Fe-55 與延伸像素邊緣響應量 CTE、暗電流地圖、QE 對波長、線性度、滿井與溢出、壞像素與陷阱、多輸出同時讀出時的串擾矩陣、快門時間地圖，以及深空乏元件在近紅外過曝後的殘留體影像。交接紀錄要列出時脈電壓與時序、操作溫度、各輸出增益、壞像素遮罩、串擾係數與快門修正，因為任何一項改變都會讓既有校正失效。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收測試台與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Silicon has a 1.12 eV bandgap, so a visible photon creates one electron–hole pair while X-rays create one pair per 3.65 eV on average, making a CCD both a photon counter and an energy meter. In a front-illuminated CCD light must first cross polysilicon gates that absorb blue and ultraviolet, limiting QE to about 40%; a back-illuminated CCD is thinned and illuminated from the back, and with an antireflection coating exceeds 90% in the visible. However, silicon's absorption length is long in the red and near infrared, about 33 µm at 900 nm and 156 µm at 1000 nm, so thin devices lose red response and reflections from both surfaces create interference fringes. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each CCD pixel is a MOS capacitor over a buried channel, and during exposure photoelectrons collect in the potential well under the gates. Readout raises and lowers adjacent gate voltages with three-phase clocks so whole rows of charge packets step toward the serial register and then, pixel by pixel, to the output amplifier. The fraction left behind per transfer is the charge-transfer inefficiency CTI, caused by bulk defect traps, proton displacement damage in space and surface states; traps capture electrons and release them later, trailing the image along the readout direction. CTI is worst at low signal and low background because no other charge has filled the traps first. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-phase clocks and charge transfer”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each charge packet is dumped onto the floating-diffusion node, whose capacitance C converts charge to voltage q/C before a source follower drives it off chip. The node must be reset before every dump and reset introduces kTC noise, so the readout chain samples once after reset and once after the charge transfer and subtracts them, usually with a dual-slope integrator implementing correlated double sampling. Read noise combines amplifier white noise and 1/f noise: longer sampling lowers the white part but not the 1/f part, while frame readout time grows linearly with pixel count divided by pixel rate. Large cameras therefore divide each chip into several outputs read in parallel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Floating-diffusion output amplifier”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Back-illuminated CCDs thin the wafer to 10 to 20 µm, and the back surface must be passivated by ion implantation with laser annealing or molecular-beam-epitaxy delta doping to build a field that drives photoelectrons toward the front-side wells; otherwise electrons generated by blue light recombine at the surface. Deep-depletion devices use high-resistivity silicon and a substrate bias to deplete 40 to 200 µm fully, raising red QE and suppressing fringes, but lateral diffusion from any undepleted region broadens the point-spread function and cosmic-ray tracks lengthen. Large focal planes tile many chips, so packaging must control flatness, gaps and thermal-expansion matching at cryogenic temperature. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thinning, deep depletion and focal-plane flatness”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dark current comes from thermally generated electron–hole pairs: depletion-region generation scales as T^1.5·exp(−E_g/2kT), diffusion from undepleted silicon as T³·exp(−E_g/kT), and surface states at the silicon–oxide interface contribute most in non-inverted operation. Multi-pinned-phase (MPP) operation inverts the surface and suppresses surface dark current by roughly a hundredfold. Laboratory cameras use multistage thermoelectric coolers to reach −70 to −100 °C, and observatories use liquid nitrogen or closed-cycle cold heads below −100 °C; too cold, however, lengthens some trap emission times and worsens CTE, and dark current is floored by other sources such as clock-induced charge and glow. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryostat and dark current”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Camera gain K in e⁻/DN follows from photon shot-noise statistics: a signal of S electrons has variance S, and subtracting two flats taken under identical conditions cancels pixel response non-uniformity, so half the variance of the difference equals S/K plus the read noise squared. The 5.9 keV Mn Kα X-rays from an Fe-55 source create about 1616 electrons in a single pixel, giving an independent absolute gain. In thick CCDs at high signal, collected charge pushes later charge into neighbouring pixels, the brighter-fatter effect, which correlates neighbours and lowers single-pixel variance below Poisson, so covariances must be added back. The PTC turnover also marks full well, which must be matched to the ADC range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Flat-field pairs and Fe-55 source”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Science frames have the bias level estimated from the overscan and the master-bias structure removed, then a dark scaled to exposure time subtracted, a normalised master flat divided out, a bad-pixel mask applied and cosmic rays rejected, either by median-combining several exposures or by Laplacian edge detection of events sharper than the point-spread function. A CCD can bin on chip, summing neighbouring charge in the serial register or a summing well before a single read, so the group pays read noise only once; this is a distinctive CCD advantage over pixel-by-pixel readout sensors, limited by serial-register full well and loss of resolution. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Bias, darks, flats and cosmic rays”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Camera acceptance turns the earlier models into measurements: PTC gain and read noise per output, CTE from Fe-55 and extended pixel edge response, a dark-current map, QE versus wavelength, linearity, full well and blooming, bad pixels and traps, the crosstalk matrix between outputs read simultaneously, a shutter-timing map and, for deep-depletion devices, residual bulk image after near-infrared overexposure. The handoff record lists clock voltages and timing, operating temperature, per-output gain, bad-pixel mask, crosstalk coefficients and shutter correction, because a change in any of them invalidates the existing calibration. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance test bench and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 把薄背照式 CCD 用在近紅外光譜，條紋振幅可達一到三成，若平場與科學影像的照明光譜不同，條紋無法除掉，天光扣除留下週期性殘差；背面鈍化不良時紫外 QE 隨照光歷史漂移，同一顆星的流量前後不一致。
恆溫器真空劣化或窗片結霜時晶片降不到設定溫度，暗電流每 6 K 翻倍而無人察覺；暗場與科學影像在不同溫度拍攝，扣除後殘留熱像素圖樣，長曝光的暗弱源被雜點淹沒或出現假源。
pitfallsEn: Using a thin back-illuminated CCD for near-infrared spectroscopy produces fringes of 10% to 30%, and if flat-field and science illumination spectra differ the fringes do not divide out, leaving periodic sky-subtraction residuals; with poor backside passivation ultraviolet QE drifts with illumination history so the same star's flux changes from frame to frame.

If cryostat vacuum degrades or the window frosts, the chip cannot reach its set point and dark current doubles every 6 K unnoticed; darks taken at a different temperature from science frames leave a residual hot-pixel pattern after subtraction, burying faint sources in long exposures or creating false ones.

guides.concept: 從釘扎光電二極體與背照式結構出發，理解 sCMOS 為何能以 1 e⁻ 以下的讀出雜訊和 95% 的量子效率成像，再把滾動快門時序、光子轉移校正、DSNU/PRNU 校正與資料鏈路檢查整合成一套可驗收的科學相機工程紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the pinned photodiode and back-illuminated structure to see why an sCMOS can image with sub-electron read noise and 95 percent quantum efficiency, then integrate rolling-shutter timing, photon-transfer calibration, DSNU/PRNU correction and data-link checks into an acceptable scientific-camera engineering record.
procedure: 科學級 CMOS（sCMOS）的每個像素都是一個釘扎光電二極體加上四到五個電晶體：轉移閘把累積的電子送到浮動擴散節點，重置電晶體清空節點，源極隨耦器把電荷轉成電壓，列選擇電晶體把訊號送上行匯流排。量子效率 QE 是入射光子被轉成可收集電子的比例；前照式像素的金屬連線與多晶矽閘會遮擋並反射光，即使加微透鏡也只有約 60% 到 80%，背照式把晶圓薄化、從背面入光，峰值 QE 可到 95%。6.5 µm 的像素尺寸是取樣解析度與全井容量之間的折衷。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「背照式像素與釘扎光電二極體」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

sCMOS 的行級讀出電路一次只能處理一列，滾動快門因此讓每一列依序重置、曝光、讀出：每列曝光時間相同，但起始時刻相差一個列時間 t_line，整個畫面的首列與末列相差 N_rows×t_line。移動物體會被剪切變形，脈衝照明會在畫面上留下亮暗條帶。全域快門讓所有像素同時開始與結束曝光，但需要在像素內增加一個儲存節點與遮光結構，讀出雜訊通常高於滾動模式（例如 2.3 e⁻ 對 0.9 e⁻），填充因子也較低。許多 sCMOS 提供全域重置或光片讀出模式，用時序而非像素結構解決同時性問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「滾動快門時序圖」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每一行都有自己的放大器與類比數位轉換器，數千個 ADC 平行工作，才能在低於 2 e⁻ 的讀出雜訊下達到每秒數十張全幅影像。重置浮動擴散節點時，開關的熱雜訊會在電容上留下隨機的 kTC 電荷，相關雙取樣先取樣重置電位、再取樣轉移後電位並相減，把這項雜訊消掉。剩下的讀出雜訊主要來自源極隨耦器的 1/f 與隨機電報雜訊，因此讀得越慢、取樣頻寬越窄，雜訊越低：同一顆相機在超靜音模式可達 0.7 e⁻，在快速模式約 1.6 e⁻。雙增益 ADC 同時以高增益與低增益數位化，再合成 16 位元輸出，兼顧低光靈敏度與全井動態範圍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「源極隨耦器與行級 ADC」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

背照式感測器把完成電路的晶圓黏到載板上，從背面研磨與蝕刻到約 10 µm 的磊晶層，再以離子佈植與雷射退火做背面鈍化，形成把光生電子推向光電二極體的內建電場，最後鍍上針對可見光或近紅外最佳化的抗反射膜。矽的吸收長度隨波長快速增加，紅光與近紅外光子可能穿透整個薄矽層而不被吸收，因此矽越薄近紅外 QE 越低，但矽越厚電子橫向擴散造成的像素間串擾越大。感測器裝在充乾燥氣體或抽真空的封裝內，以熱電致冷器冷卻到 −8 °C 到 −45 °C，降低暗電流並避免結露。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「薄化晶圓與抗反射膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光子轉移法利用散粒雜訊的統計性質校正整條讀出鏈：電子數的變異數等於其平均值，所以在以數位單位（DN）量到的平均值與變異數之間，斜率就是增益 K（DN/e⁻）。做法是在均勻照明下對每個曝光時間拍兩張，取差影像的變異數除以 2 消除固定圖樣雜訊，對平均值作圖；零光點的截距給讀出雜訊，曲線在全井附近轉折並下降。這正是 EMVA 1288 標準規定的量測核心，所得的增益把後續所有雜訊都換算到電子單位。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子轉移曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

sCMOS 每個像素與每一行都有自己的放大器和 ADC，所以偏移與增益在像素之間各不相同：暗訊號不均勻性 DSNU 是無光時各像素偏移的空間標準差，光響應不均勻性 PRNU 是均勻照明下各像素增益差異的相對標準差，行級 ADC 的差異則表現為縱向條紋。這些是固定圖樣，不會因取平均而減少，卻可以用校正移除：以多張暗幀平均成主暗幀扣除偏移與暗電流，以多張均勻照明影像平均成主平場除去增益差異。熱像素（暗電流特別高的像素）另以地圖標記並在分析時遮蔽。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「主暗幀與主平場」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

整合相機時要同時滿足兩件事：每個像素收到的電子數要讓 SNR 達標，而像素在樣品面上的等效尺寸要符合奈奎斯特取樣。SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²)，其中 S = QE·N_ph 是訊號電子數，D 是暗電流，σ_r 是讀出雜訊；低光時讀出雜訊主宰，所以 1 e⁻ 與 6 e⁻ 的差異決定能否看見訊號。取樣方面，物鏡的瑞利解析度 r = 0.61λ/NA，像素投影到樣品面的尺寸 p/M 必須不大於 r/2；放大率太低會欠取樣失去解析度，太高則把有限的光子攤到太多像素而降低每像素 SNR。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「SNR 模型與取樣匹配表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

驗收不只是核對資料表，而是把前面各單元的量測整理成一份可重現的紀錄：EMVA 1288 的增益、讀出雜訊、DSNU、PRNU、暗電流、線性度與動態範圍，附上量測時的冷卻溫度、讀出模式與韌體版本。時序方面要量觸發輸入到曝光開始的延遲與抖動，確認曝光結束訊號可用來同步光源或壓電台；資料鏈路方面要計算全幅、全速、16 位元的資料率是否在介面與儲存系統的能力之內，否則相機會丟幀而不報錯。交接時主暗幀、主平場、熱像素地圖與校正腳本必須隨相機一起交付。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「驗收紀錄與資料鏈路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Every pixel of a scientific CMOS sensor is a pinned photodiode with four or five transistors: a transfer gate moves the collected electrons to a floating-diffusion node, a reset transistor empties the node, a source follower converts charge to voltage, and a row-select transistor puts the signal on the column bus. Quantum efficiency is the fraction of incident photons converted to collectable electrons; in a front-illuminated pixel the metal wiring and polysilicon gates shade and reflect light, so even with microlenses QE stays near 60 to 80 percent, whereas back-illumination thins the wafer and admits light from the rear, pushing peak QE to about 95 percent. The 6.5 µm pixel pitch is a compromise between sampling resolution and full-well capacity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Back-illuminated pixel and pinned photodiode”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Column readout circuits handle one row at a time, so a rolling shutter resets, exposes and reads rows in sequence: every row gets the same exposure, but its start is delayed by one line time t_line, and the first and last rows differ by N_rows×t_line. Moving objects shear and pulsed illumination leaves bright and dark bands across the frame. A global shutter starts and stops exposure for all pixels at once but needs an in-pixel storage node and light shield, so read noise is usually higher than in rolling mode (for example 2.3 versus 0.9 electrons) and the fill factor is lower. Many sCMOS cameras offer a global-reset or light-sheet readout mode that solves simultaneity with timing rather than pixel structure. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Rolling-shutter timing diagram”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each column has its own amplifier and analog-to-digital converter, and thousands of ADCs work in parallel, which is how full frames can be read at tens of frames per second with read noise below 2 electrons. Resetting the floating-diffusion node leaves a random kTC charge from switch thermal noise on the capacitance; correlated double sampling samples the reset level, then the post-transfer level, and subtracts them, cancelling that term. The remaining read noise comes mainly from 1/f and random-telegraph noise in the source follower, so slower readout with narrower sampling bandwidth gives lower noise: the same camera reaches 0.7 electrons in ultra-quiet mode and about 1.6 electrons in fast mode. Dual-gain ADCs digitize each pixel at high and low gain simultaneously and merge the results into a 16-bit output, preserving both low-light sensitivity and full-well dynamic range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Source follower and column ADC”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A back-illuminated sensor is bonded face-down to a carrier wafer, ground and etched from the rear to an epitaxial layer about 10 µm thick, then passivated by ion implantation and laser annealing to create a built-in field that drives photoelectrons toward the photodiodes, and finally coated with an anti-reflection stack optimized for the visible or near infrared. The absorption length of silicon rises steeply with wavelength, so red and near-infrared photons can cross the thin silicon without being absorbed; thinner silicon lowers near-infrared QE, while thicker silicon increases pixel-to-pixel crosstalk from lateral electron diffusion. The sensor sits in a dry-gas or vacuum package cooled by a thermoelectric cooler to between −8 °C and −45 °C, which lowers dark current and prevents condensation. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thinned wafer and anti-reflection coating”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The photon-transfer method calibrates the whole readout chain from the statistics of shot noise: the variance of the electron count equals its mean, so the slope of variance against mean, both measured in digital numbers, is the gain K in DN per electron. Under uniform illumination two frames are taken at each exposure time, the variance of their difference is halved to remove fixed-pattern noise, and it is plotted against the mean; the intercept at zero light gives the read noise and the curve bends over and falls near full well. This is the core measurement prescribed by the EMVA 1288 standard, and the resulting gain converts every later noise figure into electrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon-transfer curve”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because every pixel and every column of an sCMOS has its own amplifier and ADC, offsets and gains differ from pixel to pixel: dark-signal non-uniformity (DSNU) is the spatial standard deviation of pixel offsets without light, photo-response non-uniformity (PRNU) is the relative spatial standard deviation of pixel gains under uniform illumination, and column-ADC differences appear as vertical stripes. These are fixed patterns that do not average down over time, but they can be corrected: many dark frames averaged into a master dark remove offset and dark current, and many uniform-illumination frames averaged into a master flat divide out gain differences. Hot pixels with unusually high dark current are mapped separately and masked during analysis. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Master dark and master flat”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Integrating a camera means satisfying two things at once: each pixel must collect enough electrons for the required SNR, and the pixel's equivalent size at the sample must meet Nyquist sampling. SNR = S/√(S + D·t + σ_r²), where S = QE·N_ph is the signal in electrons, D the dark current and σ_r the read noise; at low light the read noise dominates, so the difference between 1 and 6 electrons decides whether a signal is visible at all. For sampling, the objective's Rayleigh resolution is r = 0.61λ/NA and the pixel projected onto the sample, p/M, must not exceed r/2; too little magnification undersamples and loses resolution, too much spreads the limited photons over too many pixels and lowers per-pixel SNR. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “SNR model and sampling-match table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Acceptance is more than checking a datasheet; it assembles the measurements from the earlier units into a reproducible record: EMVA 1288 gain, read noise, DSNU, PRNU, dark current, linearity and dynamic range, together with the cooling temperature, readout mode and firmware version in force at the time. On timing, measure the delay and jitter from trigger input to exposure start and confirm that the exposure-end output can synchronize light sources or a piezo stage; on the data link, compute whether the full-frame, full-speed, 16-bit data rate fits the interface and storage system, because a camera that cannot keep up drops frames silently. At handoff the master dark, master flat, hot-pixel map and correction scripts must travel with the camera. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Acceptance record and data link”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 背面鈍化不良時，表面態會俘獲短波長產生的電子，藍光與紫外 QE 大幅下降，且隨溫度與照射歷史漂移；影像看起來正常，但定量螢光比值會隨時間偏移。
照明不均或光源閃爍會使差影像的變異數偏大，擬合出的增益偏高、讀出雜訊偏低，後續以電子為單位的 SNR 模型全部樂觀；症狀是重複量測的增益值離散超過 5%。
pitfallsEn: Poor backside passivation lets surface states trap the electrons generated by short wavelengths, so blue and ultraviolet QE collapses and drifts with temperature and illumination history; images look normal but quantitative fluorescence ratios shift over time.

Non-uniform or flickering illumination inflates the variance of the difference image, so the fitted gain is too high and the read noise too low, and every later SNR model in electrons becomes optimistic; the symptom is a gain value that scatters by more than 5 percent between repeated runs.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：CERN 大型強子對撞機
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Large Hadron Collider
guides.concept: 從磁剛度與亮度公式出發，理解為何 7 TeV 的質子需要 8.33 T 的 NbTi 偶極磁鐵與 1.9 K 超流氦，再把 362 MJ 的束流能量、準直與淬火保護、軌道與光學量測、注入與加速週期整合成一條可交接給操作團隊的對撞機工程鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Start from magnetic rigidity and the luminosity formula to see why 7 TeV protons need 8.33 T NbTi dipoles and 1.9 K superfluid helium, then integrate the 362 MJ stored beam energy, collimation and quench protection, orbit and optics measurement, and the injection and ramp cycle into a collider engineering chain that can be handed to the operations team.
procedure: 帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。LHC 沿用 LEP 的 26,659 m 隧道，彎轉只能由 1232 顆磁長 14.3 m 的主偶極磁鐵提供，因此彎轉半徑被固定在約 2804 m，要把質子推到 7 TeV 就必須有 8.33 T 的偶極場，這遠超過鐵磁飽和的 2 T，只能靠超導線圈。對撞機的優勢在質心能量：兩束 7 TeV 對撞得到 √s = 14 TeV，而 7 TeV 質子打固定靶只有 √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

對撞機的產率由亮度決定：事件率 = L×σ。對於 n_b 個團、每團 N 個質子、迴旋頻率 f_rev、正規化發射度 ε_n、對撞點 β 函數 β* 的高斯束，L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F，F 是交叉角造成的幾何損失因子。亮度隨每團粒子數平方上升，所以注入鏈必須提供高亮度的團，同時 β* 要由最後一組三合一超導四極磁鐵壓到次公尺等級。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ) 只有十幾微米，兩束必須以微米精度對準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每顆主偶極是一個「二合一」磁鐵：兩個 56 mm 孔徑的 cos θ 線圈裝在同一個鐵軛與低溫恆溫槽內，產生方向相反的場讓兩束反向迴旋。線圈由 NbTi 細絲嵌在銅基體中的盧瑟福纜繞成內外兩層，以沃斯田鐵不銹鋼箍環施加預應力，避免 8.33 T 下的勞侖茲力讓導體微動發熱而淬火。一旦某處失去超導，淬火偵測器在毫秒內觸發加熱片使整個線圈均勻轉為常導，並由二極體把電流旁路，讓儲存的磁能分散在整顆磁鐵而不是燒毀一小段導體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NbTi 盧瑟福纜與雙孔徑冷質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

LHC 把 NbTi 磁鐵冷到 1.9 K 而不是 4.2 K，因為臨界電流密度隨溫度下降而上升，讓同樣的導體在 8.33 T 仍有餘裕。低於 2.17 K 的氦成為超流氦 He II，有效熱導極高、黏度極低，能滲進線圈絕緣帶走熱量；每顆磁鐵的冷質量浸在 1.9 K、1.3 bar 的靜態 He II 中，熱量再經由穿過磁鐵的貝氏熱交換管傳給 16 mbar 的兩相飽和 He II。八座 4.5 K 製冷站各約 18 kW，加上 1.8 K 冷壓縮機單元，維持約 36,000 噸冷質量與 120 噸氦；束流造成的同步輻射、影像電流與電子雲熱負載則由 5 K 到 20 K 的束流屏截住，不進入 1.9 K。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米；調諧值由 BBQ 系統從束流的微小振盪頻譜讀出，色品度則以調變 RF 頻率、觀察調諧變化量測。光學函數 β 的誤差（β-beating）用 AC 偶極激發束流做逐圈量測再反解。超導磁鐵在注入能量 450 GeV 時持續電流會隨時間衰減、在升流開始時又「回彈」，改變六極場分量 b₃，因此必須以參考磁鐵的量測建立場模型，前饋修正六極校正磁鐵。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

設計值下每束儲存 362 MJ，足以熔化約 700 kg 銅，而超導線圈只要吸收每立方公分數十毫焦的瞬間能量就會淬火，因此只有極小比例的束流可以在磁鐵附近損失。多級準直系統在 IR7 做橫向清除、IR3 做動量清除：主準直器以碳纖維複合材料顎板放在約 5 到 6 倍束流尺寸處攔截暈粒子，次級準直器與吸收器再接住散射產物，清除效率須達 99.99% 以上。環上約四千個游離室束流損失監測器以 40 µs 到 1.3 s 的多個時間窗持續積分，任何通道超過閾值就在三圈內觸發束流傾卸：踢磁鐵在 3 µs 的空檔中把束流引出，掃過 7 m 長的石墨傾卸塊分散能量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。每束由 4 個低溫模組內的 8 個 400.8 MHz 超導腔提供每腔 2 MV、共 16 MV 的電壓；這個電壓主要用來建立縱向的「桶」把粒子束縛成 1 ns 左右的團，真正的加速增量很小。升流時偶極電流從約 760 A 升到 11,850 A 約需 20 分鐘，RF 頻率隨速度微調，之後把 β* 從注入的 11 m 壓縮到 0.55 m 並把兩束對撞。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

冷卻完成後，每一個超導電路都要經過電氣品質保證（絕緣、接地、儀器線路）、淬火保護系統測試，再逐步升流到額定值並記錄訓練淬火；主偶極電路由 154 顆磁鐵串聯，匯流排接頭以軟焊連接，每個接頭的電阻必須在 nΩ 等級，否則焦耳熱會在失去超導時引發熱失控，這正是 2008 年 9 月事故的機制。束流試運轉再從第一圈、RF 捕獲、升流、壓縮到對撞逐步解鎖，每一步都有機器保護檢查表；交接給操作團隊的文件包括每個電路的訓練歷史、接頭電阻量測、損失監測器閾值表與亮度校正結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]. The LHC reuses the 26,659 m LEP tunnel, and all bending comes from 1232 main dipoles of 14.3 m magnetic length, so the bending radius is fixed near 2804 m; reaching 7 TeV therefore demands a dipole field of 8.33 T, far beyond the 2 T saturation of iron and achievable only with superconducting coils. The collider's advantage is centre-of-mass energy: two 7 TeV beams give √s = 14 TeV, whereas a 7 TeV proton on a fixed target yields only √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “26.7 km ring and main dipoles”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

A collider's output is set by luminosity: event rate = L×σ. For Gaussian beams with n_b bunches of N protons each, revolution frequency f_rev, normalized emittance ε_n and interaction-point beta function β*, L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F, where F is the geometric loss from the crossing angle. Luminosity grows with the square of the bunch population, so the injector chain must deliver bright bunches, while β* is squeezed to sub-metre values by the final triplet of superconducting quadrupoles. The beam size at the interaction point, σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ), is only some tens of micrometres, so the two beams must be aligned to micrometre precision. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each main dipole is a two-in-one magnet: two cos θ coils with 56 mm apertures share one iron yoke and cryostat and produce opposite fields so the two beams circulate in opposite directions. The coils are wound in two layers of Rutherford cable made of NbTi filaments in a copper matrix and are pre-stressed by austenitic stainless-steel collars so that the Lorentz forces at 8.33 T cannot let the conductor move and heat itself into a quench. When superconductivity is lost anywhere, quench detection fires heaters within milliseconds to drive the whole coil normal and a bypass diode diverts the current, so the stored magnetic energy is spread over the entire magnet instead of burning a short length of conductor. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NbTi Rutherford cable and twin-aperture cold mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The LHC cools its NbTi magnets to 1.9 K rather than 4.2 K because critical current density rises as temperature falls, giving the same conductor margin at 8.33 T. Below 2.17 K helium becomes superfluid He II, with enormous effective thermal conductivity and negligible viscosity, so it penetrates the coil insulation and carries heat away; each magnet's cold mass sits in static He II at 1.9 K and 1.3 bar, and heat passes to two-phase saturated He II at 16 mbar in a bayonet heat-exchanger tube running through the magnets. Eight 4.5 K refrigerators of about 18 kW each, plus 1.8 K cold-compressor units, hold roughly 36,000 tonnes of cold mass and 120 tonnes of helium; beam-induced loads from synchrotron radiation, image currents and electron cloud are intercepted by beam screens at 5 to 20 K so they never reach 1.9 K. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre; the tune is read by the BBQ system from the spectrum of tiny beam oscillations, and chromaticity is measured by modulating the RF frequency and watching the tune shift. Errors in the beta function (beta-beating) are measured turn by turn with an AC dipole exciting the beam and then inverted. In superconducting magnets at the 450 GeV injection energy, persistent currents decay with time and snap back when the ramp starts, changing the sextupole component b₃, so a field model built from reference-magnet measurements feeds corrections forward to the sextupole correctors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

At design values each beam stores 362 MJ, enough to melt about 700 kg of copper, while a superconducting coil quenches after absorbing only tens of millijoules per cubic centimetre in a fast loss, so only a tiny fraction of the beam may be lost near magnets. A multi-stage collimation system cleans the betatron halo in IR7 and the momentum halo in IR3: primary collimators with carbon-fibre-composite jaws at about 5 to 6 beam sigmas intercept halo particles, secondary collimators and absorbers catch the scattered products, and the cleaning efficiency must exceed 99.99 percent. Some four thousand ionization-chamber beam-loss monitors integrate over several windows from 40 µs to 1.3 s, and any channel above threshold triggers a beam dump within three turns: kicker magnets extract the beam during a 3 µs gap and sweep it over a 7 m graphite dump block to spread the energy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV; the SPS injects 12 batches into each ring and filling takes about 4 minutes 20 seconds. Each beam is driven by 8 superconducting 400.8 MHz cavities in 4 cryomodules at 2 MV each, 16 MV in total; this voltage mainly builds the longitudinal bucket that confines particles into bunches of about 1 ns, and the actual acceleration increment is tiny. During the ramp the dipole current rises from about 760 A to 11,850 A in roughly 20 minutes while the RF frequency tracks the velocity, after which β* is squeezed from 11 m at injection to 0.55 m and the beams are brought into collision. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

After cool-down every superconducting circuit passes electrical quality assurance (insulation, grounding, instrumentation wiring) and quench-protection tests, then is ramped stepwise to nominal while training quenches are logged; a main-dipole circuit strings 154 magnets in series with soldered bus-bar splices whose resistance must stay at the nanoohm level, otherwise Joule heating after loss of superconductivity drives thermal runaway, which is exactly the mechanism of the September 2008 incident. Beam commissioning then unlocks first turn, RF capture, ramp, squeeze and collisions in turn, each step gated by a machine-protection checklist; the handoff package to operations contains every circuit's training history, splice-resistance measurements, loss-monitor threshold tables and luminosity-calibration results. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。
若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。
pitfallsEn: A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp.

If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：CERN Linac4 直線加速器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Linac4 linear accelerator
guides.concept: 以取代 Linac2、自 2020 年起為 CERN 全部質子束流源頭的 86 m 長 Linac4 為對象，說明為何把注入能量從 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV 並改用 H⁻ 能讓 PS Booster 亮度約加倍，再把 45 keV 離子源、3 MeV RFQ、斬波線、三種 352.2 MHz 加速結構、飛行時間相位掃描、損失與剝離預算、碳膜電荷交換注入與可靠度驗收整合成可交接的加速器紀錄。
guides.conceptEn: For the 86 m Linac4 that replaced Linac2 and since 2020 sources every proton beam at CERN, show why raising injection energy from 50 to 160 MeV with H⁻ ions roughly doubles PS Booster brightness, then integrate the 45 keV source, 3 MeV RFQ, chopper line, three 352.2 MHz accelerating structures, time-of-flight phase scans, loss and stripping budgets, carbon-foil charge-exchange injection and reliability acceptance into a transferable accelerator record.
procedure: LHC 束流的亮度在注入鏈最前端就被決定：PS Booster 在低能注入時，束流自身的空間電荷使橫向工作點偏移 ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²)，偏移過大就會跨越共振造成發射度成長與損失。把注入能量從 Linac2 的 50 MeV 提高到 160 MeV，β·γ² 增加約一倍，同樣的工作點偏移可容納約兩倍粒子。改用帶兩個電子的 H⁻ 則可做電荷交換注入：剝離膜在環內把 H⁻ 變成質子，這是非保守的過程，新進束流可以疊放在已循環束流的相空間上而不受劉維定理限制，多圈累積時損失與發射度成長都比質子隔板注入小。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「H⁻ 束流與 PSB 注入點」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Linac4 所有加速結構都在 352.2 MHz 工作，這也是 LEP 的頻率，讓它能沿用 LEP 的速調管與波導。粒子必須在每個加速間隙都遇到同一個 RF 相位：在 0 模的 Alvarez 型 DTL 中，相鄰間隙相距 βλ，即粒子在一個 RF 週期飛過的距離；在 π 模結構中相鄰單元相位相反，間距為 βλ/2。由於 β 從 0.08 增加到 0.52，單元沿線逐漸變長，每種結構只在某一 β 範圍內效率最高。同步相位取負值（例如 −20°），讓早到的粒子得到較少能量、晚到的得到較多，形成縱向聚焦，代價是能量增益乘以 cosφ_s。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「352.2 MHz 加速間隙與單元長度」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Linac4 的離子源以數十 kW 的射頻加熱氫電漿，配合銫降低表面功函數以增加 H⁻ 產額，同時被引出的電子由偏轉磁場導到電子收集器，H⁻ 以 45 keV 引出。低能傳輸線以螺線管把束流匹配進 RFQ，殘氣電離產生的正離子部分中和空間電荷。3 m 長的 RFQ 把束流從 45 keV 加速到 3 MeV：四片電極的正弦調制同時提供與速度無關的電四極聚焦與縱向加速場，並把直流束流絕熱地聚束成 352.2 MHz 的微束團，這正是低 β 時磁聚焦無效、空間電荷最強時所需的功能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「RF 驅動 H⁻ 離子源與 RFQ」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

3 MeV 的中能傳輸線上有靜電偏轉板斬波器，依 PSB 約 1 MHz 的 RF 桶結構移除特定微束團，約 65% 的束流保留，被移除的束團在 3 MeV 打到吸收器，那裡活化最小，避免它們在 PSB 捕獲時於 160 MeV 損失。斬波器上升時間必須短於 2.84 ns 的束團間距。之後 DTL 以漂移管內的永久磁鐵四極聚焦把能量提高到 50 MeV；50 到約 102 MeV 用七個模組的耦合腔 DTL，四極磁鐵放在腔外，便於對準與冷卻；102 到 160 MeV 用十二個 π 模結構，在 β 約 0.5 時有較高的有效分路阻抗。所有結構以 LEP 遺留的 352 MHz 速調管與新增速調管供電。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「斬波線、DTL、CCDTL 與 PIMS」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

每個加速腔的 RF 振幅與相位都要設定在讓束流以同步相位到達的位置，否則能量誤差會一路累積。做法是讓某一腔的相位掃過 360°，同時以下游兩個束流位置監測器的相位訊號量測飛行時間，換算束流能量；把量到的能量對相位曲線與模擬的特徵曲線擬合，得到該腔的振幅與相位偏差。腔體依序調整，前一腔確定後作為下一腔的參考。H⁻ 還可以用雷射把多餘電子光剝離，做不攔截的束流剖面量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「BPM 之間的飛行時間」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

亮度是流強除以發射度，設計要求在 PSB 注入處的正規化 rms 橫向發射度約 0.4 mm·mrad，沿線成長約 40%，其中約一半發生在斬波線。空間電荷失配與 RF 誤差會在束流周圍形成暈，暈粒子打到管壁成為損失；為了能人工維護，常用每公尺約 1 W 的損失上限。H⁻ 另有特有的損失途徑：與殘氣碰撞失去一個電子變成中性 H⁰，不再受四極磁鐵與偏轉磁鐵控制，沿直線飛到下一個轉彎處撞上真空管；束內碰撞與強磁場中的勞侖茲剝離則在更高能量才變得重要。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「發射度量測與束流損失監測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

160 MeV 的 H⁻ 經傳輸線送到 PSB，以脈衝式踢束磁鐵與隔板把連續的束流段依序分配到上下堆疊的四個環。每個環的注入區以局部軌道凸起讓 H⁻ 與循環質子會合，H⁻ 穿過薄碳膜時兩個電子被剝離，變成質子留在環內；未完全剝離的 H⁰ 與 H⁻ 被導向內部吸收器。注入期間逐步改變凸起高度做橫向相空間塗佈，以得到目標發射度與分布；但循環質子每圈都可能再穿過碳膜，引起多重庫侖散射、核反應損失與碳膜加熱，因此塗佈與凸起收回時序必須讓穿膜次數最少。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「碳剝離膜與 PSB 四環分配」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Linac4 依結構安裝順序分段試運轉：先在測試站驗證離子源、RFQ 與斬波線，再於隧道內逐段把能量推進到 50、100 與 160 MeV，2016 年達到 160 MeV，之後以可靠度運轉累積故障統計，再於 2019 到 2020 年的長停機期間接上 PSB。整機可用率是串聯子系統可用率的乘積，所以離子源、每一座 RF 站、真空、電源與控制都要分配可用率預算。交接紀錄要包含 RF 設定點與相位掃描結果、離子源操作參數、損失地圖、聯鎖門檻與備品策略，讓營運團隊能在更換元件後快速回到已知狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「可靠度運轉與交接紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: LHC beam brightness is fixed at the very front of the injector chain: at low-energy injection into the PS Booster the beam's own space charge shifts the transverse tune by ΔQ ∝ N/(ε_n·β·γ²), and too large a shift crosses resonances, growing emittance and causing losses. Raising injection energy from Linac2's 50 MeV to 160 MeV roughly doubles β·γ², so the same tune shift accommodates about twice the particles. Switching to H⁻ ions carrying two electrons enables charge-exchange injection: a stripping foil converts H⁻ to protons inside the ring, a non-conservative process that lets incoming beam be stacked onto the circulating beam's phase space without the Liouville constraint, so multi-turn accumulation produces less loss and emittance growth than proton septum injection. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “H⁻ beam and PSB injection point”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

All Linac4 structures run at 352.2 MHz, the LEP frequency, which lets the linac reuse LEP klystrons and waveguides. A particle must meet the same RF phase at every gap: in a 0-mode Alvarez DTL adjacent gaps are βλ apart, the distance travelled in one RF period, while in a π-mode structure adjacent cells are in opposite phase and spaced βλ/2. Because β grows from 0.08 to 0.52, cells lengthen along the linac and each structure type is most efficient only in a certain β range. The synchronous phase is negative, for example −20°, so early particles gain less energy and late ones more, giving longitudinal focusing at the cost of multiplying energy gain by cosφ_s. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “352.2 MHz gaps and cell length”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The Linac4 source heats a hydrogen plasma with tens of kilowatts of RF and uses caesium to lower the surface work function and raise H⁻ yield, while co-extracted electrons are bent onto an electron dump and the H⁻ ions are extracted at 45 keV. The low-energy transport line matches the beam into the RFQ with solenoids, and positive ions from residual-gas ionisation partly neutralise space charge. The 3 m RFQ accelerates from 45 keV to 3 MeV: the sinusoidal modulation of its four vanes provides velocity-independent electric quadrupole focusing and a longitudinal accelerating field, and adiabatically bunches the DC beam into 352.2 MHz micro-bunches, exactly what is needed when magnetic focusing is weak at low β and space charge is strongest. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “RF-driven H⁻ source and RFQ”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 3 MeV medium-energy line carries an electrostatic deflecting-plate chopper that removes selected micro-bunches to match the roughly 1 MHz RF bucket pattern of the PSB, keeping about 65% of the beam; removed bunches hit an absorber at 3 MeV where activation is minimal instead of being lost at 160 MeV during PSB capture. The chopper rise time must be shorter than the 2.84 ns bunch spacing. The DTL then reaches 50 MeV with permanent-magnet quadrupoles inside its drift tubes; seven cell-coupled DTL modules take the beam from 50 to about 102 MeV with quadrupoles outside the cavities for easier alignment and cooling; twelve π-mode structures go from 102 to 160 MeV with higher effective shunt impedance near β ≈ 0.5. All structures are powered by reused LEP 352 MHz klystrons and newer klystrons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Chopper line, DTL, CCDTL and PIMS”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Each cavity's RF amplitude and phase must be set so the beam arrives at the synchronous phase, otherwise energy errors accumulate down the line. One cavity's phase is swept through 360° while the time of flight between two downstream beam-position monitors is measured from their phase signals and converted to beam energy; fitting the measured energy-versus-phase curve to the simulated signature yields that cavity's amplitude and phase offsets. Cavities are set in sequence, each settled one serving as reference for the next. H⁻ beams also allow non-intercepting profile measurement by laser photodetachment of the extra electron. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Time of flight between BPMs”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Brightness is current divided by emittance, and the design calls for a normalised rms transverse emittance of about 0.4 mm·mrad at PSB injection, with roughly 40% growth along the line, about half of it in the chopper line. Space-charge mismatch and RF errors build a halo whose particles strike the beam pipe as losses, and a limit of about 1 W per metre is commonly used to keep hands-on maintenance possible. H⁻ has its own loss channels: a collision with residual gas strips one electron to make neutral H⁰, which no longer responds to quadrupoles or dipoles and flies straight into the vacuum pipe at the next bend; intra-beam stripping and Lorentz stripping in strong magnetic fields matter only at higher energies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Emittance meters and beam-loss monitors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The 160 MeV H⁻ beam travels down the transfer line to the PSB, where pulsed kickers and septa distribute successive slices to four vertically stacked rings. In each ring a local orbit bump brings the H⁻ beam alongside the circulating protons, and on crossing a thin carbon foil both electrons are stripped, leaving protons that stay in the ring; partially stripped H⁰ and unstripped H⁻ are steered to an internal dump. The bump height is changed during injection to paint transverse phase space to the target emittance and distribution, but circulating protons can cross the foil every turn, causing multiple Coulomb scattering, nuclear losses and foil heating, so painting and bump-collapse timing must minimise foil traversals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Carbon stripping foil and four-ring distribution”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Linac4 was commissioned in stages following installation: source, RFQ and chopper line were first validated on a test stand, then energy was pushed in the tunnel to 50, 100 and 160 MeV, reaching 160 MeV in 2016, followed by a reliability run to accumulate fault statistics before connection to the PSB during the 2019–2020 long shutdown. Overall availability is the product of series subsystem availabilities, so source, every RF station, vacuum, power supplies and controls each receive an availability budget. The handoff record holds RF set points and phase-scan results, source operating parameters, loss maps, interlock thresholds and the spares policy so operations can return to a known state quickly after any component change. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reliability run and handoff record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若只提高直線加速器的流強而不提高注入能量，PSB 注入時空間電荷工作點偏移超過允許範圍，束流跨越整數或半整數共振，發射度成長並在環內損失，下游 LHC 的亮度目標無法達成，還造成環內活化。
BPM 電纜延遲隨溫度漂移 20 ps，對應約 2.5° 的相位誤差與約 40 keV 的能量誤讀，操作員據此把腔體相位設偏，束流偏離波峰進入下一段結構，縱向失配在高能段轉為損失；若沒有保存掃描結果，下次更換速調管後只能從頭重做。
pitfallsEn: Raising linac current without raising injection energy pushes the space-charge tune shift at PSB injection beyond its allowance, the beam crosses integer or half-integer resonances, emittance grows and particles are lost in the ring, so the LHC brightness target is missed and the ring is activated as well.

A 20 ps temperature drift in BPM cable delay corresponds to about 2.5° of phase and roughly 40 keV of misread energy, so operators set the cavity phase wrongly, the beam enters the next structure off crest and the longitudinal mismatch becomes losses at high energy; without saved scan results, every klystron replacement forces the procedure to start from scratch.

guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Super Proton Synchrotron
guides.concept: 以 SPS 的 744 台常溫偶極磁鐵與 Bρ = 3.3356·p 為起點，理解它如何把 26 GeV/c 質子加速到 450 GeV/c，再把 200 MHz 行波腔與固態放大器、非晶碳鍍膜、線掃描器發射度量測、三階共振慢引出損失預算與向 LHC 轉移的機器保護整合成可驗收的注入器工程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from the SPS's 744 warm dipoles and Bρ = 3.3356·p, see how it takes protons from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c, then integrate 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities with solid-state amplifiers, amorphous-carbon coating, wire-scanner emittance measurement, the third-integer slow-extraction loss budget and LHC-transfer machine protection into an acceptable injector engineering record.
procedure: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。因為 ρ 被隧道幾何固定，同步加速器必須讓磁場隨動量同步上升，並以射頻頻率鎖住軌道長度；注入端的低場與頂端的高場相差十幾倍，兩端的場品質都要顧到。總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 以 200 MHz 行波腔加速，諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev 決定環上射頻「桶」的數目；LHC 型束流以 25 ns 間隔佔據每 5 個 5 ns 桶中的 1 個。縱向穩定取決於滑相因子 η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²：高於轉變能時，動量較高的粒子繞一圈反而較慢。SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。鐵芯在 2 T 附近開始飽和，因此 450 GeV 已接近常溫鐵磁鐵的實用上限，這也是 LHC 必須改用超導磁鐵的原因。疊片抑制斜坡時的渦電流，但鐵的磁滯使同一電流下的磁場取決於前一循環的最高場；SPS 在超循環中交錯 LHC、固定靶與其他用戶循環，磁場歷史不斷改變。偶極分為兩種孔徑型式，以配合不同位置的束流尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。線掃描器以細碳纖維線快速穿過束流，由下游閃爍體量二次粒子簇射得到橫向剖面 σ，再以 ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w 換算，其中 β_w 為量測點的 Twiss β 函數、D·δ 為動量分散造成的寬度。誤差來源包括 β_w 的光學誤差、線速度與位置編碼、線材受熱以及量測點色散的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速線掃描器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。ZS 由五個各長 3.15 m、每個含 2080 根鎢錸細線的槽構成。約 4.8 s 的平頂把約 3.5×10¹³ 顆質子均勻送出，形成實驗所需的長 spill；打在線上的質子造成損失與活化，是慢引出的核心限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。引出踢磁鐵必須在束串間隙內上升到位，任何時序或強度錯誤都可能讓整串高能束流打到傳輸線或 LHC 注入區，因此傳輸線末端設有可移動的注入保護準直器（TCDI），引出前由互鎖系統檢查軌道、強度與磁鐵電流，並先以低強度探針束驗證路徑。束串的強度與發射度決定 LHC 亮度，也決定出錯時的破壞力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SPS 同時服務 LHC、北區固定靶、HiRadMat、AWAKE 與離子運轉，控制系統把不同循環排成超循環，每個循環有自己的磁場斜坡、射頻程式與引出設定。LIU 升級把 200 MHz 行波腔由 4 座增為 6 座，並由 Thales 交付兩套固態功率放大器：每套 16 座 144 kW 放大塔、每塔 80 個 1.8 kW 功率模組，全系統 5120 顆電晶體，以大量並聯換取優雅降級與高可用度。驗收必須同時證明束流參數與系統可用度達標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]. Because ρ is fixed by the tunnel geometry, a synchrotron must raise the field in step with momentum while the RF frequency locks the orbit length; injection and top fields differ by more than a factor of ten, and field quality matters at both ends. The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “744 main dipole magnets”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS accelerates with 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities, and the harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev sets how many RF buckets fit around the ring; LHC-type beams at 25 ns spacing fill one in every five 5 ns buckets. Longitudinal stability depends on the slip factor η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²: above transition, higher-momentum particles take longer per turn. Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The iron begins to saturate near 2 T, so 450 GeV is close to the practical limit of warm iron magnets, which is why the LHC had to use superconducting magnets. Laminations suppress eddy currents during the ramp, but iron hysteresis makes the field at a given current depend on the previous cycle's peak; the SPS interleaves LHC, fixed-target and other users in a supercycle, so the magnetic history keeps changing. The dipoles come in two aperture types matched to the local beam size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). A wire scanner sweeps a thin carbon fibre rapidly through the beam, a downstream scintillator records the secondary shower to give the transverse profile σ, and ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w converts it, with β_w the Twiss beta at the scanner and D·δ the width from momentum spread. Error sources include optics error in β_w, wire speed and position encoding, wire heating and the dispersion correction at the scanner. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast wire scanners”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Protons at 400 GeV/c for North Area fixed targets leave by third-integer slow extraction: sextupoles create a triangular stable region in phase space, the horizontal tune is driven towards 80/3 ≈ 26.667, the stable area shrinks, and particles step outward along separatrices every three turns, jumping over the thin-wire array of the electrostatic septum (ZS) whose field deflects them into the extraction channel. The ZS consists of five 3.15 m tanks, each with 2080 tungsten–rhenium wires. A flat top of about 4.8 s spreads roughly 3.5×10¹³ protons into the long spill experiments need, and protons striking the wires cause loss and activation, the central limit of slow extraction. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electrostatic-septum tungsten–rhenium wire array”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. Extraction kickers must reach full field inside the inter-train gap, and any timing or strength error can steer a whole high-energy train into the transfer line or the LHC injection region; movable injection-protection collimators (TCDI) therefore sit at the end of the lines, an interlock system checks orbit, intensity and magnet currents before extraction, and a low-intensity probe beam validates the path first. Train intensity and emittance set LHC luminosity and also the damage potential of a mistake. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The SPS serves the LHC, North Area fixed targets, HiRadMat, AWAKE and ion runs, and the control system arranges their cycles into a supercycle, each with its own field ramp, RF programme and extraction settings. The LIU upgrade increased the 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities from four to six and Thales delivered two solid-state transmitters, each with sixteen 144 kW amplifier towers of eighty 1.8 kW RF modules, 5120 transistors in all, trading massive parallelism for graceful degradation and high availability. Acceptance must demonstrate both beam parameters and system availability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “200 MHz solid-state amplifiers and the supercycle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。
束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。
pitfallsEn: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.

With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it.

guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：CERN 反質子減速器
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: CERN Antiproton Decelerator
guides.concept: 以 26 GeV/c 質子打銥靶、在 3.57 GeV/c 收集反質子為起點，理解 AD 如何把它們逐平台減速到 100 MeV/c，再由周長 30.4 m 的 ELENA 降到 100 keV，並把隨機冷卻、電子冷卻、Schottky 診斷、極高真空與效率鏈整合成可交接給 ALPHA、AEgIS、BASE 等實驗的低能反物質工程。
guides.conceptEn: Starting from 26 GeV/c protons on an iridium target and antiproton collection at 3.57 GeV/c, see how the AD decelerates them plateau by plateau to 100 MeV/c and the 30.4 m ELENA ring takes them to 100 keV, then integrate stochastic and electron cooling, Schottky diagnostics, extreme-high vacuum and the efficiency chain into low-energy antimatter engineering handed to experiments such as ALPHA, AEgIS and BASE.
procedure: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銥靶與磁喇叭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AD 是倒著運轉的同步加速器：磁場與射頻頻率同步下降，把反質子由 3.57 GeV/c 依序減到 2 GeV/c、300 MeV/c 與 100 MeV/c。加速器以動量描述粒子，因為磁剛度 Bρ 正比於動量；實驗端則關心動能。減速時幾何發射度按 1/(βγ) 反向增長、相對動量分散也變大，就像加速時的絕熱阻尼倒過來；若不在平台上冷卻，束流會在減速途中撐滿孔徑而流失。射頻系統還必須追蹤速度由 0.97c 降到 0.1c 的大幅頻率變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 3.57 與 2 GeV/c 的高動量平台，AD 使用隨機冷卻：拾取電極量測束流某一取樣片段的平均位置或動量偏差，訊號經寬頻放大後沿環的弦線捷徑傳送，在同一批粒子抵達踢擊器時施加修正。每次修正只作用在約 1/(2W) 時間片內粒子的平均值，粒子數越少、頻寬越寬，冷卻越快；這是 van der Meer 為 SppS 對撞機累積反質子所發明的技術。放大器熱雜訊與粒子在拾取器到踢擊器之間混合不足，都會抵消冷卻效果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「隨機冷卻拾取器與踢擊器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在 300 與 100 MeV/c 的低動量平台改用電子冷卻：在一段直線段內讓一束約數 A、橫向溫度很低的電子與反質子以相同平均速度同行，反質子經庫侖碰撞把多餘的熱運動交給電子，電子束持續更新，並在收集極回收大部分能量。速度匹配要求電子的 γ 與反質子相同，即電子動能 T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec²；導引螺線管把電子約束成磁化的冷電子束。冷卻力在相對速度小時最強，所以電子冷卻擅長把已預冷的束流壓到極小的發射度與動量分散。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子冷卻器電子槍、螺線管與收集極」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AD 每循環只有 10⁷ 量級的反質子，平均電流低於一般直流電流變壓器的有效解析度，因此強度與動量分散主要靠縱向 Schottky 訊號量測：粒子隨機分佈在環上，在每個迴轉諧波 n·f₀ 附近產生雜訊帶，帶的功率正比於粒子數，寬度正比於動量分散。由頻寬換算 Δp/p 需要滑相因子 η，而 η 取決於晶格的動量壓縮因子，必須以獨立量測校正，否則所有冷卻效果的評估都帶有系統誤差。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Schottky 拾取器與低強度診斷」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

反質子速度越低，與殘氣分子的散射截面越大，停留在平台上的時間也越長，因此真空要求隨能量下降而急遽提高。AD 平均真空約 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr，ELENA 則要求約 3×10⁻¹² Torr 的極高真空：真空室以低導磁率不鏽鋼（如 316LN）製作並可烘烤至 300 °C，廣泛採用 NEG（非蒸散型吸氣劑）鍍膜提供分布式抽氣，每台偶極與每段直線段配置 NEG 與離子泵組合，並使用全金屬閥門與 ConFlat 接頭。此壓力下殘氣以氫為主，損失與發射度增長主要來自單次散射。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NEG 鍍膜與極高真空」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

過去 AD 直接把 5.3 MeV 反質子送給實驗，實驗再以降能箔片把能量降到可捕捉的 keV 等級，絕大多數反質子在箔片中湮滅或散開。ELENA 是周長 30.4 m 的小型減速環，把動量由 100 MeV/c 降到 13.7 MeV/c（動能 5.3 MeV 到 100 keV），在中間平台與末端以電子冷卻縮小束流，再分成 4 個束團經靜電傳輸線送到不同實驗區；在 100 keV 時靜電偏轉元件輕巧且沒有磁滯。結果使可捕捉的反質子數增加 10 到 100 倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ELENA 環與靜電傳輸線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

AD 與 ELENA 的價值以每天送進實驗阱的反質子數衡量，它是產額、捕獲、各段減速與冷卻效率、ELENA 傳輸與實驗端捕捉效率的乘積。循環時間約 100 至 110 s，主要由各平台冷卻時間決定；縮短冷卻會降低束流品質，延長則降低速率。交接紀錄需列出每個平台的強度、發射度、動量分散、循環時間與可用度，讓 ALPHA、AEgIS、ASACUSA、BASE、GBAR 等實驗共享同一份基準，才能把阱內數量的變化追溯到加速器端或實驗端。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「約 100 s 的 AD 循環」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference. Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Iridium target and magnetic horn”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The AD is a synchrotron run in reverse: field and RF frequency fall together, taking antiprotons from 3.57 GeV/c to 2 GeV/c, 300 MeV/c and 100 MeV/c. Accelerator physicists describe particles by momentum because magnetic rigidity Bρ is proportional to it, while experiments care about kinetic energy. During deceleration geometric emittance grows as 1/(βγ) and relative momentum spread widens, adiabatic damping run backwards; without cooling on the plateaus the beam would fill the aperture and be lost on the way down. The RF system must also follow the large frequency swing as speed drops from 0.97c to 0.1c. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On the high-momentum plateaus at 3.57 and 2 GeV/c the AD uses stochastic cooling: a pickup measures the mean position or momentum error of a sample slice of the beam, the signal is amplified over a wide band and sent along a chord across the ring, and a kicker corrects the same particles when they arrive. Each correction acts only on the average of the particles within a time slice of about 1/(2W), so fewer particles and wider bandwidth cool faster; van der Meer invented the technique to accumulate antiprotons for the SppS collider. Amplifier thermal noise and poor mixing between pickup and kicker both erode the cooling. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Stochastic-cooling pickups and kickers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

On the low-momentum plateaus at 300 and 100 MeV/c the AD switches to electron cooling: over a straight section an electron beam of a few amperes with very low transverse temperature travels at the same mean velocity as the antiprotons, which hand their excess thermal motion to the electrons through Coulomb collisions; the electron beam is continuously renewed and most of its energy is recovered in a collector. Velocity matching requires the same γ, so the electron kinetic energy is T_e = (γ − 1)m_ec², and a guiding solenoid keeps the electrons as a cold magnetized beam. The cooling force is strongest at small relative velocity, so electron cooling excels at squeezing a pre-cooled beam to tiny emittance and momentum spread. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-cooler gun, solenoid and collector”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

With only about 10⁷ antiprotons per cycle, the AD's mean current is below the useful resolution of ordinary DC current transformers, so intensity and momentum spread are measured mainly from longitudinal Schottky signals: particles randomly distributed around the ring create noise bands near each revolution harmonic n·f₀, whose power is proportional to particle number and whose width is proportional to momentum spread. Converting width to Δp/p needs the slip factor η, which depends on the lattice momentum compaction and must be calibrated independently, or every assessment of cooling carries a systematic error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Schottky pickups and low-intensity diagnostics”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The slower the antiproton, the larger its scattering cross-section on residual gas and the longer it sits on a plateau, so vacuum requirements tighten sharply as energy falls. The AD averages about 4×10⁻¹⁰ Torr, while ELENA needs extreme-high vacuum near 3×10⁻¹² Torr: chambers of low-permeability stainless steel such as 316LN bakeable to 300 °C, extensive NEG (non-evaporable getter) coating for distributed pumping, combined NEG and ion pumps at every dipole and straight section, and all-metal valves with ConFlat joints. At this pressure the residual gas is mostly hydrogen and losses and emittance growth come mainly from single scattering events. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NEG coating and extreme-high vacuum”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The AD used to deliver 5.3 MeV antiprotons directly and experiments slowed them to trappable keV energies with degrader foils, where most annihilated or scattered away. ELENA is a 30.4 m decelerator ring that lowers momentum from 100 MeV/c to 13.7 MeV/c (5.3 MeV to 100 keV kinetic energy), electron-cools the beam on an intermediate plateau and at the end, and splits it into 4 bunches sent through electrostatic transfer lines to different experimental zones; at 100 keV electrostatic deflectors are compact and free of hysteresis. The result is 10 to 100 times more trappable antiprotons. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ELENA ring and electrostatic transfer lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The value of the AD and ELENA is measured in antiprotons delivered into experiment traps per day, the product of production yield, capture, each deceleration and cooling efficiency, ELENA transfer and trapping efficiency. The cycle lasts about 100 to 110 s, dominated by cooling time on the plateaus; shortening cooling degrades beam quality while lengthening it lowers the rate. The handoff record must list intensity, emittance, momentum spread, cycle time and availability for every plateau so that ALPHA, AEgIS, ASACUSA, BASE, GBAR and others share one baseline and changes in trapped numbers can be traced to the accelerator or the experiment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “The roughly 100 s AD cycle”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
